jobs.title: Product Engineer - AI Finance
jobs.excerpt: About DoitWe are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more.
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

We are looking for product engineers to own product areas within Doit's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Engineer, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Philippines. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Philippines.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Role-specific interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: About the RoleThere are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native.
jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

As Lead Software Engineer, AI Email Apps, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

  • Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, digital agencies, and tech companies across SaaS, eCommerce, and FinTech. Unlike traditional outsourcing, you’ll be placed directly with a client as a valued, long-term member of their team.

Job Summary

We are looking for a results-driven Google Ads Manager with at least 2 years of hands-on experience managing and optimizing paid search campaigns.

In this role, you'll be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing Google Ads campaigns to drive measurable business results. You'll work closely with marketing teams to maximize return on ad spend (ROAS), improve conversion rates, and scale campaign performance.

The ideal candidate is analytical, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing advertising budgets while making data-driven decisions. Previous experience working in a digital marketing or performance marketing agency is a strong advantage.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, launch, manage, and optimize Google Ads campaigns across Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max, and YouTube, as applicable.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience targeting to identify growth opportunities.
  • Monitor and optimize campaign performance, focusing on ROAS, CPA, CPC, CTR, and conversion rates.
  • Manage advertising budgets effectively to maximize campaign profitability.
  • Write and test compelling ad copy to improve click-through and conversion rates.
  • Implement and troubleshoot conversion tracking using Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Google Tag Manager.
  • Conduct A/B testing across ad creatives, landing pages, bidding strategies, and targeting.
  • Prepare performance reports with actionable insights and recommendations.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and stakeholders to align paid advertising strategies with business objectives.
  • Stay up to date with Google Ads platform updates, industry trends, and best practices.

Requirements

  • Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns.
  • Proven track record of successfully managing and optimizing paid advertising campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of Google Ads, including Search, Display, Shopping, and Performance Max campaigns.
  • Experience with Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Tag Manager, and conversion tracking.
  • Solid knowledge of keyword research, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, and campaign optimization.
  • Ability to analyze campaign data and translate insights into actionable improvements.
  • Experience managing advertising budgets and optimizing campaigns for ROI and ROAS.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience working at a digital marketing agency, PPC agency, or performance marketing agency.
  • Experience managing multiple client accounts or campaigns simultaneously.
  • Google Ads certifications.
  • Familiarity with other advertising platforms such as Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, or Microsoft Ads.
  • Experience with landing page optimization and conversion rate optimization (CRO).
  • Experience working with international clients, particularly in the UK, US, or Australian markets.

Benefits

🌎 Fully remote role with flexible work environment

🚀 Work with high-growth companies and performance-driven teams

📈 Opportunity to scale campaigns with significant ad budgets

🎯 Performance-based bonuses tied to campaign success

🤝 Direct collaboration with international clients and marketing leaders

At Blueground, we believe that when your base is reliable, the world opens up. That’s why we’re building the world’s leading platform for living.

Every year, 350 million people move between cities—yet today’s housing options haven’t caught up with the needs of this modern, mobile generation. Blueground was built to change that.

Powerful proprietary tech, operational excellence, and a team that executes with speed and discipline.

Our culture is grounded in five principles:

  • Guests First – Every decision starts with their experience.
  • Move Fast – We value speed, momentum, and action.
  • Dive In – The magic is always in the details, and we go deep.
  • Embrace Change – Change isn’t a disruption; it’s how we grow.

This role is responsible for identifying extension opportunities, negotiating updated terms with property partners, and ensuring that all related documentation is completed accurately and on schedule. Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor upcoming lease end dates and proactively contact guests to discuss extension opportunities
  • Log and track all extension requests to ensure timely follow-through
  • Liaise with property partners to request and negotiate updated pricing for extended stays
  • Prepare and present updated quotes to guests, incorporating applicable fees, add-ons, or exceptions
  • Secure guest approval and coordinate with property partners to finalize updated lease agreements
  • Process completed extensions and update internal systems with accurate dates, pricing, and terms
  • Maintain accurate account records and escalate issues that may delay or jeopardize an extension

Skills & Competencies

  • Attention to Detail: Able to manage a high volume of accounts without letting dates, documents, or details slip
  • Communication: Native-like fluency in English, written and verbal, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally with guests
  • Customer Service & Rapport Building: Builds trust with customers and makes them feel confident their stay is in good hands, with clear, concise communication
  • Negotiation: Comfortable presenting options and addressing objections through a consultative, solutions-oriented approach
  • Organization & Self-Direction: Manages a high-volume pipeline independently, prioritizing time-sensitive tasks effectively
  • Adaptability: Learns new software and internal systems quickly and maintains clean, accurate records
  • Composure Under Pressure: Handles competing deadlines and guest concerns with patience and professionalism
  • Collaboration: Partners effectively with Sales, Customer Experience, and Operations to complete extensions

Qualifications

  • 1–2 years of experience in customer service, sales support, account management, or a related field
  • Native-like fluency in English required, written and verbal
  • Experience with CRM or customer support software preferred; training provided on Blueground's internal systems
  • Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of accounts or tasks with accuracy and minimal error
  • Strong written communication skills for professional correspondence and documentation
  • Prior experience in real estate, corporate housing, or hospitality is a plus but not required

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation package
  • Private health Insurance
  • Meal Allowance
  • Enhanced parental leave
  • Complimentary accommodation at Blueground locations
  • A culture that embraces Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion at its core

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: Who we areRanked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly.
jobs.description:
Who we are

Ranked in 2024 by the Financial Times, Moniepoint is Africa’s fastest-growing fintech, trusted by over 10 million business and individual accounts, processing billions of Naira in transactions monthly. Our mission is to enable financial happiness for every African, everywhere.

About this role:

We're looking for a Data Scientist to sit at the heart of how we fight fraud — building the models, experiments, and detection systems that protect millions of customers and merchants across our platform. This is a high-impact role at the intersection of machine learning, product, and engineering, where your work will directly shape how Moniepoint detects and responds to emerging fraud threats.

You are a data-driven, intellectually curious Data Scientist who is energized by hard problems in fraud and financial crime. You'll prototype and ship ML models, design experiments, and uncover new fraud signals across our ecosystem — partnering closely with engineers, product managers, and analysts to turn your work into production-grade systems.

Responsibilities:

  • Prototype, evaluate, and help produce machine learning models for fraud detection; own their ongoing monitoring and retraining cycles.

  • Design and run experiments to measure the impact of fraud interventions, balancing customer experience against loss reduction.

  • Size fraud typologies across our product lines to inform prioritization and investment decisions.

  • Build and maintain anomaly detection systems to surface novel fraud vectors before they scale.

  • Work closely with fraud operations, engineers, product managers, and data analysts to translate model outputs into real-world mitigations.

Experience & Background:

  • A strong foundation in statistics with a degree in a quantitative field (Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, Computer Science, or similar).

  • 3+ years of experience in data science, decision science, or risk analytics within fraud, payments, or financial crime.

  • Hands-on experience building and deploying machine learning models in a production environment.

  • Fraud, risk, or financial services experience is a strong plus.

  • Solid grounding in data science fundamentals: experimentation, statistical inference, model evaluation, and feature engineering.

  • Comfort working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams with high ownership expectations.

Skills & Competencies:

  • Proficiency in Python and SQL; comfort working across the full model development lifecycle.

  • An investigative instinct — you enjoy digging into data to find patterns others miss.

  • The ability to communicate technical findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders and translate insights into action.

What Success Looks Like in This Role:

  • Production-grade ML models and anomaly detection systems that effectively surface and mitigate novel fraud vectors before they scale.

  • Well-designed experiments that successfully balance customer experience against fraud loss reduction.

  • Clear sizing of fraud typologies that effectively drives product prioritization and strategic investment decisions.

  • Seamless cross-functional alignment where technical model outputs are consistently translated into real-world fraud mitigations.

Why Join Us?

  • Culture: We put our people first and prioritize the well-being of every team member. We've built a company where all opinions carry weight and where all voices are heard. We value and respect each other and always look out for one another. Above all, we are human.
  • Learning: We have a learning and development-focused environment with an emphasis on knowledge sharing, training, and regular internal technical talks.
  • Compensation: You'll receive an attractive salary, pension, health insurance, annual bonus, plus other benefits.

Moniepoint is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.

About the InfoSec team
At Affirm, security is integral to our mission of building honest financial products and driving the company’s long-term success. The Security Operations and Resilience Engineering (SOR) program is the foundation of our prevention, detection, and response capabilities, helping safeguard Affirm’s assets and enterprise security ecosystem. As part of our Security Team, you’ll join a group of passionate, highly skilled professionals redefining fintech security through collaboration, innovation, and a team-first mindset.

About the role
We’re seeking an experienced security leader to lead Affirm’s global security investigations and incident response program as we expand internationally. This leader will guide complex investigations and incidents while building the operating practices, readiness, and technical capabilities needed to support consistent response across regions and scale with the business.

In this role, you’ll lead a technically deep, engineering-oriented team that manages major incidents and builds better response capabilities. You’ll direct complex investigations while staying close to the technical work, bring structure to ambiguity, guide responders and executives through critical decisions, and turn incident findings into durable engineering improvements. You’ll also help shape AI-enabled investigation workflows, including agentic approaches to evidence gathering, analysis, and coordination, with human oversight and clear security, privacy, and operational safeguards.

What you’ll do

  • Lead security incidents and investigations across the full lifecycle, from initial assessment through containment, remediation, recovery, and post-incident review.

  • Serve as incident commander for major security events, set clear roles and decision paths, and coordinate large technical and cross-functional response groups through ambiguity.

  • Guide technical investigations and root-cause analyses with engineering teams, validate fixes, and drive durable corrective actions across the business.

  • Manage and develop a technical, engineering-oriented response team, set priorities, coach engineers, and build incident command depth and consistent execution across regions.

  • Set operating objectives and global readiness practices, including playbooks, escalation paths, exercises, on-call readiness, postmortems, and measures of response effectiveness.

  • Drive engineering improvements to response tooling, security telemetry, detection, and automation, including agentic AI workflows that support investigation and analysis with appropriate human oversight and security and privacy safeguards.

  • Translate complex security and incident metrics into actionable executive dashboards and board-level risk reporting, surfacing trends and remediation priorities that drive cross-functional action.

What we look for

  • 10+ years of experience in security operations, incident response, or a related security field.

  • Proven ability to lead major security incidents and investigations in technology-driven, cloud-native environments, from detection and assessment through containment, remediation, and recovery.

  • Strong technical foundation in security operations, with depth in investigations, incident response, detection, root-cause analysis, and/or digital forensics across cloud and enterprise environments. Experience in fintech or payments, and familiarity with using threat intelligence to inform response, are nice to have.

  • Experience managing and developing technical or engineering teams, setting direction and priorities, coaching engineers, and guiding hands-on incident work alongside engineering improvements.

  • Track record of building scalable response capabilities through repeatable practices, on-call readiness, exercises, postmortems, operational measures, and security tooling such as SIEM, EDR, or SOAR.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication, including translating complex incidents, security metrics, and customer or business impact into clear executive updates and board-level reporting, and aligning cross-functional partners.

  • Demonstrated ability to independently move ambiguous work forward, make sound decisions with incomplete information, and drive investigations, remediation, and program improvements to completion with measurable results.

  • An AI-forward mindset and sound judgment in applying AI to security operations, including agentic investigation or automation workflows with human oversight and appropriate security, privacy, and operational safeguards.

Pay Grade - R

Equity Grade - 9

Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.

Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).

CAN base pay range per year: $209,000 - 269,000

Location - Remote Canada

This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan.

#LI Remote

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.
  • Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.
  • Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Finance.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Finance app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Philippines. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Philippines.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

As Lead Engineer, Machine Learning, you own the execution layer of our intelligence, turning research and model capabilities into reliable, scalable production systems.

You will work across the model lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, inference, and deployment. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of research, systems, and product.

What You'll Own

  • Own the end-to-end ML systems powering our company, from data and training to evaluation, inference, and deployment.

  • Build and evolve training and fine-tuning pipelines for large models.

  • Design evaluation systems that measure capability, robustness, safety, and real-world product performance.

  • Architect high-performance inference systems, optimizing latency, GPU utilization, memory, cost, and reliability.

  • Build data pipelines and systems for high-quality real-world and synthetic training data.

  • Establish reliable production infrastructure for deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving models.

  • Partner closely with research and application engineering to turn model capabilities into product improvements.

  • Make pragmatic technical trade-offs and rapidly iterate based on real-world performance.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience building and shipping ML systems used in production, not just research prototypes.

  • Strong understanding of modern large-model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and inference.

  • Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals.

  • Experience operating ML workloads at meaningful scale, particularly GPU-based systems.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguous problems independently.

  • A bias toward experimentation, measurement, and shipping.

  • High standards for correctness, reliability, and production quality.

Outcomes

  • Research and models reliably translate into production-ready solutions with clear performance and quality targets.

  • ML pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are stable, efficient, and maintainable.

  • Production issues are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact.

  • Team members are supported, aligned, and able to deliver high-impact ML work with minimal friction.

  • Iterations on models and systems are measurable, safe, and improve user experience over time.

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • GPU-based training and inference system

Ideal Experience

  • You have built or shipped real ML systems used by people, not just demos.

  • You are comfortable working with large models and understanding their failure modes.

  • You write strong, production-grade code and care about system correctness.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.title: Head of Institutional Sales
jobs.excerpt: We’re hiring someone to lead our sales team.  Not a fundraiser, and not someone who manages a book of LPs: a sales leader who builds a team that wins sophisticated buyers and keeps winning them.
jobs.description:
We’re hiring someone to lead our sales team. Not a fundraiser, and not someone who manages a book of LPs: a sales leader who builds a team that wins sophisticated buyers and keeps winning them.

Pairs is a vetted private capital network. We put breakout US founders, from seed to Series B, in front of the family offices, VCs and strategic investors who know their market and can open the doors they need. We work only with the top 1% of deals, vet every founder and investor before they join, and invest our own money alongside our investors in a few of the companies we believe in most.

What your team sells
Your team matches our clients’ raises with the investors who fit them. Each associate holds a book of investor members and client companies. They learn what every investor is looking for, pitch the right company at the right moment, and turn that interest into founder meetings. It’s relationship-led, long-cycle business development with some of the most demanding buyers there are. Done well, it compounds. Send one deal that doesn’t fit, and an investor stops reading.

The role
This is a sales leadership role first. You’ll run six associates and report directly to both founders.
Most of running a sales team is unglamorous, and that’s the part that matters. When conversion dipped on one of our teams, more leads didn’t fix it. Daily standups, weekly reviews of real call recordings and coaching time spent on the people who needed it did. We want someone who already works that way.

What you’ll own

  • The rhythm: a Monday kickoff on priorities and targets, weekly 1:1s with every associate, live call coaching, and a Friday review of every win and loss.

  • The numbers: discovery calls, new investors onboarded, pitches, founder meetings and referrals, reported weekly to both founders.

  • Conversion: turning investor interest into founder meetings, and finding out why when it doesn’t happen.

  • Your team: hiring, onboarding and growing every associate.

  • The standard: every introduction your team sends is one you’d put your own name on.

  • Senior calls: when a call needs someone senior in the room, that’s you. You’ll also work closely with client success, so every client’s raise keeps moving.

Who we’re looking for

  • 5+ years in sales or business development, including leading a team, ideally of five or more people. You can tell us what they achieved and who you grew.

  • You’ve hired people, coached them and, when it came to it, let them go.

  • You’ve sold to sophisticated buyers: institutions, investors, or wealth and financial services clients.

  • You’ve worked with family offices or VCs, whether selling to them, working alongside them or raising from them yourself. You know how they decide.

  • You run a team on numbers, and you know the difference between activity and progress.

  • AI tooling and a clean CRM handle your admin, so your hours go to people.

What you get
A heavily performance-weighted package: a base salary plus a direct share of your team’s commissions, with no cap on the upside. On-target earnings of US$200K to US$300K when the team performs well. Fully remote, with a few hours of overlap with US Eastern time. A team that is already working, a direct line to both founders, and a seat where the companies defining the future meet the capital that backs them.

How to apply
Hit apply. The form is short and we read every application. Please don’t name investors or companies from past roles anywhere in it.

Compensation: $200K – $300K OTE, uncapped

Compensation Range: $200K - $300K

Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $20-$50 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Pharmaceutical

What if your expertise in pharmaceutical auditing, regulatory compliance, quality systems, and inspection readiness could help artificial intelligence better understand compliance risks, regulatory expectations, and audit best practices?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting experienced pharmaceutical professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We're seeking experienced Regulatory Compliance Auditors who can apply their auditing expertise, compliance knowledge, and industry experience to evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content.

This isn't a traditional auditing position. You won't be conducting supplier audits, preparing organizations for regulatory inspections, or managing compliance programs. Instead, you'll evaluate complex compliance and audit-related content, identify technical inaccuracies, assess regulatory reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your pharmaceutical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.


Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Regulatory Compliance Auditor Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance of Pharmaceutical AI-generated content.

You'll analyze auditing, quality, manufacturing, compliance, supplier oversight, and inspection-readiness scenarios, identify errors or unsupported conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in regulatory requirements, audit principles, and pharmaceutical industry best practices.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex pharmaceutical and biotechnology challenges.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content: Assess scientific, technical, and regulatory responses for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with industry standards.
  • Review scientific and regulatory information: Examine content related to quality systems, manufacturing, validation, submissions, development, and compliance activities.
  • Analyze technical reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are supported by relevant scientific principles, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices.

jobs.description:
Maximus is looking for a Lead Growth Product Manager.

Company: Maximus | Location: Remote (US) | Reports to: Head of Product | Type: Full-time

About Maximus

Maximus () is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability and 8-figure ARR with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors and operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, and Shopify.

About the Role

This is a growth role with real surface area and real resources behind it.

You get a dedicated engineering pod, an embedded designer, a marketing team spending a meaningful budget you'll partner with daily, and direct access to leadership. You will own the conversion product — the get-started flow, eligibility and questionnaire experience, plan selection, payment methods, and checkout — across Testosterone, Weight Loss, and every protocol we launch. You'll play a critical role in executing strategies around organic growth, referral programs, abandonment reclamation, and average order value.

This role spans several growth domains at once, with the autonomy to sequence them yourself, budget for the AI and experimentation tooling you need, and a real voice in how we build it. We expect this role to operate AI-first — using it to compress the cycle from idea to live test and to ship more experiments than a team our size otherwise could.

We're looking for someone who has run this before at a DTC subscription business at a meaningful scale. Someone with a powerful voice and a game plan that is centered around data and buyer psychology. You'll set the testing agenda, uphold the fundamentals across every flow we own, and iterate well past market par.

You will report to the Head of Product and lead a dedicated engineering pod aligned to our Acquisition task force. This is a senior IC role with full ownership of the conversion and organic growth roadmap.

What You'll Do

The conversion product

  • The get-started flow, eligibility and questionnaire experience, plan selection, payment methods, and checkout across every protocol

  • The acquisition product roadmap — the sequenced bets that ladder up to our growth objectives — built in close partnership with Marketing

  • Distinct strategies by service line. What wins in Testosterone is not what wins in GLP-1: different personas, different objections, different economics

  • Pricing strategy executed downstream in the funnel, with latitude to propose and run your own promotions

AOV and the economics behind it

  • Average order value through the mechanics at the point of purchase: plan mix and ordering, longer-duration adoption, add-on attach, bundle presentation

  • The commercial case for your work — you should be able to bring Finance a test proposal, a budget ask, and clear success criteria, and defend all three

Experimentation and the platform

  • The testing roadmap and cadence, brief through readout, held to a real evidence standard

  • The case for the funnel, experimentation and analytics stack we invest in. This role shapes the platform, it doesn't inherit it

Organic growth and reclamation

  • Organic net-new customer growth, the referral program, and cart and flow abandonment reclamation — as products, not campaigns

  • Continuity with Marketing so the journey holds together end to end: the claim in the ad matches the landing page, which matches what a prospect sees in the flow, carrying their context forward rather than starting from scratch


What You'll Bring

The things that will separate a strong candidate here:

  • You've moved AOV or plan mix, not just conversion rate. Plenty of growth PMs optimize CVR. Far fewer have changed what a customer commits to at the moment of purchase

  • You've scaled paid spend and watched blended conversion dilute as traffic got colder — and you know how to read cohort-level signal instead of chasing a blended number down

  • You've made an offer or pricing recommendation that leadership adopted, and you can walk through the economics you used to make the case

  • You build your own measurement. You write your own queries, you're fluent in Amplitude, and you've stood up instrumentation rather than inherited a dashboard

  • You're subscription-aware. You know a cheap customer who churns in month two isn't a win, and you've designed acquisition with retention in view

  • You've killed an idea you believed in because the data didn't support it, and you can tell that story without flinching

Plus the baseline:

  • 6+ years in product management, with at least 3 owning a consumer conversion funnel with direct revenue accountability at meaningful paid spend

  • Fluency with modern funnel and AI tooling, and a real opinion on how to compress the cycle from idea to live test

  • Excellent written communication; our culture runs on clear documents and explicit tradeoffs

  • Nice to have: telehealth, regulated consumer, or another high-consideration category where eligibility or compliance shapes the funnel

Who You Are

You have strong opinions about funnels and you hold them loosely when the data disagrees. You're comfortable owning a number leadership watches weekly. You'd rather run six well-designed tests this quarter than one perfect one. You know the difference between a growth hack and a growth system, and you're building the second.

Relentlessly resourceful. Highly proactive, doesn't quit, finds solutions with little guidance. Strong bias for action and comfort in ambiguity with a high degree of autonomy.

Passion for men's health and development. Genuine interest in helping men develop a healthy masculinity, and personal investment in health optimization — diet, exercise, sleep, focus, relationships.

World-Class Benefits

  • Full Suite: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance

  • Flexible vacation/time-off policies

  • Liquidity of options whenever available

  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

Note: We utilize AI note-taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note-takers for their own records if they wish.

Compensation Range: $150K - $225K

jobs.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

We are looking for a Cloud DevOps Engineer to join a project team that makes a Kubernetes-based platform run on Microsoft Azure. The platform runs on Google Cloud today and is deployed to many clusters with GitOps. The team will find what depends on GCP, build a new Azure environment as code, port the platform components to it, and support the customer's application teams while they move their services.

Other things to know:

  • The project team brings together DevOps, Cloud and Platform Engineers, who work as CodiLime subject matter experts (SMEs)

  • We work inside the customer's own repositories, through merge requests reviewed by the customer's Cloud Infrastructure team, and pair with their engineers so that they can run Azure on their own after the project

  • The customer is a company with teams in Europe, so you will work with a working-hours overlap with Central European Time

  • The work is phased: it starts with a gap analysis, followed by the platform port and support for the application teams

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so we may invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

  • Analysing the existing GCP-based platform and cloud infrastructure code, and proposing an Azure equivalent for every GCP dependency

  • Designing the target Azure environment: subscriptions, networking, AKS, identity, secrets, DNS, container registry, storage and databases

  • Building the Azure environment as code with Terraform, through the customer's review and deployment flow

  • Porting platform components to AKS with the same GitOps workflow (Flux) as on GCP, following the existing per-provider patterns

  • Preparing CI/CD changes and automation so that every release is built, deployed and tested on Azure

  • Helping choose how to manage cloud resources from Kubernetes in a way that avoids new vendor lock-in (for example Azure Service Operator, Crossplane or Terraform)

  • Supporting the customer's application teams when they move their services, and fixing the platform issues they find

  • Handing over knowledge to the customer's engineers through pairing, documentation and a final knowledge-transfer session

Do we have a match?

As a Mid/Senior Cloud DevOps Engineer, you should ideally meet the following criteria:

  • 4+ years of experience in DevOps, cloud or platform engineering roles

  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, in particular AKS, networking, identity (Microsoft Entra, workload identity), Key Vault, Azure DNS and storage

  • Good knowledge of Google Cloud (GCP), in particular GKE, IAM, Cloud DNS, storage and managed databases, enough to understand an existing GCP setup and map it to Azure

  • Hands-on experience with Infrastructure as Code with Terraform, including modules and a reviewed workflow

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines, for example GitLab CI, with automated tests and releases

  • Good knowledge of Kubernetes and Linux

  • Experience with GitOps, for example Flux or Argo CD

  • Experience with production-grade deployments

  • Knowledge of a scripting language (for example Bash or Python)

  • Experience working with customers or technical stakeholders on a shared codebase

  • Fluency in English (minimum B2 level)

  • Willingness to learn: you will face challenges that require creativity, individual solutions and teamwork

  • Readiness to work in an international environment, with working hours that overlap with Central European Time

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate:

  • Experience with a migration between public clouds, or with multi-cloud Kubernetes

  • Experience with Config Connector, Azure Service Operator, Crossplane or similar tools that manage cloud resources from Kubernetes

  • Knowledge of secrets management with External Secrets, SOPS and cloud key management

  • Experience with cert-manager, external-dns and ingress or load balancing on Kubernetes

  • Experience with Atlantis, Nix or moon

  • Knowledge of networking in the public cloud (virtual networks, private clusters, NAT, VPN)

  • Microsoft Azure, HashiCorp Terraform or Kubernetes (CKA, CKAD, CKS) certifications

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

jobs.description:
Job Title: Medical Billing & Prior Authorization Specialist
Position Type: Full-Time

Work Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM Central Time (with 1-hour unpaid lunch break)

Work Days: Monday – Friday

Weekend Availability: 1–2 hours on weekends, only as needed (Saturday and Sunday, around 1:00 PM Central Time, 1 hour each for follow-ups)

Salary: $5–7 per hour, depending on experience
Workplace: Remote

Preferred Candidate Location: Philippines

About the Role

Our Client is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Medical Billing & Prior Authorization Specialist to join a well-established, US-based psychology and psychiatry practice.

The clinic provides comprehensive mental and behavioral healthcare services, including psychotherapy, psychological evaluations, neurofeedback, and Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation (TMS). With approximately six providers serving 30–50 patients daily, the practice is committed to delivering quality patient care while maintaining efficient administrative and billing operations.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with US healthcare insurance billing, claims processing, and prior authorizations. You will initially support the clinic's billing operations, including covering responsibilities during an existing team member's maternity leave, before transitioning into a long-term collaborative billing role.

This opportunity is ideal for someone who is organized, proactive, comfortable communicating with insurance companies and patients, and interested in growing within a healthcare practice.

Key Responsibilities

Medical Billing & Insurance Claims Processing (Top Priority)

  • Manage and process approximately 20–30 US healthcare insurance claims daily, ensuring accurate and timely submissions.
  • Review billing information, insurance coverage, provider details, and documentation before submitting claims.
  • Identify and resolve billing discrepancies, rejected claims, and processing issues.
  • Ensure accurate billing for services involving psychologists, psychiatrists, and doctoral interns, following applicable payer requirements.
  • Coordinate with insurance companies to resolve claims-related concerns and maintain proper reimbursement workflows.

Prior Authorization Management

  • Handle prior authorization requests for applicable behavioral health and psychiatric services.
  • Verify insurance requirements, coverage limitations, and authorization status.
  • Coordinate with providers, insurance companies, and internal staff to obtain necessary documentation.
  • Track pending authorizations, follow up on outstanding requests, and prevent delays in patient services.
  • Maintain accurate records of authorization approvals, denials, and expiration dates.

Billing Follow-Up & Administrative Support

  • Follow up on unpaid, pending, rejected, or denied insurance claims.
  • Contact insurance companies to clarify claim statuses, payment discrepancies, and billing requirements.
  • Maintain organized billing records and track outstanding tasks.
  • Assist in documenting billing procedures and improving administrative workflows.
  • Collaborate with the existing billing specialist and clinical team to ensure continuity of billing operations.

Patient Communication & Clinic Coordination

  • Conduct outreach and communicate with other clinics, insurance representatives, and patients as needed.
  • Assist patients in understanding their insurance benefits, coverage, and billing responsibilities within the scope of the role.
  • Provide general information about the clinic's services and assist with service-related inquiries.
  • Handle inbound and outbound calls professionally using RingCentral.
  • Support additional administrative responsibilities as assigned, with training provided.

Systems & Tools

  • TherapyNotes: Current practice management and EHR platform.
  • Tebra: Planned EHR transition in January 2027.
  • RingCentral: Phone communication and coordination.
  • Insurance payer portals: For eligibility verification, claims processing, prior authorizations, and follow-ups.

Requirements

Experience & Qualifications

  • Must have previous hands-on experience with US healthcare insurance billing and claims processing. This is a non-negotiable requirement.
  • Experience handling insurance claims submissions, billing follow-ups, and resolving claim discrepancies.
  • Knowledge of prior authorization workflows, insurance eligibility, and benefits verification.
  • Familiarity with US healthcare billing procedures, payer requirements, and insurance terminology.
  • Strong attention to detail, particularly when reviewing provider information, billing responsibilities, and insurance documentation.
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines independently.
  • Strong verbal communication skills, with clear, easily understandable spoken English.
  • Experience in psychology, psychiatry, or behavioral health billing is highly preferred.
  • Experience using TherapyNotes, Tebra, RingCentral, or similar healthcare systems is an advantage.
  • Previous experience working remotely or as a healthcare virtual assistant is preferred but not mandatory.
  • A medical degree, nursing license, or other clinical license is not required.
  • Willingness to learn additional administrative workflows and adapt to evolving clinic needs.

Basic Requirements

  • Must be proficient in speaking and writing English clearly and professionally.
  • Must have relevant US healthcare billing experience.
  • Must be comfortable communicating with US patients, insurance representatives, and healthcare professionals.
  • Must be able to submit an NBI Clearance and/or Local Police Clearance before onboarding (mandatory).
  • Must be available for video meetings with the camera on when required.
  • Must be willing to work US Central Time business hours and accommodate occasional weekend follow-ups when necessary.
  • Must demonstrate professionalism, confidentiality, reliability, and the ability to work independently.
  • Must be able to follow HIPAA guidelines and maintain patient information confidentiality

Technical Requirements

  • Computer: Reliable laptop or desktop computer.
  • Internet: Stable high-speed internet connection (minimum 25 Mbps).
  • Audio: Noise-canceling headset.
  • Video: Working webcam for virtual meetings.
  • Workspace: Quiet and professional work environment.

Benefits

  • Dedicated HR & Contractor Support Team: Access to world-class support for questions, guidance, contract matters, and client communication.
  • Premium VPN Access (Optional): A secure VPN license can be provided upon request to enhance privacy and security for client-related tasks.
  • HIPAA & Cybersecurity Training + Certification (Provided): Access to our internal HIPAA compliance training, cybersecurity modules, and certification to help you confidently handle PHI for U.S. healthcare clients.
  • Top 1% VA Performance Training: Access to our proprietary training on communication, client management, productivity systems, and best practices to help you become a top-performing VA and increase long-term client retention.
  • Client-Approved U.S. Holidays: Contractors may take U.S. holidays off according to the client’s needs and schedule.
  • Client-Approved Paid or Unpaid Time Off: Time off may be granted by your client. Paid time off is optional and only if offered by the client.
  • Access to Tools & Resources: Templates, workflow guides, productivity tools, and client-specific SOP support to help you perform at your best.
  • Optional Performance-Based Incentives: Some clients may offer bonuses, incentives, or increased hours based on your performance.

These are optional resources and client-approved allowances available to you as an independent contractor. Any resources, training, or allowances listed are optional contractor perks and not employee benefits.

jobs.description:
About Us

Red Cell Partners is an incubation firm building and investing in rapidly scalable technology-led companies that are bringing revolutionary advancements to market in three distinct practice areas: healthcare, cyber, and national security. United by a shared sense of duty and deep belief in the power of innovation, Red Cell is developing powerful tools and solutions to address our Nation’s most pressing problems.

About Trase

Co-founded in 2023 by Joe Laws and Grant Verstandig, Trase Systems is AI, Uncomplicated. Trase empowers enterprise leaders to harness the full potential of AI without the associated complexity and risks. We are an end-to-end solution for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI in the enterprise. Our platform specializes in bridging the “last mile” of AI adoption, unlocking AI's full potential while driving efficiency and significant cost savings.Trase is at the forefront of AI Agent innovation, topping the Hugging Face GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, ahead of industry giants such as Google, Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI. We are leveraging our cutting-edge technologies to develop mission-critical agentic applications in complex industries such as Healthcare, Oil & Gas, and National Security.

About the Role

As a Senior or Staff Full Stack Software Engineer at Trase, you will build and support software for Red Cell Federal (RCF), Red Cell Partners (RCP), and RCP incubations and portfolio companies. You will join Trase's dedicated RCF/RCP support team, delivering user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and integrations with a strong focus on federal, government, and national security programs.

Red Cell Partners is an investment and incubation firm that builds and supports technology companies, including Trase. Red Cell Federal is our federal-focused partner within that ecosystem. This role helps RCF and other RCP partner companies adopt Trase OS and build secure AI applications for their missions.

This is a hands-on role with ownership from requirements through production support. You will work directly with partner engineers, Product, the dedicated TPM and DevOps/SRE engineers, Trase Platform Engineering, and GRC to deliver working solutions across the frontend, backend, and integration layers.

The level will reflect your experience and demonstrated scope. Senior engineers will independently own complex features and partner integrations end to end. Staff engineers will also lead architecture across engagements, establish reusable engineering patterns, and mentor engineers.

Why this Role is Needed

RCF and RCP companies need software that works within their applications, security controls, and deployment environments. Success requires intuitive user experiences, reliable APIs and agent workflows, clear audit trails, and dependable integrations.

You will close partner-specific functionality gaps, diagnose issues across application and platform boundaries, and deliver small, validated increments. You will also turn recurring partner needs into reusable improvements with Trase's platform team.

What You'll Do

  • Build full-stack features for RCF/RCP partners, from responsive UI interfaces and administrative tools to backend services, data models, and production integrations.
  • Work directly with partner engineers and Product to clarify use cases, reproduce issues, define acceptance criteria, and deliver small increments. Surface scope, dependencies, and risks with the TPM before committing dates.
  • Integrate partner applications and agents with Trase OS APIs and SDKs, external APIs, MCP tools, and model-provider endpoints. Provide working examples and clear integration documentation.
  • Build reliable agent and workflow integrations, including asynchronous execution, event streaming, state handling, retries, timeouts, and error recovery. Preserve correctness and data integrity across failures.
  • Create usable interfaces for configuring agents, managing connections and policies, reviewing runs, and inspecting logs, traces, costs, and audit history. Make failures and recovery actions understandable to users.
  • Implement authentication, authorization, role-based access, secrets integration, and audit events across frontend and backend services. Partner with Governance, Risk and Compliance on application security findings and engineering evidence for applicable federal requirements.
  • Adapt application configuration and dependencies for customer-managed cloud, private-network, and on-premises environments. Work with DevOps/SRE on packaging, deployment prerequisites, and end-to-end validation.
  • Own quality through code reviews, unit and integration tests, end-to-end tests, representative workflow evaluations, and regression coverage. Verify application behavior in the target environment before partner handoff.
  • Diagnose and resolve partner-reported defects across the UI, APIs, SDK, data stores, and runtime services. Add useful telemetry, support incident investigation, and validate fixes with partners.
  • Support releases, upgrades, and ongoing application maintenance, including federal deployments such as Second Front where applicable. Review and integrate partner contributions, maintain API/SDK compatibility, and coordinate security fixes with platform and DevOps/SRE owners.
  • Document architecture, setup, known limitations, and troubleshooting steps; provide partner walkthroughs and knowledge transfer. Share reusable solutions with the platform team and mentor other engineers.

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship is required.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and supporting production applications; scope and technical leadership appropriate to Senior or Staff level.
  • 5+ years of hands-on full-stack development spanning modern web frontends, backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Strong frontend skills with TypeScript/JavaScript and React, Next.js, or comparable frameworks, including state management, API integration, and clear, accessible user experiences.
  • Strong backend engineering skills in Python, TypeScript/Node.js, Go, Java, or a similar language, including API design, service integration, validation, and error handling.
  • Experience designing data models and working with relational databases, migrations, caching, and asynchronous or event-driven processing.
  • Experience implementing authentication, authorization, secure API access, secrets handling, and audit logging in production applications.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing, code review, Git, containers, CI/CD, and deploying or troubleshooting applications in cloud or Kubernetes environments.
  • Ability to debug across browser, service, API, and data layers using logs, metrics, and traces, and to own issues through validated resolution.
  • Strong technical judgment, clear written and verbal communication, and experience translating ambiguous customer requirements into maintainable solutions and useful documentation.
  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve implementation, testing, troubleshooting, or code review, with careful validation of the resulting changes.

Strongly Preferred

  • Prior full-stack software engineering experience supporting national security, defense, federal agencies, or other government programs.
  • An active U.S. government security clearance.
  • Experience with federal application security and delivery requirements, such as STIG hardening, NIST controls, RMF/ATO evidence, FedRAMP, or DoD impact-level environments.
  • Experience integrating identity providers such as Keycloak using OAuth/OIDC, or implementing fine-grained access and sensitive-data controls.
  • Experience building AI/LLM applications, agent integrations, RAG, tool/MCP connections, evaluations, or workflow systems such as Temporal.
  • Customer-facing or forward-deployed engineering experience across multiple partner organizations, including onboarding, technical handoffs, and ongoing support.
  • Experience adapting applications for government cloud, restricted-network, or on-premises deployments, including Second Front or comparable federal delivery platforms

If you want to be on the cutting edge of technology, building AI solutions for the future, and are up for a challenge, let’s talk!

Salary Range: $180,000-240,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

Some travel to customers may be required.

Our Red Cell Partners Benefits (may differ for each incubation):

For full-time roles

  • Career track opportunity with potential for rapid advancement with strong performance as the firm grows
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health care including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family.
  • Paid maternity and paternity for 14 weeks at employees' normal pay.
