jobs.excerpt: FonctionEn tant qu'UX Designer expérimenté, vous concevez des interfaces conviviales et améliorez en continu l'expérience utilisateur des applications.
jobs.description:
Fonction

En tant qu'UX Designer expérimenté, vous concevez des interfaces conviviales et améliorez en continu l'expérience utilisateur des applications.

Vous accordez une attention particulière à la maintenance et à l'évolution du Design System. Vous veillez à ce que ses composants, ses modèles et ses directives restent cohérents, accessibles et à jour, tout en accompagnant les équipes dans leur utilisation.

Vous participez à l'analyse des besoins et développez une bonne connaissance des utilisateurs et de leur environnement afin de définir les exigences des applications.

Vous définissez et planifiez les méthodes de recherche, puis contribuez au recrutement des participants afin de recueillir les informations nécessaires au moyen d'entretiens, d'enquêtes, de focus groups et de tests utilisateurs.

Vous proposez la solution la plus adaptée et concevez des interfaces en basse et haute fidélité selon une approche de prototypage mobile-first.

Vous accompagnez les analystes et les développeurs dans la conception des interfaces utilisateur. Vous vérifiez que les applications développées répondent aux besoins des utilisateurs et aux exigences de leur environnement.

Vous veillez au respect des normes d'accessibilité, notamment de WCAG 2.1, ainsi que des standards UX/UI.

Vous disposez d'une expérience dans la conception, la gestion et la maintenance de Design Systems et contribuez activement à leur évolution.

Tout au long des projets, vous entretenez une communication régulière et efficace avec les clients et l'équipe.

Vous êtes bilingue en français et en néerlandais.

Un portfolio est requis pour que la candidature puisse être examinée.

Functie

Als ervaren UX Designer ontwerp je gebruiksvriendelijke interfaces en verbeter je voortdurend de gebruikerservaring van toepassingen en websites.

Je besteedt bijzondere aandacht aan het onderhouden en verder ontwikkelen van het Design System. Je zorgt ervoor dat componenten, patronen en richtlijnen consistent, toegankelijk en actueel blijven en ondersteunt de teams bij het correcte gebruik ervan.

Je neemt deel aan de behoeftenanalyse en zorgt ervoor dat je de gebruikers en hun omgeving goed kent, zodat je de vereisten van de toepassingen correct kunt bepalen.

Je bepaalt en plant de onderzoeksmethoden en helpt bij het rekruteren van deelnemers om de nodige informatie te verzamelen via interviews, enquêtes, focusgroepen en gebruikerstests.

Je stelt de meest geschikte oplossing voor en ontwerpt interfaces in low en high fidelity volgens een mobile-first aanpak.

Je ondersteunt analisten en ontwikkelaars bij het ontwerp van gebruikersinterfaces. Je ziet erop toe dat de ontwikkelde toepassingen voldoen aan de behoeften van de gebruikers en aan de vereisten van hun omgeving.

Je waakt over de naleving van WCAG 2.1, toegankelijkheidsrichtlijnen en UX/UI-standaarden.

Je hebt ervaring met het ontwerpen, beheren en onderhouden van Design Systems en draagt actief bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling ervan.

Doorheen de projecten onderhoud je een regelmatige en doeltreffende communicatie met klanten en het team.

Je bent tweetalig in het Nederlands en Frans.

Een portfolio is vereist om de sollicitatie te kunnen beoordelen.

  • Expérience en prototypage d'interfaces en basse et haute fidélité, selon une approche mobile-first.

jobs.description:
CapIntel is a software platform built for wealth management enterprises to help financial advisors explain complex investment strategies to their clients. Advisors at some of the biggest banks across North America are winning trust by using CapIntel to easily compare investments and create compelling, educational presentations. Ultimately, we're focused on investors getting better service, understanding their investments, and feeling at ease knowing their future is secure.

Since launching in 2019, CapIntel has seen rapid adoption and industry recognition, earning top placements in Deloitte’s Technology Fast 50 Canada and Fast 500 North America in 2025, ranking us among the fastest-growing technology companies. To support this momentum, we’re growing our team rapidly—investing in people who drive innovation at scale to expand our impact across the North American wealth management industry.

About the Role

As Technical Lead for the Data team at CapIntel, you'll own the platform that every CapIntel product depends on: the pipelines, workflows, and services that ingest, normalize, and serve financial instrument data and client portfolio data to advisors and institutions. This is a hands-on leadership role. You'll split your time roughly evenly between leading the team and building alongside it, and you'll be accountable for both the reliability of the platform and the growth of the people who run it. The team has built a mature, observable platform. Durable workflow orchestration, standardized logging and metrics, continuous monitoring, and a quality-first definition of done are now in place, and production incidents have become rare. Your job is to take that foundation to the next level: build a team that owns outcomes and can turn data reliability into a product advantage that advisors and investors actually feel. You'll work closely with the Data Product Manager, the other engineering team leads, Architecture, Client Solutions, and Implementation. You'll also be a go-to resource for other teams adopting the workflow and observability patterns the Data team pioneered. This role is ideal for a senior data engineer who has already led a small team, prefers building leverage over being the hero, and gets energy from raising the bar for everyone around them.

What You'll Do

Lead the team

  • Lead a team of data engineers day to day, matching people to work deliberately and planning capacity ahead of need rather than in reaction to it
  • Grow ownership and technical leadership across the team, so delivery, client onboarding, and production support do not depend on any single person, including you
  • Run performance management with clear expectations, and timely actions
  • Hire, onboard, and ramp new engineers so they are independent quickly, and handle transitions and handovers without disruption to clients

Own the platform

  • Own the architecture and health of the Data platform: serverless services, batch and streaming pipelines, legacy pipelines, search indexes, and durable workflow orchestration
  • Drive the evolution toward an enterprise-grade data architecture, covering data contracts, lineage, data quality checks, and DataOps practices
  • Build systematic, proactive monitoring of data flows so data quality issues are caught before a client or advisor sees them
  • Formalise and embed incident response for the team: on-call expectations, runbooks, severity classification, communication during incidents, and blameless post-incident reviews that actually change the system
  • Keep the quality bar high through design review, code review, testing discipline, and a definition of done the whole team holds each other to

Deliver for clients

  • Own client data onboarding and implementation work for the Data team, making it faster and more predictable for clients and other teams.
  • Partner with Product to translate client and advisor needs into data capabilities that create visible, positive moments for users, not just a platform that stays up
  • Contribute hands-on code to the platform, particularly on new systems, high-risk changes, and areas that need a reference implementation

Multiply beyond the team

  • Measure and communicate the team's outcomes (reliability, data quality, onboarding time, delivery predictability) so leadership, other teams, and clients can see the impact
  • Coach other teams on the workflow, observability, and data patterns the Data team owns, and contribute standards that other teams adopt because they work
  • Use AI tooling as a core part of how the team works, from development and review agents to internal knowledge tools, and help define how the team uses AI safely on financial data

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with at least 4 years focused on data engineering, data platforms, or ETL in production
  • 2+ years leading engineers as a team lead or tech lead, including hiring, performance management, and growing others into technical leadership
  • Deep, current Node.js and TypeScript experience. This is a core requirement for the role; Python experience is a welcome addition alongside it
  • Deep experience designing and operating data pipelines on AWS, including serverless architectures
  • Hands-on production experience with Temporal.io, or a comparable durable workflow orchestration platform (for example Airflow, Dagster, or Step Functions) with a clear ability to ramp on Temporal quickly
  • Strong SQL and experience with relational databases and search technologies (for example PostgreSQL and OpenSearch or Elasticsearch)
  • A track record of building observability into data systems (structured logging, metrics, dashboards, alerting) and using it to reduce incidents
  • Experience leading incident response and running post-incident reviews that lead to lasting fixes
  • Evidence that you've built a team that delivers without you: delegation, ownership, and a team that is better because you were there
  • Experience making engineering outcomes measurable and visible to non-technical stakeholders
  • Composure under pressure. You keep discussions constructive when systems, clients, or timelines are under stress

Bonus Experience

  • Experience with financial instrument or market data and the reconciliation challenges that come with it
  • Experience in a regulated industry and familiarity with data privacy obligations such as PIPEDA
  • Experience with DataOps practices, data contracts, data lineage, or data quality frameworks
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools as an established part of your own and your team's workflow, or building AI tools over internal data
  • Familiarity with Datadog or similar observability platforms

This is an existing vacancy.

At CapIntel, we design compensation with intention. Each role is assessed against the impact, skills, and experience it requires, and we align our pay to competitive market data so candidates know what to expect from the start.

Your final offer will reflect your experience, skillset, and location. The listed range is a guideline, and the range for this role may be modified.

Compensation at CapIntel goes beyond base pay. Depending on the role, total rewards may include variable pay, equity, comprehensive benefits, flexible time off, and dedicated opportunities for growth and development.

If you’d like to understand more about our approach, we’re happy to walk through it during the hiring process.

For roles based in or eligible to work from Ontario, the expected base salary range is:
$145,000—$170,000 CAD

Not sure you meet every requirement?

We care most about mindset: your drive, curiosity and commitment to delivering great work. While experience matters, we know that careers aren’t always linear. If this role excites you and you believe you can make an impact with us, we want to hear from you.

Why you'll enjoy working here

Learn more about life at CapIntel on our Careers page, including the virtues that inspire how we work and the perks and benefits designed to support your growth and well-being. We’re a team built on trust, respect, and collaboration. This powers everything we do and creates a space to challenge and elevate each other as we work towards our shared vision. If this speaks to you, we’d be excited to have you with us.

Fleet Manager

Job Description:
The Landline Company () is revolutionizing air travel by bridging the gap between regional communities and major airline hubs. We partner with top airlines like American Airlines and Air Canada to offer innovative multimodal connections across North America. We've launched a first of its kind remote terminal checkpoint to expand the reach of major metro airports into local neighborhoods. Our luxury motorcoaches replace short flights with a faster, more sustainable alternative in reducing costs, addressing pilot shortages, and enhancing passenger journeys.

Salary: 90,000 – 120,000

Job Type: Full Time, Salary Exempt

The Role: 
The Motorcoach Fleet Manager oversees Landline’s fleet management and maintenance functions. The role ensures the fleet is safe, clean, compliant, available, and maintained in accordance with OEM maintenance intervals, regulatory and Landline operational requirements. The Fleet Manager is the single point of contact for the Landline leadership team, maintenance business partners, OEMs, and our dispatch team.

The role will lead the maintenance function within Operations.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the maintenance function at Landline with the plan, vendors and data for our fleet, with a path to scaling to support a 100-motorcoach fleet in the future
  • Build and maintain a rolling maintenance forecast aligned to OEM intervals and usage patterns, keeping every vehicle within OEM PM intervals
  • Maintain the maintenance budget with Finance, including updates and variance reporting
  • Coordinate unscheduled and corrective maintenance without disrupting service operations
  • Keep accurate service records in Fleetio and Samsara; track DVIR resolution and escalate out-of-service conditions to System Operations Control (SOC - Dispatch)
  • Manage parts and consumables procurement and validate pass-through costs from our maintenance partners
  • Flag recurring issues or vehicles approaching end of useful life using maintenance data
  • Serve as Landline's representative for all work at external maintenance facilities; issue work orders to fully utilize dedicated resources
  • Schedule all planned and unplanned work and ensure buses are positioned on time
  • Review and approve partner invoices, flag discrepancies, and track overflow technician usage against budget
  • Plan and conduct quarterly reviews with key maintenance vendors
  • Give the SOC and leadership a real-time view of fleet readiness (operational, in maintenance, or out of service) and communicate constraints proactively
  • Own Fleetio and Samsara as key user, including partner access and IT interfaces
  • Plan and manage vehicle assignments, identify capacity risks in advance, and support planning for additions, retirements, and configuration
  • Maintain vehicle files (registration, insurance, inspections, warranties)
  • Serve as primary contact with OEM reps; manage warranty claims and authorizations and coordinate technician training
  • Track Technical Service Bulletins (TSBs), service bulletins, and recalls and ensure timely action; advise leadership on OEM reliability and procurement
  • Provide the SOC advance notice of maintenance windows, report unplanned outages with return-to-service estimates, and collaborate on scheduling trade-offs
  • Ensure federal, state, and local compliance and timely inspections; keep audit-ready records and report KPIs (MTBF, out-of-service days, cost per vehicle)

What We’re Looking For:

  • 5-10 years of experience in transportation operations, logistics, aviation, fleet operations, or operations-focused consulting including transportations, or a similar field
  • A degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Supply Chain, a related field or equivalent hands-on experience in a transportation logistics and/or operations environment
  • Strong data and analytical skills (Excel required; SQL, Python, or BI tools like Tableau/Power BI a plus)
  • Familiarity with Fleetio and/or Samsara
  • Comfort using and recommending AI tools (e.g. Claude Code or similar) to move quickly across a diverse and shifting set of projects
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to work with frontline hourly staff
  • A high-energy, self-directed approach and enthusiasm for solving operational problems in a fast-moving startup environment
  • Comfort working remotely while collaborating across multiple locations and time zones
  • The ability to think "bigger" than any single function as someone who understands the balancing act between commercial, finance, and operations, and can design solutions that serve the whole business rather than optimizing for one group at another's expense
  • Six Sigma certification (Green Belt, Black Belt, etc.) is a nice-to-have
  • Comfort working remotely while collaborating across multiple locations and time zones

Perks & Benefits:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan
  • Paid time off
  • Flight benefits through our airline partners
  • Company-paid life insurance

Location: 
Remote, with up occasional travel to station locations in the USA / Canada. Residents of New York City, Philadelphia, Boston, Fort Collins, South Bend, and Toronto are preferred.

Schedule: 
Standard business hours local time Monday – Friday (CST, EST, MST)

jobs.excerpt: What does Spamhaus do? Spamhaus, together with its partner abuse.
jobs.description:
What does Spamhaus do?

Spamhaus, together with its partner abuse.ch, strengthens trust and safety for the Internet. We extract intelligence from globally sourced signals that enable us to provide the community and clients with actionable and timely datasets to provide protection, insight and context to behaviour relating to internet resources.

As the market leader in email blocklists (DNSBLs) for the past two decades, we are moving into the broader cyber threat intelligence market to leverage the breadth of signals and actionable intelligence we have on Internet activity.

Why work for Spamhaus?

We hire people who are passionate about our purpose and want to work in an organization where they will be stretched and have the opportunity to question and challenge.

Self-motivated individuals looking for a non-corporate environment will enjoy our culture. We have a start-up mentality: we are extremely hardworking, ideas are welcome, and team members are expected to “get stuck in.” Our teams’ efforts make a difference, and their work really does "move the needle".

Established over 25 years ago (the same year as Google), Spamhaus is still 100% owned by its founder; we bring experience, expertise, and stability in a fluid marketplace.

The Team:

The Cyber Threat Intelligence Focus Unit (CTI FU) team members are located across Europe and work closely with our partner abuse.ch. The team is a small group of developers, product specialists and malware researchers, and this role is a key addition to it.

The team focuses on malware research and building features and functionality for our Cyber Threat Intelligence offering, the CTI Hunting Platform. This role may be required to work with and supervise interns and other more junior team members. We value strong communication and a fail-fast approach. If you enjoy collaborating openly, sharing your work regularly, and being part of a close-knit and supportive team, you’ll feel at home here.

Key responsibilities will include:

  • Write, test, and maintain high-fidelity detection rules (such as YARA) with low false-positive rates, optimized for scalable deployment across continuous detection and retrohunt pipelines.
  • Own the quality of detection rule sets, including rule verification, false-positive risk assessment and performance testing.
  • Reverse engineer Windows and Linux malware, including emerging families, packers and obfuscated payloads, and identify opportunities for detection and intelligence extraction.
  • Develop, maintain malware configuration extractors and parsers to automatically recover command-and-control (C2) infrastructure, campaign identifiers, and other relevant intelligence from files.
  • Work with the developers to support our in-house sandbox with better detection capabilities, and ensure proper output when detonating modern threats.
  • Supervise and review the work of any interns or other junior team members, setting their priorities and giving regular feedback.
  • Where appropriate, share findings with the wider security community, working with marketing to produce content and present at appropriate events.

Required Experience & Skills

  • 5+ years of professional experience in Malware Analysis, Reverse Engineering or Detection Engineering.
  • Expert-level experience writing detections using proven tools such as YARA and Suricata, including performance tuning, false-positive management and testing against large sample sets.
  • Proven ability to build your own malware configuration extractors (for example, in Python), including handling common encryption and obfuscation schemes.
  • Hands-on experience with malware sandboxes, such as CAPE, and an understanding of how sandbox output feeds detection and extraction workflows.
  • Strong reverse engineering skills using disassemblers, decompilers and debuggers, and knowledge of packers and common obfuscation methods.
  • Knowledge of Windows and Linux OS internals and of the network protocols commonly used by malware families.
  • Proficiency in Python, plus familiarity with Assembly (x86/x64), C and at least one of Go or Rust.
  • The ability to set your own research priorities, recommend direction based on client and product focus, and guide a less experienced colleague.
  • Strong written and verbal communication in English, including explaining technical findings to developers and non-technical colleagues.

Preferred / Nice-to-Have

  • Experience with sandbox development or sandbox internals in general, including hardening and anti-evasion techniques. Drakvuf experience would be ideal, but is not critical.
  • Experience with sandbox environment hardening and anti-evasion techniques.
  • Familiarity with large-scale YARA scanning and retrohunt platforms such as VirusTotal and Censys
  • A public track record of research, rules, or tooling (for example, conference talks, blogs, or open-source contributions).

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary.
  • Excellent annual leave allowance.
  • Opportunity to work in a dynamic and supportive environment.
  • Flexible working hours and remote work setup.

Location:

European-based. Everyone at Spamhaus works from home; however, global travel is required approximately three times a year for face-to-face meetings and event attendance.

Contract:

Permanent.

Salary:

€70,000 - €110,000 depending on experience and location.

ABOUT AVOYA

Avoya Travel is transforming how people plan and book vacations by connecting travelers with expert travel professionals through our innovative platform. ABOUT THE OPPORTUNITY

Do you thrive in a detail-oriented, fast-paced environment where organization, communication, and problem-solving are key? In this role, you'll serve as a central point of contact for group travel operations, working closely with internal teams, vendors, and agencies to monitor bookings, manage documentation, track deadlines, and support revenue-generating group opportunities. We're looking for someone who is customer-focused, highly organized, and passionate about delivering exceptional service. The ideal candidate enjoys working independently, has strong analytical and administrative skills, and is comfortable navigating multiple systems while maintaining a high level of accuracy.   • Assign internal group reference codes and organize group documentation to support reporting, accounting, and reconciliation processes.
  • Support independent agencies with their private affinity groups and ensure they understand and adhere to vendor group policies.

    • Reliable childcare/eldercare when applicable

  • Knowledge of destinations, supplier programs, and travel industry trends.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Investing Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The Network Supply Manager will be responsible for operational procurement activities supporting Nebius network infrastructure and data-center projects across the United States.
The role will primarily focus on U.S. projects, suppliers, deployments, and operational procurement requirements. The successful candidate must also be willing and able to support network connectivity and data-center projects in other regions based on business priorities and team requirements.
The position covers supplier sourcing, RFQs, proposal evaluation, commercial negotiations, contract execution, purchase orders, invoice processing, payment tracking, and supplier onboarding. The role will work closely with Engineering, Finance, Legal, Data Center, and other internal teams to ensure procurement activities are completed efficiently and in accordance with Nebius procurement policies.
The successful candidate should understand the U.S. telecommunications supplier landscape and have general knowledge of major global telecommunications carriers, infrastructure providers, and data-center operators.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take primary ownership of operational procurement for network connectivity, IP address resources, and data-center services across the United States.

  • Support the sourcing, purchase, leasing, transfer, and commercial evaluation of IPv4 and IPv6 address resources.
  • Ensure compliance with Nebius procurement policies, competitive sourcing requirements, and internal approval processes.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with U.S. regional suppliers and global service providers.

  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in IT procurement, telecommunications procurement, strategic sourcing, or procurement operations.
  • Experience with supplier sourcing, RFQs, proposal evaluation, and commercial negotiations.
  • Experience using ERP, procure-to-pay, or procurement-management systems.
  • General understanding of telecommunications, network connectivity, and data-center services.
  • General knowledge of major global telecommunications carriers, network infrastructure providers, and data-center operators.
  • Ability to evaluate supplier proposals based on pricing, technical and commercial scope, delivery timelines, service levels, and contractual terms.
  • Ability to manage multiple procurement requests and competing priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to maintain complete and accurate procurement records.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical, financial, legal, and operational stakeholders.
  • Willingness and flexibility to support procurement activities and projects outside the United States when required.
  • Professional fluency in English.

Highly Desirable Experience

  • Procurement or supplier-management experience within the U.S. telecommunications or data-center market.
  • Experience working with U.S. regional carriers, global telecommunications providers, data-center operators, and network infrastructure suppliers.
  • Experience supporting data-center deployments, network expansions, or Point of Presence (PoP) projects in the United States.
  • Knowledge of the U.S. supplier landscape, commercial practices, delivery challenges, and relevant regulatory considerations.

Nice to Have

  • Experience procuring telecommunications or network services such as IP Transit, DIA, DCI, Dark Fiber, DWDM, cross-connects, colocation, and Remote Hands.
  • Experience with MOFN solutions or other dedicated fiber infrastructure models.
  • Experience with Network as a Service solutions.
  • Experience sourcing, purchasing, leasing, or transferring IPv4 and IPv6 address resources.
  • Familiarity with IP address due diligence, reputation checks, Regional Internet Registries, and address-transfer processes.
  • Experience supporting global network infrastructure or data-center expansion projects.

About Nebius

Nebius AI is an AI cloud platform with one of the largest GPU capacities in Europe. Launched in November 2023, the Nebius AI platform provides high-end, training-optimized infrastructure for AI practitioners. As an NVIDIA preferred cloud service provider, Nebius AI offers a variety of NVIDIA GPUs for training and inference, as well as a set of tools for efficient multi-node training.

Nebius AI owns a data center in Finland, built from the ground up by the company’s R&D team and showcasing our commitment to sustainability. The data center is home to ISEG, the most powerful commercially available supercomputer in Europe and the 16th most powerful globally (Top 500 list, November 2023).

Nebius’s headquarters are in Amsterdam, Netherlands, with teams working out of R&D hubs across Europe and the Middle East.

Nebius AI is built with the talent of more than 500 highly skilled engineers with a proven track record in developing sophisticated cloud and ML solutions and designing cutting-edge hardware. jobs.title: 🇫🇷 Head of Product - AI x EdTech -  French fluent
jobs.excerpt: This isn’t another product job. It’s the chance to define a new category : The Operating System (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.
jobs.description:
This isn’t another product job.

It’s the chance to define a new category : The Operating System (OS) for Human Greatness Augmented with AI.

Science-backed. Design-led. AI-powered. Global.

A chance to build an AI-native Product Department

You’ll be working with the most complex data in the world : the human mind.

Deep inside you are looking for a new adventure with…

  • 🚀Ambition around AI field : Smart teammates driven to create an iconic, international product

  • 🔥Impact : you strive to make a real difference in the company's growth, and not be a number in a big organization

  • 😍Mission : knowing your greatness left a mark in people's lives, through technology and behavioral science

At Paradox, we believe that greatness is trainable.

That’s why we want to empower people at scale by leveraging cutting edge technologies like AI, and crafting user experiences with outstanding aesthetics.

We do that by merging :

- Human Intelligence (coaches, peers, and mentors)

- Structured Intelligence (protocols, mental models, rituals),

- Technological Intelligence (AI personalization, feedback loops, adaptive journeys)

To create one seamless ecosystem: Paradox OS.

This is why we are looking for a Head of product to make Paradox a category-defining global brand loved for its product.

This is a full-time position from our beautiful offices in Dubai, Paris or Lisbon or remotely anywhere in the world.

OUR BELIEFS

We believe self-help is broken.

Most learning platforms are used the same way : consuming generic theories, getting quick highs, ending with no real change.

At Paradox, we believe people deserve more.

More than content. More than motivation.

They deserve a system that knows them, one that adapts, challenges, and grows with them.

We believe that every human learns differently, and that technology can do more than entertain or save time.
It can translate insight into transformation, through AI personalization, lean experimentation, and deep psychological understanding.

Because learning shouldn’t just make you feel inspired for a day, it should change how you live, think, and create.

OUR VISION

At Paradox, we want to re-invent how people grow.

We do not build another course or coaching app but the Operating System for Greatness.

Founded by David Laroche - a creator followed by over 2 million people and known for his interviews with icons like Tony Parker, Mike Horn, Richard Branson, and Gad Elmaleh, Paradox aims to build something that will live beyond any individual (including its founder), for decades to come.

Our ambition is to compete with players like Mindvalley (150M ARR), but with a sharper vision, grounded protocols for achievers, people who want more for their life, refusing mediocrity.

To do that, we bring together designers, tech, coaches, and filmmakers to create learning experiences that are cinematic, precise, and effective.

We move fast, aim high, and hold ourselves to the standards of Apple, Spotify, and MasterClass. No fluff, focused on meaningful impact.

While others hide their numbers, we want to let our results speak loudly for us.

Get obsessed with transforming our clients’ lives and let those transformations be our marketing.

OUR AI-NATIVE AMBITION 🤖

We want to build an AI-native company, with agents in every department doing the work alongside our people.

In product, that means building a self-learning AI for product management: a system that learns from every user signal, experiment and release, and gets sharper at deciding what to build next.

For our clients, it means a self-learning AI that serves them through psychology and coaching, and gets better at helping each person change with every interaction.

You won’t just use AI tools: you’ll help design the agents, loops and feedback systems that make Paradox learn faster than anyone else.

YOUR MISSION 🚀

As Head of Product, you’ll be the architect of a new category, transforming growth into a living ecosystem powered by AI, behavioral science, and design.

You won’t just build features, you’ll craft experiences that rewire behavior.

You’re the architect bringing clarity between vision and execution, the person who turns “we should build this” into “it’s live, here’s the data and tangible impact.”

Every product cycle you lead will integrate:

  • Protocols : guided frameworks grounded in psychology that rewire perception, emotion, and action.

  • Pods : human connection, accountability, and shared rituals.

  • Loops : adaptive, AI-powered coaching cycles that evolve with each user.

  • Personalization : experiences that feel uniquely theirs, every time.

Going from a successful personal brand, to an international tech-driven iconic brand, is far from easy. It will be messy, chaotic - requiring constant iterations on MVPs and innovation in tech. Therefore to achieve this here are :

🎯 YOUR 5 MAIN MISSIONS

1. Make AI-native a way of building the company

  • Translate the founder’s strategic vision into a clear product strategy.

  • Build and maintain the roadmap that connects business goals, user outcomes, and technological innovation.

  • Ensure every feature supports the evolution of the Paradox ecosystem: Loops, PX Agents, Protocols, Membership.

2. User Understanding & Behavioral Insight

  • Be obsessed with user problems : talk to users weekly, analyze patterns, and identify where transformation breaks.

  • Turn insights from behavioral science, coaching psychology, and learning design into actionable product hypotheses.

  • Design loops, feedback, and rituals that make growth tangible.

  • build for both the heart (inspiration) and the brain (structure).

3. Build, Ship, Learn Fast, create AI Loops

  • Apply Lean Startup methodology and scientific thinking to validate ideas through MVPs, not opinions.

  • Design experiments and measurable success metrics before building.

  • Iterate on a weekly basis on new hypothesis

4. AI Native Product Analytics & Impact Measurement

  • Define and track product success metrics (activation, retention, transformation rates).

  • Connect data to business KPIs, know how your product drives lifetime value, not just engagement.

  • We don’t track metrics just for internal dashboards, we track them also to prove transformation.

  • Help marketing leverage this data to fuel authentic, evidence-based storytelling — showing the world what real transformation looks like.

5. Blend emotions (“open the heart of people”) with precision (“build loops, scoring, protocols”).

  • Create a visceral experience that translates into emotions of inspiration, awe from users.

  • Use a Science-backed, Cinematic, Contrarian style : Every product touchpoint should be grounded in behavioral science, expressed with cinematic beauty, and challenge conventions

THE IDEAL CANDIDATE 😍

Experience :

  • 3–6 years as a Product Manager / Product Owner in EdTech, SaaS, or Consumer Tech.

  • Bonus: experience in AI-driven products, learning design, or personal development platforms.

  • You’ve shipped at least one major feature or product end-to-end, and can show measurable results.

  • Uses Figma comfortably, prototypes directly.

Traits :

  • Craft-obsessed : You get things done, you love to work much beyond 9-5, you have a doer mentality, a bias for outcomes and want to be a beast in your field

  • User & Impact Obsessed: You think in outcomes, not outputs, you care about transformation.

  • Analytical & System Thinker: You can turn a vague problem into a clear hypothesis, metrics, and roadmap.

  • Digital & AI savvy : you’re able to build AI Agents (if not, you demonstrate ability to learn while applying).

  • Cross-disciplinary Curiosity: You speak both tech and human; You can move from vision to spreadsheet to Figma

Language

French : native

English: Fluent English, you can hold a conversation on specific details with English-speaking colleagues.

Our chosen language for written communication is English.

IT MIGHT NOT BE FOR YOU

❌ If you need clarity before chaos — wrong place.
❌ If you prefer balance over intensity — wrong season.
❌ If you build to deliver, not to elevate — wrong mission.

❌Surface-level Vision Alignment : you like the idea of Paradox but doesn’t want to get the depth. Paradox is design-led; you must touch the product, not just manage it.

✅ If you’re obsessed with systems, psychology, and design…
✅ If you dream of using AI to amplify what makes us human…

WHY JOIN US ❤️

Build a product that fuses neuroscience, design, and AI to reinvent how humans grow.

The chance to build a product that could redefine human potential.

Work with filmmakers, psychologists, engineers, and creatives obsessed with impact.

In the heart of our headquarters stands the 100 000 Dreams Wall,

Every photo on that wall is a life rewritten:

“I ran a marathon.”

“I started my company.”

“I found peace with my father.”

You will play a crucial role in the development of an Iconic Product.

Growth & Ambition

-> 🏅Being surrounded by A-players who strive to perform

Competitive Salary

But you don’t just want a competitive paycheck, you also want…

Impact & Meaning

->Playing a crucial role in the development of a company whose content and products will be used by millions of people

->Waking up in the morning feeling like you are making a difference is something!
We receive messages every day from clients who have successfully lost weight, quit smoking, reached a milestone in their business, built better relationships, and made positive changes in their lives.

-> ❤️ Contributing to the Paradox Foundation (our non-profit), dedicated to empower teenagers

But that's not all, we believe that driven people deserve…

Freedom & Well Being 🗽

-> 😎A company culture based on autonomy & accountability

-> 🗽Flexible working hours

-> 🌎A remote culture from day one with the freedom to work from wherever you want

-> 🏤Magnificent office in Dubai, Paris, Lisbon - it feels like home :)

-> 🧍‍♀️Standing desks paid by the company if you live far from our offices

-> 💻Work on Mac, for us it counts :)

-> 🏀350€ per year paid by the company to take care of yourself ( for your gym, or dance class or whatever make you feel great)

-> 📚150€ of books or education - At Paradox, we are learner lovers and we want to support you in that

-> 🔥6 1:1coachings - A Paradox Coach supporting you on anything personal or professional, we want you to live your best life

HOW TO APPLY 📃

⚠️ To complete the recruitment process, each candidate must organize calls with his or her previous managers. If you are not comfortable with this : do not apply ⚠️

If all this sounds good to you, come and write the next chapter with us 🚀🚀🚀🚀

HIRING PROCESS 📃

That job description resonated with you?

Here is your tailor made hiring process

📃 A 6 to 8 minutes application survey (with a short video assignment)

💻 A 30mn video call with Timy, HR, to deep dive into your career path and ambitions

💻 A 1h video call with Timy, HR, to discuss how you'd fit into Paradox’s Product team

💻 A 1h culture-fit video call, to assess alignment with our values and mindset

💻 A 1h final video call with David, CEO, to discuss Product Vision and the next milestones to build

💼 Reference check to understand how you operate across environments and help set you up for a smooth onboarding

🫵🚀 Welcome aboard!

About our hiring process

Our recruitment process is tailored to do our best to avoid that you or us realize that we’re not a perfect fit. Every step serves a purpose and will allow us to get to know you better as much as it’ll help you understand more where you’ll be stepping in.

We also want you to have time to ask all of your questions regarding the mission, the long-term vision of your team and the company, our values, with the relevant interlocutor in front of you.

If you believe design and AI can awaken what’s best in us then this isn’t a career move.

Welcome to Paradox.

Let’s build the Operating System for Greatness.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE 

Zeta Global (NYSE: ZETA) is the AI-Powered Marketing Cloud that leverages advanced artificial intelligence (AI) and trillions of consumer signals to make it easier for marketers to acquire, grow, and retain customers more efficiently. Through the Zeta Marketing Platform (ZMP), our vision is to make sophisticated marketing simple by unifying identity, intelligence, and omnichannel activation into a single platform – powered by one of the industry’s largest proprietary databases and AI. Our enterprise customers across multiple verticals are empowered to personalize experiences with consumers at an individual level across every channel, delivering better results for marketing programs. Zeta was founded in 2007 by David A. Steinberg and John Sculley and is headquartered in New York City with offices around the world. To learn more, go to .

THE ROLE

Zeta Global is seeking a Senior Customer Success Manager, CRM. In this role, you will serve as a strategic partner to enterprise clients, helping them maximize the value of Zeta's marketing technology solutions to drive customer engagement, retention, and growth.

You will own relationships with a portfolio of clients, working closely with marketing leaders and cross-functional teams to develop data-driven strategies, optimize campaign performance, and deliver measurable business results. The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of lifecycle marketing, a consultative approach to client relationships, and the ability to translate complex marketing challenges into actionable solutions.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Own Strategic Client Relationships: Serve as the primary point of contact and trusted advisor for a portfolio of enterprise clients, building strong relationships with key stakeholders and understanding their business objectives, marketing strategies, and KPIs.
  • Drive Loyalty Strategy & Performance: Partner with clients to develop and execute loyalty and lifecycle marketing strategies that improve customer engagement, acquisition, retention, and lifetime value.
  • Deliver Data-Driven Insights: Analyze campaign performance, customer engagement trends, and marketing KPIs to identify optimization opportunities and provide actionable recommendations.
  • Maximize Platform Adoption: Guide clients in leveraging Zeta's platform capabilities, ensuring they are effectively utilizing available solutions to achieve their marketing and business goals.
  • Lead Strategic Business Reviews: Present campaign results, performance insights, and strategic recommendations to client stakeholders, demonstrating measurable value and identifying opportunities for continued growth.
  • Support Client Retention & Growth: Proactively identify account risks, address client challenges, and partner with commercial teams to uncover opportunities for upselling, cross-selling, and expanding client relationships.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work closely with internal teams across Customer Success, Analytics, and Operations to execute client initiatives, resolve challenges, and deliver a seamless client experience.
  • Champion the Voice of the Customer: Share client feedback, industry trends, and emerging needs with internal stakeholders to inform product enhancements and improve the overall customer experience.
  • Drive Operational Excellence: Manage multiple client priorities, oversee key deliverables, and ensure timely execution while maintaining a high standard of client service.

REQUIREMENTS 

  • 5+ years of experience in Customer Success, Client Services, Account Management, or a related client-facing role within MarTech, SaaS, or digital marketing.
  • Strong understanding of email marketing, marketing automation, loyalty programs, and customer lifecycle strategies.
  • Experience managing enterprise client relationships and serving as a strategic advisor to senior marketing stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze marketing performance data, identify trends, and translate insights into actionable business recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship management skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to balance multiple client accounts, competing priorities, and cross-functional initiatives.
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience working with enterprise email service providers (ESPs), customer data platforms (CDPs), or marketing automation platforms such as Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Adobe Campaign, Braze, Iterable, or similar technologies.
  • Familiarity with email marketing performance metrics, including deliverability, engagement, conversion, and customer retention.
  • Experience with audience segmentation, personalization, customer journey orchestration, and omnichannel marketing strategies.
  • Understanding of marketing data, analytics, and campaign measurement.

LOCATION

This is a remote position based in the United States.

BENEFITS & PERKS

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Employee Equity and Stock Purchase Plan
  • Employee Discounts, Virtual Wellness Classes, and Pet Insurance And more!!

SALARY RANGE

The salary range for this role is $90,000 - $100,000 depending on location and experience. 

PEOPLE & CULTURE AT ZETA

Zeta considers applicants for employment without regard to, and does not discriminate on the basis of an individual’s sex, race, color, religion, age, disability, status as a veteran, or national or ethnic origin; nor does Zeta discriminate on the basis of sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

BJAK is building a AI Finance Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a hybrid role. You are expected to work from our local office at least 3 days per week, with the remaining days offering flexibility to work remotely.

Candidates should be based in, or able to work from, the location where the role is advertised.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreAI is changing how software gets built.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

AI is changing how software gets built. Code production is becoming a commodity. The focus is shifting from writing code to specifying, orchestrating, verifying, and governing change – and the toolchain is the new constraint.

We are at the center of this shift. We build Develocity, a toolchain observability and intelligence platform used by some of the world's leading software organizations – Netflix, Airbnb, Spotify, SAP, major global banks, and hundreds more. Develocity helps software teams achieve delivery excellence through deep observability, build and test acceleration, and AI-powered intelligence across the entire toolchain – with support for Gradle Build Tool, Apache Maven™, sbt, npm, Python, and Bazel.

We are an AI-native company. AI is not a feature we're bolting on – it's central to how we work, how we think about our product, and where we're heading. Develocity encodes a decade of build and test expertise into a context engineering layer: the ground truth AI agents need to change code safely, and the governance to attribute and gate that change at machine speed. Trust, evidence, and explainability are at the core of everything we build.

We have partnered with the Apache Software Foundation, the Commonhaus Foundation, the Micronaut Foundation, and other OSS projects such as Spring, Quarkus, Kotlin, JUnit, AndroidX, and many more to bring the values of Develocity also to the OSS Community.

Our Values

Seek to Understand: Everything starts with listening and understanding, and we strive to understand different viewpoints, problems, and motivations. Before we take action, we ensure we truly grasp the challenges, perspectives, and goals.

Know the Why: We approach our work with a clear sense of purpose, ensuring every step is deliberate and focused. We take meaningful action with urgency, but never at the expense of thoughtful consideration.

Innovate & Iterate: We embrace challenges and are not afraid to try new things, even if they might fail. With deep understanding and a clear purpose, we can develop creative and bold solutions to tackle challenges.

Own the Outcome: We are empowered to take initiative and we maintain transparency in our work and its outcomes. When we execute, we take responsibility for our decisions, measure the success of our innovations, and learn from the results.

Who You Are

We're building a new SRE team and looking for founding members to help shape how we operate. You'll be responsible for the reliability, performance, and availability of Develocity instances serving paying customers, open-source projects, and public-facing services, plus supporting infrastructure like artifact registries.

You'll work on our internally-built Cloud Application Platform, Kubernetes on AWS, and develop deep expertise in it. When incidents happen, you'll troubleshoot issues across the stack, from application to infrastructure. You'll collaborate with the Cloud Platform team to improve the tooling you depend on, and with engineering teams to build reliability into how we ship software. If you like automating things and hate doing the same task twice, you'll fit in well.

You'll be part of a distributed, remote-first team that values asynchronous communication and written documentation. Strong self-direction and clear communication across time zones are essential.

Responsibilities

  • Operate and maintain all Develocity instances and supporting services.
  • Participate in an on-call rotation, owning incident response and troubleshooting issues across the stack.
  • Drive automation across application deployment, upgrades, monitoring, self-healing, and recovery.
  • Build and maintain observability for all managed services (logging, metrics, tracing, and alerting).
  • Work with engineering teams to build reliability into features from the start.
  • Run incident response and retrospectives, and make sure we learn from them.
  • Own disaster recovery, backups, and business continuity.
  • Communicate with customers during incidents and maintenance windows.
  • Optimize performance, resource usage, and costs.
  • Help evolve our SaaS operations as we grow.

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in SRE, DevOps, or equivalent role operating production services at scale.
  • Strong Kubernetes experience in production environments.
  • Cloud infrastructure expertise, preferably AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, EC2).
  • Proficiency with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana) and Infrastructure as Code (Terraform).
  • Track record of incident management and response.
  • Knowledge of SRE best practices (SLAs, SLOs).
  • Scripting proficiency (Python, Bash) for automation.
  • Experience with 24/7 on-call rotations.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience operating SaaS platforms at scale.
  • Familiarity with Develocity.
  • JVM language experience (Java, Kotlin).
  • Disaster recovery planning and execution experience.
  • Customer-facing incident communication skills.
  • Experience establishing SRE practices in new or growing teams.

What We Offer

  • A ground-floor role in a new SRE team—you'll shape how we do things, not inherit someone else's decisions.
  • Real ownership of production systems used by engineers at companies you've heard of.
  • Direct interaction with customers when things go wrong (and when they go right).
  • A culture that values automation over heroics.
  • In-person meetings, such as our annual company offsite and team meetings.
  • Work from home in a remote-first environment.
  • Competitive salaries and equity grants.

Compensation

The US salary range for this position is $180,000-240,000 which reflects the target ranges for all US locations. Within this range, individual pay is determined by geographic location and additional factors including but not limited to experience, relevant skills, qualifications, seniority, performance, and travel requirements. Our recruiting team can share more information about the specific salary range for your location during the hiring process.

Location

  • Remote from anywhere in PST timezone.
  • While our team works remotely and is spread across the globe, we deeply value daily interactions and collaboration.

jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within BJAK's AI Finance.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Austria. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Austria.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

The role ensures requirements traceability, verification and validation readiness, risk management, and alignment of safety objectives with program milestones, supporting both product delivery and safety assurance objectives.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead planning and execution of safety-critical initiatives across the autonomous vehicle lifecycle, ensuring alignment between product roadmaps, safety goals, and deployment milestones.
  • Establish and maintain traceability between hazards, safety requirements, system requirements, verification activities, validation evidence, and release decisions.
  • Coordinate cross-functional safety activities including hazard analysis, safety assessments, safety case development, and operational readiness reviews.
  • Drive integrated verification and validation planning across simulation, test environments, closed-course testing, and field operations to support evidence-based deployment decisions.
  • Manage program risks, technical dependencies, and change impacts across systems, software, hardware, perception, localization, controls, and operational teams.
  • Monitor safety and program metrics, proactively identifying issues that could impact system performance, safety objectives, regulatory compliance, or delivery commitments.
  • Facilitate executive reviews and technical governance forums, providing clear visibility into program health, residual risk, and safety readiness.

What you need to succeed

  • Experience leading programs involving autonomous systems, ADAS, robotics, aerospace, industrial automation, or other safety-critical platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience applying ISO 21448 (SOTIF) across the safety lifecycle, including hazard analysis and risk assessment (HARA), safety goals, functional and technical safety concepts, and ASIL decomposition. About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

Our objective is to organise anyone's life, allowing us all to spend time on valuable and meaningful things

As Principal Software Engineer, AI Email App, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

What You'll Own

  • Own the application engineering strategy and execution across backend, mobile, and desktop.

  • Design reliable systems for AI-powered workflows, including state, orchestration, tool use, retries, fallbacks, and failure handling.

  • Build the APIs and abstractions that connect AI systems to real-world product experiences.

  • Lead a small, senior engineering team and raise the technical bar through design reviews, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship.

  • Make high-impact trade-offs across latency, reliability, cost, security, and user experience.

  • Establish strong production foundations: observability, monitoring, testing, and operational excellence.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

What We're Looking For

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Strong hands-on background building and shipping backend systems used in production.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

  • A strong bias toward ownership, shipping, and learning from real-world usage.

  • High standards for code quality, reliability, and engineering fundamentals.

Outcomes

  • Production systems are observable, monitored, and stable under real-world load.

  • Decisions consistently balance speed, cost, reliability, and user experience.

  • Features across backend, mobile, and desktop work smoothly and reliably.

  • Latency and reliability improve measurably over time.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

Interview process

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

jobs.description:
We're looking for an Online Wedding Coordinator: a warm, organised person who talks to brides every day, works out what they need and connects them with the right Wedded Wonderland vendors, venues and packages.

Fully remote (Philippines) | Full-time

Role overview

You are the first friendly voice a bride hears from Wedded Wonderland. This is an advisory, online-only role. You won't run weddings on the day. You listen, recommend and connect, then make sure every bride feels looked after until she has booked what she needs.

Key responsibilities

Talk to brides

  • Reply to new enquiries on website chat, WhatsApp and email within agreed response times.
  • Run short discovery calls by video or phone to learn each bride's date, destination, guest count, budget, style and cultural or religious traditions.
  • Be the bride's go-to contact from first enquiry until she has booked, with regular check-ins along the way.

Match brides to what they need

  • Recommend venues and vendors from the Wedded Wonderland directory, such as photographers, planners and stylists, florists, entertainment, and hair and makeup.
  • Introduce brides to vendors and follow up so each introduction becomes a conversation or a booking.
  • Suggest Wedded Wonderland destination wedding and honeymoon packages when they suit the bride's plans.
  • Share helpful guides, real-wedding stories and event invitations (e.g. Wedded World) to keep brides engaged.

Keep things organised

  • Log every bride in the CRM with her date, destination, budget, needs, vendors introduced and next step.
  • Track the status of each introduction and booking. Flag hot leads and issues to the team.
  • Collect feedback from brides and vendors, and suggest gaps in the directory (for example, a destination with too few photographers).
  • Write and improve saved replies, FAQs and checklists for common bride questions.

What you'll bring

Must have

  • 2+ years in a client-facing role such as customer service, sales, concierge, hospitality, events or bridal.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, with a warm, polished tone suited to a luxury brand.
  • Confidence on video calls and the ability to build rapport quickly with brides from different cultures.
  • Strong organisation: you can juggle 30+ active conversations without dropping a follow-up.
  • Experience using a CRM or helpdesk, and comfort with Google Workspace.
  • A reliable laptop, stable internet (25 Mbps+) and a quiet place to take calls, plus a backup power or internet option.

Nice to have

  • Wedding, event or destination travel experience.
  • Sales or lead-conversion experience with measurable results.
  • Knowledge of popular destinations such as Italy, Greece, Bali or Mexico.
  • Familiarity with WhatsApp Business, Zoho or live-chat tools.
  • A second language, such as Spanish, Arabic or Hindi.

What we offer

  • Fully remote, full-time work with a growing global wedding brand.
  • Training on our directory, vendor partners and packages.
