What We Can Achieve Together:

The Impact Finance & Markets Division at The Nature Conservancy provides technical and strategic leadership to create transformational impact with the private sector by translating the value of nature and conservation approaches into actionable, science-based strategies that can help solve societal challenges. The Contracts Manager will serve as the primary point of contact and subject matter expert for contractual agreements across Impact Finance & Markets (IFM). As part of the IFM operations team, the position will manage the full agreement lifecycle, including intake, pre-contract requirements, drafting, review, approvals, execution, tracking, deliverables, amendments, and close-out. The Contracts Manager will provide responsive guidance to project managers, strengthen consistency and compliance, and improve the systems, tools, and resources used to manage IFM agreements.


This position may be based in any country with an established office in time zones equivalent to U.S. Eastern, Central, Mountain, or Pacific time zones. The Contracts Manager may work remote, hybrid, or in person. They will report to the Deputy Director, Impact Finance and Markets.


Relocation assistance and immigration sponsorship are not available for this position.


Please submit a cover letter and resume. Applications without a cover letter will not be considered.


If interested in this role apply immediately as we may close the posting at any time.


We’re Looking for You:

The Contracts Manager will support IFM’s priorities by developing and implementing an efficient, consistent, and well-controlled money-out and money-in contracts function. They will apply extensive knowledge of TNC policies, procedures, templates, systems, and approval requirements; advise staff on agreement-related questions; identify risks and process gaps; and coordinate with Legal, Finance, Purchasing, Information Security, Records Management, and other subject matter experts. The position will develop guidance and training, maintain reliable records and reporting, and develop and implement practical improvements to workflows, systems, and tools.


The Contracts Manager will obtain and maintain certification as a TNC Certified Contracts Specialist (CSS) and obtain training related to money-in contractual and private grant agreements. In the event IFM performs work under a public award, the Contract Manager will complete public awards training.


The Contracts Manager, in partnership with project managers, will coordinate, and as appropriate, draft, review, negotiate, process, execute, amend, renew and close out contractual agreements with external parties.


The Contracts Manager will serve as IFM’s Business Unit Records Management Coordinator and maintain IFM’s Delegation of Authority records. The Contracts Manager may perform other duties as necessary related to operations.


They will approach all work with a spirit of collaboration and respect for colleagues and partners across geographies and cultures.


RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

  • Act independently within broad program goals and under established guidelines to prioritize tasks in the absence of specific instructions and exercise independent judgment based on analysis and experience to identify and solve problems;
  • Develop and implement new initiatives or the improvement of existing procedures that will ensure business unit and organization-wide goals and strategies are achieved;
  • Ensure programmatic commitments, Conservancy policies and procedures, and legal requirements are met and managed for compliance; Decisions may bind the organization financially or legally;
  • Collaborate with Finance staff on managing private awards;
  • Collaborate, as needed, with Grants Specialists on managing public awards;
  • Demonstrate sensitivity in handling confidential information;
  • Manage projects with several variables - set realistic deadlines, manage a timeline, and ensure accountability;
  • Work across functions, geographies, and organizational levels and adapt guidance to varied contracting contexts.
  • Financial responsibility may include purchasing, processing invoices, and assisting with budget preparation or tracking;
  • May participate in complex negotiations;
  • Must be independent and self-motivated with the ability to participate effectively in a remote team environment.
  • Be willing to work longer hours as needed; and
  • Work environment involves only infrequent exposure to disagreeable elements and minor physical exertion and/or strain.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree and 5 years' experience or equivalent combination;
  • Previous contracting experience, coursework, or dedicated training;
  • Experience with organizational skills and attention to detail;
  • Experience managing and implementing multiple projects;
  • Experience interpreting guidelines to achieve desired results;
  • Experience with business process analysis and/or improvement;
  • Experience in business writing, editing, and proofreading;
  • Experience organizing time and managing diverse activities to meet deadlines;
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams; and
  • Experience handling confidential information.

Desired Qualifications

  • Multi-lingual skills and multi-cultural or cross-cultural experiences are appreciated;
  • Ability to analyze information for the purpose of preparing reports, coordinating activities, and solving problems;
  • Ability to manage and implement complex processes;
  • Ability to use existing technology to achieve desired results; and/or
  • Experience in supporting Financial and/or Legal processes.

Salary Information:


This position may be based in any country where TNC has an established entity, taking into consideration legal restrictions, such as non-national ratios and immigration processing times. For U.S. based applicants only, the starting pay range for this position is generally within the range of $80,000 – $104,000 for annual base salary and is based on location, qualifications, specific skills, and experience. This range only applies to candidates whose country of employment is the USA.


For all other applicants, pay ranges will be in local currency, the pay range will be based on the local labor market, and not tied to the above pay range. Your geographic location will be confirmed during the recruitment and used to determine your actual pay range. Additionally, for all applicants, actual pay will fall within a range based on a variety of factors including, for example, the candidate’s qualifications, specific skills, and experience.

Who We Are:

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. We’re rooted in our mission and guided by our values, which include respect for all people, communities, and cultures. Whether it’s career development, flexible schedules, or a rewarding mission, there’s many reasons to love life inside TNC. Want a better insight to TNC? Check out our TNC Talent playlist on YouTube to hear stories from staff or visit Glassdoor.

One goal is to cultivate an inclusive work environment so that all our colleagues around the globe feel a sense of belonging and that their unique contributions to our mission are valued. In addition to the requirements in our job postings, we recognize that people come with talent and experiences outside of a job and consider each applicant’s unique experience. Please apply – we’d love to hear from you. To quote a popular saying at TNC, “you’ll join for the mission, and stay for the people.”

What We Bring:

Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Through grassroots action, we have grown from a small non-profit into one of the most effective and wide-reaching environmental organizations in the world. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

TNC offers a competitive, comprehensive benefits package including health care benefits, flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) plan with an 8% employer match, parental leave, accrued paid time off, life insurance, disability coverage, employee assistance program, other life and work well-being benefits. Learn more about our Benefits and Perks here.

We’re proud to offer a flexible work environment that supports of the health and well-being of the people we employ.

Our recruiting process includes a rolling interview process to ensure we engage applicants in a timely manner. This means we may review applications in the order in which they are received. Once a strong candidate pool is identified, the role will be unposted. The timeline may vary depending on the expressed interest in the role, so we highly encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.

Employees must submit their application by logging into Workday and applying via the Jobs Hub.

The Nature Conservancy is an Equal Opportunity Employer.Our commitment to equal employment opportunity includes the recognition that our conservation mission is best advanced by the leadership and contributions of people of all backgrounds, beliefs, and culture. Recruiting and mentoring staff to create an inclusive organization is a priority, and we encourage applicants from all cultures, races, colors, religions, sexes, national or regional origins, ages, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity, military, protected veteran status or other status protected by law.

The successful applicant must meet the requirements of The Nature Conservancy's background screening process.

Senior Account Director

Company: Pixis Drones, LLC.
Location: New York or Los Angeles preferred / Remote

What We're About:
Pixis Drones is building the most exciting new media platform in marketing: the night sky. Hundreds of synchronized drones turn a brand's logo, product, or message into a moment an entire crowd looks up at together, and then shares. We blend creative storytelling with cutting-edge technology to create aerial displays that people remember long after the last drone lands.

What This Role is About:

We are hiring one of our founding sellers. As Senior Account Director, you will be selling something nobody else in the room has, to brands and agencies that are always looking for the thing that breaks through. You will open the doors, lead the pricing conversations, and help write the playbook for how this category gets sold.

This role is ideal for a proven hunter who has closed meaningful deals in out-of-home media, sponsorships, events, or experiential marketing, and who already has brand and agency relationships that take their calls. If you like a challenge and want to be early at a company creating a new media channel, this is the seat.

What You'll Do:
New Business & Relationships
  • Prospect and close brand and agency accounts through outbound outreach, referrals, events, and the relationships you already have.
  • Build your own book of business, generating net-new pipeline rather than relying on inbound leads.
  • Position drone shows as premium media for product launches, brand reveals, sponsor takeovers at festivals and stadiums, and seasonal campaigns.
  • Invite prospects to live shows and let the product do the selling.
Pricing & Deal Strategy
  • Own the pricing conversation. When a client asks what it costs, answer quickly and with a clear recommendation.
  • Build tiered packages based on drone count, show length, custom animation, branded QR codes and logos, and multi-city or multi-date runs.
  • Run the full sales cycle, from discovery and creative brief through proposal, negotiation, and contract, with a clean handoff to production and creative.
Account Growth & Pipeline
  • Turn one-off activations into seasonal commitments, multi-show agreements, and agency preferred-vendor relationships.
  • Log every touch in HubSpot, report weekly on pipeline and bookings, and forecast accurately each month.
Building the Playbook
  • Bring market feedback back to leadership to shape pricing, packaging, case studies, and sales collateral.
  • Help define how Pixis sells as we grow, setting the standard for the sellers who come after you.
Who You'll Sell To:
  • Agencies: Experiential, event production, sports and entertainment marketing, media, and PR agencies buying drone shows as a repeatable line item in client activations, including preferred-vendor and volume agreements.
  • Brands: CMOs, brand managers, and sponsorship leads at consumer, auto, beverage, tech, and retail companies buying launches, brand reveals, sponsor takeovers, and seasonal campaigns.
  • Venues & Properties: Pro teams, stadiums, festivals, resorts, and destinations selling branded shows to their own sponsors, often co-sold with the brand.
What Makes You Successful:
  • 4+ years of quota-carrying sales experience in out-of-home media, sponsorships, events, or experiential marketing.
  • A track record of hitting or beating quota on deals in the $60K to $250K+ range, not small transactional sales.
  • Active relationships with brand marketers and agencies (experiential, event, sports and entertainment, media), ideally in New York or Los Angeles.
  • A hunter's mentality, with the drive to generate your own pipeline and open new doors.
  • The ability to sell a vision before the client has seen it, backed by strong presentation and proposal skills.
  • Confidence to quote, recommend, and defend pricing without escalating every question.
  • Working knowledge of a CRM. HubSpot experience is highly preferred.
  • Willingness to work some evenings and weekends around live shows and events.
Nice to Have
  • Premium seating, suite, or hospitality sales experience with a pro team, venue, or live entertainment property.
  • Experience with live event production, drone shows, or FAA show approvals.
  • A network in sports, music festivals, auto, beverage, or consumer tech marketing.
  • Early-stage or startup experience, and a story about building something from zero.
How Success Is Measured:
In your first year, success looks like:
  • $3,000,000 in new bookings revenue
  • 25 new brand and agency accounts closed
  • 35 shows signed
  • Qualified pipeline maintained at 2x quota
  • Client pricing requests answered within one business day
Compensation & Benefits:
  • Base salary of $90,000 to $110,000, based on experience.
  • Uncapped commission on closed revenue, with accelerators above quota.
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage, plus paid time off.
  • Front-row seats to every show you sell.
How We Work:
At Pixis Drones, precision meets creative spectacle. We engineer safety and reliability into every show, and we bring that same rigor and creativity to how we grow the business. We welcome people from diverse backgrounds and provide the systems training, mentorship, and room to grow that help you build a career here.

Next Steps:
To apply, please respond to this posting with your resume and a short cover letter. In it, tell us about the biggest sponsorship, media, or experiential deal you have closed, and how you would pitch a drone show to a brand that has never bought one. Only qualified applicants will be contacted.

Community Sports Partners | Remote — Latin America & the Caribbean
Predominantly evenings and weekends, Toronto/Eastern time
$1,000–$1,500 monthly base + $1,000+/month performance bonus potential

Build and run sports programs with the urgency, resourcefulness and accountability of a founder.

We are building a high-growth sports business and looking for someone who loves sport and wants personal responsibility for making leagues and programs succeed. You will own the process from initial planning through sales, launch, execution, customer experience and growth.

This is an intense, hands-on role with high expectations. You will pursue ambitious growth targets, solve problems under pressure and follow through on commitments. Your impact will be measured in filled programs, reliable delivery, returning players and sound financial results.

What you will own

• Planning: Assess demand, prepare budgets and launch timelines, coordinate venues and permits, and confirm schedules and staffing.

• Sales: Follow up with players and team captains, convert enquiries into paid registrations and fill available spaces.

• Execution: Coordinate local staff, referees, coaches and equipment. Check readiness before games and resolve problems during delivery.

• Growth: Build partnerships, support campaigns, increase repeat registrations and identify opportunities for new programs and locations.

• Customer experience: Own player communications, resolve complaints and restore confidence when something goes wrong.

• Results: Track registrations, revenue, costs, program occupancy and retention. Report progress honestly, identify gaps early and deliver improvements.

High growth. High intensity.
Personal accountability.

A conventional 9-to-5 mindset—waiting for instructions, doing only the assigned task or leaving problems for someone else—is incompatible with this role. We actively challenge passive working habits and address repeated failures of ownership through performance reviews.

• Think creatively: Find overlooked audiences, develop partnerships, test new offers and create practical ways to fill programs.

• Show tenacity: Follow up consistently, work through setbacks and adapt when the first approach fails.

• Move with purpose: Turn ideas into action quickly, measure what works and expand successful approaches.

• Own the outcome: Raise problems early with a proposed response, escalate decisions when needed and coordinate the people required to resolve them. Build processes that prevent repeat failures.

Working hours

Hours are predominantly evenings and weekends in Toronto/Eastern time, when our customers and programs are most active. These are the core working hours of the role. Specific shifts and weekly hours will be agreed before starting. Within that schedule, we expect focus, urgency and dependable ownership.

This is one role advertised across multiple recruitment locations. Applicants throughout Latin America and the Caribbean are welcome, including outside the advertised metropolitan locations. Please apply once.

Requirements

What you bring

Practical experience in sports leagues, clubs, tournaments, facilities or program operations; sustained passion for sport demonstrated through real involvement; strong organization and numerical skills; fluent spoken and written English; confidence with spreadsheets and operational systems; and the ability to coordinate people remotely. You must be based in Latin America or the Caribbean.

Apply

Submit your CV and a brief summary of the sports programs you have helped run, what you personally owned and the results you achieved. Our application process includes Culture Index and Criteria assessments.

Complete both assessments using the same email as your application. If already completed for Community Sports Partners, indicate this in the form.

  • Culture Index survey
  • Criteria GAME assessment — English

Benefits

Compensation and progression

Start as a Coordinator at USD $1,000–$1,500 per month, depending on experience, plus the potential to earn USD $1,000+ per month in performance bonuses, based on targets and calculation terms agreed in advance. Bonuses are variable, not guaranteed.

Over the first six months, you will build toward Manager responsibilities. Progression to Manager will depend on successful completion of probation and a six-month review of growth results, operational reliability, initiative and readiness to lead independently. Promotion is earned through results.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

About Verto

At Verto, we're on a mission to democratise global finance and empower businesses in Emerging Markets to reach the world. Founded by British-Nigerian entrepreneurs Ola Oyetayo and Anthony Oduu, our roots in Africa provided a firsthand understanding of the significant challenges businesses face with cross-border payments, ranging from illiquid currencies and high fees to slow transactions. This deep-rooted insight is why Africa remains a core focus, as we're committed to bridging the gap between emerging and developed markets and fostering global economic growth.

What started as an FX solution for the Nigerian Naira has evolved into a market-leading platform, enabling thousands of businesses to seamlessly transfer billions of dollars annually. We believe that where you do business shouldn’t determine your success or ability to scale. We're creating equal access to the easy payment and liquidity solutions that are already a given in developed markets.

We're not alone in realising this crucial need; we're backed by world-class investors including Y-Combinator, Quona, and MEVP. With Verto receiving the Milken-Motsepe Prize, appearing on CNBCs list of fastest growing UK companies, the Deloitte Fast 50 and Sifted’s fastest-growing UK tech companies, we are building a seamless cross-border payment future.

Our extensive workforce includes both union and nonunion teams, which, combined with our specialized equipment fleet, allows us to effectively meet our clients' needs for power delivery, emergency restoration, and ongoing maintenance. We've been involved in some of the most challenging and recognizable electric projects across the U.S. From the electric plant to the end users, MasTec's experienced managers and crews consistently deliver transmission, distribution, and substation & switchyard services with an unfailing commitment to safety, integrity, and sustainable practices. The Transmission Line Engineer is responsible for the engineering and design of high-voltage electrical transmission line systems, applying principles of both electrical and civil engineering to develop safe, reliable, constructible, and cost-effective solutions. This role supports the full lifecycle of transmission line projects, from initial design development and engineering analysis through detailed design, documentation, material takeoffs, and constructability review. The ideal candidate will have strong hands-on experience designing overhead transmission lines, with the ability to work on projects involving transmission systems up to 500 kV. The Transmission Line Engineer will collaborate closely with project management, engineering disciplines, Sales, customers, and field personnel to ensure designs meet project requirements, applicable industry standards, schedule and budget objectives, and customer expectations. In addition to performing technical engineering work, this position will provide technical guidance and coordination to other team members, participate in design reviews, and represent the Engineering department in internal and external meetings. Strong analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills. Ability to work independently and effectively within a multidisciplinary team.

jobs.excerpt: Apartment Life is seeking a HubSpot Systems Administrator to build and maintain efficient, scalable, and sustainable technology systems.
jobs.description:
Apartment Life is seeking a HubSpot Systems Administrator to build and maintain efficient, scalable, and sustainable technology systems. This role manages and enhances our HubSpot environment, integrations, and automations in support of our mission of building community and transforming lives in apartment communities nationwide.

The Tech Systems team is small and fully remote. The work is cross-functional and directly supports the staff who serve our communities.The role is roughly two-thirds operational throughput and one-third build. A high volume of small items moves through this seat daily, alongside project work. It suits someone who values a clean queue, reliable data, and a well-maintained portal.

HubSpot experience is preferred, or experience with a comparable CRM or business systems platform.

IMPORTANT DETAILS

  • This position is full time (40 hours) position.
  • Meticulous attention to detail, strong troubleshooting instincts, and the tenacity to follow a problem through to its cause.
  • Excellent documentation and communication skills.
  • Self-motivated, self-disciplined, high ownership, and flexible. Suited to a small, fully remote team.
  • A systems thinker who understands how data, tools, and people connect, with the ability to read documentation and work through unfamiliar systems.
  • 3+ years with HubSpot, or comparable experience administering a similar CRM or business systems platform.
  • Hands-on experience configuring a CRM platform: users and teams, permissions, record layouts and views, pipelines and stages, properties, and custom objects.
  • Experience with contact and company data management at scale: merges, associations, deduplication, imports, and cleanup.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and relational databases, with the ability to trace data across connected systems.
  • Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, JSON, and authentication methods.
  • Solid understanding of dashboards, reporting, and data structures.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Helpdesk Excellence
    Address HubSpot and other helpdesk requests promptly and professionally. Every member of the Tech Systems team carries a share of helpdesk coverage, which allows a small team to absorb PTO and unplanned leave. This seat also keeps system-generated work moving: program drops and backfills, go-live verifications, fell-throughs, program conversions, and scheduled record checks.
  2. Develop & Enhance HubSpot Features, Workflows, and Integrations
    Build, test, and deploy features, automations, and system improvements across HubSpot and its connected systems, as prioritized by the VP of Tech Systems. This includes custom-coded workflow actions, which run on Node.js. Manage native and API-based integrations with platforms such as Mapsly, Greenhouse, Qwilr, SyncMatters, and Plant an App. Test in sandboxes before going live, and build reports and dashboards that turn data into insight.
  3. Maintain System Stability and Data Integrity
    Keep systems reliable and secure through regular updates, patches, and data syncs. Trace and resolve sync issues between HubSpot and connected systems. Run and improve the recurring audits that catch bad data before it reaches the teams: duplicates, missing or invalid values, orphaned associations, and reporting gaps. Document solutions to strengthen the team's knowledge base.
  4. HubSpot Platform Administration
    Own day-to-day configuration of our HubSpot environment: users, teams, seats, and permissions; record layouts and views; pipelines and stages; properties and property groups; contact and company management including merges, associations, and duplicates; and imports and data cleanup. Make deliberate, documented changes that keep the portal coherent as the organization changes, and handle HubSpot onboarding, offboarding, and ownership transfers.
  5. Collaborate with Tech Leadership and the Team
    Partner with the VP of Tech Systems to clarify requirements, assess feasibility, and align priorities with organizational strategy. Partner with our team and support reps on HubSpot's AI capabilities, including Breeze agents, to bring an organization-wide AI approach. Matrix, our platform built on Plant an App, has a primary administrator on the team; this role builds enough familiarity with it to provide coverage during PTO. System knowledge at Apartment Life is concentrated in a few people, so this role learns deeply and documents thoroughly. Cross-training is a standing expectation on this team.

SUCCESS FACTORS

  • HubSpot and its connected integrations operate smoothly and reliably.
  • The organization fully leverages HubSpot’s functionality for marketing, operations, and data management.
  • Work is owned from intake through resolution and kept visible to the team in Asana.
  • Communication is warm, proactive, and timely: same day when possible, within one business day as the standard.

As the business needs.

We’re looking for actively practicing physicians (MD/DO) with an active, unrestricted US medical license to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Dans le cadre d'un programme public de numérisation, une équipe de développement recherche un data engineer spécialisé en BI et DevOps. Le programme vise à accélérer le traitement des amendes, à réduire la charge administrative des acteurs de la chaîne pénale, à numériser le traitement de l'information et à améliorer le service aux citoyens.

Le projet

La mission porte sur deux volets liés au traitement numérique des infractions routières :

  • l'automatisation du règlement extrajudiciaire des infractions routières mineures ;
  • le suivi des dossiers relevant de l'article 67ter de la loi sur la circulation routière.

Le premier volet traite les dossiers selon une procédure progressive, avec une première proposition de paiement, une transaction, un ordre de paiement et, si nécessaire, une déclaration de force exécutoire ou un certificat destiné au recouvrement à l'étranger. Les dossiers, documents, délais et actions de suivi doivent rester traçables. Les décisions importantes, notamment les contestations et les éventuelles citations, restent du ressort des personnes compétentes.

Le second volet concerne l'obligation, pour une personne morale, de communiquer l'identité du conducteur effectif d'un véhicule impliqué dans une infraction. En cas de non-identification, une transaction peut être proposée. Le projet vise à améliorer le taux d'identification, à assurer un suivi cohérent des dossiers et à mieux détecter la récidive.

Un troisième pilote a démarré le 10 décembre 2025 avec 50 dossiers. Les étapes prévues pour les deuxième et troisième trimestres 2026 comprennent l'envoi d'ordres de paiement et l'intégration avec le système de gestion des dossiers. Une intégration ultérieure avec le système financier est envisagée, sans calendrier concret à ce stade en raison de dépendances entre les différents systèmes.

📝 Votre profil

Vous rejoignez l'équipe de développement en tant que data engineer avec un solide profil DevOps appliqué à la BI. Vous faites le lien entre les normes, les directives et les besoins d'information du métier, d'une part, et leur mise en œuvre technique, d'autre part.

Vous traduisez les besoins en exigences claires, veillez à la qualité des données sur toute la chaîne et vous assurez que les données sont fiables, vérifiables et reproductibles, de la source au rapport. Vous travaillez avec l'environnement existant, notamment SAS, et contribuez à l'évolution de la plateforme de données.

Responsabilités principales

Exigences et normes : rôle de passerelle

  1. Traduire les normes, standards et directives liés à l'architecture, à la sécurité de l'information, au RGPD et aux politiques IT en exigences fonctionnelles et techniques pour les flux de données et le reporting.
  2. Recenser les besoins d'information avec le Product Owner et les analystes fonctionnels, puis les formaliser en user stories avec des critères d'acceptation clairs.
  3. Définir les données et les KPI de manière univoque au moyen d'un dictionnaire de données et d'une couche sémantique.
  4. Être la personne de référence pour les questions relatives aux données et à la BI, en assurant la coordination avec les développeurs, les architectes, les testeurs et les parties prenantes.

Qualité des données

  1. Élaborer, automatiser et suivre des règles de qualité concernant notamment l'exhaustivité, l'exactitude, l'actualité et la cohérence.
  2. Intégrer des contrôles aux processus de chargement, détecter les anomalies et en assurer le suivi jusqu'à leur résolution.
  3. Documenter la traçabilité, les modèles de données, les flux et les processus.
  4. Rendre compte de la qualité des données à l'équipe, au Product Owner et à la direction.

BI DevOps

  1. Mettre en place et gérer la CI/CD pour les pipelines de données, les modèles et les rapports, avec gestion des versions, revues de code, tests automatisés et releases contrôlées dans les environnements de développement, de test et de production.
  2. Mettre en place la supervision et les alertes pour les traitements batch et les chargements de données.
  3. Participer au suivi des quality gates pour le code de données et les rapports.
  4. Assurer la gestion des releases et des changements, ainsi que la résolution des incidents.

Data engineering

  1. Développer et maintenir des processus ETL et ELT.
  2. Mettre à disposition une couche de publication fiable pour les outils BI, notamment SAS Visual Analytics, Power BI et Apache Superset.
  3. Contribuer à l'évolution de la plateforme de données et rendre la logique indépendante des outils lorsque cela est pertinent.
  4. Préparer les données pour de futures applications d'IA en veillant à leur documentation, leur qualité et leur accessibilité sécurisée.

Gouvernance et conformité

  1. Contribuer à la traçabilité des données, des décisions, du code et des tests conformément aux exigences de contrôle interne et d'audit.
  2. Contribuer au respect des règles de sécurité de l'information, du RGPD et de la gestion des accès, de la source au rapport.

Qualifications et aptitudes requises

Formation et expérience

  • Diplôme de bachelor ou de master en informatique, ICT ou domaine similaire, ou expérience équivalente.
  • Au moins 5 ans d'expérience pertinente en data engineering, datawarehousing ou BI, dont au moins 2 ans au sein d'une équipe de développement utilisant la CI/CD.
  • Expérience démontrée dans la traduction de besoins métier et de qualité en exigences et critères d'acceptation pour les données.
  • Expérience dans la mise en place et le suivi de contrôles de qualité des données.

Certifications

  • Une certification DAMA CDMP ou une certification équivalente en gestion ou qualité des données constitue un atout.
  • Une certification de cloud data engineer, par exemple Microsoft ou Databricks, ou une certification DevOps constitue un atout.

Compétences techniques

  • SQL à un niveau expert et modélisation des données, notamment Kimball et/ou Data Vault, SCD et chargements incrémentiels.
  • Expérience des processus ETL/ELT et du traitement batch, ainsi que de SAS 9.4, notamment Base SAS, Enterprise Guide et DI Studio.
  • Expérience pratique avec Azure Data Factory et PostgreSQL.
  • Maîtrise de Python et expérience de GitHub pour le versionnage, les stratégies de branchement, les revues de code et la CI/CD.
  • Connaissance d'Azure Synapse Analytics.
  • Automatisation des tests et utilisation d'outils de contrôle de la qualité des données, tels que les tests dbt ou des solutions équivalentes.
  • Surveillance et alertes des processus de traitement des données.
  • Connaissance de SAS Visual Analytics, Power BI et/ou Apache Superset, ainsi que du principe d'une couche sémantique.
  • Une expérience avec dbt, Docker et Azure constitue un atout.
  • Utilisation efficace de Jira ou Azure Boards.

Compétences personnelles

  • Esprit analytique, rigueur et sens aigu de la qualité.
  • Excellentes aptitudes de communication, avec la capacité de clarifier des demandes imprécises et d'échanger avec des interlocuteurs techniques et non techniques.
  • Organisation, pragmatisme et intérêt pour l'automatisation.
  • Esprit d'équipe et volonté de partager ses connaissances.
  • Autonomie, proactivité et orientation résultats dans un environnement public complexe.
  • Connaissance du néerlandais ou du français, compréhension de l'autre langue nationale et connaissance fonctionnelle de l'anglais.
  • Disponibilité à temps plein.

📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Voor een publiek digitaliseringsprogramma zoekt een ontwikkelteam een data engineer met een specialisatie in BI en DevOps. Het programma wil de verwerking van boetes versnellen, de administratieve werklast in de strafrechtketen verminderen, informatieverwerking digitaliseren en de dienstverlening aan burgers verbeteren.

Het project

De opdracht omvat twee luiken rond de digitale verwerking van verkeersovertredingen:

  • de automatisering van de buitengerechtelijke afhandeling van lichte verkeersovertredingen;
  • de opvolging van dossiers die vallen onder artikel 67ter van de Wegverkeerswet.

Het eerste luik verwerkt dossiers volgens een opeenvolgende procedure met een eerste betalingsvoorstel, een minnelijke schikking, een bevel tot betaling en indien nodig een uitvoerbaarverklaring of een certificaat voor invordering in het buitenland. Dossiers, documenten, termijnen en vervolgacties moeten traceerbaar blijven. Belangrijke beslissingen, zoals betwistingen en eventuele dagvaardingen, blijven bij de bevoegde personen.

Het tweede luik betreft de verplichting van een rechtspersoon om de identiteit van de werkelijke bestuurder van een voertuig dat bij een verkeersovertreding betrokken was, mee te delen. Bij niet-identificatie kan een minnelijke schikking worden voorgesteld. Het project wil de identificatiegraad verhogen, een consistente dossieropvolging verzekeren en recidive beter in kaart brengen.

Een derde pilootproject ging op 10 december 2025 van start met 50 dossiers. De geplande stappen voor het tweede en derde kwartaal van 2026 omvatten het uitsturen van bevelen tot betaling en een integratie met het dossierbeheersysteem. Een latere integratie met het financiële systeem wordt voorzien, maar heeft momenteel nog geen concrete timing door afhankelijkheden tussen de verschillende systemen.

📝 Jouw profiel

Als data engineer met een sterk DevOps-profiel voor BI maak je deel uit van het ontwikkelteam. Je vormt de brug tussen standaarden, richtlijnen en informatiebehoeften van de business enerzijds en de technische uitvoering anderzijds.

Je vertaalt behoeften naar duidelijke requirements, bewaakt de datakwaliteit doorheen de volledige keten en zorgt ervoor dat data van bron tot rapport betrouwbaar, controleerbaar en reproduceerbaar is. Je werkt met de bestaande omgeving, waaronder SAS, en denkt mee over de evolutie van het dataplatform.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

Requirements en standaarden: brugfunctie

  1. Standaarden en richtlijnen voor architectuur, informatieveiligheid, GDPR en interne IT-beleidslijnen vertalen naar concrete functionele en technische requirements voor datastromen en rapportering.
  2. Samen met de Product Owner en functionele analisten informatiebehoeften verzamelen en uitwerken in user stories met duidelijke acceptatiecriteria.
  3. Gegevensdefinities en KPI's eenduidig vastleggen met een datawoordenboek en semantische laag.
  4. Aanspreekpunt zijn voor data- en BI-vragen en afstemmen met developers, architecten, testers en stakeholders.

Datakwaliteit

  1. Regels voor datakwaliteit opstellen, automatiseren en opvolgen, onder meer voor volledigheid, juistheid, tijdigheid en consistentie.
  2. Controles in laadprocessen inbouwen, afwijkingen detecteren en opvolgen tot ze opgelost zijn.
  3. Data lineage, datamodellen, datastromen en processen documenteren.
  4. Rapporteren over datakwaliteit aan het team, de Product Owner en het management.

BI DevOps

  1. CI/CD opzetten en beheren voor datapijplijnen, datamodellen en rapporten, met versiebeheer, code reviews, geautomatiseerde tests en gecontroleerde releases in ontwikkel-, test- en productieomgevingen.
  2. Monitoring en alerting inrichten voor batchprocessen en dataladingen.
  3. Quality gates voor datacode en rapporten mee bewaken.
  4. Release- en wijzigingsbeheer ondersteunen en incidenten mee oplossen.

Data engineering

  1. ETL- en ELT-processen ontwikkelen en onderhouden.
  2. Een betrouwbare publicatielaag voorzien voor BI-tools, waaronder SAS Visual Analytics, Power BI en Apache Superset.
  3. Meedenken over de evolutie van het dataplatform en de logica waar zinvol tool-onafhankelijk maken.
  4. Data voorbereiden voor toekomstige AI-toepassingen door datasets goed te documenteren en veilig toegankelijk te maken.

Governance en compliance

  1. Bijdragen aan de traceerbaarheid van data, beslissingen, code en testen volgens de vereisten voor interne controle en audit.
  2. Bijdragen aan de naleving van informatieveiligheid, GDPR en toegangsbeheer van bron tot rapport.

Vereiste kwalificaties en vaardigheden

Opleiding en ervaring

  • Master- of bachelordiploma in ICT of een vergelijkbare richting, of gelijkwaardige ervaring.
  • Minstens 5 jaar relevante ervaring in data engineering, datawarehousing of BI, waarvan minstens 2 jaar in een ontwikkelteam dat CI/CD gebruikt.
  • Aantoonbare ervaring met het vertalen van business- en kwaliteitsbehoeften naar datarequirements en acceptatiecriteria.
  • Ervaring met het opzetten en opvolgen van datakwaliteitscontroles.

Certificeringen

  • Een DAMA CDMP-certificering of gelijkwaardige certificering in databeheer of datakwaliteit is een pluspunt.
  • Een certificering als cloud data engineer, bijvoorbeeld Microsoft of Databricks, of een DevOps-certificering is een pluspunt.

Technische kennis

  • SQL op expertniveau en datamodellering, waaronder Kimball en/of Data Vault, SCD en incrementele loads.
  • Ervaring met ETL/ELT-processen en batchverwerking, evenals met SAS 9.4, waaronder Base SAS, Enterprise Guide en DI Studio.
  • Praktische ervaring met Azure Data Factory en PostgreSQL.
  • Goede kennis van Python en ervaring met GitHub voor versiebeheer, branching-strategieën, code reviews en CI/CD.
  • Kennis van Azure Synapse Analytics.
  • Testautomatisering en tooling voor datakwaliteit, zoals dbt-tests of een gelijkwaardige oplossing.
  • Monitoring en alerting van dataprocessen.
  • Kennis van SAS Visual Analytics, Power BI en/of Apache Superset en van het principe van een semantische laag.
  • Ervaring met dbt, Docker en Azure is een pluspunt.
  • Vlot werken met Jira of Azure Boards.

Competenties

  • Analytisch en nauwkeurig, met een sterk gevoel voor kwaliteit.
  • Sterke communicatievaardigheden en het vermogen om onduidelijke vragen scherp te krijgen en te schakelen tussen technische en niet-technische gesprekspartners.
  • Gestructureerd en pragmatisch, met een automatiseringsreflex.
  • Teamgericht en bereid om kennis te delen.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en resultaatgericht binnen een complexe overheidsomgeving.
  • Kennis van het Nederlands of het Frans, begrip van de tweede landstaal en functionele kennis van het Engels.
  • Fulltime beschikbaarheid.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Vous pouvez compter sur un salaire attractif, complété par des avantages extra-légaux, y compris une voiture de société.

jobs.excerpt: About DoitWe are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more.
jobs.description:
About Doit

We are focused on reinventing how people spend, save, invest, exchange, travel, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and become an expert at ease. We believe AI will help make finance smart, assessible and safe.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few. We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future for our society.

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

The Role

Doit builds technology products used by millions of users across Southeast Asia. As our products and systems scale, we need technical leaders who can solve difficult engineering problems and raise the engineering bar around them.

The Principal Software Engineer owns technical direction and execution for major products and systems. This is a hands-on role - you will design systems, write code, and drive critical engineering work from idea to production.

What You'll Own

  • Owning technical design and execution for major products, systems and engineering initiatives.

  • Designing scalable, reliable systems across backend, frontend, APIs, databases and infrastructure.

  • Building alongside the team through coding, prototyping, code reviews, debugging and production problem-solving.

  • Driving architecture decisions and trade-offs across speed, scalability, reliability, cost and maintainability.

  • Turning ambiguous product problems into clear technical solutions and execution plans.

  • Raising engineering quality through stronger system design, testing, security, observability and development practices.

  • Leading technically critical initiatives and mentoring engineers across teams.

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience building and shipping production systems.

  • Deep expertise in backend, frontend, distributed systems, APIs, databases or cloud infrastructure.

  • Strong system design and architecture skills for complex or high-scale systems.

  • Strong coding ability and willingness to remain hands-on.

  • Track record of technically leading major engineering projects from design through production.

  • Ability to make sound technical trade-offs, influence engineers and solve complex production problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling engineering teams, systems or development practices through significant growth.

  • Experience operating across multiple products, markets or countries.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Smart Suites is redefining hospitality in Australia. From a handful of Brisbane homes in 2024, we've grown to managing 100+ short-term vacation rentals across Rocklea, Sunnybank, Acacia Ridge, Carina, and Kuraby, Queensland.

Guided by our core values—Customer Obsession, Ownership, Curiosity, Humility, Efficiency, and Teamwork (COCHET)—we use technology, automation, and operational discipline to deliver exceptional guest experiences. Every stay we host is clean, comfortable, and personalized.

Now, we're expanding our offshore operations team in the Philippines to support this growth.

Why Join Us

The Role

As our Property Services and Cleaning Associate, you'll play a key role in keeping our properties safe, functional, clean, and guest-ready at all times.

You'll be responsible for coordinating maintenance and repair tasks, supporting recurring exterior and common-area upkeep, and assisting with selected cleaning operations across our portfolio. This includes working closely with vendors, cleaners, contractors, logistics, and internal operations teams to ensure tasks are completed on time, to standard, and with accurate documentation.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and confident managing multiple moving parts in a fast-paced hospitality environment.

What You'll Do

  • Maintenance Coordination: Oversee repair and maintenance jobs, including guest-caused damage and general wear-and-tear issues
  • Vendor & Contractor Management: Coordinate with vendors, handymen, cleaners, suppliers, and third-party property managers to ensure timely completion of work
  • Purchase Order Processing: Create and manage purchase orders for repairs, replacements, and cleaning-related services
  • Property Upkeep Scheduling: Coordinate recurring services such as lawn mowing, bin movement schedules, and common area cleaning
  • Progress Tracking & Reporting: Maintain accurate job records, updates, timelines, and completion statuses across all tasks
  • Cleaning Operations Support: Help organize cleaning inspections, confirm schedules, monitor service quality, and support escalations when needed
  • Virtual Quality Checks: Conduct virtual inspections to verify work quality and confirm standards are met
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Work closely with logistics, operations, vendors, and service providers to keep properties running smoothly

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience in property coordination, maintenance scheduling, cleaning operations, or similar operational support roles
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks, follow-ups, and deadlines
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills
  • Comfortable working with vendors, cleaners, contractors, and internal teams
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to timely, accurate work
  • Comfortable using digital tools and task-tracking systems such as Zoho, Trello, Monday.com, or similar platforms
  • Tech-savvy, dependable, and proactive in identifying and resolving issues
  • Able to work with urgency while maintaining quality and accuracy

Engagement Details

  • Type: Independent contractor (PH offshore)
  • Compensation: AUD 1,500 – 1,700/month
  • Schedule: Full-time, AU shift, Flexible within business operating hours of 5:00 AM – 10:00 PM PH time
  • Time Tracking: All contractors use Hubstaff for time and productivity tracking to ensure accuracy and transparency in work.

Selection Process

  • Initial Interview (30 to 45 minutes): An initial conversation to learn about your background, experience, and professional goals. You'll also have the chance to ask questions about the engagement and the client.
  • Technical Live Assessment (60 to 90 minutes): This stage evaluates your practical capabilities in sales outreach, lead qualification, and virtual negotiations, using real-world scenarios relevant to the scope of services.
  • Behavioral Interview (60 minutes): Focuses on your communication style, cultural alignment, and how you build trust and relationships in a remote business environment.
  • Pre-Engagement Steps (10 - 15 minutes)
    • IT Audit: To ensure compliance with technology standards and security protocols.
    • Reference Check: We will contact your provided professional references to verify your history and capabilities.
  • Meet the Founder (30 to 60 minutes): A welcoming conversation where you'll connect directly with the company's founder. This is your chance to discuss engagement terms, share your own goals, and ask any final questions. You'll also get an inside look at the company's vision, culture, and exciting growth plans for the future.

Ready to join a fast-growing, values-driven hospitality brand?

Click Apply Now and become part of Smart Suites.

About Agile Defense

At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.
Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.
Requisition #: 1985
Job Title: Contracts Manager
Location: Remote to McLean, VA
Salary Range: $105,000 - $115,000

SUMMARY

We are seeking a full time Contracts Manager to provide contracts management support on Federal Government Prime Contracts and Subcontracts, working with functional leads across Operations, Finance, Accounting, Security, Pricing, Procurement, and other teams. The ideal candidate will have experience in negotiating contract artifacts such as Non-Disclosure Agreements, Teaming Agreements, Prime Contracts and Subcontracts, and will work with teams to build, refine, and implement processes that ensure continued compliance and effectiveness.

JOB DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the primary interface with Contracting Officers and prime teaming partners, building relationships and effectively communicating to drive contract compliance.
  • Negotiate and support internal understanding of contractual terms and conditions, ensuring favorable positions and outcomes for the company.
  • Work across functional teams to ensure the contract is performed in accordance with contractual and legal requirements, customer specifications, and government regulations.
  • Collaborate with Finance and Operations to proactively monitor contract funding and timely notify the Government and Prime Contractors of limitations of funds.
  • Ensure company risk associated with funding shortfalls is properly mitigated through ATP and contract funding requests and tracking.
  • Document key contract data for company files, processes, and requests for information, including participating in workflows with other functions to develop contract briefs and other records as appropriate.
  • Serve as a resource and escalation point for Operations and other teams as issues related to contracts arise.
  • Operate as an internal partner and subject matter expert to support the company in navigating complex contract challenges and opportunities.

SUPERVISORY DUTIES

  • This is a non-supervisory position.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education, Background, and Years of Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree, with focus in Business Administration, Contracts Management, Finance, or related field preferred.
  • Experience: Minimum 5 years in contracts or legal profession.

ADDITIONAL SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS

Required Skills

  • Experience in reviewing, editing, and compliant execution of contract agreements.
  • Experience managing the full lifecycle of contracts, including pre-award, award, execution, and closeout.
  • Ability to advise program team of contractual issues/opportunities and impacts of contract terms and conditions and flow down requirements.
  • Demonstrated ability to multi-task, effectively prioritize, and meet deadlines.
  • Demonstrated experience interpreting and identifying appropriate FAR/DFARs requirements.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, and strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to identify and implement new ideas to streamline and improve business processes across contracts and other functions.
  • Ability to foster relationships both internally within the company and externally with Contracting Officers and prime contracts POCs.

Preferred Skills

  • Ability to effectively negotiate contract terms and conditions to maintain preferable outcomes and positive relationships.
  • Ability to juggle competing priorities and utilize time management techniques to meet deadlines and complete tasks.
  • Strong interpersonal skills, with ability to communicate effectively and demonstrate teamwork and flexibility.
  • Certified Federal Contracts Manager (CFCM) or equivalent certification desired.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Environmental Conditions

  • Position is remote

Strength Demands

  • Sedentary – 10 lbs. Maximum lifting, occasional lift/carry of small articles. Some occasional walking or standing may be required. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally, and all other sedentary criteria are met.

Physical Requirements

  • Stand or Sit; Walk; Repetitive Motion; Use Hands / Fingers to Handle or Feel; Stoop, Kneel, Crouch, or Crawl

Our Core Values

Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together.
What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together, these values infuse vibrancy, integrity, and a tireless work ethic into advancing the most important national security and critical civilian missions. It's how we show up every day. At Tilt, we're constantly exploring new ways to understand financial behavior and reduce risk. The work you do in this role will go directly into the foundational models we're building for our products.

We're looking for a Senior Data Scientist to join our Methodologies group — a role focused on building and advancing foundational modeling approaches. You'll build and test deep learning methods such as transformers to improve how we understand financial data and make lending decisions.

This is a great role for someone who's deeply curious about new modeling techniques and wants to see their ideas make a real difference. You'll work with a small, experienced team of data scientists and engineers, taking projects from first idea to working model on financial data challenges — from credit decisioning to customer behavior!

You'll also be at the forefront of how data science is practiced in the age of AI agents. Our team builds with agentic tools every day, and you'll use them in your own work and help build the specialized agents that speed up both DS and business workflows.

We're looking for someone who enjoys learning, experimenting, and collaborating — a person who can connect technical exploration to meaningful business impact. If you're excited by applying new methodologies in ways that help people access fairer credit, you'll fit right in.

How you'll make an impact

  • Build, train and evaluate deep learning models on Tilt's financial data.

  • Ship models and model components that plug into Tilt's existing ML pipelines to improve credit modeling and loss prediction.

  • Own your projects end to end, from hypothesis to a model in use, with general direction from the team's leads.

  • Work closely with data scientists, engineers, and product partners to turn your results into practical solutions.

  • Run representation learning experiments — including pretraining and fine-tuning — on real financial data, with a clear design up front and an honest read on what worked.

  • Share findings and help peers pick up new deep learning methods.

  • Measure the impact of your models not just by accuracy, but by how they improve outcomes for Tilt's customers and partners.

  • Use agentic development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex) to speed up experimentation, feature engineering and model iteration.

  • Build and improve specialized agents that support DS workflows.

Why you're a great fit

  • Hands-on experience building and training deep learning models

  • Comfort working with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar).

  • Experience applying ML to real-world problems, ideally in financial services (credit, lending, payments, or banking).

  • Experience taking a project from an open question to a measurable business outcome.

  • Clear, thoughtful communication — you can explain technical ideas in ways others can engage with.

  • Bonus: hands-on experience building with LLMs or agent frameworks, or excitement to learn. You see agents as a way to multiply what a small, senior team can do.

We're in this together, working to expand access to fair credit and prove that people are incredible. When you join us, it's not just another day at the [virtual] office, you're helping millions of hardworking people reach better financial futures.

The DevOps Engineer’s roles and responsibilities are multifaceted, requiring technical agility and operations mindset simultaneously.   • Maintain infrastructure-as-code practices (e.g., using Terraform).
  • Monitor and troubleshoot pipeline failures, notebook issues, and deployment inconsistencies.
  • Collaborate with Data Engineers and Platform teams to maintain development, staging, and production environments.
  • Implement best practices for version control, testing, and notebook promotion in a multi-environment setup.
  • Store and manage Databricks secrets, tokens, and configuration securely within Azure Key Vault and DevOps variable groups.
  • Understand and apply DevOps practices in a data platform context.

Position Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of experience in DevOps engineering or a related role, with a focus on Microsoft Azure, including other cloud-based data integration and associated technologies.
  • Proficiency with data analytics and AI platforms and automating notebook execution.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages for automation and various programming.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is$138,000 to $182,000 and reflects the range of experience and qualifications we may consider.   • Time Off & Leave – 20 PTO days, 7 paid holidays, and 1 floating day to make your own, and paid parental leave
  • Wellness & Growth – Work life assistance resources, physical wellness perks, mental health support, employee referral program, and BenefitHub for employee discounts

About Monogram Health

Monogram Health is a leading multispecialty provider of in-home, evidence-based care for the most complex of patients who have multiple chronic conditions. Monogram health takes a comprehensive and personalized approach to a person’s health, treating not only a disease, but all of the chronic conditions that are present - such as diabetes, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, heart failure, depression, COPD, and other metabolic disorders.

Monogram Health employs a robust clinical team, leveraging specialists across multiple disciplines including nephrology, cardiology, endocrinology, pulmonology, behavioral health, and palliative care to diagnose and treat health issues; review and prescribe medication; provide guidance, education, and counselling on a patient’s healthcare options; as well as assist with daily needs such as access to food, eating healthy, transportation, financial assistance, and more. Monogram Health is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and on holidays, to support and treat patients in their home.

Monogram Health’s personalized and innovative treatment model is proven to dramatically improve patient outcomes and quality of life while reducing medical costs across the health care continuum.

About the Role

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

As Lead Engineer, Machine Learning, you own the execution layer of our intelligence, turning research and model capabilities into reliable, scalable production systems.

You will work across the model lifecycle: data, training, evaluation, inference, and deployment. This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who wants to operate at the intersection of research, systems, and product.

What You'll Own

  • Own the end-to-end ML systems powering our company, from data and training to evaluation, inference, and deployment.

  • Build and evolve training and fine-tuning pipelines for large models.

  • Design evaluation systems that measure capability, robustness, safety, and real-world product performance.

  • Architect high-performance inference systems, optimizing latency, GPU utilization, memory, cost, and reliability.

  • Build data pipelines and systems for high-quality real-world and synthetic training data.

  • Establish reliable production infrastructure for deploying, monitoring, and continuously improving models.

  • Partner closely with research and application engineering to turn model capabilities into product improvements.

  • Make pragmatic technical trade-offs and rapidly iterate based on real-world performance.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience building and shipping ML systems used in production, not just research prototypes.

  • Strong understanding of modern large-model training, fine-tuning, evaluation, and inference.

  • Strong software engineering and systems fundamentals.

  • Experience operating ML workloads at meaningful scale, particularly GPU-based systems.

  • Strong technical judgment and the ability to navigate ambiguous problems independently.

  • A bias toward experimentation, measurement, and shipping.

  • High standards for correctness, reliability, and production quality.

Outcomes

  • Research and models reliably translate into production-ready solutions with clear performance and quality targets.

  • ML pipelines, training loops, and inference systems are stable, efficient, and maintainable.

  • Production issues are detected, debugged, and resolved quickly, minimizing user impact.

  • Team members are supported, aligned, and able to deliver high-impact ML work with minimal friction.

  • Iterations on models and systems are measurable, safe, and improve user experience over time.

Tech Stack

  • Python

  • PyTorch / JAX

  • GPU-based training and inference system

Ideal Experience

  • You have built or shipped real ML systems used by people, not just demos.

  • You are comfortable working with large models and understanding their failure modes.

  • You write strong, production-grade code and care about system correctness.

How We Work

We are a small, high-talent-density, hands-on team. Engineers have broad ownership and are expected to exercise strong judgment and execute independently.

We make decisions quickly, work closely together, and balance speed with engineering fundamentals. We care less about process and more about building something exceptional.

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 3, but no more than 4 interviews.

Applications are evaluated by our technical team members. Interviews will be conducted via virtual meetings and/or onsite.

We value transparency and efficiency, so expect a prompt decision. If you've demonstrated the exceptional skills and mindset we're looking for, we'll extend an offer to join us. This isn't just a job offer; it's an invitation to be part of a team that's bringing AI to have practical benefits to billions globally.

About Irth

Irth develops SaaS solutions for utility damage prevention and infrastructure risk management. Gas, electric, telecommunications, and pipeline operators across the United States and Canada rely on our products—including UtiliSphere, DigTix, Insights, Borealis, and Stake Center—to protect critical infrastructure.

Because our customers operate critical infrastructure, they expect strong security practices and adherence to rigorous security standards.

We are seeking a hands-on Cybersecurity Lead to strengthen and oversee Irth's security program. This individual will serve as both a cybersecurity practitioner and policy leader, partnering closely with engineering, infrastructure, IT, GRC, and executive leadership.

The ideal candidate can translate security findings into actionable remediation, lead incident response, establish security standards, and clearly communicate Irth's security posture to customers and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1. Vulnerability Management & Remediation

  • Own the triage and prioritization of security findings from SAST tools, infrastructure security assessments, penetration tests, and newly disclosed CVEs.
  • Assess risk and severity, establish remediation priorities, and assign ownership and deadlines.
  • Partner directly with engineering and infrastructure teams to resolve vulnerabilities through patching, configuration changes, dependency upgrades, and resource decommissioning.
  • Integrate security findings into engineering work management systems, ensuring every finding has an assigned owner, tracking ticket, and target remediation date.
  • Report remediation progress, outstanding risks, and security trends to IT, engineering, and executive leadership.
  • Provide appropriate vulnerability and remediation updates to customers.

2. Incident Response & Security Communications

  • Lead security incident response from initial detection and investigation through containment, remediation, and post-incident review.
  • Coordinate urgent vulnerability and CVE responses across technical teams.
  • Establish and manage incident communications, including internal status updates, executive briefings, and Customer Experience talking points.
  • Prepare accurate, timely customer-facing communications regarding potential exposure, remediation status, and detection activities.
  • Maintain incident response runbooks and on-call escalation procedures.
  • Conduct regular incident response tabletop exercises.

3. Cloud, Identity & Access Security

  • Own cloud security posture across AWS and Microsoft Azure, including account structure, security guardrails, and continuous monitoring.
  • Establish and enforce identity and access management policies covering:
    • Least-privilege access
    • Role-based access and permissions
    • Session duration and expiration
    • Multi-factor authentication (MFA)
    • Privileged access management
    • Employee and contractor onboarding, transfers, and offboarding
  • Manage and strengthen identity controls across Microsoft Entra ID and AWS IAM.
  • Conduct regular access reviews for employees, contractors, and third-party vendors.
  • Identify and remediate excessive permissions, inactive accounts, and access control gaps.

4. Security Policy, Compliance & Customer Trust

  • Develop, maintain, and enforce corporate security policies, standards, and procedures aligned with NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) and ISO 27001.
  • Own the technical security controls supporting SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 compliance.
  • Partner with Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) teams on audit readiness, evidence collection, and remediation of control gaps.
  • Monitor regulatory and industry requirements affecting critical infrastructure customers, including:
    • TSA pipeline security directives
    • NERC CIP-related customer security expectations
    • Applicable Canadian privacy legislation
  • Translate applicable regulatory and customer requirements into practical technical security controls.
  • Lead technical responses to customer security questionnaires in partnership with GRC.
  • Represent Irth's cybersecurity program during customer security reviews and calls.
  • Manage third-party penetration testing engagements and security vendors.
  • Support cybersecurity due diligence for acquisitions.

Role Expectations

This is a hands-on leadership role requiring both technical execution and program ownership. The successful candidate will be expected to:

  • Drive security findings through resolution rather than simply identify risks.
  • Establish accountability and measurable remediation timelines.
  • Work effectively across engineering, infrastructure, IT, GRC, and executive teams.
  • Balance security risk, business priorities, and operational requirements.
  • Communicate technical security issues clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Build customer confidence through a mature, transparent, and well-managed security program.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in cybersecurity engineering or security operations, including at least 3 years leading a security program or function, preferably within a SaaS organization.
  • Hands-on cloud security experience across AWS and Microsoft Azure, including:
    • Identity and Access Management (IAM)
    • Cloud network security controls
    • Security logging, monitoring, and audit trails
    • AWS CloudTrail and Microsoft Entra sign-in and audit logs
    • Cloud security posture management tools such as Wiz
  • Demonstrated experience owning vulnerability management end to end, including identifying, triaging, prioritizing, assigning, tracking, and driving remediation in partnership with engineering teams.
  • Proven experience leading security incident response, including delivering clear, timely written communications to executive leadership and customers during high-pressure situations.
  • Working knowledge of SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, and NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF), including experience serving as a key technical control owner through at least one SOC 2 Type II audit.
  • Ability to review and interpret application code, infrastructure-as-code (IaC), and Linux and Windows server configurations to evaluate security risks and validate remediation approaches.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, sound technical judgment, and the ability to distinguish between issues requiring immediate escalation and those that can be resolved through routine remediation.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting utilities, pipelines, energy providers, or other critical-infrastructure customers, including familiarity with TSA pipeline security directives or NERC CIP requirements.
  • Familiarity with Canadian privacy requirements, including Quebec's Law 25.
  • Experience securing AI-enabled and agent-based development workflows or implementing security controls for LLM-powered SaaS product features.
  • Experience conducting cybersecurity due diligence or supporting security integration activities related to mergers and acquisitions.
  • Relevant industry certifications, such as:
    • Certified Information Systems

AI Use in Hiring
