You will own scope, timelines, budget, communication, and adoption so clients realize value from their investment.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead discovery with client stakeholders to understand business goals, workflows, priorities, and success measures
  • Translate client needs into a practical project plan with clear scope, outcomes, milestones, roles, timelines, and budget
  • Own implementation and integrated-solution delivery from kickoff through adoption; manage decisions, risks, dependencies, timelines, and budget to keep work on track. Monitor Professional Services outcomes, including Time-to-Value, CSAT, Budgeted Delivered Hours, realization, and utilization, and take action when performance is off plan
  • Align internal teams, including Data Migration and Data Integration resources and client stakeholders around priorities, responsibilities, and delivery commitments
  • Partner with client stakeholders and data specialists to map, transform, and validate data from multiple sources so it supports the client's business processes in Unanet
  • Recommend and configure the solution to meet client objectives, applying industry best practices, product knowledge, and business acumen
  • Drive clear, timely collaboration and decision-making across internal and external project teams; confirm owners and follow through on commitments
  • Build deep expertise in Unanet's CRM capabilities and explain how product features support the client's goals and workflows
  • Demonstrate the product and design and deliver role-based end-user training that prepares client stakeholders to use the solution, remotely or onsite
  • Identify and resolve complex client escalations promptly, communicating clearly and driving issues to resolution

Your First 90 Days

In your first 30 days, you will complete new-hire orientation, review your onboarding plan, and build relationships with your teammates through one-on-ones. You will set up your demo account, learn the internal tools, attend available training sessions and webinars, and shadow client calls to understand how we lead goal-focused implementations.

In your first 60 days, you will begin owning your first client project with support from your mentor and team. You will continue your onboarding plan, build confidence leading client conversations and project activities, and reach a 25% realization target.

In your first 90 days, you will take full ownership of new projects, lead delivery around client business goals and needs, and demonstrate proficiency in Unanet's features. You will reach a 65% realization target.

About You

  • 3+ years of B2B software implementation experience
  • Strong project management skills, including the ability to set expectations, drive decisions, and hold internal and external teams accountable to deadlines and milestones
  • Exceptional organizational, documentation, and time-management skills
  • Ability to understand strategic business goals and turn them into actionable implementation plans
  • Ability to travel up to 25% annually

Your Differentiators

  • Prior experience in the Architecture, Engineering, or Construction industry
  • Experience implementing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) solutions
  • PMP or similar project-management certification
  • Bachelor's degree

Our Values

  • We are a Team. Employees, customers, and partners working together.
  • We are Customer-Focused. Customers are the heart of everything we do.
  • We are Driven. Seeking exceptional outcomes.
  • We Own our Success. Every employee has a stake in our company.
  • We do the right thing and have fun in the process.

You will be eligible for employee equity as well as discretionary bonus compensation, subject to plans that may be in effect from time to time. You will further be eligible to participate in Unanet's employee benefits plans and programs. For more details on Unanet's benefits offerings, please visit .

As Staff Software Engineer, AI Email App, you own the engineering layer that turns AI capability into a reliable product. You will shape the architecture across backend services, APIs, and client applications, while leading a small team of senior engineers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You stay close to the code, make critical architectural decisions, and ensure the system remains fast, reliable, and coherent as it scales.

  • Partner closely with ML leadership to turn model capabilities into robust, shippable product experiences.

  • Move quickly while keeping the architecture simple, maintainable, and ready to scale.

  • Significant experience leading application or product engineering for complex systems.

  • Experience building AI-powered products or systems that integrate with modern ML/LLM capabilities.

  • Comfortable working across backend and client platforms, with deep expertise in at least one.

jobs.description:
Allara is a comprehensive women’s health provider that specializes in expert, longitudinal care that supports women through every life stage. Trusted by thousands of women nationwide, Allara makes expert healthcare accessible by connecting patients with multidisciplinary care teams that have a deep understanding of hormonal, metabolic, and reproductive care. Allara provides ongoing support for hormonal conditions like PCOS, chronic conditions like insulin resistance, and life stages like perimenopause, helping patients see improved health outcomes. As one of the fastest-growing women’s health platforms in the U.S., Allara is bridging long-overlooked gaps in healthcare for women.

The Opportunity

Allara is hiring its first Director of Data to build the backbone of how the company collects, models, governs, and uses data. Reporting to the VP of Engineering, this is a hands-on leadership role: in your first months you will be in the pipelines yourself, cleaning up our ETL, consolidating duplicated logic, and closing gaps in our source data. Over time you will define and drive the company's longer-term data strategy, set the standards the rest of the organization builds on, and grow the data function as Allara scales. This is a player-coach role, senior enough to own strategy and still happy to get the pipelines right yourself, and the hands-on work comes first.

Location: Hybrid (NYC). We value in-person collaboration and aim for at least three days per week in our NYC office, with flexibility as needed.

Your Impact

  • Make Allara's data trustworthy, so every team can make decisions on numbers they believe.

  • Turn a fragmented, duplicated data setup into one reliable source of truth with traceable lineage.

  • Define the data strategy that lets Allara scale its use of data, from AI-assisted analysis across departments and leveraging health data to drive better outcomes.

  • Build and lead the data engineering function over time.

  • Partner with Product, Growth, Finance, Strategy, and Clinical as the owner of the shared data platform and standards.

Responsibilities

First 6 to 12 months (hands-on)

  • Clean up the pipelines. Audit our existing ETL across Fivetran and Mozart into Snowflake, stabilize reliability and freshness, and fix the brittle parts the business has learned to work around.

  • Consolidate duplication. Collapse duplicated models, metrics, and transformation logic into a single, well-documented modeling layer, so there is one definition of each number rather than several that disagree.

  • Close source-data gaps. Map what we collect against what the business needs and close the gaps across our systems.

  • Make the data trustworthy. Stand up data-quality testing, monitoring, and alerting.

  • Establish one source of truth. Define a canonical metric and semantic layer

Ongoing (strategy and ownership)

  • Own the data strategy. Shape how Allara collects, models, governs, and uses data as the company scales, and advises leadership on tooling, investments, and build-versus-buy decisions.

  • Own governance and compliance. Own data governance, access control, and PHI and PII handling appropriate for a HIPAA-covered healthcare environment.

  • Own the shared platform. Serve departmental stakeholders and data analysts, as the owner of the platform and standards they build on, and enable trustworthy self-serve analytics.

  • Own AI-ready data. Own the shared, AI-ready data layer and the canonical terminology definitions and skills that power AI-assisted analysis across departments.

  • Build the team. Hire, mentor, and lead the data engineering function over time, setting the technical bar and the practices the team works by.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years in data engineering or analytics engineering, including direct, recent ownership of production ETL and warehouse modeling.

  • Strong SQL and a cloud warehouse (Snowflake preferred), ETL tooling, and a transformation and modeling layer.

  • A proven track record of taking over brittle, duplicated, or undocumented pipelines and turning them into reliable, documented, trusted data.

  • Strong data modeling fundamentals and a real bias toward a single source of truth.

  • Experience designing data governance and handling sensitive data, with comfort around security and access control in a regulated environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Healthcare or HIPAA experience, including familiarity with EMR data (FHIR) and claims.

  • Experience with D2C growth metrics

  • Experience with Amplitude and product event taxonomy, and enabling AI or LLM-assisted analytics such as semantic layers, metric catalogs, or Claude skills.

  • Experience building and managing a data team at a high-growth startup (Series B to D).

Having these would be advantageous over candidates lacking these qualifications and would potentially allow the candidate to have a greater and/or more immediate impact on the role.

What Allara Offers

Compensation & Career Growth

  • $220,000-$250,000 with opportunities for advancement

  • Equity

  • Professional development & employee learning programs

Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including but not limited to: candidate experience, location, education, certifications, and skill set. In addition to base salary, our total compensation package includes equity, comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision), generous paid time off, and additional wellness and professional development perks.

Work Environment & Flexibility

  • 100% remote within the U.S./or 3-day hybrid in NYC

  • Unlimited PTO & 11 company holidays/ or L1 offerings

Health & Wellness

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits

  • Health Savings Account (HSA) & Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

  • Long- and short-term disability coverage

  • Annual employee wellness stipend

Family & Future Planning

  • 401(k) plan

  • Parental leave & family planning support benefits

Additional Perks

  • Company-issued laptop

  • Annual work-from-home stipend

  • Commuter benefits (if applicable)

  • A collaborative, mission-driven culture focused on improving patient care

At Allara, we believe in celebrating everything that makes us human and are proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace. We embrace diversity and are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better we can serve our members. We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against candidates or patients based on race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, disability, national origin, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.description:
Wir bei SoSafe haben das Ziel, der führende Anbieter für Human Risk Management Lösungen in Europa zu werden. Cyberkriminalität kostet die Welt jährlich >$10 Billionen, mit steigenden Kosten um 15 % pro Jahr – werde Teil der Lösung und gestalte die Zukunft der Cybersicherheit aktiv mit!

Als Digital Account Executive (m/w/d) wirst du Teil eines dynamischen, ambitionierten und internationalen Teams von Account Executives, das auf Zusammenarbeit, täglichen Wissensaustausch und die kontinuierliche Optimierung von Vertriebsprozessen setzt. Erfolg treibt uns an – und mit unserer offenen, motivierenden Teamkultur macht das Erreichen von Zielen gleich doppelt so viel Freude.

Du baust eigenständig eine starke Sales-Pipeline und ein belastbares Netzwerk auf – denn nachhaltiger Vertrieb beginnt mit deiner eigenen Initiative. Mit deinem Gespür für die Herausforderungen und Bedürfnisse deiner Kunden identifizierst du die richtigen Chancen, positionierst unser Cybersecurity-Angebot überzeugend und präsentierst Lösungen, auf die deine Kunden nicht verzichten können. So erreichst und übertriffst du deine Vertriebsziele.

Teamwork ist entscheidend – du arbeitest eng mit internen Teams wie Customer Success und Partner Managern zusammen, um ein reibungsloses und wirkungsvolles Kundenerlebnis zu gewährleisten. Deine Fähigkeit, Abschlüsse zu erzielen und neues Geschäft voranzutreiben, ist entscheidend für deinen Erfolg und dein Wachstum in dieser Rolle.

So trägst du zum Erfolg bei:

  • Identifikation und Akquise neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten im SMB-Segment am DACH Markt

  • Verantwortung für den gesamten Vertriebszyklus – von der Erstansprache bis zum Abschluss – mit dem Ziel, neue Kunden zu gewinnen und deine Sales-Quote zu erfüllen

  • Aufbau, Qualifizierung und eigenständige Entwicklung neuer Leads zur Sicherstellung einer nachhaltigen und gut gefüllten Sales-Pipeline.

  • Steuerung, Verhandlung und Abschluss von Cross- und Upselling-Potenzialen in enger Kooperation mit Customer Success Managern

  • Aufbau nachhaltiger Beziehungen zu wichtigen Entscheidungsträgern potenzieller Kunden und überzeugende Präsentation des Mehrwerts unserer Cybersecurity-Lösungen

  • Präsentation unseres innovativen Produkts in Online-Demos, persönlichen Meetings und auf Veranstaltungen zur Stärkung des Kundengeschäfts

Was dich auszeichnet:

  • Mindestens 1 Jahr full cycle Sales Erfahrung im SaaS-Vertriebsumfeld in DACH mit mit Fokus auf Neukundengewinnung – idealerweise im SMB-Vertrieb in einem agilen, schnelllebigen Umfeld

  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Ownership – du übernimmst Initiative, bleibst konsequent zielorientiert und bringst Deals mit Disziplin und Nachhaltigkeit zum Abschluss

  • Teamfähigkeit und cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit – du arbeitest eng mit Marketing, Customer Success und Produktteams zusammen, um Kundenbedürfnisse bestmöglich zu adressieren

  • Proaktivität und Eigenverantwortung – du organisierst deine Pipeline selbstständig, setzt klare Prioritäten und handelst lösungsorientiert

  • Anpassungsfähigkeit und Gespür für Prioritäten – du findest dich schnell in einem dynamischen Start-up-Umfeld zurecht und bleibst auch unter Druck fokussiert

  • Lernbereitschaft und Offenheit für Feedback – du nutzt Coaching aktiv zur Weiterentwicklung deiner Vertriebsskills und hinterfragst bestehende Ansätze konstruktiv

  • Sicherer Umgang mit KI-gestützten Vertriebs- und Produktivitätstools – du nutzt KI-Tools wie ChatGPT, Claude oder vergleichbare Lösungen zur Gesprächsvorbereitung, Angebotserstellung und Recherche; du bist vertraut mit KI-gestützten Sales-Tools zur Optimierung deiner Outreach- und Closing-Aktivitäten

  • Erfahrung mit CRM- und Prospecting-Tools – du hast erste Kenntnisse in Salesforce oder HubSpot, LinkedIn Sales Navigator sowie gängigen Sequencing-Tools

  • Bereitschaft zum hybriden Arbeiten – mit regelmäßigen Präsenztagen im Kölner Büro

  • Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt – weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus

Was wir bieten*:

  • Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 33 Tage Urlaub und zusätzliche finanzielle Unterstützung während der Elternzeit

  • Well-being und finanzielle Unterstützung: Zugang zur Open-Up App, Mitarbeiterrabatte, sowie Wellbeing & Fitness Benefits mit Urban Sports Club

  • Verbindung & Gemeinschaft: Virtuelle Events, gemeinsame Teamaktivitäten und Möglichkeiten für lokale Treffen

  • Und vieles mehr: Technische Ausstattung, Empfehlungsprämien, ein individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget, hundefreundliches Büro

*Die oben genannten Vergünstigungen gelten für Vollzeitmitarbeiter und können je nach Standort leicht variieren. Dies ist nur eine Auswahl – mehr erfahren Sie im Verlauf des Bewerbungsprozesses.

Über uns

Wir bei SoSafe haben es uns zur Aufgabe gemacht, die digitale Welt sicherer zu gestalten, indem wir den menschlichen Faktor in der Cybersicherheit in den Mittelpunkt stellen.
Als eines der am schnellsten wachsenden Security-Awareness-Scale-ups weltweit nutzen wir verhaltenswissenschaftliche Erkenntnisse und datengesteuertes Lernen, um Menschen effektiv gegen Cyber-Bedrohungen zu stärken. Unser Human Risk Management-Ansatz unterstützt Unternehmen dabei, ihre Mitarbeiter*innen zum wirkungsvollsten Schutzschild gegen Sicherheitsrisiken zu entwickeln.

Mit der Unterstützung führender VCs wie Highland Europe und Global Founders Capital expandieren wir weltweit in rasantem Tempo. Wir suchen Teamplayer, die sinnvolle Veränderungen im Bereich Cybersicherheit vorantreiben, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit uns wachsen wollen.

Wenn du in einem lebendigen, zielorientierten Umfeld aufblühst, das Innovation, Vielfalt und Zusammenarbeit großschreibt – dann bist du bei uns genau richtig!

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Finance.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Finance app areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Hong Kong. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Hong Kong.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.excerpt: About BJAKThe original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money.
jobs.description:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

BJAK is building a AI Neobank Superapp for Southeast Asia across payments, remittance, insurance, wealth, and trading.

These products move real money. Reliability, regulatory requirements, and third-party financial rails are fundamental to the product - not considerations around the edges.

The Technical Product Lead owns a product vertical end-to-end, from strategy and outcomes through technical design, delivery, and launch.

We are AI-native by default, but AI is a means, not the goal. The bar is knowing where AI genuinely improves an outcome, where deterministic systems must remain in control, and how to build products that are reliable, auditable, and trusted.

What You'll Own

  • Owning a product vertical end-to-end, including strategy, metrics, roadmap, priorities and delivery.

  • Shaping technical design with engineering across APIs, data flows, ledgering, reconciliation, failure handling, security and scalability.

  • Driving trade-offs across correctness, speed, cost, reliability, regulatory requirements and user experience.

  • Building regulatory requirements into the product across KYC, transaction monitoring, limits, privacy and licensing.

  • Applying AI where it improves outcomes, with clear evaluation, safeguards, human oversight and failure handling.

  • Shipping products around external dependencies, including regulatory approvals, financial rails and third-party partners.

  • Aligning Engineering, Design, Compliance, Operations, Treasury and Finance around clear product decisions and launch requirements.

What We're Looking For

  • 5+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex technical products from strategy through production.

  • Strong technical foundation across system architecture, APIs, databases, workflows, failure modes and distributed systems.

  • Experience working closely with engineers and ability to review, challenge and contribute to technical designs.

  • Experience in payments, banking, remittance, insurance, trading or another regulated, high-consequence product domain.

  • Strong product judgment and ability to make difficult trade-offs under technical, regulatory and operational constraints.

  • Experience building with LLMs or AI products, including evaluation, reliability and understanding when AI should not be used.

Nice to have

  • Engineering or highly technical product background.

  • Experience building zero-to-one fintech or consumer products.

  • Experience defining evaluation frameworks for ML or LLM-powered products.

Outcome

  • Clear vertical strategy and legible roadmap

  • Ships fast and clears the gates that actually block launch

  • Money is correct and users are never misled about the state of their funds

  • AI features are valuable, predictable and trusted

  • Trade-offs made deliberately under uncertainty and hold up when challenged

  • Engineering, design, compliance, and operations are aligned with minimal friction

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

  1. Online assessment or practical task

  2. Technical interview

  3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

Who The Client Is: Founded in 2016, our client is a diversified Australian business group headquartered in Cairns, with operations spanning multiple industries, including supermarkets, restaurants, cafes, backpacker accommodation, and transport services.

Built on a foundation of innovation, integrity, and excellence, the group continues to expand its business operations, focusing on sustainable growth, operational efficiency, and delivering quality services across its various ventures.

  • At least 3 years of bookkeeping or accounting experience.
  • Previous experience supporting Australian businesses.

  • Ability to review and organise accounting records and improve existing processes.

This is a fully remote role set up under an Independent Contractor Agreement.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Senior Restoration Engineer, DFIR
Location: Remote (Texas residency required)
Employment Type: Full-Time
Travel: Up to 50%


Help us insure it

Vector3 is Tokio Marine HCC’s cyber services team, a member of the Tokio Marine group of companies. When organizations are hit by ransomware, network intrusions, or destructive malware, Vector3 responds. Our Digital Forensics and Incident Response (DFIR) team helps clients contain the threat, investigate what happened, and return critical operations to service safely. We work alongside client IT teams, managed service providers, legal counsel, and insurance carriers.


Role Overview

Senior Restoration Engineer, DFIR

We are seeking a Senior Restoration Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership for containment, recovery, and restoration on Vector3 Incident Response engagements. Reporting to the Director of Engineering, this engineer will lead the restoration workstream for ransomware, network intrusion, destructive malware, and other cyber incidents. They will help clients bring critical technology services back online while preserving forensic and containment requirements.

This is not a standard infrastructure or disaster recovery role. The successful candidate will assess damaged or compromised environments, build practical restoration plans, direct complex rebuild and recovery work, and validate security controls before systems return to service. They will do this under real-time pressure during active incidents. The Senior Restoration Engineer will work closely with Engagement Managers, forensic consultants, Security Operations Engineers, client IT teams, MSPs, counsel, carriers, and technology vendors, and will provide technical guidance to Restoration Engineers and other delivery resources.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the technical restoration workstream for ransomware, network intrusion, destructive malware, and other cyber incidents, from initial assessment through return to normal operations.
  • Quickly assess the client’s environment, business-critical services, backups, identity systems, network dependencies, and security tooling to define restoration priorities and sequencing.
  • Develop and maintain a practical restoration plan covering dependencies, owners, milestones, risks, and validation requirements.
  • Advise Engagement Managers and clients on safe recovery decisions, including whether a system should stay offline, be rebuilt, be restored from backup, or be replaced.
  • Lead and perform the rebuild and recovery of Windows servers, endpoints, Active Directory, virtualization platforms, core network services, and other critical infrastructure.
  • Support the recovery of Microsoft 365 / Entra ID, file services, DNS, DHCP, VPN, firewalls, remote access, backup platforms, and business-critical applications.
  • Validate backup integrity, coordinate test restores, and establish clean recovery points before production restoration.
  • Guide credential resets, privileged account recovery, domain hardening, segmentation, EDR deployment, and other containment measures.
  • Partner with forensic and security operations teams so that restoration does not compromise evidence or reintroduce a threat actor.
  • Confirm endpoint protection, patching, access controls, logging, and network restrictions are in place before restored systems are reconnected.
  • Serve as a senior technical point of contact for client IT leadership, providing clear status updates, risks, dependencies, and next steps in restoration meetings and executive updates.
  • Maintain accurate restoration records, including systems rebuilt, credentials reset, configurations changed, and validation completed.
  • Develop reusable restoration playbooks, checklists, scripts, and standards that improve the speed, quality, and consistency of Vector3 recovery services.
  • Provide day-to-day technical guidance and quality review for Restoration Engineers, and support scoping, estimation, and solution design for restoration engagements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent professional experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in infrastructure engineering, systems administration, disaster recovery, incident response, or ransomware recovery, including leading complex restoration or recovery work.
  • Advanced hands-on experience administering and recovering Windows Server, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, file services, and related enterprise infrastructure.
  • Strong experience with virtualization platforms such as VMware or Hyper-V, and with backup, replication, and disaster recovery technologies.
  • Working knowledge of network infrastructure and security controls, including firewalls, VPN, routing, segmentation, remote access, and endpoint security tooling.
  • Experience with Microsoft 365 / Entra ID and cloud or hybrid identity environments.
  • Demonstrated experience rebuilding systems, restoring from backup, validating clean recovery points, and troubleshooting complex infrastructure dependencies under time pressure.
  • Ability to participate in rotating after-hours and on-call coverage supporting 24/7/365 Incident Response engagements.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in digital forensics and incident response, managed services, consulting, or another client-service environment.
  • Azure, AWS, or other cloud infrastructure experience.
  • Strong scripting or automation skills using PowerShell or similar tools.
  • Relevant certifications such as Microsoft, VMware, Cisco, CompTIA, GIAC, or vendor certifications in infrastructure, cloud, backup, or incident response.

Core Competencies

  • Restoration Leadership: Ability to own the technical recovery workstream and drive it from assessment to return to service.
  • Infrastructure Depth: Advanced, hands-on command of Windows, identity, virtualization, and backup environments.
  • Secure Recovery Judgment: Ability to balance speed of recovery against containment, evidence preservation, and residual risk.
  • Problem Solving Under Pressure: Ability to find alternative recovery paths when systems, configurations, or backups are unavailable.
  • Client Communication: Ability to lead technical discussions with client IT leaders and executives during high-stress incidents.
  • Technical Mentorship: Ability to guide, review, and raise the quality of work across restoration resources.

Skills & Attributes

  • Sound technical judgment with the ability to make decisions with incomplete information.
  • Ability to manage multiple urgent priorities without losing attention to detail.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in high-pressure environments with frequent interruptions and rapidly changing priorities.
  • Willingness to work extended or irregular hours during active incidents, and to work remotely, at a Vector3 office, or on-site at client locations.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefit package
  • Strong learning culture with ongoing development opportunities
  • Opportunities for growth and career advancement
  • Comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, with eligibility beginning on your first day of employment
  • Basic life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) plan with 6% company match
  • 20 days of PTO and two floating holidays (prorated)
  • Approximately 11 paid holidays and volunteer time off
  • Paid parental leave
  • Access to our award-winning wellness program, including mental health services, fitness network membership, and a complimentary Headspace subscription
  • Student loan matching program
  • Employee discount program
  • An opportunity to do meaningful work and love what you do

About Us

Tokio Marine HCC is a global industry-leading specialty insurance group, backed by the strength and stability of the Tokio Marine Group. Offering over 100 classes of specialty insurance, we empower clients to pursue opportunities confidently through our “Mind Over Risk” philosophy. More than an insurance company, we are an organization built on innovation, unity, and trust.

At our core, we are Always Advancing, driven by innovation and an entrepreneurial spirit that keeps us moving forward. Our people are Experts in Tomorrow, using curiosity and smart working to anticipate what’s next. With a culture rooted in Reaching Out, we foster genuine collaboration and support, ensuring every individual has the opportunity to succeed and make a difference.

Applying our Mind Over Risk philosophy to writing insurance allows our customers to take on opportunity with confidence. That philosophy defines our way of thinking, unites us as a team, and differentiates us from our competitors. We are much more than just an insurance company; we are a good company.

Equal Opportunity Employer

TMHCC is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances.

jobs.description:
Senior Tax Associate | R.D. Barnett PLLC

Compensation$80,000-$105,000, depending on experience, credentials, and demonstrated capabilityStart dateTarget start date of no later than January 5, 2027LocationRemote within approved U.S. work locations

Sharp tax work. An accounting brain. A soft spot for better systems.

Job postings are funny

They are often part wish list, part sales pitch, and part collection of phrases no human has ever used in conversation. That does not tell you what the work feels like, who you will work with, or whether you will actually enjoy being here. We would rather be honest, so here is the real story.

About R.D. Barnett PLLC

R.D. Barnett PLLC is a Seattle-based tax, accounting, and advisory firm founded by Dean Barnett to help entrepreneurs, privately held businesses, and individuals make smarter financial decisions. We work alongside our clients to understand what they are building, how their businesses operate, and how their financial decisions connect.

Our clients include closely held businesses, professional service firms, real estate owners, entrepreneurs, and the individuals and families behind them. Their needs often span business operations, multiple entities, related real estate, and personal tax planning. We connect those pieces so clients can understand their numbers, spot opportunities earlier, and make confident decisions.

A growing focus of our firm is PracticeDen, our veterinary-focused tax, accounting, and advisory service line. We work with independent veterinary practices and their owners, helping them understand their numbers, navigate tax decisions, and build businesses that support their goals. From opening or acquiring a practice to growing an established one or planning a transition, we connect the financial details to the bigger picture. We also continue to serve clients beyond the veterinary industry.

This role has a functional home in Tax and works with accounting, advisory, and client-service teammates across the firm. The goal is bigger than accurate filings. We want the business, related entities, and owner’s individual return to tell one coherent story, with practical advice clients can actually use.

The Role (and Why It’s Interesting)

We are looking for an experienced, hard-working, and self-motivated Senior Tax Associate who can prepare a wide variety of returns, hand off thoughtful, reviewer-ready work, and help us make tax season run a little smarter. You will work across entity and individual clients, often following the numbers across an operating business, related entities and real estate, and the owner’s personal return.

You will own day-to-day execution, workpaper quality, status visibility, and early issue identification. Tax Managers will set technical direction, approve material positions, and help you grow toward greater independence, planning exposure, client leadership, and review responsibility.

Tax preparation is the main event. You will gather information, build workpapers, prepare calculations and returns, support planning, handle e-filing and delivery, research unusual issues, and help resolve notices or other technical projects. In other words: you will do real tax work from beginning to end, not spend your days moving numbers from one box to another without understanding why.

This is also not a stay-in-your-lane-forever role. While traditional accounting work won’t be your primary responsibility, a strong accounting brain is essential. You should be able to read a trial balance, understand the financial statements, reconcile important accounts, propose adjustments, and recognize when the accounting needs attention before a return can move forward. Recurring bookkeeping is not part of this role unless separately assigned and scoped.

As R.D. Barnett grows, this role can grow with it. We do not expect you to know every answer. We do expect you to be genuinely inquisitive with a solution-driven purpose: ask better questions, trace the issue to its source, and move toward a sensible answer. Curiosity about how businesses operate and how tax decisions affect their owners is essential.

What You’ll Actually Do

Make tax work look easy

  • Prepare the returns. All kinds of them. That includes federal, state, and local returns for individuals and closely held entities, with a core mix of Forms 1040, 1065, 1120-S, and 1120. It may also include trusts and estates, related real estate entities, and other returns as assigned.
  • Make review a pleasant experience. Build clean, complete workpapers with clear support, reconciliations, calculations, notes, and tie-outs. Your reviewer should not need detective training to follow your work.
  • Follow the financial trail. Connect business, related-entity, real estate, and individual filings so every related return tells the same story.
  • Bring an accounting brain to the return. Reconcile balance-sheet accounts, retained earnings, fixed assets, basis, owner activity, payroll, sales or excise tax, and other book-to-tax items that are part of the engagement.
  • Know what went into the software. Enter and validate tax data, carryforwards, fixed assets, prior-year items, and current-year activity in UltraTax CS or a comparable platform.
  • Raise your hand early. Spot missing information, inconsistencies, unusual issues, capacity concerns, and potential deadline problems before they become deadline-day surprises.
  • See the process through. Help with extensions, estimates, e-filing, secure delivery, tax notices, and the less-glamorous details that still have to be right.
  • Know when the work has changed. Recognize services outside the agreed scope and bring them to a manager before committing to additional work, fees, or timing.
  • Support planning without freelancing. Identify potential planning opportunities, research assigned questions, document the facts and authority, and bring clear recommendations and unresolved questions to the manager.

Use technology like you mean it

  • Make Excel earn its keep. Build traceable workpapers and useful analyses, clean up data, review trial balances, and propose journal entries without turning the workbook into a haunted house.
  • Pick up new tools quickly. Tax software, workflow platforms, portals, collaboration tools, if it makes the work better, you should be comfortable learning it.
  • Use AI thoughtfully, not blindly. Look for responsible ways to improve research, documentation, data handling, and repetitive workflows. Use only firm-approved systems, protect client information, verify every output, and remain accountable for the final work.
  • Notice when a process is clunky, then improve it. Test practical fixes, document what works, and help us scale without trading accuracy for speed.

Be a great human to work with

  • Keep people out of the dark. Communicate about status, open items, scope, risks, and deadlines before someone has to chase you.
  • Write like a person. Draft clear, professional client emails and explain requests without burying the point in tax jargon.
  • Treat review notes as fuel. Ask thoughtful questions, apply the feedback, and make the next engagement better.
  • Help shape the firm. Contribute to documentation, training, and the systems and habits our growing team will rely on.
  • Work across the team. Coordinate with accounting, advisory, and client-service teammates when the tax return exposes an accounting issue, planning opportunity, or client need.

What You Bring to the Team

The must-haves

  • Real tax experience. You have at least three years of recent public accounting tax experience, including at least two busy seasons owning returns from client intake through reviewer submission. You can prepare a varied return mix, understand what the numbers mean, and deliver work that is truly ready for review.
  • Individual and entity experience. You have meaningful experience with individual and closely held business returns, not just one narrow slice of a return. Trusts and estates are bonus points!
  • A strong accounting brain. You can read financial statements, reconcile accounts, understand journal entries, and trace activity into a tax return without losing the plot.
  • Excel power-user energy. Formulas, lookups, pivot tables, data cleanup, and well-organized workpapers should feel familiar, not frightening.
  • An eye for the tiny things. You catch the transposed number, the missing support, and the line that does not tie before someone else does.
  • AI and automation curiosity. When you see a repetitive process, you naturally wonder whether a robot should be doing the boring part. You are excited to test better ways of working, but you do not hand the robot the keys and walk away. Approved tools, client privacy, professional judgment, and verified outputs are nonnegotiable.
  • Clear communication and sound judgment. You write well, think before you act, and can receive feedback without turning it into a courtroom drama.
  • Busy-season stamina. You are prepared for 55+ hours during the heaviest filing-deadline stretches, typically February through April 15 and September through October 15. We hope that is reserved for the worst of times, not the regular rhythm.
  • Remote-work reliability. You maintain a secure, professional workspace, dependable internet, and availability for Pacific Time collaboration during agreed working hours (typically 10am-2pm PST).
  • Professional references from prior employers, supervisors, or clients.

CPA or Enrolled Agent credential is not required. We value demonstrated capability, sound judgment, and a commitment to continued learning.

Bonus points for:

  • CPA license, EA certification, CPA eligibility, or active progress toward a credential
  • Experience reviewing simpler returns or training less-experienced preparers
  • Tax-tech fluency with UltraTax CS or another professional preparation platform, e-file and portal workflows, or digital delivery tools
  • A useful AI or automation story: something you improved, sped up, or made less painful in a tax or accounting workflow
  • Comfort around the broader accounting stack, such as QuickBooks, Workpapers CS, Practice CS, SurePrep, SafeSend, SharePoint, Notion, Missive, , Gusto, Double, or similar systems
  • Experience with wonderfully complicated owners: closely held businesses, multi-entity structures, real estate, professional service firms, or business owners with interconnected tax needs
  • Multistate, pass-through entity tax, basis, fixed asset, owner compensation, or closely held business planning experience

You’ll probably thrive here if…

  • You keep the details on a short leash. Projects, files, open questions, and deadlines do not mysteriously disappear on your watch.
  • You communicate before people have to ask. A clear update today is better than a heroic explanation tomorrow.
  • You care about service. You want clients and teammates to have a genuinely good experience, and you are willing to take out the trash, literally or figuratively, when that is what helps.
  • You can be trusted. You use discretion, exercise good judgment, and protect sensitive client information as if it were your own.
  • You are genuinely inquisitive with a solution-driven purpose. You ask why, research and test what you do not know, and turn curiosity into a practical next step instead of collecting interesting questions for sport.
  • You own your work. Mistakes happen; hiding them or repeating them is the problem. You speak up, fix the issue, and learn from it.
  • You can handle change. R.D. Barnett is growing, technology keeps moving, and the perfect process may not exist yet.
  • You take the work seriously without taking yourself too seriously. Public accounting is demanding. A sense of humor makes the hard days better.
  • You build momentum as a form of mutual appreciation. You follow through, communicate early, and move work forward because making teammates chase you is nobody’s love language.

How You’ll Know You’re Crushing It

  • Your reviewer can follow your work without a scavenger hunt. Returns tie, support is clear, and avoidable review notes become rare.
  • There are fewer surprises. Missing information, odd activity, planning ideas, scope changes, and potential problems surface early.
  • People trust your follow-through. Client requests make sense, deadlines stay visible, and projects do not vanish into a status-update black hole.
  • The systems get smarter. You adopt new tools thoughtfully and improve processes without weakening accuracy, controls, or confidentiality.
  • The numbers work too. You meet the production, realization, timekeeping, and project-delivery expectations assigned to your role and portfolio.
  • You get better every cycle. Feedback shows up in the next engagement, and your confidence, judgment, and independence keep growing.

The Practical Stuff: Pay, Benefits, and Where You’ll Work

Now, let’s talk about the part of the job everyone scrolls for.

  • Compensation: Full-time, exempt position with a base salary of $80,000-$105,000 annually, depending on experience, credentials, and demonstrated capability.
  • Flexible start: Start date is flexible, with a target start no later than January 5, 2027.
  • Remote work: This is a remote position within U.S. states and localities approved by the firm. Changes in primary work location or regular work from another state or locality require advance approval.
  • Working hours: The role must maintain dependable availability for Pacific Time collaboration, client needs, training, and scheduled team meetings. The heaviest filing-deadline stretches may require 55+ hours, but that should describe the worst of times, not most of the time.
  • Equipment: The firm provides the computer and standard technology equipment needed for the role, including monitors, keyboard, mouse, headset, and related accessories.
  • Medical, dental, and vision: The firm currently pays 100% of the employee premium for its medical plan (BCBS PPO) and dental and vision plans (Delta Dental PPO). Coverage begins on the first day of the month following the employee’s start date. Dependents may be added at the employee’s cost. Benefits remain subject to plan terms.
  • 401(k): The firm currently matches employee contributions up to 3% of eligible pay. Eligibility begins on the employee’s start date, subject to plan terms and the applicable vesting schedule.
  • Paid holidays: Six current firm holidays: New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Thanksgiving Day, the day after Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day, plus four floating holidays. Tax-season blackout dates apply.
  • Vacation: Fifteen vacation days per calendar year, prorated based on the official start date. Vacation is subject to the firm calendar and busy-season blackout periods.
  • Paid sick and safe time: Accrual begins on the first day of employment. The firm uses Seattle’s paid sick and safe time requirements as its minimum standard and applies any more protective law required by the employee’s work location.
  • Volunteer time: Two paid volunteer days.
  • Professional development: Continuing education and growth opportunities, including reimbursement for approved certification, licensing, professional membership, and destination CPE expenses within firm policy.
  • Optional cell-phone coverage: Participation in the firm’s Verizon plan is available under the current cell-phone policy. The firm does not subsidize or reimburse the purchase of the device.
  • Personal tax support: Employees may use firm software to prepare their personal income tax returns and may request reasonable tax guidance from the firm’s principals at no charge, subject to firm policy.

Ready to Join R.D. Barnett?

If you are a strong tax preparer with an accounting mind, a sharp eye, and genuine curiosity about better technology, we would love to hear from you. Bring your judgment, your Excel shortcuts, and your best ideas for making tax work better. We will bring interesting clients, meaningful work, and a team that cares about doing both well!

Our process includes an introductory interview, a practical tax assessment, and a technical conversation with the hiring manager.

Come build something better with us at R.D. Barnett.

How to Apply and How to Stand Out

We will consider complete applications in the following order:

  1. Introductory video: Candidates who submit a thoughtful 30-second to 3-minute introductory video will move to the top of the review list. Tell us who you are, why the role caught your attention, and what you would bring to R.D. Barnett. Production quality is not the point. We want to meet the human behind the resume.
  2. Thoughtful cover letter: Candidates who write a specific, genuine cover letter will be considered next.
  3. Standard application: We will also consider candidates who submit the application without a video or cover letter.

We notice thoughtful follow-up. A respectful LinkedIn message or direct email to a member of our team after applying can help us understand your interest and how you communicate. Please keep it human, specific, and concise.

jobs.excerpt: Introduction Are you committed to community safety?
jobs.description:
Introduction

Are you committed to community safety? We work hard to protect clients, customers, and teammates from fire hazards by installing, maintaining, and inspecting fire suppression systems. Our fire suppression systems ensure uninterrupted operations in businesses you likely visit, and our technicians take pride in their communities, prioritizing safety for all. If you share this passion and commitment, let's talk about how you can join us in our mission and build your future with us!

Position Summary

The Fleet Manager owns both the strategic planning and day to day execution of Marmic's vehicle fleet of approximately 1,200 vehicles operating out of branch locations across the country. This includes vehicle acquisition and lease versus buy strategy, preventive maintenance and driver scheduling, fuel efficiency and cost reduction, DOT and registration compliance, insurance and claims management, fleet safety, and reporting on fleet performance and budgets. The role also owns the accuracy of fleet data across all systems, including Enterprise Fleet Management and the company's Geotab telematics platform. Given the size and geographic spread of the fleet, the role requires strong systems discipline and the ability to coordinate consistent processes across many locations. The Fleet Manager partners closely with Supply Chain, Finance, HR, and branch operations leadership to ensure the fleet supports business needs safely, efficiently, and cost effectively.


Core Responsibilities

The Fleet Manager is accountable for both the strategy and the hands-on execution of each of the following areas:

Vehicle Acquisition & Lifecycle Strategy

  • Develop and execute the company's vehicle acquisition strategy, including lease versus buy analysis, vehicle specification, and replacement cycle planning.
  • Partner with Enterprise Fleet Management and Supply Chain leadership on the purchasing, leasing, and disposal of vehicles to optimize total cost of ownership.
  • Forecast future vehicle needs based on business growth, replacement cycles, and branch requirements, and partner with Supply Chain and Finance leadership on vehicle procurement and capital planning.

Fleet Data & Systems Management

  • Maintain and manage the vehicle status list within Enterprise Fleet Management, ensuring vehicle assignments, in service and out of service status, and vehicle details are accurate and current at all times.
  • Administer the company's Geotab telematics program, including device installation coordination, GPS and diagnostic monitoring, driver behavior reporting, and troubleshooting of device issues.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact with Enterprise Fleet Management and Geotab account representatives, escalating and resolving issues as needed.

Maintenance, Driver Operations & Cost Efficiency

  • Develop and execute a preventive maintenance strategy and scheduling program across the fleet, coordinating repairs to minimize vehicle downtime.
  • Oversee driver scheduling and supervision in coordination with branch leadership, ensuring adequate vehicle availability and coverage across all locations.
  • Develop and execute fuel efficiency and cost reduction strategies across the fleet, monitoring fuel spend and identifying opportunities for savings.

Insurance & Claims Management

  • File and manage all vehicle insurance claims from first notice of loss through final resolution, coordinating with insurance carriers, adjusters, branch managers, and repair vendors.

Minimum Qualifications

Benefits & Perks

Job Title: In-Home Traveler Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant Full Time - Oregon

Job Location: Work at Home, Oregon, United States

We’re building a world of health around every individual — shaping a more connected, convenient and compassionate health experience. At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. Join us and be part of something bigger – helping to simplify health care one person, one family and one community at a time.

Do you have a passion for engaging with people and helping them on their journey to better health? Signify Health, part of CVS Health®, is seeking a Full Time Clinician (Nurse Practitioner or Physician Assistant) to provide In-Home Health Evaluations, engaging with people in the comfort of their own homes and helping bridge gaps in care. In this role, you’ll be primarily traveling - up to 100% of the time - across a defined coverage area, as defined by business needs. This may require overnight hotel stays, car rentals and/or flights, depending on the prescribed coverage area. Holding multiple state licenses will be required, as dictated by business needs.

You’ll play a critical role in building trusted relationships to make people healthier, helping bring flexible, comprehensive and personalized health evaluations right to people’s front doors.

Job highlights

The visit, which lasts about 45 minutes, allows for time to connect one-on-one and answer health questions. It includes a medication and medical history review, a physical evaluation, and, if ordered by the person’s health plan, additional diagnostic tests (i.e., diabetic eye exams, spirometry, etc.). You’ll use an iPad and an intuitive clinical workflow for each evaluation and are not required to prescribe medicine, order lab tests or alter people’s current treatment regimen.

In this role, you will:

  • Bring your heart into every visit, joining a national network of purpose-driven clinicians dedicated to improving health outcomes

  • Be part of our efforts to visit millions of people nationwide with the goal of providing connections to the right care for people’s unique needs

  • Work with Signify Health as a clinician colleague, fulfilling the requirements of the specified role

  • Be flexible to travel locally and within licensed states

  • Conduct virtual visits as needed

  • Provide all Signify Health services as indicated including Diagnostic & Preventive Services products (i.e., spirometry, DEE, bone density screening, etc.)

A Note on Our Work Environment:

As an in-home clinician, your primary workplace is the private residence of health plan members. We are dedicated to meeting health plan members where they are, wherever they call home. These environments are diverse and may present a variety of conditions. Candidates must be able to comfortably and safely perform their duties in homes that may contain household pets, secondhand smoke and other potential airborne allergens or irritants.

Why Clinicians Enjoy Working with Signify Health
“I love seeing health plan members at home. You get a better picture of their health when you see where they live.” - Erica R., PA

At Signify Health, we have the time to help people and to truly listen to their questions and concerns. We can help guide them so they can take better care of themselves. We really can make a change in communities.” - Ali B., NP

I like how Signify Health manages my experience. I’m just doing the clinician part of my job without all the administrative responsibilities. I have the time to provide education so people have a better understanding of their health. I can answer their questions without rushing out the door.” - Andrew K., PA

  • Health, dental and vision insurance

  • Paid time off

  • 401K

  • Supplies and other perks

  • Malpractice coverage

40

Remote – Philippines | Independent Contractor | Project Budget: AUD $2,000, subject to discussion

We are now ready to transform our online presence, and we are looking for an experienced Project-Based Front-End Web Developer to help bring that vision to life.

The Mission

Our current website is hosted on Lodgify's proprietary platform. We are moving to WordPress to create a faster, more flexible, user-friendly, and scalable website that better represents the Smart Suites brand.

This is more than a basic website transfer.

You will help reshape how guests discover our properties, explore their accommodation options, and complete their bookings online. You will be responsible for rebuilding the website in WordPress, integrating the Mews booking widget, preserving our SEO performance, configuring website forms and email delivery, and supporting the website through testing, deployment, and handover.

The finished website must be visually polished, mobile-responsive, secure, search-engine optimized, and easy for our internal team to manage.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Website Migration and WordPress Development

  • Lead the migration of the Smart Suites website from Lodgify to WordPress.
  • Rebuild existing pages, content, navigation, and functionality.
  • Customize WordPress using Elementor or another approved page-building solution.
  • Create reusable templates and components that can support future properties, landing pages, and marketing campaigns.
  • Minimize downtime during migration and launch.

Front-End Development

  • Develop and enhance pages using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and other appropriate front-end technologies.
  • Translate approved designs and content into functional, visually consistent web pages.
  • Ensure the website is fully responsive across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • Ensure compatibility with Chrome, Safari, Microsoft Edge, and Firefox.
  • Resolve layout, functionality, and performance issues identified during testing.

Mews Booking Integration

  • Integrate and configure the Mews booking widget or booking engine.
  • Ensure a smooth guest journey from property discovery to booking completion.
  • Test the booking experience across devices and browsers.
  • Troubleshoot integration errors, script conflicts, tracking problems, and display issues.
  • Coordinate with Smart Suites and Mews support when required.

Forms, Email, and SMTP Setup

  • Build and configure contact, enquiry, newsletter sign-up, and lead-capture forms.
  • Set up SMTP or another reliable email delivery service.
  • Configure automated confirmations, internal notifications, and spam protection.
  • Test all forms and email workflows before launch.
  • Ensure form submissions are handled securely.

SEO Migration

  • Audit the current website's URLs, titles, metadata, headings, images, and indexable pages.
  • Preserve existing URLs wherever practical.
  • Implement 301 redirects for pages with changed URLs.
  • Transfer page titles, meta descriptions, headings, image alt text, and other SEO elements.
  • Generate and submit an updated XML sitemap.
  • Review robots.txt and website indexing settings.
  • Configure Google Analytics, Google Search Console, Google Tag Manager, or existing tracking tools where applicable.
  • Identify and resolve broken links, redirect errors, missing pages, and post-launch indexing issues.

Performance, Security, and Accessibility

  • Optimize images, scripts, stylesheets, caching, and page-loading performance.

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid ​

As a fast-growing, family-founded brand, we are on a mission to make learning meaningful for families around the world.

We are seeking a Director of Recruiting to own how Hadley Designs finds, vets, and closes the growth operators and future leaders who will carry our next phase of growth. If you treat recruiting like a growth problem, love being the face of a brand to candidates, and want the autonomy to run the whole engine, this role is for you.

About Hadley Designs

Hadley Designs is redefining early education with creativity and purpose. Every product we create is hand-drawn and teacher-designed, crafted with care to build confidence and connection. Our screen-free tools help families and teachers make learning fun and meaningful, nurturing curiosity and creativity in children.

Our mission is to design screen-free products that parents can trust to help their children learn, grow, and reach their full potential. Our vision is to build the most trusted children's brand in the world, present in millions of homes, reshaping how families learn, connect, and grow.

Role Overview

As our Director of Recruiting, you will own how Hadley Designs sources, vets, and closes top talent for every open role, from Amazon and ecommerce operators to senior leaders. You will design and run the recruiting engine that consistently delivers a strong top of funnel, put every candidate through a process that shows who they really are, and bring our leadership only the people worth their time.

This is a leadership-tier role with end-to-end ownership of recruiting, from the pipeline to the right people joining our team. A recruiting administrator handles the busy work, so your time goes to meeting candidates, sourcing them, and finding new ways to reach great talent. You will run first-round interviews, including for director-level roles, manage our outside recruiting partners to our standards, and be the face of Hadley Designs for every candidate, so you need to be great on camera and great with people.

Key Responsibilities

  • Recruiting pipeline management. Source candidates outbound and inbound across LinkedIn, Workable, job boards, online communities, referrals, and your own network, and filter applicants for red flags, competency match, and alignment with each role profile.
  • Test project and interview operations. Run our Culture Index step, case studies, and first-round interviews, review submissions, and manage the candidate experience end to end, including for the people we do not hire.
  • Sourcing channel optimization. Manage and optimize sourcing channels based on performance, and build "always hiring" shortlists for recurring high-leverage roles.
  • Outside recruiting partners. Manage our agency partners so every candidate they send follows the same process, and hold them to our terms.
  • New talent channels. Find creative new ways to reach great people, especially in the online communities where they already spend time.
  • Employer brand and reviews. Monitor and manage Glassdoor and Indeed reviews, organize team review drives, ask for feedback, flag issues, and protect our rating.
  • Hiring metrics and funnel reporting. Deliver weekly hiring pipeline reports broken down by channel and role, and track funnel performance against KPIs.
  • Reference checks. Run reference checks, by phone for leadership roles.

How Success Is Measured

  • Average time to fill open roles under 45 days
  • 250 or more qualified applicants per active role per week
  • Weekly hiring pipeline report by sourcing channel, 100% complete and on time
  • 15 or more completed candidate case studies available for review per role per week
  • A Glassdoor company rating of 4.5 or higher across the year, with Indeed tracked beside it
  • An interview and recruiting experience candidates rate highly, including the people we do not hire

Requirements

Who You Are

You are a recruiting-strong, systems-oriented leader. You have personally closed difficult hires, not just managed a team that did. You move fast in a sourcing pipeline, you can run a structured interview that lands the right read on a candidate in 30 minutes, and you are as comfortable pitching a role on camera as you are defending the company on Glassdoor. You look at people the way a growth marketer looks at growth, and you want the autonomy to run the whole engine.

You Have

  • 3 to 5+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience, ideally in remote or ecommerce organizations; agency recruiting experience is a big plus
  • A proven track record of hiring across marketing, operations, Amazon, ecommerce, product, and leadership roles
  • Confidence and presence on camera, and comfort representing a brand to candidates
  • Experience running structured interviews, test projects, and case studies
  • Outbound sourcing experience, and expert-level LinkedIn and Workable skills
  • Real creativity in tapping online communities to find talent in unusual places
  • AI capability, a CRM and documented SOPs. You use AI every day to get more done with less, which is a must-have here and a capability rather than any one tool, and you have a clear view of how all three make recruiting faster and better now and going forward
  • Strong writing ability, from clear job posts to compelling outreach and direct candidate communication
  • The ability to handle 5 to 10 active roles at a time with no drop-off in process
  • Experience building and running reporting for hiring metrics
  • Experience managing outside recruiting agencies

Benefits

Why You'll Love Working Here

Your work will directly impact how families experience learning through the Hadley Designs brand. You will join a passionate, mission-driven team that values trust, creativity, and collaboration, with the freedom of a remote role and flexible working hours.

  • Remote-first work environment
  • Paid time off and holidays
  • Access to learning resources and professional development
  • Free access to Hadley Designs products
  • Regular interaction with leadership, including the CEO
  • Stability from more than a decade as a family-founded, mission-driven brand

Our Hiring Process

Every candidate completes a Culture Index assessment and a case study before interviews. For this role, reference checks are done by phone.

Apply Today

If you are ready to build the team behind a brand that is shaping the future of learning, apply now to join Hadley Designs as our Director of Recruiting.

P.S. If you don't hear from us within four weeks of your application, please consider that as our decision to move forward with other candidates, but we truly appreciate your interest in Hadley Designs.

Job Title: IRT Systems Project Manager

Job Location: Nottingham, Nottinghamshire, United Kingdom

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

IRT Systems Project Manager

We are seeking an experienced IRT Systems Project Manager to lead the design, implementation, and delivery of Interactive Response Technology (IRT) solutions supporting global clinical trials.

In this highly consultative role, you will partner with pharmaceutical and biotechnology clients to translate complex clinical study protocols into effective IRT system designs that ensure patients receive the correct study treatment throughout the trial. You will act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing expert guidance on system strategy, study configuration, and best practices while managing projects through the full lifecycle from design to go-live.

This role combines technical IRT expertise, client consultation, and project leadership, offering the opportunity to work across a diverse portfolio of clinical research studies.

Key Responsibilities

IRT System Design & Client Consultation

  • Review and analyse clinical study protocols to understand study objectives and system requirements.
  • Partner with clients to design IRT solutions that align with protocol requirements and operational goals.
  • Provide strategic guidance and recommendations on optimal system design and study setup.
  • Author and maintain detailed user requirements and design documentation.
  • Collaborate with clients and internal stakeholders to review, refine, and approve system requirements.

Project Management & Delivery

  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of assigned IRT studies, ensuring project milestones and timelines are achieved.
  • Manage study implementation activities to support successful study launch ahead of First Patient In (FPI).
  • Monitor project scope, identify potential risks, and manage change requests and budget impacts where required.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful execution of project deliverables.
  • Conduct system quality reviews and support client demonstrations throughout the project lifecycle.

User Acceptance Testing (UAT)

  • Coordinate and support internal and client-facing User Acceptance Testing activities.
  • Work closely with technical and validation teams to ensure systems meet study requirements.
  • Guide clients through the UAT process and provide expert support in resolving questions and issues.
  • Ensure testing outcomes are accurately documented and implemented before production release.

Leadership & Continuous Improvement

  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for IRT system design and implementation.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives, standards development, and lessons learned activities.
  • Support protocol amendment activities and system enhancements throughout the study lifecycle.
  • Deliver comprehensive study handovers and training to operational teams.
  • Mentor junior team members and contribute to technical training programmes.
  • Support client meetings, bid defence presentations, quarterly business reviews, and audit activities as required.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.
  • Several years of experience in clinical research, clinical technology, project management, or a related field.
  • Hands-on experience delivering and managing Interactive Response Technology (IRT) solutions.
  • Strong understanding of clinical trial operations, patient randomisation, and clinical supply management processes.
  • Experience working directly with sponsors, CROs, or other external stakeholders.
  • Proven ability to interpret clinical protocols and translate requirements into effective system solutions.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong client-facing consulting and relationship management skills.
  • Excellent project planning, organisation, and prioritisation abilities.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to delivering quality outcomes.
  • Collaborative team player with the ability to work independently.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and other business applications.

Why Join Us?

As an IRT Systems Project Manager, you will play a critical role in the successful execution of clinical trials that help bring innovative therapies to patients around the world. You will work closely with leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies, collaborate with global experts, and contribute to the delivery of technologies that support life-changing research.

IQVIA is a leading global provider of clinical research services, commercial insights and healthcare intelligence to the life sciences and healthcare industries. We create intelligent connections to accelerate the development and commercialization of innovative medical treatments to help improve patient outcomes and population health worldwide. Learn more at

IQVIA is committed to integrity in our hiring process and maintains a zero tolerance policy for candidate fraud. All information and credentials submitted in your application must be truthful and complete. Any false statements, misrepresentations, or material omissions during the recruitment process will result in immediate disqualification of your application, or termination of employment if discovered later, in accordance with applicable law. We appreciate your honesty and professionalism.
