  • Add supporting visuals (graphics, lower thirds, on-screen text, B-roll).
  • Apply sound effects, licensed music, color correction, and polished finishing touches.
  • Add accurate captions for accessibility and sound-off viewing.

2. Short-Form Content Creation (Social Media Clips)

  • Review long-form content (YouTube videos, interviews, podcasts) to identify compelling moments.
  • Edit short-form clips (15–60 seconds) for TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, etc.
  • Add dynamic captions, text treatments, motion elements, zooms/punch-ins, graphics, and sound design.
  • Optimize pacing and hooks for maximum retention and virality.

3. Event Highlight Reels & Interview Content

  • Edit high-energy event recaps using professional footage, transitions, text overlays, and music.
  • Craft clean, polished interview-based videos with strong narrative flow.
  • Incorporate B-roll, branded graphics, and color correction to maintain a consistent visual identity.

4. Long-Form Editing (Podcasts & YouTube)

  • Edit full podcast episodes and long-form YouTube videos.
  • Assemble multi-camera timelines, add graphics, incorporate B-roll, and create smooth pacing.
  • Ensure brand consistency, storytelling clarity, and a clean, polished final output.

5. Audio Editing & Production

  • Clean, level, and master audio tracks for podcast release (Apple Podcasts, Spotify, etc.).
  • Handle noise reduction, EQ, compression, and clarity enhancement.
  • Export final podcast audio in the required platforms’ technical specs.

6. Workflow & Communication

  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet quick-turn deadlines.
  • Deliver consistent updates, follow organized naming conventions, and maintain efficient file management.
  • Communicate proactively about needs, blockers, and delivery timelines.

Requirements

  • Proven video editing experience, specifically in:
    • Educational videos
    • Short-form social content
    • Event highlight reels
    • Interviews
    • Long-form podcast or YouTube content
  • Expert-level proficiency in at least two of the following editing software's:
    • Adobe Premiere Pro
    • Final Cut Pro
    • CapCut
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Social trends and viral content structure
    • Video codecs, formats, and aspect ratios
    • Color correction and basic motion graphics
    • Audio editing and mixing
  • Fast, reliable, and detail-oriented, with the ability to meet tight deadlines.
  • Creative instincts and an eye for storytelling, pacing, and audience engagement.
  • Additionally, we're looking for someone who's experienced in:
      • Editing 10-bit footage
      • Creating realistic AI characters of real people,
      • Editing Talking head content
      • Editing Event highlight reels
      • Editing Real estate video content

Role Overview

The ML/AI Engineer sits within the data platform and architecture team and is responsible for productionising, operating and improving machine-learning and AI workloads on the enterprise data platform using AWS and Databricks. The role combines ML/AI engineering with practical data engineering, working closely with data scientists, data engineers, platform engineers, product teams and governance stakeholders to build reliable data and feature pipelines, curate production-ready datasets, and establish reusable MLOps/AIOps capabilities that support secure, observable and cost-effective AI services from data ingestion and experimentation through deployment, monitoring, retraining and retirement.

Key Responsibilities

  • MLOps/AIOps Platform Engineering: Design and implement reusable platform components and golden paths for experiment tracking, model registry, pipeline orchestration, deployment, monitoring, feedback and retraining using Databricks, MLflow and approved AWS services.
  • Production Engineering: Convert notebooks and prototypes into modular, tested, containerised and maintainable batch jobs, APIs, model-serving endpoints or agentic services, with clear interfaces and operational ownership.
  • Feature Engineering Pipeline: Design, build and maintain reliable feature engineering pipelines on Databricks and AWS for ingesting, transforming, validating and serving structured and unstructured data used by ML/AI workloads.
  • Performance and Cost Engineering: Optimise Spark and SQL jobs, file layout, partitioning, cluster configuration and workload scheduling to improve reliability, runtime and AWS/Databricks cost efficiency.
  • CI/CD/CT Automation: Build automated workflows for testing and promoting code, data, features, prompts, models and infrastructure across environments, including quality, security, evaluation and human approval gates.
  • Reproducibility and Governance: Implement source, data, model, prompt and environment versioning; capture lineage, evaluation evidence, approvals and deployment history; and provide rollback and retirement mechanisms.
  • Monitoring and Reliability: Implement dashboards and alerts for system health, latency, throughput, errors, resource utilisation, cost, data quality, drift and model performance; maintain runbooks and support incident response and root-cause analysis.
  • Model Evaluation and Experimentation: Develop repeatable offline and online evaluation, regression testing, champion-challenger comparison and A/B testing patterns, with agreed release and rollback criteria.
  • Security and Responsible AI: Apply least-privilege IAM, encryption, secrets management, network and environment controls, vulnerability scanning, audit logging, sensitive-data controls and safeguards for untrusted AI inputs and tool use.
  • Recommendation and Search Support: Support model maintenance and retraining, package and dependency updates, new data ingestion, experimentation, filters, logic changes and performance reporting for recommendation and search workloads.
  • Optimisation and Continuous Improvement: Improve scalability, resilience, deployment frequency and cost efficiency; reduce manual steps and duplicated patterns; and contribute to the team’s MLOps maturity roadmap.
  • Documentation and Capability Transfer: Produce architecture decisions, model cards, release evidence, operational runbooks and user guidance, and coach internal teams so supported solutions can be operated sustainably.

Education & Experience

  • Education: Degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical discipline.
  • Experience: Typically 4–7 years of relevant software, data or ML engineering experience, including hands-on delivery and operation of ML/AI systems beyond prototype stage. Candidates with fewer years but strong evidence of end-to- end production ownership may also be considered.

Essential Requirements

  • Strong Python and software-engineering capability, including APIs, packaging, automated testing, Git, code review, debugging and modular design.
  • Hands-on experience with Databricks and MLflow for experiment tracking, model registry, workflow orchestration or model serving.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Spark/PySpark and SQL, including distributed data processing, query optimisation, partitioning, joins, incremental processing and troubleshooting data pipelines.
  • Experience designing and implementing lakehouse or data-lake pipelines using Databricks, Delta Lake and AWS S3, including Bronze, Silver and Gold data-layer patterns.
  • Experience with data modelling, schema design, data contracts, metadata, lineage, data-quality validation and reconciliation for production analytics and ML datasets.
  • Experience orchestrating batch or streaming workflows using Databricks Workflows, AWS Glue, Step Functions, EventBridge, Apache Airflow or an equivalent enterprise orchestration tool.
  • Hands-on AWS data and cloud engineering experience with a relevant mix of S3, Glue, Lake Formation, IAM, KMS, ECR, ECS/EKS, Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, CloudWatch, API Gateway, Secrets Manager, Redshift, MSK/Kinesis or equivalent approved services.
  • Experience with Docker, infrastructure as code such as Terraform, and CI/CD platforms such as GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins or Harness.
  • Understanding of ML lifecycle controls covering data validation, feature engineering, training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, drift, retraining and retirement.
  • Ability to implement reproducibility and traceability across code, datasets, features, parameters, environments, prompts and model artefacts.
  • Experience implementing system and model observability, alerts, runbooks, incident diagnosis and rollback or recovery procedures.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security, least-privilege access, encryption, secrets management, vulnerability management and audit logging.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Databricks Unity Catalog, Delta Live Tables or Lakeflow, feature engineering/feature stores, change data capture, event streaming using MSK/Kinesis/Kafka, and cross-account or governed data-sharing patterns.
  • Experience productionising generative-AI or agentic systems, including orchestration, state, prompt/version management, evaluation, controlled tool use, guardrails and human approval.
  • Experience with Kubernetes, OpenTelemetry, Prometheus, Grafana, model drift tooling, A/B testing or champion- challenger deployment.
  • Experience supporting high-volume, low-latency or public-facing AI services and optimising cloud inference and training costs.
  • Experience in Singapore public-sector environments, including VAPT, IM8-aligned controls, data classification, system assurance or responsible-AI governance.

Soft Skills

  • Strong engineering judgement and a pragmatic mindset, with the ability to distinguish a supportable production service from a demonstration.
  • Structured problem-solving across data, model, application and infrastructure layers, including calm and evidence-based incident handling.
  • Ability to work across data engineering and ML engineering boundaries, translating model requirements into dependable datasets, features, interfaces and service-level expectations.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain architecture, evaluation evidence, risk, cost and operational trade-offs to technical and management audiences.
  • Collaborative working style with data scientists, data engineers, platform engineers, product teams, cybersecurity and governance stakeholders.
  • Ability to work independently, document decisions, manage ambiguity and deliver through incremental, testable outcomes.
  • Commitment to knowledge transfer, reusable engineering patterns and sustainable in-house capability rather than bespoke solutions.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for product leads to shape and drive major product areas within BJAK's AI Investing.

This role is for senior product builders who can own direction, execution, product quality and outcomes across multiple workstreams or squads.

What You'll Own

  • Lead product direction for major AI Investing areas.

  • Define priorities, roadmap, product standards and success metrics across multiple features or squads.

  • Guide PMs, Product Owners, designers and engineers toward clear execution.

  • Work across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel and other financial services.

  • Turn regulatory, operational and business constraints into practical product decisions.

  • Drive launch quality, post-launch learning and continuous improvement.

  • Help build a product culture focused on speed, clarity, user value and honest measurement.


What We're Looking For

  • Strong experience leading digital product areas, not just individual features.

  • Able to balance strategy, execution, UX, data, engineering and business outcomes.

  • Strong judgement on prioritization, trade-offs and product sequencing.

  • Experience leading or mentoring PMs / POs / cross-functional squads is a strong advantage.

  • Comfortable with high ambiguity, fast changes and senior stakeholder pressure.

  • Able to simplify complex financial products into usable journeys.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or regulated products is a strong advantage.


The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Can set direction and still go deep into details.

  • Pushes teams to move faster without lowering product quality.

  • Knows when to simplify, when to scale and when to say no.

  • Can lead through clarity, not bureaucracy.

  • Avoids false claims and understands that product impact usually comes from many iterations and teams.


This Role Is Not For

  • Product leaders who only manage people and meetings.

  • People who cannot go deep into product details.

  • Candidates who are too slow for a high-growth environment.

  • Leaders who push vanity metrics without understanding real user impact.

  • People who need large teams before they can create progress.

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in US. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in US.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.description:
Overview

The Associate Manager AGI Research provides day-to-day supervision of research interns on the Technical Prospecting team and coordinates their work within priorities, project plans, evaluation methods, and technical standards established by the Director of AGI Research and technical leadership. The role assigns work, maintains schedules and workflow, monitors progress, coaches interns, addresses routine performance matters, and recommends actions when established processes do not fully address an operational issue. The role also performs hands-on research and prototyping activities and escalates material technical, scope, resource, and policy decisions to the appropriate leader.

Responsibilities

  • Coordinate assigned intern research activities using priorities, research questions, roadmaps, delivery targets, and procedures established by technical leadership.
  • Translate approved project objectives into individual assignments, weekly goals, and schedules for interns, and monitor progress at frequent intervals.
  • Maintain current records of assignments, milestones, owners, risks, and dependencies; provide routine status reports and use judgment to identify and escalate issues that may affect delivery, compliance, or stakeholder commitments.
  • Administer established planning and review routines, including cycle planning, weekly check-ins, milestone reviews, and demos.
  • Assign work and maintain project-level schedules and milestones within the approved program plan; adjust day-to-day workflow when needed and escalate capacity constraints, material timeline risks, and proposed scope changes to technical leadership.
  • Review project documentation and results for completeness, repeatability, and readiness for demonstration; evaluate available information and provide recommendations to technical leadership regarding whether work should be adopted, revised, or discontinued.
  • Support the Director of AGI Research in refining assigned research questions and confirm that approved baselines, success measures, and acceptance criteria are documented before work begins.
  • Apply and monitor established evaluation methods, approved test data, benchmarks, accuracy measures, and error-analysis practices; investigate exceptions and recommend process or method changes to technical leadership.
  • Monitor compliance with established documentation and version-control requirements for code, prompts, data, and experiment logs, and resolve routine gaps with the assigned intern.
  • Conduct targeted literature, tool, and vendor reviews using established criteria and summarize findings and operational recommendations for the Director and technical leads.
  • Perform hands-on research, prototyping, coding, debugging, testing, and documentation using approved AI tools and established development practices.
  • Conduct first-level reviews of intern code, prototypes, and documentation against established correctness, performance, security, maintainability, and AI-native SDLC standards; document findings, require routine corrections, and escalate material technical exceptions to technical leadership.
  • Perform individual technical tasks related to the unit, such as creating a limited prototype, reproducing a result, building an evaluation aid, or resolving a routine blocker, while maintaining day-to-day supervisory responsibilities.
  • Collect and document business and operational requirements from end users and sponsors using approved templates; clarify routine questions and obtain leadership approval for unclear requirements or material changes in scope or acceptance criteria.
  • Coordinate technical reviews, document decisions and required actions, and monitor completion of feedback provided by technical leadership regarding APIs, services, and application architecture.
  • Facilitate knowledge-sharing sessions on approved AI tools and techniques and recommend practical improvements to team procedures for leadership review.
  • Provide input on intern selection, administer established onboarding activities, assign daily work based on approved project needs and demonstrated skills, and monitor schedules and workflow at frequent intervals.
  • Hold regular 1:1s with each intern to review progress against assigned goals, resolve routine workflow issues, reinforce established expectations, and provide timely coaching and feedback.
  • Administer the established intern performance process, document goals and progress, complete midpoint and end-of-internship evaluations, address routine performance issues, and elevate significant concerns with recommended action to the Director and HR.
  • Coach interns on established AI-assisted development practices, research rigor, end-user engagement, and communication of technical trade-offs; reinforce a constructive environment for questions, learning, and documented experimentation.
  • Coordinate established recruiting, onboarding, access, training, and offboarding processes with HR and university relations; provide documented performance input for internship and conversion decisions.
  • Review and approve intern timecards, maintain required records, and resolve routine administrative exceptions in accordance with company policy.
  • Coordinate with the Director of AGI Research, technical leads, engineering, data science, and business stakeholders to keep assigned intern work aligned with approved priorities; communicate status and evaluate and explain operational risks and technical trade-offs to support leadership decisions.
  • Monitor intern compliance with security, privacy, and data-handling policies; investigate routine exceptions, take corrective action within established procedures, and escalate material concerns.
  • Maintain project templates, onboarding materials, standard operating procedures, and the research archive; identify recurring process gaps and recommend practical updates to leadership.
  • Hire, develop, coach, lead and retain top-tier talent, with a focus on building and improving a team and culture that is able to assist in employing best in class practices to support and drive high levels of internal and external customer satisfaction.
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • Degree in computer science, machine learning, AI, data science, engineering, or a related technical field, with one of the following:
  • Bachelor’s degree + 2-3 years of experience;
  • Master’s degree + 1-2 years of experience;
  • PhD + 0-1 years of experience.
  • Relevant experience includes software engineering, applied AI, machine learning, or data science research, and technical program or project management.
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or managing technical contributors such as interns, early-career engineers, or research assistants (formal or informal), including coaching them, giving direct and timely feedback, and handling difficult conversations.
  • Working knowledge of AI-assisted development tools and the ability to review intern code and prototypes for compliance with established technical, security, and documentation standards.
  • Ability to quickly evaluate and adopt new AI tools and use them to speed up research and development work.
  • Experience supporting applied research or experiments using established methods, including documenting hypotheses, applying approved evaluation metrics, analyzing results, and recommending next steps for leadership review.
  • Experience translating approved objectives into individual assignments, short-term goals, schedules, and routine status reporting for a small team or work unit.
  • Ability to work within general direction and established procedures, clarify routine requirements with end users and sponsors, and escalate material questions regarding scope or acceptance criteria.
  • Clear communication in writing, in person, and in demos, including explaining complex technical concepts and results so others can make decisions or take action.
  • Sound judgment about data security and privacy, especially with sensitive healthcare and claims data.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint), SharePoint, and project tracking tools such as Jira or Asana.
  • Preferred: Hands-on experience with LLM application patterns such as agentic workflows, retrieval-augmented generation, tool use, prompt engineering, and LLM evaluation.
  • Preferred: Experience with knowledge graphs or graph databases.
  • Preferred: Experience on fast-paced product, research, or innovation teams, or in running internship or university programs.
  • Preferred: Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or OCI) and containerization (Docker or Kubernetes).
  • Preferred: Exposure to healthcare, clinical chart review, medical coding, or claims concepts. This is a plus, not a requirement, and ramp-up support is provided on the job.
  • Preferred: Scrum Master (CSM or PSM I) or SAFe Agilist (SA) certification, or experience with objectives and key results (OKRs) or similar goal-setting frameworks.

Cognitive / Mental Requirements

  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Solving problems and thinking critically, including problems that arrive without a clear definition.
  • Working independently to define scope, goals, and acceptance criteria from unclear or minimal instructions.
  • Motivating, developing, and holding others accountable while supporting their growth.
  • Making data-driven recommendations and gaining buy-in from end users, sponsors, and cross-functional partners.
  • Applying statistics to evaluate experiment results and interpret them correctly.
  • Understanding and building solutions with modern programming languages, frameworks, and AI tools.
  • Prioritizing multiple tasks and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment, working across several teams, and handling confidential information properly.
  • Assessing the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned.

Physical Requirements and Working Conditions

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • No adverse environmental conditions expected.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.

Base compensation ranges from $50.50 to $60.00 per hour. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

Non-Exempt employees are eligible to receive overtime pay for hours worked in excess of 40 hours in a given week, or as otherwise required by applicable state law.

Cotiviti offers team members a competitive benefits package to address a wide range of personal and family needs, including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance coverage, 401(K) savings plans, paid family leave, 9 paid holidays per year, and 17-27 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, depending on specific level and length of service with Cotiviti. This role also is eligible to participate in Kodiak's annual discretionary bonus program, which is dependent on various factors, including individual and company performance.


The Distributor Sales Manager – UNFI & KeHE drives profitable sales growth across independent retail networks served by these distributors. This role owns the UNFI and KeHE headquarters relationships, distributor sales targets, trade budgets, annual business plans, promotional programs, forecasting, and operational performance. The manager leads broker partners responsible for independent retail execution, while coordinating with Kodiak account managers who separately own major retail customers. Working across Sales, Finance, Demand Planning, and Supply Chain, this role expands distribution, strengthens in-stock performance, and improves returns on trade investment.

What will you do?

  • Own UNFI and KeHE headquarters relationships, leading distributor-level strategy, business reviews, issue resolution, and joint initiatives to deliver agreed sales and distribution goals.
  • Own distributor sales targets and trade budgets; build account plans, monitor performance against revenue and spending goals, and adjust investments to drive profitable growth.
  • Lead broker partners covering independent retailers throughout both distributor networks; establish objectives, scorecards, field priorities, and accountability for distribution gains and retail execution.
  • Build and maintain distributor sales forecasts with Demand Planning and Supply Chain, incorporating baseline trends, new items, promotional lifts, and independent retail opportunities.
  • Own national UNFI and KeHE promotional calendars and evaluate independent retailer one-off requests; manage submissions, execution, trade spend, deductions, and post-event ROI analysis.
  • Lead new-item setup, authorizations, and item maintenance at UNFI and KeHE. Partner with brokers to convert distributor availability into independent retailer placement and reduce distribution voids.
  • Develop annual joint business plans and review performance by distributor
  • Represent Kodiak at the KeHE and UNFI trade shows to strengthen distributor and broker relationships, support independent retail opportunities, and advance sales priorities.

You bring the following capabilities to the role:

  • Extensive knowledge of distributors' workflow, portal, and strategies.
  • Translates distributor sales data, inventory trends, and promotional results into forecasts, investment decisions, and clear actions that improve sales and profitability.
  • Manages broker teams through measurable goals, performance reviews, and practical field priorities that improve independent retail distribution and execution.
  • Builds productive distributor headquarters relationships and resolves cross-functional challenges to keep joint business plans on track.
  • Manages trade budgets, promotional commitments, and deductions with financial discipline to maximize returns and control costs.
  • Travel: Attendance at KeHE and UNFI trade shows is required, along with periodic distributor headquarters meetings, broker reviews, and market visits.
  • Coordinates multiple distributor initiatives with Sales, Finance, and Supply Chain to deliver accurate setups, timely promotions, and reliable product availability.

Your experience should clearly demonstrate:

  • Experience owning distributor or wholesale customer relationships in consumer-packaged goods, preferably with UNFI, KeHE. Distributor portal experience a plus
  • Demonstrated accountability for sales targets, trade budgets, customer business plans, and profitable growth.
  • Experience directing broker organizations or external sales partners to achieve measurable independent retail distribution and execution results.
  • Hands-on experience with distributor promotional calendars, trade spending, billbacks or deductions, and promotional effectiveness analysis.
  • Experience with demand forecasting, distributor DC inventory management, and coordination with supply chain partners.
  • Experience managing distributor new-item setup, authorizations, item maintenance, and expansion into independent retail outlets.
  • Experience working well internally as there is plenty of crossover from large customers and distributor networks.

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Pinterest is looking for a thoughtful, highly skilled Staff Motion Designer to join the Design Innovation team. You will define and evolve the motion design language that brings clarity, coherence, and delight to Pinterest across surfaces and flagship features. This is a hands-on, horizontal role for a rare blend of motion craft leader, systems thinker, and design technologist. You will establish reusable motion principles, patterns, tokens, and implementation guidance within the design system; partner directly with product and engineering teams to solve challenging interaction problems; and build tools and prototypes that make it easier to explore and ship exceptional motion at scale. Your impact will extend from the details of a single interaction to the cohesive experience of Pinterest as a whole.

What you’ll do

  • Define and evolve Pinterest’s motion design language – principles, interaction and transition patterns, timing and tokens, specifications, and guidance – so motion is intentional, coherent, accessible, and reusable across the product ecosystem.
  • Lead motion direction for flagship and AI-forward experiences, using motion to clarify state, cause and effect, hierarchy, feedback, progress, and system responsiveness.
  • Partner horizontally with product designers, engineers, product managers, researchers, and content designers to connect individual feature work to a shared motion strategy and raise the quality of shipped experiences.
  • Turn high-craft explorations into scalable design system contributions that reduce ad hoc implementation, improve consistency, and enable teams to move faster with confidence.
  • Rapidly prototype and validate motion ideas using the right medium – motion studies, design tools, code, AI-enabled tools, or custom prototypes – to create shared understanding and accelerate decisions.
  • Work closely with engineering throughout implementation to solve technically ambitious animation challenges while balancing performance, platform conventions, accessibility, and maintainability.
  • Develop or enable lightweight tools, templates, and workflows that help designers explore visual and motion ideas quickly and help engineering teams build sophisticated animations reliably.
  • Stay at the leading edge of AI-enabled motion and visual-creation tools, applying them strategically to improve ideation, prototyping, and production while maintaining critical thinking, quality validation, and ownership of final outcomes.
  • Conduct motion quality reviews, give actionable feedback on designs and implementations, and mentor designers in motion principles, systems thinking, prototype craft, and productive engineering partnership.
  • Clearly articulate the rationale, tradeoffs, and user impact behind motion decisions to teams, leaders, and executives; build alignment around a high bar for motion craft and system quality.

What we’re looking for

  • Minimum 8 years of experience in motion design, product design, interaction design, or a closely related discipline, with a portfolio demonstrating exceptional motion craft in shipped digital products or platforms.
  • A staff/principal-level track record of influencing horizontally across teams, shaping a product or design-system direction, and raising quality without relying on formal authority.
  • Deep command of motion and interaction design principles, including timing, choreography, easing, spring behavior, feedback, and transitions – and strong judgment about when motion improves usability, comprehension, emotion, and trust.
  • Experience creating or materially evolving scalable motion systems, such as principles, token sets, pattern libraries, documentation, tooling, and governance that teams can adopt across products and platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience partnering closely with engineers to implement complex motion; practical fluency in performance, technical constraints, platform conventions, handoff, and quality assurance.
  • A design technologist mindset: comfortable using prototyping tools, AI, and code or technical workflows where useful to explore ideas, communicate intent, and improve how teams design and build.
  • Strong product and systems thinking: able to connect craft decisions to user needs, product strategy, accessibility, implementation efficiency, and measurable impact.
  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to synthesize ambiguity, create clear documentation, facilitate constructive critique, and align diverse cross-functional partners.
  • A collaborative, low-ego working style with a passion for learning, experimentation, mentoring, and inclusive design. You consider reduced-motion preferences, cognitive load, and diverse user needs from the beginning of the design process.
  • Bachelor’s degree in design, animation, human-computer interaction, a related field, or equivalent experience.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience defining motion for AI, conversational, multimodal, or other emerging product experiences.
  • Experience contributing to platform-wide design systems, public motion systems, or open-source animation libraries.
  • Experience building designer-facing or engineer-facing tools that improve motion prototyping, handoff, or implementation quality.
  • Experience in large-scale consumer products, personalization, or rapid experimentation environments.

Join us to define the motion language that makes Pinterest’s next generation of products feel clear, capable, and unmistakably Pinterest—raising the bar for craft, trust, and coherence for millions of Pinners.

jobs.description:
Technical Woodworks and Metalworks Draftsman

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our client is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Technical Draftsman (Woodworks & Metalworks) to develop accurate technical drawings, 3D models, and production-ready documentation for custom wood and metal fabrication projects.

The role involves translating design concepts, sketches, and engineering specifications into detailed fabrication drawings for projects such as kitchens, closets, built-in cabinetry, custom furniture, pergolas, shading structures, roof frameworks, gates, doors, and other bespoke fabrication works.

The successful candidate will collaborate closely with designers, architects, engineers, project managers, and production teams to ensure all drawings meet project specifications, fabrication requirements, quality standards, and deadlines.

COMPANY OVERVIEW

Our client is a design studio specializing in technical design and production drawings for custom wood and metal fabrication.

Their work focuses on bridging the gap between concept and manufacturing by translating ideas, sketches, and specifications into accurate 3D models and clear technical documentation ready for real-world production.

They work closely with carpenters, metal workshops, architects, and designers to ensure every drawing is optimized for fabrication processes, materials, and assembly requirements.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Prepare detailed technical drawings, plans, schematics, and 3D models for custom wood and metal fabrication projects.
  • Translate sketches, design concepts, engineering data, and project specifications into accurate and production-ready technical drawings.
  • Develop shop drawings, cutting lists, joinery details, exploded views, and fabrication details for woodworking and cabinetry projects.
  • Produce detailed fabrication drawings for metalwork projects, including pergolas, shading structures, roof frameworks, gates, doors, and steel structures.
  • Incorporate technical details such as dimensions, materials, joints, screws, bolts, hinges, and assembly requirements.
  • Apply CNC machining and modeling techniques where required for woodworking and production.
  • Review, update, and revise drawings to reflect design changes, project developments, and actual site conditions.
  • Coordinate with designers, architects, engineers, project managers, carpenters, and metal fabrication teams to ensure alignment with project requirements.
  • Ensure all technical drawings are accurate, complete, and compliant with project specifications, fabrication standards, and quality requirements.
  • Provide technical support and clarification to production teams throughout the fabrication and installation process.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Proven hands-on experience in technical drafting, woodworking, carpentry, cabinetry, or metal fabrication.
  • Strong understanding of wood and metal materials, fabrication methods, and manufacturing processes.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and execute technical drawings, sketches, and engineering specifications.
  • Proficiency in relevant technical design and CAD software, such as:
    • SolidWorks
    • Inventor
    • Cabinet Vision
    • TopSolid
  • Experience producing accurate, detailed, and production-ready 2D and 3D technical drawings.
  • Hands-on experience with CNC machining and modeling, particularly for woodworking projects.
  • Experience in kitchens, closets, built-ins, doors, custom furniture, steel structures, or other bespoke fabrication projects.
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and technical documentation.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and meet project deadlines.
  • Professionalism, accountability, and effective communication skills.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with Rhino for 3D modeling and technical design.
  • Experience with Grasshopper for design automation.
  • Knowledge of both woodworking and metal fabrication processes.
  • Experience in complex fabrication projects and on-site installation.
  • Background in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, Woodwork Furniture Design, or a related field.
  • Practical carpentry or metalworking experience.

REQUIREMENTS

Interested candidates are invited to submit their updated CV/resume and portfolio showcasing relevant technical drafting and fabrication projects.

Portfolio should ideally include:

  • Detailed 2D and 3D technical drawings labeled with the software used.
  • Woodworking projects such as kitchens, closets, cabinetry, doors, and custom furniture.
  • Metal fabrication projects such as pergolas, roof structures, gates, doors, and steel frameworks.
  • Technical fabrication details, including dimensions, joints, screws, bolts, hinges, and assembly specifications.
  • Examples of CNC modeling and production-ready shop drawings.

Sales Assistant (CRM, Scheduling & Sales Operations Support) – Remote | U.S. Hours

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (Aligned with Sales Team Schedules)

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a highly organized and proactive Sales Assistant to support a fast-moving sales team across CRM management, scheduling, follow-ups, proposals, reporting, and day-to-day sales operations.

This is not a direct selling role.

Instead, you’ll help the sales team stay organized, keep pipeline data accurate, coordinate communication, and ensure deals continue moving forward without operational gaps.

You’ll support:

  • CRM management
  • Calendar & meeting coordination
  • Sales follow-ups
  • Proposal preparation
  • Pipeline reporting
  • Cross-functional coordination
  • Day-to-day sales operations

If you’re detail-oriented, proactive, and enjoy keeping systems and people organized, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

CRM Management & Sales Operations

Maintain clean and accurate records across CRM platforms such as:

  • Salesforce
  • HubSpot
  • Zoho CRM
  • Pipedrive

You’ll:

  • Update leads, contacts, and opportunities
  • Maintain accurate pipeline stages
  • Log activities and notes
  • Remove duplicate records
  • Identify and correct missing information
  • Maintain strong CRM hygiene
  • Ensure sales leadership has reliable pipeline visibility

Scheduling & Sales Coordination

Coordinate sales meetings efficiently across multiple calendars and time zones.

Schedule:

  • Sales calls
  • Product demos
  • Follow-up meetings
  • Client meetings
  • Internal preparation sessions

Use tools such as:

  • Google Calendar
  • Outlook
  • Calendly

Ensure sales representatives have the right meeting context, materials, and information before calls.

Proposal & Sales Document Support

Prepare polished client-facing sales materials, including:

  • Proposals
  • Quotes
  • Presentations
  • Sales decks
  • Client documents

Support RFP and RFI responses using existing templates and approved materials.

Use:

  • Google Slides
  • Microsoft PowerPoint
  • Canva

Proofread documents for accuracy, formatting, and professionalism before they are shared externally.

Reporting & Pipeline Tracking

Support leadership with accurate sales reporting.

Prepare:

  • Weekly sales reports
  • Monthly sales reports
  • Pipeline updates
  • KPI trackers
  • Sales dashboards

Track:

  • Pipeline activity
  • Deal progression
  • Conversion metrics
  • Sales performance indicators

Ensure reporting remains accurate and up to date.

Communication & Follow-Ups

Draft and coordinate professional sales communications, including:

  • Follow-up emails
  • Meeting summaries
  • Reminders
  • Thank-you emails
  • Next-step communications

Support inbound lead routing and initial coordination.

Track outstanding follow-ups so opportunities and client requests don’t fall through the cracks.

Cross-Functional Coordination

Work closely with:

  • Sales
  • Marketing
  • Finance
  • Operations
  • Leadership

Track internal handoffs, responsibilities, and next steps.

Help prevent delays by ensuring teams have the information and documentation required to keep deals moving.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Are highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Naturally follow up and close operational loops
  • Enjoy working with CRMs, calendars, and structured workflows
  • Communicate clearly and professionally
  • Can manage multiple priorities simultaneously
  • Notice missing information and inconsistencies quickly
  • Are proactive rather than waiting to be reminded
  • Enjoy supporting high-performing sales teams
  • Take ownership of accuracy and execution

Required Experience & Skills

  • 1–2 years of experience in:
    • Sales Support
    • Administrative Support
    • Sales Operations
    • Operations Coordination
  • Hands-on experience with at least one CRM, such as:
    • Salesforce
    • HubSpot
    • Zoho CRM
    • Pipedrive
  • Strong scheduling and calendar management skills
  • Proficiency with:
    • Google Workspace
    • Microsoft Office
  • Strong written English communication
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • High attention to detail
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment
  • Availability during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

Experience with:

  • Proposal preparation
  • Sales presentations and decks
  • SDR / BDR workflows
  • Sales pipeline management
  • B2B SaaS
  • Marketing agencies
  • Recruiting
  • Professional services

Basic Excel or Google Sheets experience with:

  • Pivot tables
  • Dashboards
  • Trackers
  • Sales reports

is also valuable.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might:

  • Review and update CRM records
  • Check active opportunities for missing information
  • Schedule sales calls and demos
  • Coordinate calendars across different time zones
  • Prepare a proposal or presentation for an upcoming meeting
  • Send follow-up emails and reminders
  • Update pipeline trackers and sales dashboards
  • Generate reports for sales leadership
  • Coordinate internal handoffs between Sales, Finance, and Operations

In short: You keep the sales engine organized, accurate, and operating without friction so the sales team can focus on building relationships and closing deals.

Key Metrics for Success

  • On-time meeting scheduling and coordination
  • Follow-up completion and responsiveness
  • Proposal and documentation accuracy
  • Sales reporting accuracy
  • Pipeline visibility
  • Reduction in missed tasks and communication gaps

Why This Role Stands Out

Apply Now

If you:

  • Are strong with scheduling, follow-ups, and documentation
  • Thrive in detail-oriented, fast-moving environments
  • Want to build your career in sales operations or RevOps

jobs.excerpt: About ImprovadoImprovado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams.
jobs.description:
About Improvado

Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams. We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI. Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role

Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured. That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from. You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change. You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do

Salesforce and GTM stack

  • Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).
  • Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes. Manage licences and vendor renewals.
  • Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash

  • Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.
  • Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance. Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.
  • Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model

  • Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).
  • Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.
  • Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes. Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.
  • Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation

  • Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.
  • Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership

  • Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product. Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements

  • 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands-on admin of a live Salesforce org.
  • Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric). dbt is a plus.
  • Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.
  • Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.
  • Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.
  • Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have

  • Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.
  • ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.
  • Salesforce development (Apex, triggers, API).
  • Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.
  • Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.
  • HubSpot to Salesforce migration.
  • Attribution or CS health score data.
  • Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer

  • Remote-first environment
  • Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises
  • 20 working days of PTO per year
  • US holidays and additional days off
  • Professional development reimbursement

jobs.excerpt: About UsObserve. AI is the enterprise-grade Customer Experience AI platform that unifies conversations, intelligence, and action to turn contact centers into performance engines.
jobs.description:
About Us

Observe.AI is the enterprise-grade Customer Experience AI platform that unifies conversations, intelligence, and action to turn contact centers into performance engines. Built to optimize the full lifecycle of human and AI agents, Observe.AI enables enterprises to automate customer interactions, augment agent performance, and deliver governed AI at scale.

On a single platform, Observe.AI combines Voice and Chat AI Agents, real-time AI Copilots, and Conversation Intelligence with 100% interaction coverage for quality, compliance, and performance management. Trusted by leading brands, Observe.AI delivers fast time-to-value, measurable ROI, and consistent, high-quality customer experiences across every channel.

Why Join Us

You will build and own an enterprise territory, selling a technically complex AI platform to contact center owners and to the CIO, CTO, finance and, at times, CEO sponsors who fund the change. We sell to companies with 1,000 to 10,000 employees and roughly 300 to 2,000 contact center agents. In these companies the buying group is small enough to reach the executive who decides, and you are expected to reach them.

This is a high-ownership role with a high bar. You will land the platform through the intelligence that shows where automation pays off, then expand into AI agents. You will also help set the playbook that the next hires follow.

What Success Looks Like

  • Land 5 or more new logos per year at a target ACV of $250K or more.
  • Win one or two expansions or upsells inside your existing account base each year.
  • Hold 4 to 5x pipeline coverage, with a meaningful share self-sourced in your own territory.
  • Forecast within 10% of actual, using Commit, Strong Upside, Upside, and Pipeline.

What you'll be doing:

Own your territory like a CEO

  • Build and run a territory plan for enterprise accounts that fit our profile, and say no to accounts that do not.
  • Source your own pipeline through multi-threaded outreach to operations leaders and executives. Personally run outbound campaigns, with AI doing the heavy lifting on research and personalization.
  • Navigate large, matrixed organizations with technical and business stakeholders.

Lead complex, technical sales cycles

  • Sell to two buying centers: contact center operations (CX, quality, workforce, and support leaders) and the technology and finance executives who own architecture, security, and budget.
  • Explain how voice and chat AI agents and copilots work, in plain terms, to a skeptical CIO. Cover guardrails, data handling and residency, integration with CCaaS platforms (such as Genesys, NICE, Five9, and Amazon Connect), and how performance is measured.
  • Run proof-based evaluations. Work with Solutions Engineers and forward-deployed engineers to scope use cases and win the technical and security evaluation, and keep the process honest from first call to signature.
  • Build ROI cases that a CFO will sign off on, tied to cost per contact, containment, quality, and agent productivity.
  • Run deals on MEDDPICC, and hold every deal to our Five Wins gates (business, product, technical, security, and commercial) before it advances.

Build and scale the AI agent motion

  • Turn what works in your deals into repeatable plays, and share what you learn with Product, Engineering, CX, and Marketing.
  • Mentor Enterprise AEs on technical selling and executive engagement.
  • Show up in person for executive roundtables and customer events, and help turn happy customers into references.

Operate with discipline

  • Keep CRM and deal records current. Our goal is for AI to maintain most of the record, so what you put in should be accurate and brief.
  • Run account plans and expansion strategies, and take pricing through our deal desk and discount tiers.

How We Work

Observe.AI is an AI-native company, and we expect you to be too. You will build your own AI workflows for account research, outbound, deal strategy, and forecasting, and pick up new tools as they appear. You do not need a specific stack. You need curiosity and a record of changing how you work when something better arrives.

We move at startup speed, debate openly, and expect people to hold a position and change it when the evidence changes. We want people who welcome deal inspection and coaching, ask for help early, and partner closely with Sales Development, Solutions Engineering, and forward-deployed engineering. Everyone follows the process, leaders included.

What you'll bring to the role

  • 8 or more years in enterprise SaaS with complex, technical sales cycles.
  • A record of closing six- and seven-figure net-new deals, with ACVs of $250K or more, in the last three years.
  • Experience selling AI/ML, automation, workflow, infrastructure, security, or contact center technology (CCaaS, workforce, or quality management). Agentic AI experience is a strong plus.
  • Credibility with technical buyers: you can discuss architecture, security, and integration without a rehearsed script, and you know when to bring in an engineer.
  • A record of self-sourced pipeline in a greenfield or lightly covered territory.

Skills & Attributes

  • Mastery of MEDDPICC or an equivalent framework, and the discipline to use it when it slows a deal down.
  • Comfort with usage-based and committed-spend pricing models.
  • Executive presence, and the ability to simplify technical value for a CIO and an operations leader alike.
  • A builder's mindset: scrappy, resourceful, and resilient, with high urgency and high accountability.

Why You'll Love It Here

  • Competitive compensation including equity: Market-aligned base pay, performance incentives, and meaningful equity ownership.
  • Excellent medical, dental, and vision insurance options: Comprehensive coverage for employees and eligible dependents.
  • Flexible paid time off: Our flexible PTO policy lets you take the time you need to recharge, keep your balance, and perform at your best.
  • Additional time to recharge: 10 company holidays, an annual company-wide Winter Break, and paid parental leave to support life outside of work.
  • 401(k) plan: Long-term financial planning support with tax-advantaged retirement savings.
  • Quarterly Lifestyle Spending Account: A flexible quarterly stipend for wellness, learning and professional development, and personal growth.
  • Monthly mobile and internet stipend: Support for remote and hybrid work connectivity.
  • Pre-tax commuter benefits: Tax-efficient transit and commuting support for hybrid and in-office employees.
  • Autonomy and agency: Play a meaningful role in scaling a category-defining GenAI platform that is transforming the future of customer experience.

Salary Range

The on-target earnings (OTE) for this role are $270,000-$300,000 with a target 50/50 split between base and variable, plus equity in the form of options. Compensation varies based on qualifications, skills, location and experience.

Our Commitment to Inclusion and Belonging

Observe.AI is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer that proudly pursues and hires a diverse workforce. Observe.AI does not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion or religious belief, ethnic or national origin, nationality, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, age, military or veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state, or federal laws or prohibited by Company policy. Observe.AI also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.

We welcome all people. We celebrate diversity of all kinds and are committed to creating an inclusive culture built on a foundation of respect for all individuals. We seek to hire, develop, and retain talented people from all backgrounds. Individuals from non-traditional backgrounds and historically marginalized or underrepresented groups are strongly encouraged to apply.

If you are ambitious, make an impact wherever you go, and are ready to shape the future of Observe.AI, we encourage you to apply. For more information, visit www.observe.ai.

The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:

This is where a desire to make a difference in people's lives meets a passion for algorithm development and data science. The Algorithms team is at the very heart of what we do at Dexcom. Join us if building models, developing signal processing approaches, and transforming emerging sensing technologies into impactful healthcare solutions excites you.

As a Senior Algorithm Engineer, you will play a key role in developing advanced sensing algorithms that power next-generation continuous glucose monitoring and health sensing technologies.

Where you come in:

  • Develop physics-based, mechanistic, and data-driven models to characterize sensor behavior and improve measurement performance.

  • Design and implement signal processing, estimation, calibration, detection, and predictive algorithms.

  • Drive clinical performance assessments and algorithm maturation in collaboration with sensor, systems, hardware, firmware, clinical, and product teams.

  • Provide technical insights on algorithm architecture, design tradeoffs, verification strategies, and implementation approaches.

  • Identify opportunities to optimize overall system performance and resource utilization.

  • Facilitate algorithm design transfer activities with firmware, verification, and validation teams.

What makes you successful:

  • Expert-level proficiency in Python, MATLAB, C/C++, or similar technical computing environments.

  • Deep expertise in statistical estimation, signal processing, optimization, and mathematical modeling.

  • Strong understanding of machine learning techniques and practical model development.

  • Demonstrated experience developing algorithms for sensing technologies, measurement systems, medical devices, or related disciplines.

  • Experience analyzing large and complex datasets with multiple signals and dependencies.

  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

  • Ability to thrive in ambiguous, fast-paced technical environments.

Preferred:

  • Experience with calibration, estimation, filtering, or measurement system algorithms.

  • Experience transitioning algorithms from research into commercial products.

  • Experience applying strong software engineering practices in data-driven application development.

  • Knowledge of design controls, verification and validation processes, and product development lifecycles.

  • Publication, patent, or demonstrated record of innovation.

What you’ll get:

  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.

  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.

  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.

Background

The African Climate Foundation (ACF) is the first and only African-led climate change re-granting organisation on the continent. Through a combination of grant making, fellowships, transformational research, technical assistance, coalition building and advocacy the ACF seeks to support interventions at the nexus of climate change, and development that have the greatest potential to deliver long-term socio-economic transformation and inclusive development. ACF also provides Fiscal Hosting (also called Fiscal Sponsorship) services to support emerging and mission aligned organisations and initiatives.

About the Transport Programme

The ACF Transport Programme supports an African-led transition to clean, safe, affordable and accessible transport. It works on the policy, finance and public support needed to move people and goods more sustainably, and treats electric mobility as one part of a wider shift that also covers public and popular transport such as buses and minibus taxis. Working with governments, financial institutions, civil society, research partners and the private sector, the programme combines grant-making, technical assistance, research, convening and advocacy. It also collaborates with partners and global initiatives, so that African priorities shape how transport systems are planned and financed.

Purpose

Reporting to the Transport Programme Manager, the Programme Officer will work closely with the Senior Programme Officer and Programme Manager to deliver the Africa Transport strategy. This role is suited to a dynamic, early-career professional with strong research, coordination, and communication skills, and a passion for mobility and sustainable transport.

jobs.title: Google Ads Media Buyer / Growth Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Everyone can run a search campaign.  Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.
jobs.description:
Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked.

That is the whole job.

Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business.

So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero.

You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end.

Here is what "end to end" actually means.

You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number.

You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

Requirements

What the job looks like

  • Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month.
  • Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working.
  • Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people.
  • Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing.
  • Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target.
  • Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule.
  • Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery.
  • Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why.
  • Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.
  • Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt.

You are a fit if

  • You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search.
  • You are fluent in the whole stack, not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have.
  • You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it.
  • You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list.
  • You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard.
  • You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.
  • Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too.

You are not a fit if

  • "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.
  • You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question.

Benefits

Why this role is exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.
