jobs.description:
Remote (U.S. – based, Eastern or Central time zone)

The Opportunity:

The Systems Engineer – Platform Deployment Operations is a hands-on, customer-facing role dedicated to a long-term engagement with a global enterprise client. You will expand SPHEREboard’s unstructured data capabilities, which collect permission and activity data from file servers and NAS platforms, into new regions and secure network zones, and keep the platform healthy once it is running.

It suits a systems or infrastructure engineer who understands how Windows, Linux, directory, network, and storage systems work together; can deploy technical software where every change crosses regional, regulatory, and organizational boundaries; and enjoys working closely with client teams as a trusted, steady technical partner.

Essential Functions:

  • Plan and design deployments: Review target architecture, confirm prerequisites, and design deployments for new regions and secure zones that meet local regulatory, data residency, and change control requirements; shepherd changes through client approvals.
  • Build the infrastructure: Provision virtual machines and appliances (including OVA-based components) using infrastructure as code such as Terraform, specifying region, identifiers, CPU, memory, and storage. Install and configure SPHEREboard application, SQL Server database, and data collection components.
  • Configure access the right way: Set up service accounts, groups, database and file system permissions, and credential retrieval, such as CyberArk safes for authenticating to Linux servers. When a client asks for a tighter least-privilege model, such as granular sudo rights instead of full sudo, research it, test it in our lab, and agree the approach.
  • Connect storage and collect activity data: Configure connectors to Hitachi, NetApp, and Windows file platforms over SMB/CIFS and NFS; deploy and validate activity collection; run migrations and upgrades across DEV, QA, and PROD.
  • Manage networking and certificates: Request firewall and port changes, validate DNS and connectivity between components, and request, install, and test SSL/TLS certificates.
  • Keep the platform healthy: Track scan coverage and data refreshes and drive failures to a successful re-scan. Diagnose issues caused by client-side changes, such as a modified GPO, closed port, expired certificate, or rotated credential, by understanding how systems authenticate, communicate, and share data.
  • Work with the data: Query and validate data in SQL, deliver it through feeds such as CSV extracts or Power BI datasets, and reconcile what the platform shows against the live environment.
  • Document and improve: Maintain runbooks, service account inventories, and deployment records; share field lessons with Engineering and Product.

Requirements:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, or technical operations, ideally in large, regulated enterprises.
  • Strong Linux administration: users and groups, file ownership and permissions, sudo, SSH, services, and logs; comfortable with shell scripting.
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server and Active Directory (accounts, groups, Group Policy, LDAP, Kerberos), enough to work confidently with the systems SPHEREboard connects to.
  • Solid understanding of file share permissions: NTFS/NFS and share permissions.
  • Practical networking knowledge: TCP/IP, DNS, firewalls and ports, proxies, and SSL/TLS certificates (requesting, installing, and validating them).
  • Experience with virtualization (VMware or cloud VMs, OVA appliances) and infrastructure as code such as Terraform.
  • Working SQL skills on Microsoft SQL Server, including queries, joins, permissions, and basic database administration.
  • Methodical diagnosis of multi-system issues from symptom to root cause, with a security-minded approach to least privilege, credentials, and change control.
  • Client skills: Builds trusted relationships with varied client personas, from infrastructure engineers to security and business stakeholders; learns who to go to for what; explains findings clearly; and influences without authority.

Preferred Experience:

  • Deploying enterprise software in customer environments, as a vendor or consultant.
  • Hitachi or NetApp NAS administration, or file activity monitoring tools.
  • CyberArk or another PAM platform, particularly credential retrieval for infrastructure, servers and applications.
  • Multi-region deployments with data residency rules (APAC, EMEA); Cassandra or similar data stores.
  • PowerShell, REST APIs, and reporting tools such as Power BI or Tableau.

Personality Traits:

  • Inquisitive: Asks the right questions; wants to know how things work, not take them at face value.
  • Systems thinking: Sees how components connect, authenticate, and depend on each other.
  • Data storytelling: Reads granular details or an Excel export and tells the story of what the data means versus the live environment.
  • Automation mindset: Turns repeatable work into consistent, documented steps.

What Success Looks Like:

  • New regions and secure zones go live on a predictable cadence, with validation evidence.
  • Scan coverage stays high, and failures are resolved quickly and don’t recur.
  • Client teams trust the engineer, changes clear approvals smoothly, and documentation stays current.

Why Join Us:

Build deep expertise on a demanding global deployment that reduces data access risk, at a high-growth, collaborative company with competitive compensation, benefits, and room to grow.

About SPHERE:

SPHERE is the global leader in Identity Hygiene. We are dedicated to reshaping modern identity programs by embedding this foundational fabric, enabling organizations to quickly reduce risks. We work through an identity lens that protects an organization’s accounts, data, and infrastructure. Our solutions deliver immediate time-to-value by leveraging automation to discover, remediate and secure identities, now and forever.Driven by our core values of passion, empathy, and authenticity, our vision drives us to continually innovate, helping our clients to sleep better knowing their attack surface is drastically reduced, thwarting the plans of bad actors every single day.

jobs.title: Senior Compiler Engineer – Rust GPU
jobs.excerpt: NVIDIA is dedicated to reinvent accelerated computing.
jobs.description:
NVIDIA is dedicated to reinvent accelerated computing. Reinvention requires great technology and amazing people. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is hiring a Senior Compiler Engineer to join our team driving the next generation of GPU systems programming. We are redefining how developers write high-performance GPU software by bringing the safety, expressiveness, and modern tooling of Rust to native GPU and CUDA development. On this team, you will build cutting-edge compiler pipelines, custom intermediate representation (IR) frameworks, and JIT compilation systems that bridge host and device execution—allowing developers to write memory-safe, high-performance GPU kernels in idiomatic Rust.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Develop Rust-to-GPU Compiler Pipelines: Design, implement, and maintain custom compiler backends (such as rustc codegen backends and proc-macros) and Rust-native intermediate representation (IR) frameworks to compile standard Rust directly to high-performance CUDA PTX and machine code.

  • Build compiler IRs and Optimizers: Work with modern compiler architectures to lower Rust AST and MIR into IRs including MLIR, PTX, and LLVM, including GPU-specific optimizations.

  • Support complex ahead-of-time, just-in-time, and link time optimization workflows: Build state-of-the-art tooling to support users targeting a broad family of NVIDIA GPUs, host platforms, and feature sets.

  • Define Safe Parallel Abstractions: Architect innovative compiler-enforced safety models that extend Rust's ownership, borrowing, and lifetime disciplines across the GPU launch boundary—preventing data races and enforcing memory safety during asynchronous GPU execution.

  • Expose Next-Gen Hardware Features: Implement type-safe, ergonomic device-side abstractions in Rust for low-level GPU hardware primitives, including shared memory, barriers, scoped atomics, Tensor Memory Accelerator (TMA), and warp/cluster-level operations.

  • Build the future: Supporting today’s accelerated computing applications is not sufficient. We have to build composable building blocks for others around us to build the applications of tomorrow.

What we need to see:

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • 5+ years of relevant work or research experience in compiler development, language design, or GPU code generation.

  • Deep expertise in the Rust programming language, including a strong grasp of compiler internals (rustc), Rust MIR, procedural macros, and Rust's borrow-checker/lifetime model.

  • Hands-on experience with compiler infrastructures, intermediate representations (IRs), and code generation (such as LLVM IR, MLIR, or custom IR systems).

  • Solid understanding of parallel programming models, GPU architectures, and CUDA programming.

  • Strong software design skills, including debugging, profiling, and benchmarking compilers and GPU kernels.

  • Ability to orchestrate agents for product requirement design, architecture, code development, testing, code review, and issue triage.

  • Ability to work independently, define project goals and scope, and drive complex compiler-engineering efforts from research to production.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • A track record of contributing to the Rust compiler (rustc), Cargo tooling, or open-source Rust-to-GPU projects.

  • Experience building custom compiler front-ends, AST translators, or JIT engines.

  • Familiarity with MLIR or other extensible compiler frameworks.

  • Deep proficiency in low-level GPU programming, including the use of modern hardware features (e.g., Tensor Cores, warp-level shuffles, or asynchronous transfer pipelines).

  • Experience designing Domain-Specific Languages (DSLs) or tile-based programming abstractions for tensor processing.

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for programming languages and systems technology, we want to hear from you.

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary range for this position is 152,000 USD – 241,500 USD.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Our Mission

Learnlight is an EdTech company that believes in putting people first. We take every opportunity to do that with enthusiasm, initiative, and commitment. We find joy and deep satisfaction in delighting our clients, empowering our learners, and helping our team to excel in everything they do.

Our mission is to help organizations develop human skills to understand, empathize, and connect effectively with others in the global workplace. Combined with a long-term, sustainable approach, we aim to safeguard our people, the communities we serve, and our planet.

Exploring Future Opportunities at Learnlight

At Learnlight, we are continually assessing our future capabilities and how we can best support our evolving business needs.

As part of this process, we are exploring the possibility of building an in-house capability specializing in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central. While our future operating model and team structure are still under consideration, we are interested in connecting with experienced Business Central professionals whose technical expertise could align with our potential future needs.

We are therefore inviting expressions of interest from professionals with strong hands-on development experience in Business Central, particularly those who enjoy designing robust technical solutions, building integrations and improving the reliability and scalability of business systems.

Please note that this is not an active vacancy, and no formal recruitment process or hiring timeline has been confirmed. We are still evaluating our future operating model, technical requirements and potential team structure. Any opportunities that may arise will depend on the outcome of this assessment and subsequent business decisions.

The Potential Opportunity

Should we decide to establish this capability in-house, the focus would be on strengthening our technical ownership of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, supporting business growth and ensuring our systems remain scalable, reliable and fit for the future.

We would be particularly interested in connecting with professionals who could contribute to:

  • Designing, developing and maintaining AL code, extensions and customisations, following Microsoft best practices and upgrade-safe development patterns.
  • Translating functional requirements into robust, maintainable technical solutions, working closely with Finance, Operations and functional specialists.

  • Managing Business Central environments, sandboxes, deployment pipelines, version updates and extension publishing to support stable releases.
  • Developing workflow automations and system enhancements, ensuring appropriate testing and documentation, and helping resolve complex technical issues.

What You Could Bring

We would welcome expressions of interest from professionals with relevant technical expertise and a strong understanding of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, particularly:

  • Strong hands-on experience developing in AL, building and maintaining extensions, and understanding Business Central architecture, events, triggers and upgrade-safe development patterns.

Experience with the following would also be beneficial:

  • DevOps practices and Business Central deployment pipelines, including Git and CI/CD.

We would also value professionals who are proactive, self-sufficient and comfortable navigating ambiguity; who can challenge requirements constructively and guide stakeholders towards practical, maintainable solutions; and who remain calm under pressure during releases, integrations and acquisition onboarding.

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for actively practicing, US-licensed physicians (MD/DO) living outside the US, with an active, unrestricted US medical license, to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians living outside the US who are looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid ​

How to apply

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Project time expectations

You decide when and how much to contribute. For this project, tasks are estimated at around 10–20 hours per week during active phases. This is an estimate, not a minimum or a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks are submitted within the project timeline and need to meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Earnings

Earnings are per approved task, at a flat rate set to about $35/hr equivalent based on estimated task time. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the base rate. QA and adjudication tasks are paid at a higher rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved.

The airSlate Strategy department leads monetization and product-led growth strategies and analytics across airSlate’s product suite. Get to know us

Do you want to help us shape what the future of work will look like and how it will best embrace our life's aspirations? If this sounds like a journey you want to embark on, we may have the right role for you! Payfit is the Payroll & HR service for every business. Built on millions of payslips processed, Payfit combines expert-operated payroll, a complete People platform, and an AI that runs the day-to-day, so leaders can focus on their people and their growth. We are a European company operating from 3 main countries (France, Spain, and the UK) where we are supporting over 22,000 clients.

Creating a fulfilling work environment and culture is also a core mission at Payfit, and our day-to-day work philosophy is reflected in our four values:

Care: We genuinely care for others whoever they are, whatever they think.

Excellence: We aim to improve and achieve better results every day.

Humility: Staying humble and exchanging transparent feedback helps us to grow and improve.

Passion: We are the architects of Payfit's success.

A key part of our culture, and essential for our success, is also improving the diversity of our teams and building an inclusive culture where you can be yourself at work.

This is why our recruitment focuses on the skills you demonstrate, and not only on your academic background or previous professional experiences. At Payfit, we understand that you can gain applicable skills through a variety of life experiences, and we are interested in knowing them, too.

Location :
Work remotely from anywhere inFranceorSpain

Why this role, why now

AI is already part of how we work across Payfit. We’re now scaling its use across high-value workflows to help our teams work faster, with greater accuracy and consistency, and deliver measurable improvements in productivity, service quality and execution speed.

As one of our firstAI Workflow Builders, you’ll take workflows from business problem to everyday adoption. You’ll work closely with business teams to understand how work gets done, redesign processes around AI agents, build and configure solutions in short cycles, and improve them through weekly demos and user feedback. You’ll partner with our Application Framework team to ensure every solution is secure, reliable, and scalable.


The team
You'll join a dedicatedAI Enablement team of 4, plus a team leadreporting directly to the CEO. The team's mandate is focused delivery - identifying the highest-value workflow opportunities across Payfit, building AI agents that connect to our business systems, and iterating until solutions become part of everyday work.

You'll work in close, structured collaboration with the Application Framework team in Engineering - co-building shared permissions, approved integrations, evaluation frameworks, monitoring, and human interaction patterns. The focus team owns workflow delivery and adoption; Application Framework owns shared infrastructure and technical standards.
Success is measured in net time saved, cycle time reduction, quality improvements, sustained usage, and operating cost.

What you'll do

  • Map current workflows with users — simplify before automating, identify pain points, decisions, and exceptions that AI can absorb.

  • Connect systems and steps via approved integrations, APIs, or lightweight scripts — partnering with engineers when the problem requires it.

  • Pilot, document, and roll out workflows; train users, support change, and use feedback to drive sustained adoption.

  • Co-own shared patterns with the Application Framework team: permissions, evaluation, monitoring, human review steps, and security.

What you'll bring

  • Experience in business operations, process improvement, product building, consulting, or transformation.

  • Hands-on practice with agent platforms, automation tools, or low-code environments.

  • Comfort working with prompts, structured data, APIs, and lightweight scripting — you don't need to be an engineer, but you're not afraid of the technical layer.

  • A track record of simplifying processes, building working solutions, and improving them based on user feedback.

  • Strong listening and communication skills — you can turn a messy workflow conversation into a clear redesign proposal.

  • Practical approach to user adoption: you think about change management, not just configuration.

  • End-to-end ownership from discovery through rollout

About the Role

Transaction Recording & General Ledger

  • Record daily financial transactions accurately across accounts.

Accounts Payable & Receivable

  • Process incoming and outgoing payments accurately and on time.
  • Track outstanding invoices and follow up on overdue payments.
  • Maintain accurate accounts payable and receivable records.
  • Prepare and update aging reports for the finance team.

Bank & Account Reconciliation

  • Perform regular reconciliations across bank accounts and credit lines.
  • Identify, investigate, and resolve discrepancies in a timely manner.
  • Ensure account balances and supporting records are accurate.

Financial Reporting & Expense Tracking

  • Prepare monthly and periodic financial summaries, including balance sheets and profit-and-loss statements.
  • Monitor, categorize, and record business expenses.
  • Identify unusual transactions or expense discrepancies and flag them for review.
  • Maintain accurate financial data to support business decisions.

Compliance & Documentation

  • Maintain organized, complete, and audit-ready financial records.
  • Prepare supporting documentation for audits, tax filings, and compliance activities.
  • Follow established accounting procedures and documentation standards.
  • Support the finance team with additional bookkeeping tasks as needed.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in bookkeeping or a related accounting role.
  • Strong understanding of double-entry accounting, reconciliations, accounts payable, accounts receivable, and basic financial reporting.

  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for reporting and financial data management.
  • High attention to detail and a methodical approach to data entry and record-keeping.
  • Ability to identify discrepancies and maintain accurate financial records with minimal errors.
  • Professional written English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment and coordinate effectively with a finance team across time zones.

Perfect Fit / Culture

You’ll thrive in this role if you take ownership of financial accuracy, follow established processes consistently, and flag discrepancies before they become larger issues. You should be organized, dependable, and proactive in communicating progress, questions, and potential blockers.

The ideal candidate is comfortable managing bookkeeping responsibilities independently while maintaining clear communication with the finance team and meeting reporting deadlines.

Typical Day

  • Review and record new financial transactions.

  • Reconcile bank accounts and credit lines.

  • Review and categorize expenses and investigate discrepancies.

jobs.title: Media Buyer / Creative Strategist
jobs.excerpt: Media buying is now the easy part. In 2026, the buying itself is piping.
jobs.description:
Media buying is now the easy part.

In 2026, the buying itself is piping. The levers that actually move a DTC account are creative, offer, and conversion rate, and the platform keeps getting better at rewarding whoever gets those right.

So we don't hire media buyers. We hire marketers who buy media.

At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands across our service lines, 20 to 25 of them on paid media, and we spend $6-9M a month on Meta. We're hiring one person to own a handful of those accounts end to end.

Here's what "end to end" actually means here.

You are the account manager. We don't have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership and accountability: when you're the person answering for the account, it's your result, not somebody else's summary of your result.

You are the creative strategist. You do the research, you find the angles, and you write the briefs and the scripts. You direct our editors and designers rather than filing requests with them. Creative isn't a ticket you submit. It's your job.

You build the things the account needs. If conversion rate is the bottleneck, you build the landing page. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme.

You carry up to six accounts. That's the capacity we run at today, and the team averages about four and a half. You'll manage far fewer accounts than you would at most agencies. In exchange you get real ownership of the results and you get to work as an end to end marketer instead of one station on an assembly line.

You can live anywhere. We're a remote team and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you're the client's point of contact and there's nobody else to cover it. The rest of your day is yours.

If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we'll both know it fast.

If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading.

We're growing fast and we keep the bar high.

We believe the best media buyer today is a sharp marketer who uses AI every day. We built an internal creative analysis tool that connects to Claude, and we use Pipeboard to read and write to ad accounts and run heavy analysis. You don't need to know our stack yet. You do need to actually use AI in your work, not be afraid of it, and teach yourself what you don't know.

Requirements

What the job looks like

Own 4 to 6 DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, the creative lead, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $30k/mo to $1M/mo.

Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you're the one who answers when something isn't working.

Run the research before the ads. Marketing is 80% research here. You mine customer reviews, ad comments, support tickets, and Reddit for the language and objections that become angles. You pull competitor ad libraries. You run our internal tooling that OCRs and transcribes the ads in your account and ties them to performance, so you know what winning and losing actually look like in this account.

Write the briefs and the scripts, and direct the work. Creative direction is yours. You run revision rounds with our editors and designers and you hold the quality bar.

Ship creative on a cadence. Roughly 8 to 10 new ad launches a week is where accounts hold, in batches every 1 to 1.5 weeks. Informed volume, not spray and pray. We want better hypotheses, not more randomness.

Build and test landing pages. Advertorials, comparison pages, PDPs. Built in Claude Code, deployed to Vercel, tested live on a subdomain before anything gets pushed into the client's theme.

Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team.

Report on new customer economics. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended ROAS and not last click. You'll be expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it.

You're a fit if

You've done this with real money. Hands-on Meta at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them.

You're AI-native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude (or equivalent) as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it. If you can research, write, and build a converting page from scratch, we can teach you the buying.

You can write direct response in English at a native or near-native level. Hooks, scripts, ad copy, advertorial. In the customer's own words, not invented. This is the single biggest source of leverage in the role and the thing we screen hardest for. If writing persuasive English isn't a strength, this isn't the job.

You can communicate your ideas. This matters as much as anything else on this list. You'll be in front of clients constantly with nobody in between, so you need to be able to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire.

You have taste and you know when to hand off. You direct creative, you don't half-build it yourself. AI slop shipped to a client is a habit we break, not a shortcut we accept.

You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you.

Bonus: you've built or operated your own Shopify store or eComm brand. Several of our team have, and it shows.

You're not a fit if

  • "That wasn't my role" is in your vocabulary. It's the fastest way to end an interview here. If creative was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the creative.
  • You want to be told what to do this week.
  • You need a ticketing system to know what matters.

Benefits

Why This Role Is Exciting

This is not a maintenance job. You will be surrounded by people who move fast, care a lot, and take the work seriously.

You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale.

You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

jobs.excerpt: About Mile Marker We are a modern omnichannel agency uniquely connecting data, creative and media to accelerate results for growth marketers.
jobs.description:
About Mile Marker

We are a modern omnichannel agency uniquely connecting data, creative and media to accelerate results for growth marketers. Mile Marker is an agency where content fuels performance, media drives outcomes, and data underpins an engine that eliminates the gaps that slow down enterprise growth marketers. This unified growth engine feeds a learning system within Relay, our open-powered marketing stack, ensuring every impression, message and experience is built for a business outcome. Mile Marker’s client roster includes FreshPet, DoorDash, Spectrum, Webster Bank, TrueGreen, HelloFresh and Harry’s, among others.

We are a team of strategists, media experts, creatives, innovators and analysts. Over 100 Milers (our humans) strong with hybrid-offices in New York City and San Francisco.

For more information, go to.

About the role

We are seeking a hands-on Finance Manager to lead Mile Marker's accounts receivable, client media balance, and finance operations functions. Reporting to the VP, Controller, this role is the primary point of contact for our account managers and clients on invoicing, owns the reconciliation of client media advances against media vendor purchases, and manages a two-person offshore team supporting invoicing, collections, master data, and payroll administration. The ideal candidate is a process-minded operator who is comfortable configuring systems, actively uses AI to work smarter, and is energized by building a more efficient and accurate finance function.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own reconciliations of all client media balances, tracking client media advances against media vendor purchases to determine remaining funds available for media buying
  • Serve as the primary Accounts Receivable Manager, partnering with company account managers and clients to generate accurate, timely invoicing in accordance with contract terms
  • Report remaining media funds to account managers and media buyers to prevent campaign overspending.
  • Manage and delegate day-to-day invoicing to a full-time offshore team member, providing direction, review, and quality control
  • Supervise the weekly cadence of master data setup for new clients and jobs across our finance and operations tools (Deltek Workbook, Guidelines, Teamwork, and Vena), delegating execution to a dedicated offshore Finance Operations Analyst
  • Ensure data accuracy and consistency across systems, resolving data inconsistencies and errors flagged by the team
  • Oversee bi-weekly payroll administration support, ensuring paperwork prepared by the Finance Operations Analyst is complete, accurate, and on time for review and processing by the VP, Controller
  • Review aged AR reporting and support account managers in collecting client cash, escalating at-risk balances as needed
  • Participate in the month-end close, preparing and supporting balance sheet and other reconciliations as required
  • Identify and recommend ERP configuration enhancements that drive more efficient and accurate processing and reconciliations
  • Actively explore and implement AI-enabled tools and workflows to automate manual tasks and improve team productivity
  • Coach, train, and develop offshore team members, ensuring recurring weekly and bi-weekly deliverables are completed accurately and on schedule
  • Own process documentation and controls for all delegated tasks to support consistency and audit readiness
  • Continuously identify recurring finance and operations tasks that can be shifted from local resources to the offshore team, and expand team scope accordingly

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field
  • 5+ years of progressive experience in accounting or finance, with significant hands-on accounts receivable, billing, and reconciliation experience
  • Prior management of offshore resource teams a strong plus
  • ERP configuration experience and comfort learning new tools and processes
  • Familiarity with Deltek Workbook, Guidelines, Teamwork, Vena, or similar agency and FP&A platforms a plus; experience with master data management a plus
  • Exposure to payroll administration processes a plus
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and a demonstrated drive to find efficiencies by leveraging AI (required)
  • Experience supporting month-end close and preparing account reconciliations
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with account managers and clients
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and high attention to detail
  • Experience in a media agency, advertising, or project-based business, including media billing or client media funds, a strong plus

The pay range for this role is:

$70,000 - $85,000 USD per year

jobs.description:
This is a full stack engineering role focused on building and evolving Seeq's data analytics platform end-to-end. You will work across frontend and backend systems, owning features from browser to database in a complex enterprise product that serves industrial sectors like pharmaceuticals, energy, and manufacturing.

We are looking for an exceptional engineer who is highly effective across the full stack, with strong product sense and the ability to deliver polished, reliable software at every layer.

What You Will Do

You will lead the design and development of features that span the entire stack, from React-based frontend applications to backend services, APIs, and data layers.

You will work closely with Product, UX, and Engineering teams to understand user needs, make sound technical decisions, and deliver high-quality software that solves real problems.

You will own features end-to-end. You are comfortable building intuitive frontend experiences and equally comfortable working in backend services, databases, and distributed systems.

You will mentor and guide other engineers, helping raise the quality bar across the team through code review, pairing, and technical leadership.

You bring fresh technologies and approaches to the team and help the organization adopt them effectively. You are thoughtful about how AI is changing software development and how to leverage it to accelerate outcomes.

What We're Looking For

You are a highly productive engineer with a strong track record of delivering complex features across frontend and backend systems. You identify areas for improvement without waiting to be told, and you ship with consistency in a continuous delivery model.

You are meticulous and detail-oriented. You advocate for testing, continuous integration, and clean solutions. You address bugs immediately and actively reduce technical debt.

You collaborate effectively through code review, pairing, and clear communication. You are product- and user-focused — you engage with customers and can articulate the rationale behind features and pain points to your fellow engineers.

You are proficient in React, TypeScript, and modern frontend tooling (e.g., Tailwind), and can build polished, responsive user interfaces. You also bring depth in backend technologies such as a JVM language like Kotlin, Python, or GraphQL, and can work confidently with databases, distributed systems, and cloud platforms.

You bring strong ownership and agency. You do not wait to be told where the gaps are. You find them, make good judgments about where to focus, and drive improvements through to completion.

You are driven by impact beyond individual contributions. You work across boundaries for the benefit of the product and its users, and you maintain open communication about growth opportunities with your manager(s) and colleagues.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree (or equivalent experience) in computer science, software engineering, or a related field
  • Substantial professional experience in software development, with a solid record of designing, building and evolving complex software systems over a period of years: 6+ years for Staff, 10+ years for Principal
  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of software design principles, patterns, and best practices
  • Expertise in one or more backend JVM languages, such as Java, Kotlin, or Scala
  • Experience working with databases such as Postgres
  • Expertise in building large frontend applications with React or TypeScript preferred.
  • Ability to work effectively across frontend and backend codebases, owning features end-to-end
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills, with great attention to detail
  • Proven leadership skills, with the ability to guide and mentor junior engineers
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, and the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional team environment
  • Familiarity with agile development methodologies and tools, such as Scrum or Kanban

Benefits

Seeq is a remote-first (and only) company founded by serial entrepreneurs. Our executive team and board of directors have extensive experience with successful startup ventures in high-growth environments.

We are founded on the idea that companies need better solutions for quickly and easily getting business insight from their industrial process data. Our mission is to provide software and services that convert that data into meaningful information that the business can use to improve profitability and sustainability.

We have a wonderful, kind-hearted, talented team that loves to collaborate, lead by example, and exceed our customers' expectations. We are certified as a great place to work, and included in the Technology Fast 500 and Inc. Magazine's Best Places to Work.

The Perks of Working at Seeq

  • Competitive salary plus cash bonuses
    • $265,000- $310,000 CAD base salary
  • Benefits:
    • Unlimited PTO
    • Generous home office allowance
    • Annual company meetups
    • Internet and mobile phone reimbursements
    • Employee Assistance Program for coaching, counseling, and wellness
    • The best co-workers (we've analyzed the data, so we know it's true.)
    • Pet-friendly workspace (your dog will be so happy to have you home)
    • A job you'll love!

Seeq provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics.

jobs.excerpt: GROW WITH US: Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience.
jobs.description:
GROW WITH US:
Tandem Diabetes Care creates new possibilities for people living with diabetes, their loved ones, and their healthcare providers through a positively different experience. We’d love for you to team up with us to “innovate every day,” put “people first,” and take the “no-shortcuts” approach that has propelled us to become a leader in the diabetes technology industry.

STAY AWESOME:
Tandem Diabetes Care is proud to manufacture and sell the Tandem Mobi system and t:slim X2 insulin pump with Control-IQ+ technology — an advanced predictive algorithm that automates insulin delivery. But we’re so much more than that. Our company’s human-centered approach to design, development, and support delivers innovative products and services for people who use insulin. Because many of our own team members live with diabetes, or have a loved one impacted by diabetes, the work is personal, and we are committed to the cause. Learn more at tandemdiabetes.com

A DAY IN THE LIFE:

The Vice President, Global Inventory and Fulfillment leads global logistics, warehousing, distribution, inventory planning, and fulfillment. This leader balances cost, service, and supply continuity while aligning teams, partners, systems, and controls with manufacturing, commercial growth, and regulatory requirements.

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

  • Lead global freight, transportation, and distribution strategies across air, sea, and land to optimize landed cost, inventory carrying cost, and service.
  • Manage finished goods positioning, inventory turns, in-stock rates, peak capacity, and material inventory reporting, including average days on hand (ADOH).
  • Lead 3PL, carrier, and international distributor relationships; negotiate contracts and enforce service-level agreements.
  • Oversee operating budgets, capital plans, purchasing controls, and maintenance, repair, and operating (MRO) procurement.
  • Establishes and rapidly expands international business processes such as planning and distribution, including relationship with International Distributors.
  • Lead department planning for headcount, budgets, training, and systems; select and develop staff and support performance reviews, merit recommendations, and promotions.
  • Set, communicate, and evaluate annual team goals aligned with company priorities.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations, or a related technical field; Master’s degree and APICS certification preferred.
  • 15 years of progressive leadership experience in global supply chain, logistics, or fulfillment within a medical device market greater than $500M, including 8 years in senior management leading these teams.
  • Expertise in multi-region distribution centers, international trade and customs, high-volume inventory, production-cycle material planning, and procurement support for new products.
  • Strong financial acumen, including cost modeling, P&L ownership, and annual resource and material budgeting; data-driven process and resource prioritization.
  • Extensive ERP knowledge across planning, scheduling, purchasing, and inventory control.
  • cGMP experience and strong knowledge of QSR/GMP principles, documentation, policies, procedures, protocols, work instructions, and inspection requirements.
  • Ability to lead distributed teams across the US, EMEA, and Asia, collaborate across functions, communicate technical information and timelines, and drive quality and productivity improvements.

WHEN & WHERE YOU’LL WORK:

Remote (U.S.): This is a fully remote position open to candidates located within the United States, with a preference for individuals residing in the Eastern Time Zone. All necessary equipment will be provided, and onboarding and training will be conducted virtually.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS:

The starting base pay range for this position is $225,000 - $295,000 annually. Base pay will vary based on job-related knowledge, skills, experience and may also fluctuate depending on candidate’s location and the overall job market. In addition to base pay, Tandem offers a competitive compensation package that includes bonus and a robust benefits package.


Tandem offers health care benefits such as medical, dental, vision available your first day, as well as health savings accounts and flexible saving accounts. You’ll also receive 11 paid holidays per year, unlimited PTO and you will have access to a 401k plan with company match as well as an Employee Stock Purchase plan. Learn more about Tandem’s benefits here!


YOU SHOULD KNOW:

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local Fair Chance laws and regulations. A conditional offer of employment from Tandem is contingent upon successful completion of a pre-employment screening process comprised of a drug test (excluding marijuana) and background check, which includes a review of criminal history information.

Tandem has good cause to conduct a review of criminal history information of candidates for this position, as this role may involve access to proprietary, sensitive and/or confidential information, including customer protected health information. This review is required to ensure that individuals in such roles uphold high standards of trust and integrity so as to protect the interests of our customers, employees, and stakeholders.


SPONSORSHIP:

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE:
At Tandem, we believe joy fuels excellence. That's why we've built a workplace that celebrates your achievements and supports your well-being. Our team thrives on pushing boundaries and fostering growth, all while maintaining a spirit of fun and camaraderie. This is just one of the ways we stay awesome! Explore the benefits and reasons to love Tandem at .

BE YOU, WITH US!

We embrace the value that every single one of us brings to the table. But sometimes we forget that when we don’t meet 100% of a job description’s criteria – maybe you’re feeling that way right now? We encourage you to apply anyway. Because we want you to be you, with us.

Tandem is firmly committed to being an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, disability, sex, race, religion or belief, gender identity or expression, marriage/civil partnership, pregnancy/maternity, or sexual orientation. We are an inclusive organization, and we welcome applications from a wide range of candidates. Selection for roles will be based on individual merit alone.

REFERRALS:
We love a good referral! If you know someone who would be a great fit for this position, please share!

APPLICATION DEADLINE:
The position will be posted until a final candidate is selected for the requisition or the requisition has a sufficient number of applications.

Make a move that matters. Join Tandem Diabetes Care, where we're turning challenges into triumphs every day and where your talents will help shape a healthier, happier tomorrow.

Accounting Manager – GAAP, Month-End Close & Multi-Entity Accounting | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring an experienced Accounting Manager to own financial reporting, month-end close, payroll, compliance, and core accounting operations across complex client accounts.

This is not a bookkeeping or data-entry role.

You’ll take hands-on ownership of:

  • Month-end close
  • GAAP financial reporting
  • Accrual accounting
  • Payroll
  • AP & AR
  • General Ledger and reconciliations
  • U.S. sales tax
  • Multi-entity accounting
  • Financial reporting and analysis

This role is ideal for someone who understands accounting deeply, thrives in structured environments, and takes pride in keeping financial operations accurate, compliant, and organized.

What You’ll Own

Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

  • Own accurate and timely month-end close processes
  • Prepare and maintain:
    • P&L statements
    • Balance sheets
    • Cash flow reports
    • Supporting schedules
  • Prepare and review journal entries and reconciliations
  • Ensure financial reporting aligns with GAAP standards
  • Maintain clean, structured, and audit-ready workpapers
  • Meet client and internal reporting deadlines consistently

Core Accounting Operations

Oversee:

  • Accounts Payable (AP)
  • Accounts Receivable (AR)
  • General Ledger
  • Account reconciliations
  • Day-to-day accounting activity

You’ll also:

  • Maintain accurate books across multiple entities, locations, or business segments
  • Investigate and resolve accounting discrepancies
  • Ensure accounting systems remain clean and organized
  • Maintain strong financial controls and documentation

Payroll & Employee Setup

Process payroll using platforms such as:

  • Gusto
  • Paylocity
  • ADP

Responsibilities include:

  • Employee setup and onboarding within payroll systems
  • Payroll processing and validation
  • Adjustments and deductions
  • Reimbursements
  • Payroll reporting
  • Documentation and compliance

U.S. Sales Tax & Compliance

  • Calculate and file U.S. state sales tax
  • Track filing deadlines and requirements
  • Maintain organized compliance documentation
  • Ensure adherence to accounting policies and financial procedures
  • Support audits and compliance requests as needed

Financial Reporting, Analysis & Forecasting

  • Build custom financial reports and dashboards
  • Support budgeting and forecasting
  • Perform variance analysis
  • Provide financial insights to leadership
  • Use Excel and reporting tools to improve financial visibility
  • Help translate accounting data into useful business information

Process Improvement & Documentation

  • Review accounting workflows and identify inefficiencies
  • Standardize processes across clients and systems
  • Improve workflows through:
    • Automation
    • Templates
    • Documentation
  • Build and maintain accounting SOPs
  • Improve scalability without sacrificing financial accuracy

Client & Leadership Coordination

  • Communicate regularly with leadership regarding priorities and deliverables
  • Maintain visibility around reporting timelines
  • Support client-facing accounting communication when required
  • Coordinate across accounting, payroll, finance, and operational workflows
  • Proactively flag issues before they become larger problems

Requirements – Must Have

Experience

  • 5+ years of accounting or finance experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with:
    • Accrual accounting
    • GAAP financial reporting
    • Month-end close
  • Experience managing accounting across:
    • Multiple entities
    • Multiple locations
    • Multiple business segments

QuickBooks

Proficiency with one or more of:

  • QuickBooks Online
  • QuickBooks Desktop
  • QuickBooks Enterprise

Advanced Excel

Strong proficiency with:

  • XLOOKUP
  • INDEX/MATCH
  • Pivot Tables
  • Data Tables
  • Financial reporting and analysis

Payroll & Compliance

  • Experience processing payroll through Gusto or similar platforms
  • Experience handling U.S. sales tax filings
  • Strong understanding of accounting controls and financial documentation

Communication & Execution

  • Strong written and verbal English
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • High level of ownership and accountability

Nice to Have

Experience with:

  • NetSuite
  • Paylocity
  • ADP
  • Ramp
  • Bill.com
  • Clockify

Also valuable:

  • Outsourced accounting experience
  • Multi-client accounting experience
  • Experience improving accounting systems and workflows
  • Experience working across complex or multi-entity organizations

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You:

  • Take ownership of financial accuracy
  • Understand accrual accounting beyond basic bookkeeping
  • Thrive in structured, detail-oriented environments
  • Manage deadlines without sacrificing accuracy
  • Proactively identify accounting issues
  • Are comfortable managing complex accounting structures
  • Communicate clearly with leadership and clients
  • Value precision, accountability, and consistency
  • Enjoy improving systems instead of simply maintaining them

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may:

  • Review reconciliations and General Ledger activity
  • Prepare journal entries and close schedules
  • Process payroll and validate employee changes
  • Prepare financial statements
  • Review AP and AR activity
  • Investigate accounting discrepancies
  • File or review U.S. sales tax obligations
  • Build reports for leadership
  • Communicate with clients or internal stakeholders
  • Improve accounting workflows and SOPs

In short: you ensure accounting operations remain accurate, compliant, organized, and scalable across complex business environments.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Accurate and timely month-end close
  • Error-free financial reporting and reconciliations
  • Clean and audit-ready accounting records
  • Timely and accurate payroll
  • On-time tax filings and compliance
  • Strong accounting workflow consistency
  • Reliable reporting and financial visibility
  • Leadership confidence in financial accuracy

Why This Role Stands Out

  • High ownership over accounting operations
  • Direct collaboration with leadership
  • Exposure to complex and multi-entity accounting
  • Opportunity to improve systems and processes
  • Strong operational structure and clear expectations
  • Fully remote environment
  • Long-term growth potential into:
    • Senior Accounting Manager
    • Controller
    • Finance Manager
    • Director of Accounting

Interview Process

  1. Initial Screening Call
  2. Recruiter Interview
  3. Final Interview
  4. Practical Assessment – Accounting Scenario
  5. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you:

  • Have strong GAAP and accrual accounting expertise
  • Have 5+ years of accounting or finance experience
  • Are experienced with QuickBooks, payroll, and U.S. sales tax
  • Can confidently manage complex accounting workflows
  • Take pride in financial accuracy and operational ownership

We’d love to hear from you.

Important: Spark Hire Video Interview

As part of our application process, qualified candidates will be invited to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

This is your opportunity to introduce yourself and highlight your experience with GAAP, accrual accounting, month-end close, QuickBooks, payroll, multi-entity accounting, U.S. sales tax, and financial reporting.

Please complete your Spark Hire interview promptly after receiving the invitation. Candidates who do not complete the video interview may not move forward in the hiring process.

jobs.description:
At Keywords Studios, we turn our passion for games, technology, and interactive storytelling into world-class support for the creators who shape the industry. Since 1998, we’ve grown into a global network of 70+ studios, partnering with the biggest names in gaming across every stage of development — from early concept to launch and live operations.

Our goal is simple: to be the go-to global platform for technical and creative services in the video games industry. We help teams stay agile, scale quickly, and focus on building unforgettable player experiences. With deep expertise across our industry-leading service lines and a worldwide team of specialists, we work side by side with our clients as their trusted partner, providing the talent, technology, and reach needed to bring great games to life.

Join us and help drive the adoption and growth of our Player Engagement Specialized Services, including Trust & Safety, Monetization, and VIP Concierge✨

Role overview

As an Account Manager in our team, you’ll be a key member of the Player Engagement Sales & Business Development team, managing relationships with some of the world’s largest enterprise game companies. You will be responsible for developing and executing enterprise account plans, expanding product adoption, and uncovering whitespace opportunities within existing accounts.

You’ll join a global team and work cross-functionally with diverse teams and cultures to support customer success, legal and billing discussions, overall account strategy, and collaboration with the production team to protect revenues — using a combination of data and real-world insights to navigate ambiguity and deliver outcomes that benefit both our clients and Keywords. You’ll also leverage your industry network to create new opportunities and expand Player Engagement services across your accounts.

If you’re passionate about building strong client relationships, growing enterprise accounts, and delivering measurable results, this is a role where you can make a real impact!

What are we looking for? Our Account Manager has a knack for the following skills:

Account Management & Strategy

  • Build and execute enterprise account plans, including defining strategies to expand share of wallet within existing customers by addressing whitespace opportunities.
  • Work closely with product and customer success teams to expand adoption of Player Engagement services.
  • Act as the single point of contact for customer health, including overall account strategy, legal and billing discussions, and increasing overall customer usage of Helpshift platform and services.
  • Work with the production team to protect revenues.
  • Receive & respond to customer RFIs/RFPs.
  • Use existing networks within the games industry to open doors and create net new opportunities for Keywords with a focus on introducing Player Engagement Services.

Analytics

  • Report on weekly, monthly, and quarterly pipeline opportunities and progress toward quarterly revenue goals.

Communication

  • Work cross-functionally with internal teams to ensure alignment on account strategy and customer objectives.
  • Communicate effectively with senior-level stakeholders (CxO, Studio Head, SVP, VP) to maintain strong customer relationships.
  • Act as a trusted advisor, providing guidance and support to enterprise clients.

You’d be a great fit for this role if you have:

  • At least 3 years of Account Management experience supporting Game Industry customers.
  • Experience engaging with game publishers at executive levels (CxO, Studio Head, SVP, VP).
  • Proven experience managing and growing an existing book of business in excess of $20M+ ACV.
  • Experience selling to or working within the Player Engagement ecosystem.
  • Strong critical thinking, commercial creativity, and process-driven execution.
  • Data-driven mentality and ability to work through ambiguity.
  • High attention to detail and ability to perform as a trusted advisor for customers.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Self-motivated and able to thrive in a remote working environment.
  • Willingness to travel as required.

What do we offer?

Keywords Studios is dedicated to following a well-established Equal Opportunities Policy. We endeavor to create a workplace which provides equal opportunities for all employees and potential employees.

Phases of our recruitment journey:

  • Screening stage – We begin with an initial review of applications to assess alignment with the role.
  • Interview with a Talent Acquisition Specialist – Selected candidates are invited to a conversation with our Talent Acquisition team to discuss experience, motivation, and role expectations.

Snyk is the leader in secure AI software development, helping millions of developers develop fast and stay secure as AI transforms how software is built. Our AI-native Developer Security Platform integrates seamlessly into development and security workflows, making it easy to find, fix, and prevent vulnerabilities — from code and dependencies to containers and cloud.

Our mission is to empower every developer to innovate securely in the AI era — boosting productivity while reducing business risk. We’re not your average security company - we build Snyk on One Team, Care Deeply, Customer Centric, and Forward Thinking.

Why this role?

Our Solutions Architecture & SME team is seeking a new team member to support our go-to-market efforts. The Solution Architect is first and foremost a subject matter expert in Application Security testing (SAST, SCA, DAST, etc) and/or agentic software development & building AI-native applications.

Work closely with sales leaders to drive revenue through new sales campaigns and removing deal-specific roadblocks.

jobs.description:
The Care Navigator is responsible for conducting social care screenings, eligibility assessments, referral coordination, and ongoing care navigation activities for Medicaid members and other eligible populations participating in Social Care Network (SCN), 1115 Waiver, ILOS, Value-Added Benefit (VAB), and related programs. This work is completed telephonically.

The Care Navigator provides person-centered, culturally responsive, trauma-informed telephonic and technology-enabled navigation services designed to identify unmet health-related social needs and connect individuals to appropriate community-based resources and services. Responsibilities include screening completion, eligibility verification, referral placement, closed-loop referral follow-up, documentation, consent management, and coordination with community-based organizations, managed care organizations, and healthcare partners.

Documentation and tracking activities will occur within both internal and external technology platforms. The Care Navigator is expected to maintain compliance with organizational policies, state program requirements, productivity standards, quality metrics, and confidentiality regulations.

The Care Navigator reports to the Care Navigation Program Manager. This is a remote position that may be located anywhere in the United States but CST or EST hours will be worked. Occasional travel to offices in Iowa and New York may be required.

Hourly wage: $23/hour

Position Responsibilities may include, but not limited to

    • Conduct standardized, health-related social needs screenings in accordance with state and program requirements
    • Complete eligibility assessments and supporting documentation for social care services and enhanced navigation programs
    • Initiate, monitor, and close referrals within designated referral management platforms
    • Accurately document and record service activities, encounters, and time spent in accordance with program billing and reporting requirements
    • Perform closed-loop referral follow-up activities to confirm service connection and identify unresolved barriers
    • Conduct outreach attempts and follow-up activities in accordance with program timelines and documentation standards
    • Educate clients regarding available community resources, benefits, and social care services
    • Coordinate with healthcare providers, managed care organizations, and community-based organizations to support continuity of care
    • Escalate complex cases, urgent social needs, or safety concerns to supervisory or clinical staff as appropriate
    • Maintain compliance with HIPAA, confidentiality requirements, and all applicable state and federal regulations
    • Meet productivity, timeliness, documentation, and quality assurance standards established by the organization and program requirements
    • Participate in ongoing training, workflow updates, and quality improvement initiatives
    • Support reassessment and renewal activities as required by program guidelines

Required Skills and Experience

    • Minimum of two (2) years’ experience in a healthcare, social service, or behavioral health setting; this may include any role with direct client contact
    • Ability to engage individuals experiencing complex social and health-related barriers with empathy and professionalism
    • Ability to maintain accurate and detailed documentation in compliance with regulatory and organizational requirements
    • Prior work that included in-person or telephonic interactions with clients or patients
    • Excellent written, verbal, and interpersonal communication skills
    • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
    • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other standard office technology platforms
    • Exceptional attention to detail and ability to prioritize competing tasks and projects effectively
    • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while exercising sound professional judgment
    • Ability to routinely use standard office equipment and technology, including laptop computers and smartphones

Preferred Skills and Experience

    • Training or certification in Trauma-Informed Care, Motivational Interviewing, and/or Crisis De-escalation techniques
    • Experience working with individuals experiencing food insecurity, substance use disorders, behavioral health needs, homelessness, and/or transition from incarceration or institutional settings
    • Previous experience providing telephonic screenings, care navigation, care management, vocational rehab, or health coaching services

Physical Requirements

  • Repetitive motions that include the wrists, hands and/or fingers
  • Sedentary work that primarily involves sitting, remaining in a stationary position for prolonged periods
  • Visual perception to perform job including peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus

Our team members enjoy:

  • Eligible for Referral Bonuses starting Day 1
  • Weekly paychecks
  • PTO, 401k, & a Full benefits package

jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tâches et responsabilitésMissionDans le cadre de la transformation numérique d'une administration publique, l'organisation conçoit, exploite et sécurise des services numériques pour l'administration.
jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Mission

Dans le cadre de la transformation numérique d'une administration publique, l'organisation conçoit, exploite et sécurise des services numériques pour l'administration. Elle est dirigée par un CIO ou directeur général, entouré d'un comité de direction composé de 15 membres. Ce collectif traite des enjeux transversaux, avec des équipes nombreuses et des attentes élevées des autorités politiques et des directions générales.

Le collectif élargi réunit environ 50 managers. La mission vise à renforcer le fonctionnement du comité de direction en tant que collectif, notamment la prise de responsabilité de chacun et chacune, l'appropriation commune des décisions et la coopération entre les pôles. Il s'agit également d'orienter l'équipe vers la résolution des problèmes plutôt que vers la recherche de leurs causes.

Un plan de transformation a été présenté à la ministre. Il comprend notamment un volet consacré à la réorganisation, à l'évolution de la culture, au renforcement de la prise de responsabilité ainsi qu'à la clarification des missions et des rôles.

📌 Objectifs de l'accompagnement

À l'issue de l'accompagnement, le comité de direction devra :

  • partager une lecture commune de son fonctionnement actuel, de ses forces et de ses axes de progrès ;
  • s'accorder sur des règles de fonctionnement et des engagements concrets, portés par chacun et chacune ;
  • renforcer la prise de responsabilité individuelle et collective dans les décisions et leur mise en œuvre ;
  • disposer de repères lui permettant de poursuivre de manière autonome la dynamique engagée.

La dirigeante est la commanditaire de la mission et participe pleinement aux travaux avec son comité.

📝 Description de la mission

La personne retenue proposera une démarche adaptée au contexte. Celle-ci couvrira au minimum les étapes suivantes, en précisant leur contenu, leur enchaînement et leur durée.

  1. Prise de connaissance et diagnostic
    • écoute individuelle de chaque membre du comité de direction, y compris la dirigeante, ainsi que d'une partie du collectif élargi ;
    • attention particulière portée à un département d'infrastructure et d'opérations ;
    • prise en compte des démarches déjà menées au sein du comité.
  2. Restitution au comité de direction
    • partage du diagnostic avec le comité ;
    • proposition de la suite de la démarche, ajustée avec la dirigeante et le comité.
  3. Temps de travail collectif
    • organisation d'une ou plusieurs séquences de travail avec le comité, dont un temps de type séminaire ;
    • préparation de ces séquences avec les participants.
  4. Ancrage et suivi
    • suivi des engagements pris par le comité ;
    • possibilité d'un appui individuel ponctuel pour un membre du comité, à la demande.

📝 Votre profil

Une expérience en tant que Business Change Consultant expert (T4) est requise.

Vous disposez notamment des compétences suivantes :

  • expérience confirmée dans l'accompagnement de comités de direction ;
  • expérience dans l'accompagnement de dirigeants ;
  • solides capacités de communication, aisance relationnelle et pédagogie ;
  • expérience en coaching d'équipe ;
  • expérience en accompagnement du changement.

Les qualités attendues comprennent également :

  • orientation service ;
  • adaptabilité au service du changement ;
  • collaboration ;
  • créativité ;
  • flexibilité.

La maîtrise du français est requise pour cette mission.

⚠️ Ce poste est proposé en tant que rôle freelance à temps partiel (40%).

jobs.description:
Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Model Training (infra & platform)

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Required Skills:

  • Distributed ML Training Infrastructure

  • GPU Performance & Inference Optimization

  • Distributed Systems & Platform Architecture

  • Technical Leadership & System Ownership

The Role:

In this role, you will take technical ownership of the distributed systems and platforms that enable researchers to train increasingly capable models, execute large-scale experiments, and deploy specialized AI systems efficiently.

You will work across distributed training, GPU infrastructure, inference optimization, simulation environments, and agent execution frameworks, making critical architectural decisions that directly influence research velocity and model performance.

What You'll Do:

  • Architect, build, and scale shared infrastructure for supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and on-policy distillation (OPD), supporting language, multimodal, and robotics workloads.

  • Design distributed training and execution pipelines that coordinate GPU workers, rollout generation, teacher-model inference, reward computation, and simulation environments.

  • Develop high-performance infrastructure for model training and inference, optimizing GPU utilization, memory management, communication, storage, and distributed execution.

  • Build and evolve the core architecture of micro1's agent ecosystem, including execution runtimes, tool interfaces, environment integrations, model registries, and serving APIs.

  • Develop robust systems for experiment tracking, dataset and model versioning, checkpointing, fault recovery, and observability to improve research reproducibility and operational reliability.

  • Identify and eliminate infrastructure bottlenecks, reducing experiment turnaround time and enabling researchers to run increasingly complex training workloads.

  • Define technical standards, platform interfaces, and architectural patterns that support collaboration across research, infrastructure, and applied engineering teams.

  • Lead critical engineering initiatives from system design through implementation and production operations, mentoring engineers while maintaining direct ownership of technically challenging components.

What We're Looking For:

  • Strong computer science fundamentals, particularly in distributed systems, concurrency, networking, and performance engineering.

  • Extensive experience designing, building, and operating scalable backend systems or distributed computing platforms.

  • Proficiency in Python and at least one systems-oriented programming language, such as C++, Rust, or Go.

  • Hands-on experience with GPU-based machine learning infrastructure, distributed training, model inference, or large-scale compute orchestration.

  • Strong understanding of system performance, including compute utilization, memory efficiency, communication overhead, scheduling, and fault tolerance.

  • Experience designing reliable APIs, services, and infrastructure components that support complex engineering or research workflows.

  • Demonstrated technical ownership, including making architectural decisions, leading cross-functional initiatives, and delivering systems that other engineers depend on.

  • Ability to operate effectively in fast-moving research environments where requirements evolve and infrastructure must support rapid experimentation.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with distributed ML frameworks and technologies such as PyTorch Distributed, DeepSpeed, Ray, Megatron-LM, or similar systems.

  • Familiarity with GPU inference engines and optimization frameworks such as vLLM, TensorRT-LLM, or equivalent technologies.

  • Experience building reinforcement learning infrastructure, rollout orchestration systems, or distributed agent execution environments.

  • Knowledge of CUDA, GPU kernel optimization, NCCL, or low-level GPU performance engineering.

  • Experience with Kubernetes, container orchestration, cluster scheduling, and cloud-based GPU infrastructure.

  • Familiarity with simulation platforms, robotics infrastructure, or large-scale agent evaluation systems.

  • Contributions to open-source infrastructure, distributed computing frameworks, or high-performance machine learning systems.

Compensation & Benefits Notice:

All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies.
