jobs.description:
Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Model Training (applied research)

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

In this role, you will work across language models, multimodal systems, robotics, and autonomous agents, developing models optimized for specific applications and environments. You will own the full model development lifecycle, from understanding application requirements and designing training datasets to model adaptation, evaluation, and production deployment.

Our objective is to build specialized models that match or exceed the quality of frontier models on targeted workloads while significantly improving inference efficiency, latency, and cost.

You will operate at the intersection of applied machine learning research and production engineering, turning advances in model training into reliable, high-performance systems with measurable real-world impact.

What You'll Do

  1. Train, fine-tune, and adapt language, vision-language, and robotics models using supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), imitation learning, and distillation.
  2. Develop specialized models for complex applications, including multimodal understanding, robotic perception and control, and autonomous agents capable of reasoning, planning, and tool use.
  3. Build simulation-based training and evaluation environments to study policy learning, task generalization, and the transfer of capabilities from simulated to real-world settings.
  4. Combine expert demonstrations, human feedback, synthetic datasets, and environment-generated trajectories into effective training datasets, reward signals, and learning curricula.
  5. Develop specialized models that power micro1's flow ecosystem, improving data generation, annotation, quality assurance, and automated grading workflows.
  6. Incorporate expert corrections and model performance feedback into iterative training cycles to continuously improve accuracy, robustness, and task success.
  7. Optimize models for production inference, balancing quality, latency, throughput, and computational efficiency against frontier-model baselines.
  8. Collaborate with research and platform engineering teams to transition promising prototypes into scalable, production-ready model deployments.

What We're Looking For

  1. Strong foundations in machine learning and deep learning, with hands-on experience training, adapting, and evaluating modern AI models.
  2. Practical experience in one or more areas, including large language models, vision-language models, robotics, reinforcement learning, or autonomous agents.
  3. Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch, with the ability to develop reliable training, evaluation, and inference pipelines.
  4. Experience translating application requirements into measurable model objectives, benchmarks, and performance improvements.
  5. Solid software engineering fundamentals, including the ability to build maintainable systems and move research prototypes toward production.
  6. Familiarity with model adaptation techniques such as fine-tuning, distillation, imitation learning, or reinforcement learning.
  7. Strong experimental judgment and the ability to independently identify performance bottlenecks, evaluate trade-offs, and iterate toward effective solutions.

Nice to Have

  1. Experience with robotics, embodied AI, vision-language-action models, or simulation-based policy learning.
  2. Familiarity with agent frameworks, tool-using models, and environment-driven training.
  3. Experience with synthetic data generation, human-in-the-loop learning, or automated evaluation systems.
  4. Knowledge of inference optimization techniques, including quantization, batching, model compression, and efficient serving.
  5. Experience deploying specialized models in production environments with demanding latency, reliability, or cost requirements.
  6. Research contributions or open-source work in applied machine learning, multimodal AI, robotics, or agent systems.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $200,000 –$320,000. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

jobs.excerpt: Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Model Training (post-training research) Job Type: Full-time Location: Remote The Role In this role, you will investigate how learning algorithms, training data, and evaluation methodologies interact to produce stronger reasoning, generalization, and agent capabilities.
jobs.description:
Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Model Training (post-training research)

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

In this role, you will investigate how learning algorithms, training data, and evaluation methodologies interact to produce stronger reasoning, generalization, and agent capabilities. You will explore new approaches to reinforcement learning, distillation, and data-efficient training, translating research insights into scalable methods that improve model intelligence.

This is a highly experimental role at the intersection of fundamental machine learning research and large-scale model development. You will have the opportunity to formulate research hypotheses, design ambitious experiments, and develop training methods that directly influence the capabilities of our models.

What You'll Do

  1. Research, implement, and scale advanced post-training methods, including supervised fine-tuning (SFT), reinforcement learning (RL), and on-policy distillation (OPD), across large language and multimodal models.
  2. Investigate learning objectives, optimization dynamics, exploration strategies, and credit assignment mechanisms to improve training stability, sample efficiency, and capability acquisition.
  3. Develop and refine training recipes by jointly optimizing data mixtures, sampling strategies, curricula, and evaluation methodologies.
  4. Design methods for learning from expert demonstrations, human preferences, corrections, and model-generated trajectories, identifying where human feedback delivers the greatest improvements.
  5. Research the co-evolution of generators, reward models, and graders, developing approaches that improve both model performance and the quality of the training signals they consume.
  6. Design rigorous experiments, ablation studies, and evaluation frameworks to measure generalization, reasoning, and performance on realistic downstream tasks.
  7. Own research initiatives end-to-end, from identifying promising directions and implementing new algorithms to executing large-scale experiments and validating results.

What We're Looking For

  1. Strong foundations in machine learning, deep learning, optimization, and modern model training techniques.
  2. Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or post-training large-scale language or multimodal models.
  3. Deep technical expertise in one or more areas such as reinforcement learning, model distillation, reward modeling, data selection, or learning dynamics.
  4. Strong proficiency in Python and PyTorch, with the ability to implement, debug, and optimize complex training pipelines.
  5. Experience designing controlled experiments, interpreting model behavior, and translating empirical findings into actionable research directions.
  6. Ability to independently navigate ambiguous research problems, formulate hypotheses, and iterate quickly based on experimental evidence.
  7. Strong analytical thinking and a research-driven mindset, with an emphasis on reproducibility, scientific rigor, and measurable improvements.

Nice to Have

  1. Experience with RLHF, RLAIF, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning for reasoning and agentic tasks.
  2. Familiarity with distributed training, large-scale experimentation, and GPU-based model optimization.
  3. Experience developing reward models, verifiers, graders, or automated evaluation systems.
  4. Research contributions to post-training, reinforcement learning, or related areas through publications, open-source projects, or production systems.
  5. Experience investigating synthetic data generation, curriculum learning, or iterative self-improvement techniques.

Compensation & Benefits Notice

The national pay range for this full-time position is base salary of $200,000 –$320,000. All employees are eligible for equity compensation, and employees may also receive performance-based bonuses, dependent on role and subject to company policies. micro1 provides a comprehensive benefits package, including up to 100% reimbursement for health-insurance premiums, paid time off, a 401(K) plan with a company match, and additional benefits designed to support a high-performing, remote-first workforce.

jobs.description:
Cardinal Health, Inc. (NYSE: CAH) is a global healthcare services and products company. We provide customized solutions for hospitals, healthcare systems, pharmacies, ambulatory surgery centers, clinical laboratories, physician offices and patients in the home. We are a distributor of pharmaceuticals and specialty products; a global manufacturer and distributor of medical and laboratory products; an operator of nuclear pharmacies and manufacturing facilities; and a provider of performance and data solutions. Working to be healthcare’s most trusted partner, our customer-centric focus drives continuous improvement and leads to innovative solutions that improve the lives of people every day. With approximately 50,000 employees worldwide, Cardinal Health ranks among the top fifteen in the Fortune 500.


Department Overview:

Information Security and Risk develops, implements, and enforces security controls to protect the organization's technology assets from intentional or inadvertent modification, disclosure, or destruction. The function of this job family is to ensure secure, authorized, and compliant access to the organization's data, systems, and physical resources. It focuses on defining, creating, managing, and governing digital identities and their associated access privileges to protect the enterprise from security breaches, insider threats, and regulatory non-compliance


We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer to join our Workforce Identity team. In this pivotal role, you will be instrumental in designing, implementing, and managing IAM solutions that secure our global workforce and enterprise applications and facilitate the secure, efficient, and seamless integration of identity and access systems in context of our rapid growth through Mergers and Acquisitions. You will ensure robust access controls, streamline user experiences, and maintain operational continuity across our diverse IT landscape. By automating lifecycle events, integrating HR systems, and building intuitive self-service pathways, you will directly influence workforce productivity, security posture, and overall onboarding experience. The ideal candidate will have deep technical expertise in modern IAM principles, protocols and products along with strong management and communication skills.


Responsibilities:

M&A and SSO Integration

  • Lead IAM technical workstreams for Mergers, Acquisitions, and Divestitures.
  • Consolidate disparate identity providers (IdPs) into a unified enterprise SSO platform.
  • Design and execute cross-domain authentication and federation strategies to migrate or merge user populations under tight timelines.

Automation and Workflows

  • Design, implement, and maintain scalable IAM solutions including Single Sign-On (SSO), Identity Lifecycle Management (LCM), Identity Governance and Administration (IGA), and Privileged Access Management (PAM).
  • Develop automated workflows and API-driven integrations to streamline user onboarding, transitions, and offboarding (LCM), reducing manual provisioning overhead.
  • Implement infrastructure-as-code (IaC) principles for configuration management of IAM platforms.

Security Policy, Compliance and Support

  • Design and enforce Enterprise SSO Security Policies, including Phishing resistant Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), Least Privilege access models, conditional Access Policies, and Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) frameworks.
  • Conduct regular access reviews, support IT compliance audits, and ensure systems comply with regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA, SOX) to provide auditable records of access activities.
  • Troubleshoot, identify, and resolve complex identity and access-related issues, providing Tier 3 engineering support to internal teams and end-users during and after integrations.

Collaboration and Operational Excellence:

  • Manage and optimize hybrid environments consisting of Active Directory (AD) and Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams (Information Security, IT Operations, HR, and Application Development) to ensure seamless IAM alignment with business processes.
  • Develop, review, and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, runbooks, and configurations.

Qualifications:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 5+ years of progressive experience as an IAM Engineer, designing and implementing enterprise scale solutions with significant experience in supporting M&A integration projects preferred.

Core Technical Expertise:

  • Identity & Directory Services: Strong command of Active Directory (AD), Microsoft Entra ID, LDAP, and Group Policy management.
  • IAM & Federation Standards: Extensive knowledge of authentication and authorization standards (SAML, OAuth, OIDC, and SCIM).
  • IAM Platforms: Hands-on experience with enterprise IdPs and governance suites s(e.g., Okta, Ping Identity, Microsoft Entra ID, CyberArk, SailPoint, or ForgeRock).
  • Scripting & Automation: Proficiency in scripting languages (PowerShell, Python, or Bash) for automation, API integrations, and lifecycle management.
  • Security Frameworks: Solid understanding of Zero Trust architecture, Least Privilege, RBAC, and modern DevOps practices/SDLC.
  • Emerging Tech: Familiarity with AI/ML concepts and their application to risk-based authentication, user behavior analytics, and modern IAM contexts.

Professional Attributes:

  • Ownership Mindset: A self-starter who takes end-to-end ownership of projects, holding themselves accountable for the security and operational integrity of the IAM platform.
  • Analytical Problem Solving: Excellent troubleshooting abilities to resolve unique access integration challenges in a fast-paced environment.
  • Communication: Ability to articulate complex security concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

What is expected of you and others at this level

  • Applies comprehensive knowledge and a thorough understanding of concepts, principles, and technical capabilities to perform varied tasks and projects
  • May contribute to the development of policies and procedures
  • Works on complex projects of large scope
  • Develops technical solutions to a wide range of difficult problems
  • Solutions are innovative and consistent with organization objectives
  • Completes work; independently receives general guidance on new projects
  • Work reviewed for purpose of meeting objectives
  • May act as a mentor to less experienced colleagues

Team & Stakeholder Leadership

jobs.description:
À propos de nous

Nesto Cloud est la plateforme technologique hypothécaire de bout en bout, native du cloud et propulsée par l'IA au Canada. Elle aide les institutions financières à moderniser le prêt grâce à l'automatisation intelligente par l'IA, à sa technologie propriétaire d'IA et de cloud, ainsi qu'à des solutions d'impartition des processus d'affaires (BPO).

Soutenus par l'écosystème du Groupe Nesto, nous transformons des décennies d'expertise hypothécaire en une technologie de pointe qui réduit les coûts d'exploitation hypothécaire, accélère le processus de prêt, renforce la conformité et offre des expériences exceptionnelles aux prêteurs comme aux emprunteurs.

Groupe Nesto

Le Groupe Nesto est le chef de file canadien des solutions technologiques et de financement hypothécaire, gérant plus de 80 milliards de dollars canadiens en prêts hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux. Privilégié par plusieurs des plus grandes institutions financières du pays, nous combinons plus de 50 ans d'expertise hypothécaire à notre technologie propriétaire cloud et d'IA pour façonner l'avenir du prêt.

Grâce à notre technologie propriétaire cloud et d'IA, nesto est devenu l'un des prêteurs hypothécaires à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada, gagnant des parts de marché dans le secteur résidentiel direct aux consommateurs (D2C), le réseau des courtiers et le secteur commercial multi-résidentiel. Reconnu parmi les entreprises du palmarès Fast 50 de Deloitte pendant trois années consécutives, nous continuons de faire évoluer l'industrie grâce à l'innovation, la technologie et des solutions axées sur le client.

Exploitant nos activités à travers notre famille de marques — CMLS, nesto et Nesto Cloud —, notre mission est de bâtir l'écosystème hypothécaire canadien du futur et de créer un véritable champion canadien des technologies de prêt et des services financiers. Pour en savoir plus :

La vie chez Nesto Cloud

Chez Nesto Cloud, vous bâtirez l'avenir du prêt aux côtés de certains des meilleurs développeurs, ingénieurs en IA et experts en prêt hypothécaire du pays. Vous travaillerez avec une pile technologique moderne et des cadres de développement propulsés par l'IA conçus pour vous aider à innover, à développer vos compétences et à accélérer votre carrière.À propos du rôle

Nous recherchons un(e) développeur.euse SRE (System Reliability Engineering) passionné(e) qui partage nos principes fondamentaux et souhaite rejoindre notre équipe Plateforme dédiée. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec nos équipes de développement pour garantir la stabilité et la performance du système à travers diverses initiatives, alors que nous continuons à faire évoluer notre plateforme hypothécaire moderne de demain.

Ce que vous ferez

Vous appliquerez les principes de l'ingénierie logicielle aux opérations, en vous concentrant sur les objectifs fondamentaux du SRE : stabilité, performance et automatisation. De manière cruciale, vous agirez comme un.e multiplicateur.trice de force en autonomisant nos équipes de développement.

Fiabilité des services et observabilité

Piloter les efforts SRE pour améliorer la résilience globale, la disponibilité, la performance et la stabilité de la plateforme.

Concevoir et mettre en œuvre une surveillance active de bout en bout, ainsi que l'alerte et la détection des problèmes à l'aide d'outils comme Datadog.

Collecter, traiter et analyser les métriques, les journaux (logs) et les traces des systèmes et des applications pour aider à l'optimisation des performances et à la recherche de pannes.

Améliorer continuellement la performance et l'évolutivité de notre système, y compris l'étude et la mise en œuvre de solutions aux goulots d'étranglement actuels (ex: stratégie de sharding, architecture de base de données, communication entre microservices).

Automatisation et vélocité des développeurs

Créer des systèmes et des services durables grâce à une automatisation poussée afin d'éliminer les blocages opérationnels et réduire les tâches répétitives (toil).

Améliorer nos pipelines CI/CD (GitHub Actions) et le flux de déploiement (Kubernetes, ArgoCD) en renforçant l'observabilité des applications et de l'infrastructure.

Optimiser l'automatisation de notre infrastructure (Pulumi, TypeScript, Crossplane) et faire mûrir notre infrastructure cloud pour garantir qu'elle soit sécurisée, conforme et rentable.

Partage de connaissances et autonomisation

Favoriser une culture de qualité et de responsabilité en permettant aux développeurs de gérer leurs services en toute confiance.

Guider et former les équipes de développement sur les meilleures pratiques d'observabilité, les configurations d'alerte et la définition des objectifs de niveau de service (SLO) pour les services critiques.

Améliorer la clarté et l'adoption de notre processus de gestion et d'analyse des incidents.

Soutenir les développeurs lors des périodes d'astreinte et des situations critiques, en transférant vos connaissances afin qu'ils puissent intervenir rapidement lors d'incidents de production.

Collaboration transverse et propriété de la plateforme

Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de développement pour intégrer les considérations opérationnelles et conseiller sur la conception du système, la planification de la capacité et les discussions architecturales.

Participer au conseil en conception de systèmes, à la gestion de la plateforme et à la planification des capacités.

Fournir un support opérationnel de premier plan et de l'ingénierie pour les applications logicielles distribuées à grande échelle.

Participer à la rotation d'astreinte pour l'ingénierie de la plateforme.

Profil recherché

Vous avez plus de 5 ans d'expérience technique pertinente, dont une partie importante dans un rôle de Site Reliability Engineering, DevOps ou Production Engineering.

Vous possédez une expérience approfondie de l'infrastructure cloud avec l'un des principaux fournisseurs, idéalement Google Cloud et/ou AWS.

Vous maîtrisez les langages de programmation/scripting, une expérience en Go (Golang) et/ou TypeScript/JS étant fortement souhaitée.

Vous êtes un expert des technologies cloud-natives clés : Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, ArgoCD et l'Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi/Terraform).

Vous avez une expérience pratique des outils de monitoring comme Datadog ou des systèmes similaires.

Vous avez une expérience préalable dans un modèle d'affaires B2B ou SaaS à forte croissance.

Vous possédez d'exceptionnelles compétences en communication interpersonnelle, écrite et orale, favorisant une collaboration efficace entre les équipes d'ingénierie.

Vous avez un esprit hautement analytique, capable de voir à la fois la vue d'ensemble et les détails, et vous vous épanouissez dans la collaboration.

Idéalement, vous avez des connaissances ou un intérêt pour les meilleures pratiques de sécurité (balayage de vulnérabilités, détection d'intrusion, etc.).

Ce que nous offrons

Programme hypothécaire pour les employés : taux préférentiels exclusifs.

Couverture santé complète : couverture étendue de premier ordre (santé, dentaire, vision) avec couverture des médicaments à 100 %.

Accès à un régime d'épargne-retraite collectif REER/RPDB avec des contributions de contrepartie compétitives de l'entreprise.

Télémédecine et soutien familial (programmes de complément pour les congés de maternité/parentaux).

Lieu de travail flexible : entièrement à distance ou dans l'un de nos bureaux (Montréal, Québec, Toronto, etc.).

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

Contribuez à moderniser l'industrie hypothécaire canadienne.

Entreprise certifiée B Corp, soulignant notre engagement social et environnemental.

Nous avons remporté le prix CLA du prêteur hypothécaire de l’année 2023, 2024 et 2025, qui reconnaît notre excellence en matière de services de prêt.

Diversité et Inclusion

Chez nesto, nous croyons que la créativité et la collaboration sont le résultat d'une équipe diversifiée. Nous sommes engagés à favoriser une culture de la diversité, de l'équité, de l'inclusion et de l'appartenance, et nous encourageons fortement les femmes, les personnes de couleur, les membres de la communauté LGBTQIA+ et les personnes en situation de handicap à postuler. Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail inclusif et accueillant pour tous. Ce poste est ouvert à tous les candidats et candidates et peut être occupé à distance depuis n'importe où au Canada.

jobs.description:
We’re Blue River, a team of innovators driven to create intelligent machinery that solves monumental problems for our customers. We empower our customers – farmers, construction crews, and foresters - to implement safer and more sustainable solutions, driving increased profitability with less reliance on scarce labor. We believe that focusing on the small stuff – pixel-by-pixel and task-by-task - leads to big gains.

Blue River Technology aligns with John Deere’s vision to “innovate on behalf of humanity” by quickly identifying and solving high-value, high-uncertainty challenges in AI, machine learning, computer vision, and robotics. BRT acts as a research and development flywheel, building not only new products but also new platforms that reliably create value for both Deere and its customers. From fully autonomous machines to highly precise farming equipment, BRT and Deere are partnering to create technical breakthroughs in industries like agriculture and construction.

Our people are at the heart of what we do. Through cross-disciplinary collaboration, this mission-driven team is eager to define the new frontier of robotics. We are always asking hard questions, rapidly iterating, and getting our boots in the field to figure it out. We won’t give up until we’ve made a tangible and positive impact on the planet!

Blue River Technology is based in Santa Clara, CA. This position can be remote in the United States.

Summary

We are seeking a talented Radar Perception Engineer to join our team to develop and optimize the Radar Perception stack. You will play a critical role in enabling robust autonomy for our engineering machines, focusing on radar perception and data fusion with camera-based perception systems to advance our autonomous agricultural technology capabilities. You will work across the full stack, from hardware integration to algorithm development and validation.

  • Employment Type: Full-Time
  • Work Location: Remote in the United States
  • Visa sponsorship: Available for this position.

Job Responsibilities

A combination, not necessarily all-inclusive, of the following:

  • Software Development & Coding
    • Design and write robust, production-quality C++ code for real-time radar perception algorithms and robotics pipelines.
    • Apply modern software engineering best practices to maintain reusable, testable, and high-performance autonomy codebases.
  • Architecture & Integration
    • Architect and support scalable radar fusion pipelines for autonomous systems.
    • Lead the development and integration of radar data products within broader autonomy perception stacks.
    • Drive cross-functional collaboration to enhance sensor fusion performance and system reliability.
  • Algorithm Development
    • Develop and refine point cloud processing methods, including tracking and object classification and identification algorithms.
    • Implement odometric solutions and data fusion points for INS.
  • Validation & Metrics
    • Lead verification and validation efforts for radar perception systems through comprehensive field testing.
    • Drive system performance optimization and regression testing to ensure robust perception capabilities.
    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to validate system safety and performance against rigorous field operational requirements.
  • Safety & Reliability
    • Develop strategies for safety-critical edge case detection, ensuring the perception system maintains robust performance in diverse agricultural environments.
    • Maintain high-quality technical documentation for perception architectures, test results, and deployment guidelines to ensure code maintainability across the team.
    • Proactively profile system bottlenecks (CPU/memory/latency) and implement optimizations to ensure perception pipelines meet real-time constraints on deployed robotic platforms.

Required Experience and Skills

  • BS/MS in Robotics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of professional experience in perception system development, with a strong focus on radar, robotics, and embedded systems.
  • Strong proficiency in C++ and Python, with the ability to write production-level embedded code.
  • Experience optimizing perception algorithms for real-time performance on resource-constrained embedded hardware (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson, ARM-based platforms, or similar).
  • Proficiency with middleware like ROS or ROS2, and familiarity with Linux/POSIX development environments.
  • Familiarity with point cloud processing, sensor fusion, and coordinate system transformations, including object identification, classification, and tracking.
  • Ability to work in a collaborative, cross-functional environment (e.g., interacting with hardware, perception, and autonomy teams).

Preferred Experience and Skills

  • Experience working with autonomous agricultural machinery, construction equipment, autonomous vehicles, or off-highway robotics platforms.
  • Experience with radar-camera sensor fusion, including sensor calibration, time synchronization, and multi-sensor data integration.
  • Experience with radar-camera sensor fusion, including sensor calibration, time synchronization, and multi-sensor data integration.
  • Familiarity with safety-critical perception systems, edge-case analysis, and robustness testing under challenging environmental conditions.

For this position, the reasonably expected pay range is between $131,000 - $228,000/year for the level at which this job has been scoped. Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Help Shape the Future of AI in Pharmaceutical

What if your expertise in regulatory writing, CMC documentation, and global pharmaceutical submissions could help artificial intelligence better understand regulatory requirements, technical documentation standards, and submission best practices?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting experienced pharmaceutical professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We're seeking experienced Regulatory CMC Submission Writers who can apply their regulatory writing expertise, scientific knowledge, and technical documentation experience to evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical and regulatory content.

This isn't a traditional regulatory writing position. You won't be authoring submissions for health authorities, coordinating submission timelines, or supporting active filing activities. Instead, you'll evaluate complex regulatory and scientific content, identify technical inaccuracies, assess document quality and regulatory reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your pharmaceutical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.


Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Regulatory CMC Submission Writer Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, completeness, and regulatory compliance of Pharmaceutical AI-generated content.

You'll analyze regulatory, scientific, manufacturing, analytical, and technical documentation scenarios, identify errors or unsupported conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in established submission standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex pharmaceutical regulatory documentation and submission challenges.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content: Assess scientific, technical, and regulatory responses for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with submission requirements.
  • Review regulatory documentation: Examine content related to CTD/eCTD submissions, Module 3 documentation, manufacturing information, analytical data, validation summaries, and stability reports.
  • Analyze technical reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are supported by scientific evidence, regulatory expectations, and accepted documentation practices.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize unsupported claims, technical inaccuracies, documentation deficiencies, missing context, and flawed regulatory reasoning.
  • Validate information: Reference FDA requirements, ICH guidelines, CTD standards, and accepted pharmaceutical industry practices.nt FDA requirements, GMP regulations, ICH guidelines, and accepted pharmaceutical industry practices.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend technically accurate corrections.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply project-specific evaluation criteria, scoring guidelines, and quality standards.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established project timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Industry Expertise in a New Way
Use the knowledge you've developed throughout your pharmaceutical or biotechnology career to contribute to advanced AI technologies.

Help Improve Scientific Accuracy
Your evaluations will help strengthen the quality and reliability of AI-generated pharmaceutical and regulatory information.

Work Remotely
Participate in project-based assignments from an eligible location, with flexibility based on project needs and availability.

Explore the Future of Pharmaceutical Technology
Gain experience contributing to AI evaluation initiatives while applying your existing scientific and regulatory expertise.

No AI Background Required
We're looking for professionals who can recognize accurate scientific reasoning, identify errors, and communicate expert assessments with clarity.


Compensation:

Volga Partners offers project-based hourly compensation based on specialization, relevant experience, professional qualifications, geographic location, and assignment requirements.

Regulatory CMC Submission Writer Subject Matter Expert (SME): $25-$50 USD/hour

Compensation may vary based on experience level, area of expertise, and task complexity.

Project Details

    • Engagement Type: Project-based independent contractor
    • Work Arrangement: Remote
    • Primary Location: United States preferred
    • Additional Markets: Professionals outside the United States may be considered if they possess substantial U.S. pharmaceutical industry experience
    • Schedule: Variable and assignment-based
    • Project Type: Pharmaceutical AI content evaluation
    • Project Duration: Based on project requirements and assignment availability
    • Selection Process: Qualified candidates may be required to complete screening questions and evaluation exercises prior to project selection

Specific assignments, schedules, workloads, and project dates will be communicated as they are confirmed. Hours and future assignments are not guaranteed.

Bring Your Pharmaceutical Expertise to the Future of AI

If you're an experienced pharmaceutical or biotechnology professional who enjoys analyzing complex scientific information, applying regulatory and technical expertise, and contributing to innovative technology, we'd love to hear from you.

Join Volga Partners and help shape the next generation of pharmaceutical AI.

Apply today to be considered for upcoming project opportunities.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We're seeking experienced Regulatory Affairs professionals in the Pharmaceutical world who bring practical industry expertise and are comfortable reviewing technical information, exercising independent judgment, and clearly explaining their conclusions.

Required Qualifications

    • Minimum of 4 years of professional experience in Regulatory Writing, CMC Documentation, Regulatory Affairs, or Pharmaceutical Submission Support
    • Bachelor's degree or higher in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Regulatory Affairs, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline
    • Experience authoring, reviewing, or supporting pharmaceutical regulatory submissions
    • Experience preparing CTD and/or eCTD documentation

    • Knowledge of FDA regulations, CTD structure, and relevant ICH guidelines
    • Experience reviewing scientific, manufacturing, analytical, and stability documentation
    • Ability to critically evaluate scientific and regulatory information
    • Strong technical writing, editing, and document review skills
    • Strong analytical, research, and problem-solving abilities
    • Excellent written English communication skills
    • Ability to work independently and follow detailed review instructions
    • Must understand and be comfortable with a task-based freelance engagement model.

Preferred Qualifications

We encourage applications from professionals with backgrounds such as:

  • RAC certification
  • PharmD, MS, MBA, PhD, or other advanced scientific credentials
  • Experience supporting IND, NDA, BLA, ANDA, MAA, or equivalent submissions
  • Experience preparing or reviewing Module 2 and Module 3 documentation
  • Knowledge of electronic submissions and eCTD publishing processes
  • Experience compiling manufacturing, analytical, validation, and stability data

This position will ensure the Talent Acquisition function is aligned with Solventum’s overarching HR Talent Management strategic goals and comply with all legal standards, fostering a highly efficient and transparent environment for both candidates, hiring managers, and Talent Acquisition team members. 20% Strategic Leadership – Talent Acquisition

  • Use analytics to assess the effectiveness of initiatives and identify areas for further improvement.

  • Accountable for maintaining high levels of employee engagement and job satisfaction.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing global team of Talent Acquisition professionals
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, high performance, and accountability.
  • Provide coaching and development opportunities for direct reports to improve their skills and performance.
  • Ensure effective knowledge transfer and training across teams to maintain business continuity.

  • Identification and mitigation of risks related to Talent Acquisition, including data breaches, non-compliance, and vendor performance issues.

jobs.excerpt: No Grupo Stefanini, acreditamos que o futuro não acontece sozinho: ele é construído por pessoas que têm atitude para transformar ideias em realidade.
jobs.description:
No Grupo Stefanini, acreditamos que o futuro não acontece sozinho: ele é construído por pessoas que têm atitude para transformar ideias em realidade. Há quase 40 anos, conectamos tecnologia, inovação e talento para criar soluções que transformam negócios e impactam pessoas.

Somos um dos maiores ecossistemas de tecnologia da América Latina, com mais de 35 mil pessoas em mais de 40 países. Ao longo dessa jornada, evoluímos constantemente — e seguimos acreditando que são as nossas pessoas que fazem essa transformação acontecer. 🌎✨

Nosso jeito de ser é guiado por cinco Atitudes Empreendedoras, que fazem parte do nosso DNA e orientam a forma como trabalhamos e construímos o futuro juntos:

🎯 Comprometimento com o cliente — entendemos o que realmente importa e buscamos soluções com excelência e propósito.

🚀 Liderança pelo exemplo — agimos com ética, coerência e protagonismo, fazendo da nossa atitude um exemplo para quem está ao nosso lado.

🤝 Respeito pelas pessoas — valorizamos diferentes perspectivas, cultivamos diálogos abertos e contribuímos para o crescimento uns dos outros.

💡 Coragem para inovar — questionamos o convencional, propomos soluções e temos iniciativa para transformar desafios em novas possibilidades.

🌱 Humildade para aprender — reconhecemos que nunca partimos do zero, aprendemos uns com os outros e sabemos que grandes conquistas não são construídas sozinhas.

Mais do que competências técnicas, buscamos pessoas que se identifiquem com esse jeito de fazer acontecer. Pessoas que tenham vontade de aprender, coragem para inovar, respeito para construir junto e atitude para transformar.

Quer conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Stefanini, nossa cultura e as pessoas que fazem parte dessa história?

▶️ Assista ao nosso vídeo institucional e venha construir o futuro com a gente!

🎯 Missão da posição

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional para liderar o Centro de Excelência (COE) de Redes, atuando como referência estratégica, técnica e de desenvolvimento de pessoas nas disciplinas de redes, conectividade e segurança de rede.

O COE Leader será responsável por fortalecer as competências técnicas da equipe, promover a evolução da disciplina e garantir a excelência das entregas, atuando em parceria com o Client Face, responsável pela gestão da conta.

Idioma obrigatório: inglês fluente ou espanhol fluente, considerando a interação com clientes e equipes nearshore/LATAM.

Ser a principal referência técnica e de pessoas da disciplina de Redes, desenvolvendo profissionais, fortalecendo competências, estabelecendo padrões de excelência e apoiando a alocação dos talentos conforme as necessidades dos clientes e do negócio.


Principais responsabilidades

  • Gestão de pessoas: desenvolver talentos, acompanhar planos de carreira, promover mentoria técnica, capacitação contínua e retenção de profissionais.
  • Governança técnica: definir, implementar e manter padrões, frameworks, processos e melhores práticas da disciplina.
  • Liderança do COE: organizar e conduzir a equipe, garantindo a evolução das competências e a capacidade de entrega.
  • Evolução tecnológica: estruturar o roadmap da disciplina, acompanhar tendências, incentivar certificações e promover a adoção de soluções de AIOps, automação e autocura.
  • Gestão de capacidade: apoiar o planejamento de capacidade e a alocação dos profissionais de acordo com as demandas dos clientes.
  • Relacionamento estratégico: atuar em parceria com o Client Face e stakeholders, contribuindo com a visão técnica e estratégica da disciplina.

Requisitos técnicos

  • Sólida experiência em redes, roteamento e switching: BGP, OSPF, MPLS, VLAN/STP, LAN/WAN e Wi-Fi.
  • Conhecimento em tecnologias e fabricantes como Cisco, Juniper e Aruba.
  • Experiência com SD-WAN, Datacenter (Spine-Leaf, VXLAN/EVPN, ACI) e balanceadores (F5 e Citrix ADC).
  • Conhecimento em segurança de redes: NGFW, VPN, NAC e redes em Cloud, com soluções Palo Alto, Fortinet e Check Point.
  • Experiência na liderança, gestão ou mentoria de equipes técnicas.
  • Vivência na definição de padrões, processos e governança técnica.
  • Capacidade de relacionamento e articulação com stakeholders e Client Faces.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Precificação e propostas técnicas: experiência na construção de propostas e no dimensionamento de serviços, considerando esforço, senioridade, capacidade e composição das equipes.
  • IA aplicada a redes e AIOps: experiência ou atuação prática com operação assistida, detecção de anomalias em telemetria e automação NetDevOps, utilizando ferramentas como Mist AI, Cisco AI, Ansible e Python.
  • IA Generativa: conhecimento ou experiência com LLMs e copilotos aplicados à análise de configurações e logs, análise de causa raiz (RCA), documentação e ChatOps.
  • Conhecimento em engenharia de prompts e governança de IA, considerando proteção de dados sensíveis, guardrails e validação humana.
  • Certificação profissional: possuir certificação de nível profissional em redes ou segurança, conforme uma das trilhas abaixo:
    • Roteamento e Switching: CCNP Enterprise ou JNCIP-ENT.

    • Segurança de Redes: PCNSE, Fortinet FCSS Network Security (ex-NSE 7), Check Point CCSE ou CCNP Security.

  • Idioma: inglês fluente ou espanhol fluente.

Diferenciais

  • Certificações de nível expert: CCIE, JNCIE ou Fortinet FCX.
  • Experiência com redes para clusters de IA/GPU, incluindo RoCE e InfiniBand.
  • Conhecimento em segurança de tráfego de GenAI, SASE e DLP.
  • Experiência com arquitetura Zero Trust.
  • Conhecimento em soluções DDI.
  • Experiência com IPv6.

Perfil esperado

Buscamos uma liderança com visão estratégica e forte domínio técnico, capaz de desenvolver pessoas, impulsionar a inovação e conectar as necessidades do negócio às soluções tecnológicas. É importante ter perfil colaborativo, capacidade de influência, visão de futuro e habilidade para transformar conhecimento técnico em excelência operacional e valor para os clientes.

Informações adicionais

🍛 Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

👨🏼‍🎓 Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

📚 Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

🗣 Mentoring;

💉 Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

🏥 Assistência médica;

🦷 Assistência odontológica;

💰 Clube de vantagens e descontos nos melhores estabelecimentos;

🛫 Clube de viagens;

🐶 Convênio para pets.

Ever imagined saying, “I helped launch the future of transportation”?

We’re rewriting the rules of urban mobility. At Vay, customers tap a button and a car arrives - with no one inside - powered by our world-first Remote Driving technology on real public streets.

We’re live in Las Vegas and scaling fast, powered by a strategic investment of up to $410 million from Grab. If you want to build something real, visible, and genuinely transformative, you’ll feel right at home here.

  • Automate the close: Identify and help implement AI and automation to reduce manual month-end work.

  • Support audit and tax: Prepare accurate audit deliverables and state and regulatory tax filings.
  • Guide junior team members: Share knowledge and support less experienced teammates on close tasks and complex transactions.

  • Experience with NetSuite or equivalent ERP; strong Excel skills

Nice to have:

💰 EIP stock options: A stake in Vay’s future - not just a salary.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.excerpt: You’re the kind of data scientist who gets equally energized by training a gradient boosted classifier and designing an LLM-powered agentic workflow.
jobs.description:
You’re the kind of data scientist who gets equally energized by training a gradient boosted classifier and designing an LLM-powered agentic workflow. You understand that picking the right tool — whether that’s a decision tree, a language model, or a carefully chosen heuristic — matters more than chasing the latest trend. And you’re just as comfortable explaining your approach to a non-technical stakeholder as you are digging deep into a messy dataset.

Does this sound like you? Great!

We’re looking for a Senior Data Scientist to work across Expel, using both traditional machine learning and generative AI to solve meaningful problems. You’ll help teams develop the right metrics to measure what matters, build models that surface threats in our customers’ environments, and design AI-powered tools that make our analysts faster and smarter. Some of the most interesting work sits right at the intersection of GenAI and classical ML — and you’ll help us figure out where each approach wins.

Our team values collaboration, curiosity, and a “how can I help?” attitude. If you care about making data science accessible to everyone — and find mentorship rewarding — let’s talk.

What Expel Can Do For You

  • Provide opportunities where your decisions have a direct impact on our company and our customers
  • Give you real, hard problems at the frontier of both GenAI and traditional ML in a security context
  • Empower you to scale yourself by teaching others what responsible, non-hyped AI looks like in practice
  • Challenge you to push the boundaries of our data science, security, and technology vision
  • Offer an entertaining, small, and highly transparent environment where your voice matters

What You Can Do For Expel

  • Build and ship ML and GenAI systems — from anomaly detection models to LLM-powered analyst tools and agentic workflows — across the full lifecycle from research to production
  • Bring stakeholders along by clearly communicating the what, why, and how of your work, including successes and failures
  • Work across operations, engineering, and service delivery to ensure our AI and ML capabilities are easy to deploy, monitor, and maintain
  • Partner with subject matter experts to explore where prompt engineering, knowledge retrieval, and agentic AI can deliver real value alongside classical approaches
  • Foster an atmosphere of experimentation, continuous learning, and improvement
  • Stay current on emerging techniques, papers, and tools — and bring relevant ideas back to the team
  • Mentor and coach other data scientists and curious non-DS colleagues

What You Should Bring With You

  • 4+ years of professional data science experience building and shipping models in production
  • Solid grounding in traditional ML: classification, regression, anomaly detection, clustering, time series — using frameworks like scikit-learn or statsmodels
  • Hands-on experience with large language models, prompt engineering, and LLM application architectures including knowledge retrieval and grounding (e.g., embeddings-based search, vector stores)
  • Experience building or contributing to LLM-powered agentic systems, including tool use and orchestration with frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar
  • Strong Python and SQL skills, utilizing core data libraries (pandas/numpy) and visual toolkits (plotly/seaborn/matplotlib) to transform complex analysis into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders and cross-functional peers
  • Solid statistical foundations: distributions, hypothesis testing, probability, and the wisdom to know when a simpler model is the right one
  • Exemplary collaboration skills that result in higher levels of team confidence and, morale, streamlining requirements gathering to drive superior output
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences
  • Passion for finding order and meaning in large, chaotic data sets
  • Domain experience in cybersecurity (anomaly detection, threat hunting, risk scoring) is a strong plus

The Details

The base salary range for this role is between $142,900 USD and $207,200 USD + bonus eligibility and equity.

We believe in paying transparently and equitably. Your salary will ultimately be based on factors such as your experience, skills, team equity, and market data. You’ll also be eligible for unlimited PTO (which we model and encourage), work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and really excellent health benefits.

We're only hiring those authorized to work in the United States.

We're an Equal Opportunity Employer: You will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

We’ll ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please let us know if you need accommodation of any kind.

Salary Range
$142,900—$207,200 USD

About Us

EnergyLink Sourcing LLC serves as the centralized supply chain arm of Quanta Services and its operating companies. Our centralized approach enables us to establish stronger partnerships across our supplier and client networks, improve material availability, and drive greater certainty of delivery for our customers. We are proud to support dynamic projects that power communities and drive progress.Our team is driven by integrity, responsiveness, and a commitment to delivering results. At EnergyLink, we believe in building long-term relationships with our clients, our partners, and our employees – grounded in trust, collaboration, and performance. We are committed to attracting and retaining top talent by offering competitive wages, comprehensive benefits, and opportunities for professional growth.

About this Role

SOURCING MANAGER – T&D / EPC

REMOTE | EnergyLink, a Quanta Services CompanyTravel: Up to 10%

Lead the Strategy. Build the Team. Power the Future.

Great leaders don't just manage sourcing. They build high-performing teams, create strategic partnerships, and deliver results that move the business forward.

At EnergyLink, a Quanta Services company, we're looking for a dynamic, forward-thinking Sourcing Manager who is ready to take ownership, influence decisions, and lead the sourcing strategies behind some of the most essential energy infrastructure projects.

From transmission lines and substations to distribution networks, you'll lead a team responsible for securing the materials, equipment, and supplier partnerships that support complex Engineering, Procurement, and Construction (EPC) projects.

This is more than managing bids and suppliers. It's about developing people, driving commercial excellence, and creating sourcing solutions that make a measurable impact.

If you're a strategic leader who knows how to negotiate, inspire, and deliver, your next big career move starts here.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the Talent: Manage, mentor, and develop a team of sourcing professionals, including Senior Sourcing Specialists, while fostering accountability, collaboration, and high performance.

  • Own the Strategy: Develop and execute material sourcing strategies that align with project budgets, schedules, client expectations, and business priorities.

  • Drive Major Bids: Oversee complex material bid packages for Transmission, Substation, and Distribution EPC projects, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and competitive results.

  • Turn Complexity Into Clarity: Review client RFPs, engineering drawings, Bills of Materials (BOMs), material takeoffs, and specifications to identify sourcing requirements and close scope gaps.

  • Build Powerful Partnerships: Develop and strengthen relationships with key suppliers, manufacturers, and distributors to support long-term sourcing success.

  • Negotiate With Impact: Guide commercial negotiations, contract evaluations, supplier selection, and risk assessments to deliver value without compromising quality or performance.

  • Make the Call: Review and approve bid evaluations, supplier recommendations, and commercial sourcing decisions.

  • Connect the Business: Partner with Engineering, Project Management, Construction, and Supply Chain teams to align sourcing activities with project execution.

  • Champion Compliance: Ensure sourcing activities meet client requirements, internal policies, and applicable MBE/WBE, Buy American, and documentation standards.

  • Raise the Bar: Monitor sourcing performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and implement processes that increase efficiency, reduce risk, and strengthen results.

  • Think Beyond Today: Support strategic initiatives and help shape sourcing practices that position EnergyLink for continued success.

What You'll Bring

We're looking for a leader who understands the technical side of sourcing, the commercial side of business, and the people side of leadership.

  • 8–12 years of progressive experience in material sourcing, procurement, or supply chain management.

  • 4–6 years of direct experience supporting Transmission & Distribution (T&D) or electric utility projects.

  • A bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.

  • Proven experience leading sourcing teams, developing talent, managing performance, and mentoring sourcing professionals.

  • Strong knowledge of competitive bidding, RFPs, tender evaluations, supplier selection, and contract negotiations.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead complex material sourcing initiatives for large-scale EPC or utility projects.

  • Experience assessing commercial risks, evaluating supplier proposals, and developing cost-effective sourcing strategies.

  • Strong collaboration, communication, analytical, and decision-making skills.

  • The ability to manage multiple priorities, solve complex problems, and deliver results in a fast-paced project environment.

  • A leadership mindset focused on accountability, continuous improvement, and developing others.

What Will Set You Apart

  • Deep knowledge of overhead and underground T&D materials, including conductors, insulators, poles, hardware, cable, and related utility equipment.

  • Experience interpreting engineering drawings, BOMs, material takeoffs, and technical specifications.

  • Established relationships with utility material manufacturers, vendors, and distributors.

  • Experience supporting large-scale EPC construction projects.

  • Familiarity with sourcing and project management systems such as SAP, Coupa, Oracle, or Procore.

  • A track record of improving sourcing performance, negotiating favorable commercial terms, and building high-performing teams.

What You'll Get

At EnergyLink, you'll have the opportunity to shape sourcing strategies, develop talented professionals, and contribute to infrastructure projects that help power communities.

Benefits Designed Around You

Eligible employees may have access to a competitive benefits package, including:

  • Competitive Compensation: A salary package that considers your leadership experience, technical expertise, and the value you bring to the organization.

  • Remote Work Opportunity: Lead and collaborate with teams while working remotely, with travel up to 10% as business needs require.

  • Medical, Dental & Vision Insurance: Coverage options designed to support your health and the well-being of your eligible family members.

  • 401(k) Retirement Savings: An opportunity to plan, save, and invest in your financial future.

  • Paid Time Off & Holidays: Time to recharge, enjoy life outside of work, and spend meaningful moments with family and friends.

  • Life & Disability Insurance: Financial protection and added peace of mind.

  • Employee Assistance & Wellness Resources: Access to programs supporting personal well-being, where available.

  • Professional Development: Opportunities to strengthen your leadership skills, expand your industry expertise, and prepare for future career opportunities.

More Than a Position. A Place to Build Your Legacy.

  • Leadership That Matters: Build, mentor, and inspire a team while helping shape the future of sourcing at EnergyLink.

  • A Voice in the Strategy: Influence sourcing decisions, supplier partnerships, and commercial strategies that directly impact project success.

  • Meaningful Work: Support essential energy infrastructure that connects communities and helps meet the growing demand for reliable power.

  • Career Growth & Progression: Expand your leadership experience and explore future opportunities across procurement, supply chain, category management, and broader business leadership.

  • Flexibility With Purpose: Enjoy the benefits of a remote position while staying connected to your team, stakeholders, and projects.

  • Industry Exposure: Collaborate with experienced professionals across engineering, construction, procurement, and project management.

  • The Quanta Connection: Be part of EnergyLink, a Quanta Services company, with exposure to a broader network of infrastructure professionals and career possibilities.

  • A Culture Built on Results: Join an environment that values safety, integrity, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

  • The Opportunity to Leave Your Mark: Develop people, strengthen processes, build partnerships, and create results that extend beyond a single project.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Location: Remote – South Africa
Employment Type: Permanent, Full-Time
Working Hours: Monday to Friday, US Central Time (8:00 AM – 5:00 PM or 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM CT)
Industry: Ecommerce / Consumer Products

About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced, commercially minded Director of Recruiting to take full ownership of the talent acquisition function for a rapidly growing US-based ecommerce business.

This is a senior, hands-on leadership opportunity for a recruitment professional who thrives in a fast-paced, high-performance environment and has a proven track record of identifying, attracting, assessing and securing exceptional talent.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and managing the entire recruitment process, from strategic sourcing and candidate engagement through to structured assessments, interviews, offers and onboarding coordination.

You will recruit across a diverse range of functions, including ecommerce, marketing, operations, product management, Amazon marketplace operations and senior leadership.

This role requires someone who can combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, establish scalable recruitment systems and consistently deliver measurable hiring results.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Full-Cycle Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

  • Own and manage the complete recruitment lifecycle across multiple departments and seniority levels.
  • Develop and execute effective sourcing strategies to attract high-calibre talent.
  • Manage 5–10 active vacancies simultaneously while maintaining exceptional candidate quality and turnaround times.
  • Conduct initial screening calls, structured interviews and candidate evaluations.
  • Lead recruitment for specialist, managerial and director-level positions.
  • Build proactive talent pipelines for current and future hiring requirements.
  • Manage candidate negotiations, offers and hiring coordination.

Recruitment Strategy & Process Management

  • Develop, optimise and document recruitment processes, workflows and standard operating procedures.
  • Administer and coordinate structured assessments, personality evaluations, practical assignments and case studies.
  • Ensure consistent and objective candidate evaluation throughout the hiring process.
  • Identify recruitment bottlenecks and introduce improvements to increase efficiency and hiring quality.
  • Build scalable recruitment processes to support business growth.
  • Implement AI-powered recruitment tools and automation to improve sourcing, screening and administration.

Stakeholder & Agency Management

  • Partner directly with senior leadership and hiring managers to understand recruitment priorities.
  • Advise stakeholders on talent availability, candidate quality and hiring strategies.
  • Manage external recruitment agencies and specialist talent partners.
  • Establish clear performance expectations and accountability across recruitment partners.
  • Provide regular recruitment updates, candidate recommendations and market insights.

Recruitment Analytics & Performance

  • Develop and maintain recruitment dashboards and weekly performance reports.
  • Monitor recruitment funnel conversion, applicant quality, interview performance and hiring timelines.
  • Track key recruitment metrics, including time-to-fill, sourcing effectiveness and candidate experience.
  • Use recruitment data to improve decision-making and identify opportunities for process improvement.

Employer Branding & Candidate Experience

  • Represent the business professionally throughout the recruitment process.
  • Maintain a strong employer brand across platforms such as LinkedIn, Glassdoor and Indeed.
  • Deliver an engaging, professional and transparent candidate experience.
  • Develop creative sourcing approaches through professional communities, referrals and industry networks.

Key Requirements

  • Minimum 3–5+ years of proven full-cycle recruitment experience.
  • Previous experience in a senior recruitment, talent acquisition or recruitment leadership capacity.
  • Strong experience recruiting for ecommerce, digital marketing, operations, product and leadership positions.
  • Experience recruiting for international businesses, particularly US or UK organisations, is highly advantageous.
  • Agency recruitment, RPO or offshore recruitment experience is a strong advantage.
  • Advanced knowledge of LinkedIn Recruiter, Workable and applicant tracking systems.
  • Experience administering structured interviews, recruitment assessments and practical candidate evaluations.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple vacancies and deliver successful placements under tight deadlines.
  • Experience managing external recruitment agencies and hiring stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of recruitment KPIs, dashboards and performance reporting.
  • Practical experience using AI tools to improve recruitment productivity and efficiency.
  • Experience working with CRM systems and documented SOPs.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Confident and engaging on video calls, with strong presentation and interpersonal skills.
  • Highly organised, proactive and comfortable taking ownership of recruitment outcomes.

Key Performance Indicators

Success in this position will be measured against:

  • Average time-to-fill of fewer than 45 days.
  • Generating 250+ qualified applicants per role per week.
  • Achieving 15+ completed candidate case studies per role per week.
  • Maintaining an employer rating of 4.5+ on Glassdoor.
  • Consistently positive candidate experiences and hiring manager feedback.
  • Strong recruitment funnel performance and high-quality hiring outcomes.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a commercially aware recruitment leader who enjoys being directly involved in sourcing, interviewing and closing talent rather than solely overseeing a recruitment team.

You should be confident communicating with senior executives, comfortable challenging recruitment processes when improvements are needed and capable of building a highly effective talent acquisition function.

A proactive approach, strong accountability, excellent communication skills and a genuine passion for connecting exceptional talent with growing businesses are essential.

Application Requirements

Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete structured recruitment assessments and provide a short professional video introduction.

This is a fully remote position requiring full availability during US Central business hours.

jobs.description:
Job Title: Corporate Health and Safety Specialist
Location: Remote with travel to project sites

Description/Job Summary

POSITION DESCRIPTION

HydroGeoLogic, Inc. (HGL) has a position open for a corporate-based Health and Safety Specialist to support HGL’s ongoing projects across the United States.

As a Corporate Health & Safety Specialist, you will work with our high-performing HGL Team and support overall project safety performance through a combination of planning, auditing, and coordination with project teams. This role includes periodic site visits, audits, and evaluations, with field presence aligned to key project activities rather than continuous onsite support.

HGL is flexible regarding the actual physical location of a candidate within the U.S. Projects may include in-situ thermal treatment, remediation, demolition, waste cleanup, landfill cap construction, contaminated sediment removals, and groundwater treatment (both in-situ and pump-n-treat) and stabilization projects.

This position will report to the Corporate Health and Safety Director and provide Site Health and Safety support across multiple project sites nationwide.

Responsibilities/Duties

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

  • Developing and reviewing project planning documents pertaining to health and safety (APPs, AHAs, HASPs, etc.) to ensure safe project execution by the field team.
  • Serving as the primary health and safety compliance point of contact with field teams consisting of HGL staff, subcontractors, and client personnel.
  • Providing guidance and support to field teams, including participation in safety meetings, readiness reviews and briefings as needed.
  • Generating and maintaining accurate and detailed health and safety documentation for required audits.
  • Communicating with HGL’s construction and health and safety management teams to ensure compliance with project-specific and corporate procedures.
  • Reviewing on-site health and safety documentation, including personnel certifications, sign-in/orientation sheets, required OSHA signage, planning documents, and safety data sheets.
  • Leading internal and client-facing meetings pertaining to planned and completed health and safety activities.
  • Conducting periodic site visits, audits, and inspections to evaluate safety performance and ensure compliance with project and corporate requirements.

Minimum Requirements

WHAT YOU NEED TO BE SUCCESSFUL

The ideal candidate will need the following as a foundation for success in this role:

  • Bachelor’s degree (B.S. or B.A.) in Occupational Safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 30% of the time to project sites for audits, evaluations, and key project activities (travel frequency will vary based on project needs and is not expected to be continuous field deployment).
  • Minimum of 8-10 years’ experience serving as health and safety officer, with USACE, EPA and Environmental experience preferred.
  • Proficient knowledge of USACE Safety and Health Requirements Manual EM 385-1-1.
  • Able to meet class I SSHO Qualifications under USACE Safety and Health Requirements Manual EM 385-1-1.
  • Experience with health and safety procedures related to: air quality, hazardous waste, universal waste, investigation derived waste, wastewater, stormwater, spill prevention, decontamination, air monitoring, and health and safety inspections.
  • Experience working on environmental construction/remediation projects involving demolition, excavation, grading, and environmental sampling.
  • Working knowledge of Federal (OSHA) and state occupational and health and safety regulations.
  • Experience performing project safety audits.
  • Excellent communication, writing, and organization skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced group setting with corporate, project, and technical management staff.
  • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite of software, specifically in Excel and Word.
  • 40-hour OSHA HAZWOPER and current 8-hour OSHA HAZWOPER refresher, HAZWOPER Supervisor certifications.
  • OSHA 30-hour Construction Safety certification.
  • Current CPR/First Aid training certificate.

Desired Qualifications

WHAT YOU NEED TO STAND OUT – Preferred, not required

  • Certified Safety Professional (CSP) designation
  • Certified Industrial Hygienist (CIH) designation strongly preferred
  • Excavation Competent person certification
  • Fall Protection Competent Person certification
  • Confined Space Supervisor certification
  • Rigging training certification
  • Experience working with USACE and EPA clients

Physical & Environmental Requirements

PHYSICAL & COGNITIVE REQUIRMENTS

  • Ability to lift/move/relocate items up to 50 lbs
  • Prolonged sitting up to 70% of the time; Prolonged standing up to 70% of the time
  • Walking long distances; Walking over uneven or mountainous terrain
  • Repetitive hand motions (typing/tool use/etc.)
  • Ability to see details at close range; Ability to see details at a distance; Ability to interpret and analyze visual data (maps/graphs/warning indicators/etc.)
  • Driving a company or personal vehicle
  • Climbing ladders or stairs
  • Complex problem solving and decision making
  • Reading and interpreting technical documents or regulations
  • Writing reports/proposals/or technical documentation
  • Leading a team or coordinating multiple priorities
  • Communicating effectively with clients/team members/and stakeholders
  • Managing competing deadlines and shifting priorities

WORK ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

  • Must be able to work outdoors in adverse weather conditions (heat/cold/rain/snow/etc.)
  • Must be able to travel around 30% yearly, depending on project site needs
  • May work in environments with loud noises/dust/or hazardous materials
  • Must wear appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE)
  • Remote work environment
  • Potential for longer days up to 12 hours in duration

This description is not a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that may be required of the employee. Other duties, responsibilities and activities may be assigned or may be changed at any time with or without notice.

Details

Work Schedule:HGL office work is dictated by a 5-day work week; however, fieldwork schedules will deviate based on job requirements and may require longer hours and weekends.

Office Type:Primarily remote work environment with periodic site visits

Travel:Approximately 30% travel to project sites based on project needs

A favorable pre-hire drug test and physical are required.

All positions are subject to a pre-hire education and driving record verification.

This specific role supports a U.S. Federal government contract(s) which require(s) employees engaged on this contract to be U.S. citizens.

MORE ABOUT HGL AND THE OPPORTUNITY

At HGL, we share a drive and vision to restore natural resources and provide ongoing stewardship of our environment to benefit present and future generations. We believe that we can make a difference in improving the world we live in through collaboration, teamwork, and a positive work environment. This unites and empowers us to strive for excellence in all our endeavors.

HGL - WHO WE ARE

The exceptional quality of our people is key to our strength. We value our employees as individuals and as important members of our team. We offer a work environment that is flexible, inclusive, and dedicated to creating a sustainable future. By cultivating a culture of innovation, we’re able to adapt and augment our services to solve complex environmental and natural resources challenges.

Projects at HGL primarily span the United States and its territories, tackling problems associated with emerging contaminants (like PFAS), radiological contamination, and military munitions, along with chemical contamination in groundwater, surface water, sediments, and soil.

With over 550 employees, HGL is large enough to execute high-profile projects, but small enough to develop personal working environments with our talented team members. By joining HGL, you will be working toward restoring the environment and protecting our future.

HGL - WE INVEST IN YOU

It’s not just a job, it’s your career. HGL provides career growth opportunities via mentoring, training, education, and support for your certifications and licenses. Achieve your career goals and help HGL achieve its mission of restoring the environment to beneficial use for our clients and communities.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or other protected category. Some positions may require U.S. citizenship. Applicants who wish to request a reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process should contact Human Resources directly at 703-478-5186.
