jobs.description:
Oncology Clinical Data Abstractor (Contract, Remote)

About the Role

At Natera, the Oncology Clinical Data Abstractor (fully remote, contract position) will leverage their oncology clinical knowledge and expertise to curate, abstract, and interpret Signatera patient data that is critical for reimbursement. As a clinical expert working within Natera’s AI-enabled platform, you will own the process from initial record review through submission of high-quality, structured data.

You will rely on your understanding of the oncology patient journey and cancer staging to turn complex clinical records into accurate, reimbursement-ready data. You will work closely with your team to ensure consistency and quality across every record. This role is ideal for a detail-driven oncology nurse who enjoys untangling complex clinical records and takes pride in getting every data point right.

What You’ll Do

Clinical Data Abstraction

  • Review clinical documentation to abstract key oncology data related to billing and reimbursement.
  • Abstract and interpret stage of disease using AJCC staging guidelines across all tumor types.
  • Ensure accurate, complete, and timely submission of curated data, identifying and communicating patient data deficiencies and discrepancies.

AI-Enabled Platform Workflows

  • Operationalize outputs from Natera’s AI-enabled platform to manage a daily queue of records.
  • Perform high quality review of AI-generated abstractions, correcting errors and escalating issues as needed.
  • Validate, finalize, and submit abstracted records within the platform, adapting to new data measures and workflows as they are introduced.

Operational Excellence

  • Apply meticulous attention to detail to catch errors, inconsistencies, and gaps before records are submitted.
  • Use critical thinking to interpret complex clinical documentation, resolve ambiguities, and communicate findings clearly.
  • Manage a high-volume daily queue with strong organization and follow-through, meeting quality and turnaround expectations.

Qualifications

Education & Licensure:

  • BSN or higher degree required; MSN preferred.
  • Current, active Registered Nurse (RN) licensure (state or compact).

◦ Must maintain licensure in good standing throughout the contract term.

◦ Preferred: Board Certification as an Oncology Certified Nurse (OCN).

Professional Experience:

  • Minimum 3 years of oncology clinical experience (5+ years preferred) in an inpatient or outpatient setting.
  • Detailed understanding of the oncology patient journey.

Clinical Expertise:

  • Must have: Strong knowledge and interpretation of AJCC staging for all tumor types.
  • Solid understanding of cancer biology, pathology, and oncologic treatment modalities in the neoadjuvant and adjuvant settings.

Technical Proficiency:

  • Technology Adoption: Ability to master Natera’s AI-enabled platform and other internal platforms as needed.
  • Systems Familiarity: Familiarity with electronic medical records. Preferred: Epic experience, as occasional use is required.
  • Collaboration Tools: Working knowledge of the Google suite (e.g., Calendar, Chat, Sheets) for day-to-day communication and coordination.

OUR OPPORTUNITY

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. Our aim is to make personalized genetic testing and diagnostics part of the standard of care to protect health and enable earlier and more targeted interventions that lead to longer, healthier lives.

The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. When you join Natera, you’ll work hard and grow quickly. Working alongside the elite of the industry, you’ll be stretched and challenged, and take pride in being part of a company that is changing the landscape of genetic disease management.

Competitive Benefits - Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. Additionally, Natera employees and their immediate families receive free testing in addition to fertility care benefits. Other benefits include pregnancy and baby bonding leave, 401k benefits, commuter benefits and much more. We also offer a generous employee referral program!

We are committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace environment, and welcome people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives. Inclusive collaboration benefits our employees, our community and our patients, and is critical to our mission of changing the management of disease worldwide.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

This individual ensures their team consistently delivers professional, accurate, and empathetic support to members navigating eligibility, benefits, scheduling, and access to their food benefits (Medically Tailored Meals/Food Boxes).

Must be able to work M-F 9AM-5PM PST

Candidates must reside in and work within the US.

You Will:

    Team Leadership & Coaching

    • Performance & Quality Management

  • Identify coaching opportunities and performance trends; proactively address gaps.
  • Ensure adherence to scheduling, staffing coverage (including evening and weekend needs), and service level expectations.

Job Summary:

The Research Analyst role is essential for supporting and elevating the Board of Certification’s research initiatives and overall effectiveness by strengthening its capacity to conduct high-quality, data-driven research.

  • Supports the design, development, and implementation of BOC research studies.
  • Prepares and manages the integrity of research data, both quantitative and qualitative, for quality assessment, analysis, and interpretation.
  • Assists in the dissemination of research findings into reports, manuscripts, posters, presentations, and other scholarly or organizational products.
  • Assists in the management of research timelines, deliverables, documentation, and coordination across concurrent projects.
  • Supports the development and validation of surveys, assessments, and other research instruments.
  • Supports research findings and dissemination through data visualizations.
  • Supports the Examination Excellence team through developing annual examination summary reports.
  • Collaborates effectively and efficiently with the Senior Manager of Psychometrics and Research, BOC team members, volunteers, and other stakeholders.

Special Characteristics:

Ability to work independently and as a team member. Exceptional communication skills. Strong technical writing skills. Organized, detail-oriented, able to multitask, prioritize, and meet deadlines as needed. Proficient in computer skills for communication, data analysis, and database management.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Conducts comprehensive literature reviews and synthesizes relevant literature.
  • Identifies relevant theories, instruments, methodologies, and gaps in existing research.
  • Assists in developing research questions and hypotheses and identifying the appropriate methodologies and analytical strategies.
  • Assists in developing and refining survey questions and identifying validated instruments.
  • Programs survey instruments into survey software and conducts quality checks to ensure accuracy and functionality.
  • Manages and validates large datasets, including but not limited to data entry, cleaning and restructuring datasets, and merging datasets from multiple sources for quality assessment and analysis purposes.
  • Assists in conducting descriptive and inferential statistical analyses (ANOVA, regression, t-tests, etc.) and other relevant methods as required using SPSS.
  • Interprets statistical results in relation to research questions and collaborates with BOC team members to determine appropriate conclusions.
  • Prepares tables, figures, and other data visualizations for manuscripts, posters, presentations, and summary reports using Excel and Tableau.
  • Prepares annual examination summary reports using Tableau.
  • Works with Tableau Developer on data visualization duties as assigned.
  • Supports the design and implementation of qualitative research studies, including interviews and focus groups, qualitative data collection, and analysis.
  • Tracks research timelines, milestones, and deliverables; maintains project documentation.

  • Identifies opportunities for new research ideas and facilitates the operationalization of ideas into actionable projects.

  • Contributes to the development and maintenance of controlled documents for research and data analysis.
  • Performs administrative duties as assigned.
  • Assists with other duties as assigned.

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Passionate and proactive about research; possesses a strong sense of curiosity about data, research questions and ideas.
  • Strong understanding of statistical and research concepts.
  • Proficient in SPSS or other statistical software for data cleaning and analysis.
  • Working knowledge of Tableau for data visualizations and summary reports.
  • Demonstrates effective time management and organizational skills to manage multiple projects with time-sensitive components.
  • Effective verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills necessary to organize, structure, and communicate information and ideas clearly.
  • Utilizes proper grammar and vocabulary in both verbal and written usage.
  • Demonstrates strong attention to detail and analytical ability to evaluate and ensure accuracy.
  • Ability to identify problems, consider alternatives, consult with peers, and implement solutions.
  • Ability to work independently and as a team member.
  • Ability to be punctual and reliable.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Working knowledge of database management systems.

  • Baccalaureate degree in the social sciences, statistics, data analytics, or a closely related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience working in an applied research setting.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience conducting data analysis, working with large and complex datasets, and survey programming.
  • Minimum of 1 year of experience using Tableau for data visualizations.

jobs.excerpt: Why Charlie Health? Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care.
jobs.description:
Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Charlie Health is looking for a dynamic individual to serve as Clinical Admissions Therapist. The Clinical Admissions Therapist will be responsible for meeting with clients upon admission, building rapport, completing biopsychosocial assessments, and establishing treatment needs.

We’re a mission-driven team working to expand access to life-saving behavioral healthcare for people who need it most. Across all departments, we collaborate to deliver meaningful outcomes and build a more connected, effective model of care. If you're inspired by our mission and excited to help transform the behavioral health landscape, we encourage you to apply.

Responsibilities

  • Demonstrate personable and competent communication skills to develop rapport with clients and referral sources
  • Present programming information in a thorough and supportive manner to help clients gain access to care
  • Complete virtual biopsychosocial assessments for a wide range of ages, including children, teens, young adults, and adults with various mental health concerns
  • Determine appropriateness and fit for virtual intensive outpatient program (IOP) level of care
  • Construct provisional mental health diagnoses utilizing DSM-V criteria
  • Document client information in accordance with regulatory standards using electronic medical record
  • Assign treatment team members and group schedules while informing staff of new admissions
  • Interface with Admissions, Verification of Benefits, Utilization Review, and Clinical teams in facilitating intake
  • Collaborate with referral sources: hospitals, treatment centers, psychiatrists, therapists, and other behavioral health providers upon admission
  • Looking to cover the following shifts to meet the schedules and needs of our clients:
    • Mornings and Afternoons - Must be available 11am - 7pm MT
    • Afternoons and Evenings - Must be available 12pm - 8pm MT
    • Weekends encouraged
    • Will consider alternative availability on individual basis
  • Work authorized in the United States and native or bilingual English proficiency
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills
  • Access to reliable technology resources to deliver uninterrupted, confidential, and compliant telehealth services
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced environment while maintaining high attention to detail and quality of care

Requirements

  • Experience working with a wide range of ages, including children, teens, young adults, and adults preferred
  • Experience completing behavioral health assessments and admissions preferred
  • Independent licensure in a mental health field required
  • An independent license is preferred, but we’re happy to work with associate-level clinicians who are eager to grow and work toward full licensure.

Benefits

Charlie Health is pleased to offer comprehensive benefits to all full-time, exempt employees. Read more about our benefits here.

Additional Information

Note to Colorado applicants: applications will be accepted and reviewed on a rolling basis

The expected base pay for this role will be between $60,000 and $67,500 per year at the commencement of employment. However, base pay will be determined on an individualized basis and will be impacted by location and years of experience. Further, base pay is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include incentive compensation, discretionary bonuses, other short and long-term incentive packages, and other Charlie Health-sponsored benefits.#li-remote

Based on the nature of this role, you will need to complete several state background checks for clearance to see clients. Florida requires a fingerprint based background check, with more information found here. Please note that the cost for this background check will be paid for in full by Charlie Health.

Our Values

  • Connection: Care deeply & inspire hope.
  • Congruence: Stay curious & heed the evidence.
  • Commitment: Act with urgency & don’t give up.

Please do not call our public clinical admissions line in regard to this or any other job posting.

Please be cautious of potential recruitment fraud. If you are interested in exploring opportunities at Charlie Health, please go directly to our Careers Page: Charlie Health will never ask you to pay a fee or download software as part of the interview process with our company. In addition, Charlie Health will not ask for your personal banking information until you have signed an offer of employment and completed onboarding paperwork that is provided by our People Operations team. All communications with Charlie Health Talent and People Operations professionals will only be sent from @charliehealth.com email addresses. Legitimate emails will never originate from gmail.com, yahoo.com, or other commercial email services.

Recruiting agencies, please do not submit unsolicited referrals for this or any open role. We have a roster of agencies with whom we partner, and we will not pay any fee associated with unsolicited referrals.

At Charlie Health, we value being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to cultivate an environment where individuals can be their authentic selves. Being an Equal Opportunity Employer means every member of our team feels as though they are supported and belong. We value diverse perspectives to help us provide essential mental health and substance use disorder treatments to all young people.

Charlie Health applicants are assessed solely on their qualifications for the role, without regard to disability or need for accommodation.

By clicking "Submit application" below, you agree to Charlie Health's Privacy Policy and Terms of Service.

By submitting your application, you agree to receive SMS messages from Charlie Health regarding your application. Message and data rates may apply. Message frequency varies. You can reply STOP to opt out at any time. For help, reply HELP.

Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

While specific benefits and incentives may vary by geography, the core of our commitment remains the same: rewarding effort, providing growth opportunities, and creating an environment where every employee feels valued.

jobs.description:
Sales Specialist – End User: Public Sector Managed Print Services (Quebec)

Description -

Spécialiste des ventes d’imprimantes

Le Spécialiste des ventes d’imprimantes est responsable de la spécialisation en ventes, de la collaboration avec les équipes de gestion, de la gestion des relations avec les comptes, ainsi que de la fourniture d’une expertise sur les produits et services HP. Ce rôle est axé sur l’atteinte des objectifs de vente, la préparation de propositions, l’acquisition de nouveaux clients (« nouveaux logos »), et la transition fluide des clients.

Le Spécialiste des ventes d’imprimantes est responsable des activités de vente axées sur les solutions d’impression, en lien avec la stratégie globale du compte, qu’il s’agisse de clients existants ou nouveaux.

Responsabilités principales

  • Se spécialiser dans la vente et collaborer avec les équipes de gestion.

  • Gérer les relations avec les comptes et fournir une expertise sur les produits et services HP.

  • Atteindre les quotas de vente et élaborer des propositions.

  • Acquérir de nouveaux clients et assurer le transfert des comptes.

  • Identifier et poursuivre les opportunités d’expansion au sein des comptes existants et nouveaux.

  • Être responsable des activités de vente axées sur les solutions d’impression en alignement avec la stratégie du compte.

  • Collaborer avec le responsable de compte pour identifier, conclure, développer, renouveler et finaliser les opportunités.

  • Assurer une gestion rigoureuse du pipeline et atteindre les objectifs de vente.

  • Établir une relation professionnelle et consultative avec le client, incluant les cadres supérieurs (niveau C) pour les comptes moyens à grands, en développant une compréhension approfondie des besoins uniques de l’entreprise afin de proposer des solutions adaptées et axées sur les résultats.

  • Générer de manière autonome un pipeline pour les offres d’impression et de solutions HP.

  • Qualifier, documenter et mettre à jour les opportunités et la stratégie de poursuite tout au long du processus de vente.

  • Collaborer avec le responsable commercial pour garantir la taille, le suivi et la visibilité du pipeline à travers le processus de vente, et veiller à ce qu’il réponde aux attentes et aux objectifs.

  • Collaborer avec les équipes de réussite client et les ressources post-vente afin d’assurer une mise en œuvre rapide et une adoption efficace des solutions HP.

  • Tenir des réunions de transition avec les clients pour les ententes contractuelles.

  • Participer à la préparation des plans de compte (SAR), des revues trimestrielles (QBR), des présentations de valeur ajoutée (VAS) et des documents de présentation de solutions.

Formation et expérience requises

  • Minimum de 4+ ans d’expérience en vente ou dans un rôle similaire.

  • Antécédents démontrés en matière d’atteinte des objectifs de vente et de croissance des affaires.

  • Expérience ou connaissance des ventes dans le secteur public.

  • Solide compréhension des tendances du marché et capacité à transformer les analyses en opportunités d’affaires.

  • Expérience dans la navigation de structures organisationnelles complexes afin d’identifier et de maximiser les opportunités de croissance.

Connaissances et compétences

  • Pour les postes qui soutiennent des clients ou des partenaires situés dans la province de Québec, les employés doivent posséder des connaissances de base en anglais, avec la capacité de lire, écrire et parler. Ils devront s’attendre à utiliser ces compétences quotidiennement pour la communication interne de gestion.

  • Expertise en stratégie TI et en services gérés.

  • Solides compétences en gestion d’entreprise.

  • Excellentes aptitudes en résolution de problèmes et en planification stratégique.

  • Excellentes habiletés de communication et de leadership, capacité à naviguer dans des structures organisationnelles complexes.

  • Adaptabilité face aux nouvelles capacités commerciales et aux tendances émergentes (p. ex. plateformes, marchés numériques).

  • Compétences avancées en négociation et en conclusion d’ententes.

À propos de HP

HP crée de nouvelles possibilités pour que la technologie ait un impact significatif sur les personnes, les entreprises, les gouvernements et la société. Plus grande entreprise technologique au monde et classée au 10e rang du palmarès Fortune 500 en 2012, HP offre un portefeuille complet comprenant l’impression, l’informatique personnelle, les logiciels, les services et l’infrastructure TI, au service de plus d’un milliard de clients dans plus de 170 pays sur six continents.
HP invente, conçoit et livre des solutions technologiques qui génèrent de la valeur commerciale, créent une valeur sociale et améliorent la vie de ses clients.

Merci d’avoir pris le temps d’examiner cette offre. Si ce poste correspond à votre expérience et à vos intérêts, postulez dès aujourd’hui — nous avons hâte d’en apprendre davantage sur vous !
Si vous connaissez quelqu’un qui pourrait correspondre à ce poste, veuillez le recommander.

Veuillez noter que les énoncés ci-dessus décrivent la nature générale et le niveau du poste. Ils ne constituent pas une liste exhaustive de toutes les responsabilités, tâches et compétences requises. D’autres fonctions peuvent être ajoutées ou modifiées en tout temps par la direction.

Rémunération et avantages sociaux

La rémunération cible totale (OTE) pour ce poste se situe entre $132,150 et $179,750 CAD par année, avec une répartition 60 %/40 % (salaire/prime). La rémunération au sein de cette plage sera déterminée en fonction de l’expérience, des compétences et de l’équité interne.

En tant qu’employé à temps plein de HP Canada, vous serez admissible aux programmes d’avantages sociaux du groupe, incluant les régimes médicaux, dentaires, d’assurance-vie et d’invalidité, conformément aux conditions des régimes applicables. Pendant votre emploi, vous bénéficierez de 15 jours de congés payés par an, au prorata selon votre date d’embauche. Des informations détaillées sur les avantages seront fournies lors de l’embauche.

Employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances

HP Canada est un employeur garantissant l’égalité des chances. Nous valorisons la diversité sous toutes ses formes.
Sur demande, et conformément à la politique d’accommodement de HP, des mesures d’adaptation peuvent être offertes à toutes les étapes du processus de sélection pour les candidats qualifiés.
Si vous avez besoin d’aide pour remplir votre demande d’emploi ou si vous nécessitez des mesures d’adaptation liées à un handicap, veuillez écrire à .

Dans le cadre de nos obligations contractuelles, le candidat retenu devra réussir une vérification des antécédents criminels de base. Il devra également signer l’entente de confidentialité, de non-sollicitation et de conflit d’intérêts de HP.

Avis de non-responsabilité

The Managed Print Sales Specialist- Public Sector is responsible for specializing in sales, collaborating with Ownership Teams,

managing account relationships, and providing expertise on HP's products and services. This role focuses on achieving sales quotas, developing proposals, landing new logos, and ensuring client hand-offs.

The Managed Print Sales Specialist owns Print Solutions focused selling activities aligned to an overall account strategy with existing or new accounts.

The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

Hiring Manager: Matthew Sedlacek

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer with accounting and financial experience. This role offers an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for leadership and innovation.

This position is ideal for professionals who began their careers in accounting or finance and later transitioned into software engineering — individuals who now want to leverage that domain expertise to architect and scale technical solutions that solve complex financial challenges in fintech.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will design, develop, and optimize high-impact systems that power Sezzle’s financial reporting, reconciliation, and automation workflows. You’ll partner closely with cross-functional teams — including Accounting and Finance — to ensure data integrity, streamline financial processes, and build robust, auditable systems that meet enterprise-grade standards.

Your role will extend beyond development. You’ll mentor engineers, shape technical direction, and bring a strong sense of ownership to every project you lead. You should be able to build high-quality, innovative, and fully performing software in compliance with coding standards, technical design, and regulatory best practices.

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

What You'll Do:

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to enhance and maintain software solutions for financial processes.
  • Participate fully in the software development lifecycle, from design through deployment.
  • Build new features and products as part of an integrated engineering team.
  • Leverage accounting background to identify gaps and improve automation and reconciliation workflows.
  • Evaluate and deploy software tools, processes, and metrics.
  • Provide support and consulting on software systems usage.
  • Ensure compliance with project plans and industry standards.
  • Design software applications and features in Golang
  • Build reports and automations using Python and SQL.
  • Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly
  • Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products
  • Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products
  • Deliver high-quality, testable features that meet reporting and compliance standards.
  • Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For:

  • At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
  • Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go and Java Python or a similar language.
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Prior experience as an accountant or financial analyst.
  • Solid understanding of financial operations such as reconciliation, reporting, and compliance.
  • Experience in banking or financial institutions is a plus
  • Proficient in multiple programming languages (e.g., Python, Java, Go) and experience with database systems like MySQL or PostgreSQL.
  • Familiarity with software engineering tools, software development methodology, and release processes.
  • Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
  • Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
  • Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

  • Translate cutting-edge research advances into practical, high-impact production systems.

  • 7+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems in production, including deep hands-on experience with LLMs at scale.

  • Deep expertise in transformer-based models, embeddings, retrieval systems, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines.

jobs.excerpt: This is a remote position. We are evolving what product design looks like at Sumara, and this is the role that leads it.
jobs.description:
This is a remote position.

We are evolving what product design looks like at Sumara, and this is the role that leads it.

The traditional product design role is built around handoff. You sketch in Figma, hand it to engineering, wait, get a build that does not match the spec, iterate, ship something close to the original idea. The handoff is where craft, speed, and intent get lost.

AI tools are changing what a product designer can do. Tools like Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, v0, and modern Figma let a designer go from idea to working prototype, and increasingly to near-production interface, faster than a traditional designer-plus-engineer pair. The handoff shrinks. The designer ships more of what they design.

This role is for product designers who want to be at the front of that shift. Whether you are already experimenting with these tools or just curious and motivated to learn, we will invest in your growth, give you the time and the support, and help you evolve into what the industry is calling a design engineer. You set the pace.

We are building a unified financial platform that combines trading, investing, crypto, and everyday spending into a single account. Five pillars. Different latencies, different mental models, different levels of complexity. All inside one app on a phone screen. In a product that moves people’s money, polish is not a nice-to-have. It is what makes the product trustworthy.

WHAT YOU OWN

  • The design system from scratch: components, primitives, tokens, motion language, accessibility patterns, built to scale across all five pillars

  • End-to-end product surfaces: discovery, exploration, high-fidelity design, prototyping, partnership with engineering through to ship

  • Animation and interaction design: gestures, transitions, micro-interactions that make the product feel alive

  • Cross-pillar consistency: making sure trading, investing, crypto, and cards feel like one product, not five

  • Your own evolution: pulling AI tools and frontend skills into your workflow over time so you can prototype and ship more of what you design directly

You work shoulder-to-shoulder with other product designers, product managers, and engineers. You own the result, not the artifact.

HOW YOU OPERATE

You are curious about AI tools and excited to make them part of your workflow. Maybe you are already using Claude or Cursor on the side. Maybe you have heard about Claude Code and v0 but have not gone deep yet. Both are fine. What matters is the direction of travel.

We will invest time, training, and tooling in helping you become self-sufficient at prototyping and shipping using AI. By the end of year one, you should be operating much closer to a design engineer than to a traditional product designer. That is the deal we are offering, and it is rare.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • The design system is in production within six months, with clear rules other teams adopt

  • The app has a recognisable visual and interaction signature

  • Polish gaps between pillars close. The product feels like one app, not a federation of features.

  • You are visibly more self-sufficient at prototyping and shipping by the end of year one

  • New product surfaces inherit craft instead of fighting for it


Requirements

Required

  • 5+ years as a product designer shipping consumer products at quality

  • Strong taste. You have shipped interfaces that look and feel deliberately different from the average.

  • Fluent in Figma, motion, interaction design, and design systems thinking

  • Curious about AI tools and motivated to make them part of how you work, even if you are not there yet

  • Comfort working close to code. You can read it, you understand what is happening, you are open to going deeper.

  • Intent to evolve your craft, not defend the old version of it

Strong signal

  • Already experimenting with AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, v0, Lovable, or similar) in your workflow or side projects

  • A public portfolio, Dribbble, Codepen, GitHub, or live demos that show range across UI, motion, and craft

  • Mobile-first product experience (iOS and Android)

  • Experience contributing to a design system at a real product company

  • Frontend skills, even informal (React, React Native, modern CSS)

  • Fintech, trading, crypto, or any product where polish directly shapes user trust

  • Charting, data visualization, or real-time UI experience


Benefits

Benefits
  • Competitive salary commensurate with experience
  • Market standard EOSB and performance bonuses
  • Comprehensive health insurance
  • Professional development and conference budgets
  • Team building events, career mentorship, and strong company culture
  • Remote work flexibility

jobs.excerpt: About UsCo-founded in 2023 by Joe Laws and Grant Verstandig, Trase Systems is AI, Uncomplicated.
jobs.description:
About Us

Co-founded in 2023 by Joe Laws and Grant Verstandig, Trase Systems is AI, Uncomplicated. Trase empowers enterprise leaders to harness the full potential of AI without the associated complexity and risks. We are an end-to-end solution for deploying, managing, and optimizing AI in the enterprise. Our platform specializes in bridging the “last mile” of AI adoption, unlocking AI's full potential while driving efficiency and significant cost savings.Trase is at the forefront of AI Agent innovation, topping the Hugging Face GAIA Leaderboard for Generalized AI Assistants, ahead of industry giants such as Google, Meta, Microsoft, and OpenAI. We are leveraging our cutting-edge technologies to develop mission-critical agentic applications in complex industries such as Healthcare, Oil & Gas, and National Security.

About the Role

As a Senior or Staff Full Stack Software Engineer at Trase, you will build and support software for Red Cell Federal (RCF), Red Cell Partners (RCP), and RCP incubations and portfolio companies. You will join Trase's dedicated RCF/RCP support team, delivering user interfaces, backend services, APIs, and integrations with a strong focus on federal, government, and national security programs.

Red Cell Partners is an investment and incubation firm that builds and supports technology companies, including Trase. Red Cell Federal is our federal-focused partner within that ecosystem. This role helps RCF and other RCP partner companies adopt Trase OS and build secure AI applications for their missions.

This is a hands-on role with ownership from requirements through production support. You will work directly with partner engineers, Product, the dedicated TPM and DevOps/SRE engineers, Trase Platform Engineering, and GRC to deliver working solutions across the frontend, backend, and integration layers.

The level will reflect your experience and demonstrated scope. Senior engineers will independently own complex features and partner integrations end to end. Staff engineers will also lead architecture across engagements, establish reusable engineering patterns, and mentor engineers.

Why this Role is Needed

RCF and RCP companies need software that works within their applications, security controls, and deployment environments. Success requires intuitive user experiences, reliable APIs and agent workflows, clear audit trails, and dependable integrations.

You will close partner-specific functionality gaps, diagnose issues across application and platform boundaries, and deliver small, validated increments. You will also turn recurring partner needs into reusable improvements with Trase's platform team.

What You'll Do

  • Build full-stack features for RCF/RCP partners, from responsive UI interfaces and administrative tools to backend services, data models, and production integrations.
  • Work directly with partner engineers and Product to clarify use cases, reproduce issues, define acceptance criteria, and deliver small increments. Surface scope, dependencies, and risks with the TPM before committing dates.
  • Integrate partner applications and agents with Trase OS APIs and SDKs, external APIs, MCP tools, and model-provider endpoints. Provide working examples and clear integration documentation.
  • Build reliable agent and workflow integrations, including asynchronous execution, event streaming, state handling, retries, timeouts, and error recovery. Preserve correctness and data integrity across failures.
  • Create usable interfaces for configuring agents, managing connections and policies, reviewing runs, and inspecting logs, traces, costs, and audit history. Make failures and recovery actions understandable to users.
  • Implement authentication, authorization, role-based access, secrets integration, and audit events across frontend and backend services. Partner with Governance, Risk and Compliance on application security findings and engineering evidence for applicable federal requirements.
  • Adapt application configuration and dependencies for customer-managed cloud, private-network, and on-premises environments. Work with DevOps/SRE on packaging, deployment prerequisites, and end-to-end validation.
  • Own quality through code reviews, unit and integration tests, end-to-end tests, representative workflow evaluations, and regression coverage. Verify application behavior in the target environment before partner handoff.
  • Diagnose and resolve partner-reported defects across the UI, APIs, SDK, data stores, and runtime services. Add useful telemetry, support incident investigation, and validate fixes with partners.
  • Support releases, upgrades, and ongoing application maintenance, including federal deployments such as Second Front where applicable. Review and integrate partner contributions, maintain API/SDK compatibility, and coordinate security fixes with platform and DevOps/SRE owners.
  • Document architecture, setup, known limitations, and troubleshooting steps; provide partner walkthroughs and knowledge transfer. Share reusable solutions with the platform team and mentor other engineers.

Required Qualifications

  • U.S. citizenship is required.
  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record of shipping and supporting production applications; scope and technical leadership appropriate to Senior or Staff level.
  • 5+ years of hands-on full-stack development spanning modern web frontends, backend services, APIs, and databases.
  • Strong frontend skills with TypeScript/JavaScript and React, Next.js, or comparable frameworks, including state management, API integration, and clear, accessible user experiences.
  • Strong backend engineering skills in Python, TypeScript/Node.js, Go, Java, or a similar language, including API design, service integration, validation, and error handling.
  • Experience designing data models and working with relational databases, migrations, caching, and asynchronous or event-driven processing.
  • Experience implementing authentication, authorization, secure API access, secrets handling, and audit logging in production applications.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing, code review, Git, containers, CI/CD, and deploying or troubleshooting applications in cloud or Kubernetes environments.
  • Ability to debug across browser, service, API, and data layers using logs, metrics, and traces, and to own issues through validated resolution.
  • Strong technical judgment, clear written and verbal communication, and experience translating ambiguous customer requirements into maintainable solutions and useful documentation.
  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve implementation, testing, troubleshooting, or code review, with careful validation of the resulting changes.

Strongly Preferred

  • Prior full-stack software engineering experience supporting national security, defense, federal agencies, or other government programs.
  • An active U.S. government security clearance.
  • Experience with federal application security and delivery requirements, such as STIG hardening, NIST controls, RMF/ATO evidence, FedRAMP, or DoD impact-level environments.
  • Experience integrating identity providers such as Keycloak using OAuth/OIDC, or implementing fine-grained access and sensitive-data controls.
  • Experience building AI/LLM applications, agent integrations, RAG, tool/MCP connections, evaluations, or workflow systems such as Temporal.
  • Customer-facing or forward-deployed engineering experience across multiple partner organizations, including onboarding, technical handoffs, and ongoing support.
  • Experience adapting applications for government cloud, restricted-network, or on-premises deployments, including Second Front or comparable federal delivery platforms

If you want to be on the cutting edge of technology, building AI solutions for the future, and are up for a challenge, let’s talk!

Salary Range: $180,000-240,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience, skills, and other factors.

Some travel to customers may be required.

Our Trase Benefits:

For full-time roles only

  • Career track opportunity with potential for rapid advancement with strong performance as the firm grows
  • 100% employer paid, comprehensive health care including medical, dental, and vision for you and your family.
  • Paid maternity and paternity for 14 weeks at employees' normal pay.
  • Unlimited PTO, with management approval.
  • Opportunities for professional development and continued learning.
  • Optional 401K, FSA, and equity incentives available.
  • Mental health benefits are available through Tara Mind.

We’re an Equal Opportunity Employer: You’ll receive consideration for employment without regard to race, sex, color, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or on the basis of disability.

Applicant Data Disclosure

By submitting an application, you acknowledge that Red Cell Partners, LLC ("Red Cell") uses third-party service providers to facilitate its recruitment and hiring processes. These providers include applicant tracking systems, candidate verification platforms, and fraud detection tools (collectively, "Hiring Platforms"). Your application materials, including your résumé, cover letter, work samples, responses to application questions, and any other information you submit, may be transmitted to and processed by these Hiring Platforms for the following purposes:

  • Managing and administering your application throughout the hiring process;
  • Verifying the accuracy and authenticity of application materials, including by cross-referencing information you provide against publicly available sources and proprietary databases;
  • Identifying indicators of potentially fraudulent, fabricated, or materially misleading application content, including but not limited to discrepancies between submitted materials and publicly available professional profiles, geographic anomalies, and fabricated work histories.

Applications that are flagged through this process as containing indicators of fraud or material misrepresentation may be declined from further consideration. If you have questions about the status of your application or the evaluation process, please contact .

Your information will be retained only for as long as necessary to fulfill these purposes and any applicable legal obligations, after which it will be deleted in accordance with Red Cell's data retention policies.

CACI, INC. – FEDERAL has a contract with a federal agency to implement, support, and maintain a mission-critical SAP S/4HANA solution supporting transportation and logistics operations for the Department of Defense. The CACI Team manages Planning, Procurement, Fulfillment, Financials, Application Development, and Technical Operations, including Security, GRC, and Identity & Access Management—within the Joint Transportation Management System (JTMS) environment.

CACI is seeking to hire an ABAP developer for a new SAP-based development effort. This role requires deep expertise in SAP ABAP Development and prior experience supporting USTRANSCOM (USTC) transportation operations, systems, or programs.


The architect will ensure SAP ABAP capabilities align with DoD transportation doctrine, regulatory requirements (DTR, DoD FMR), and Clean Core principles while supporting complex integrations across DoD and commercial transportation ecosystems.

Duties and Responsibilities


  • Develop, test, debug, implement, maintain, and document ABAP code used in RICEFW (Reports, Interfaces, Conversions, Extensions, Forms and Workflows) objects
  • Provide optimization, enhancement and O&M support for ABAP applications which perform financial and business management functions on SAP S/4 HANA (ECC, CRM, SRM, TMS)
  • Participate in the analysis of the customer's business operations to validate requirements and scope, suggest process improvements, and assist in level of effort (LOE) estimation, if required
  • Develop and maintain SAP design and technical specification documents, and conduct unit, integration, and release testing to validate functionality
  • Support end-users Acceptance Testing activities, and participate in Production Operations and Release Management support
  • Modernize User Interfaces by designing and building applications consistent with the SAP Fiori Application Architecture, including SAP application templates (e.g.: Worklist, Master-Detail), Smart Controls, Dynamic UI Content, Smart Templates, Fragments and Themes
  • Implementing Fiori applications (transactional, factsheet and analytical) and enhancing standard applications using enhancement framework
  • Designing & modeling OData services using the Gateway Service Builder
  • Fielding applications within existing application Launchpad environment

Key Competencies


  • High degree of initiative, creativity, and technical ability to successfully function on this team is required.
  • Demonstrated experience with development, maintenance, and support of applications related to SAP ECC 6.0 or higher, SAP S/4 HANA and other IT systems.
  • Experience developing software in SAP NetWeaver ABAP Stack environments using:
  • ABAP Objects, ABAP Reports, ABAP online transactions, Webdynpro
  • SAP interfacing technologies BAPI, ALE, IDOC's, PI, SOAP, XML, Webservice, Proxies, APIs, REST services
  • Business Object Processing Framework (BOPF) and backend OData services
  • User Exits, BADIs, and Batch Programming
  • SAP UI5 related technologies and development tools (e.g.: HTML5, CSS, JavaScript, JQuery, VSCode, Eclipse, etc.)
  • Experience with SAP S/4 HANA - Data Modeling using HANA Studio, ABAP Development Tools (ADT), Code Performance Rules and Guidelines for SAP HANA, AMDP, code push down techniques, CDS views, Native SQL, ABAP Core data Services, Data Base Procedures, Text Search, ALV on HANA and HANA Live models consumption.
  • Knowledge and experience using ABAP RESTful Programming Model ABAP Development for SAP S/4HANA.
  • Expert troubleshooting, debugging and problem analysis skills.

You’ll Bring These Qualifications

  • Active DoD Secret Clearance (minimum required).
  • Minimum of 10+ years of development experience and 5+ years of SAP ABAP development experience.
  • Strong knowledge of:

o SAP standard functionality using ABAP Objects and other modern SAP technologies.

o SAP ABAP Data Dictionary and other SAP repository objects.These Qualifications

Desired Qualifications

  • Prior experience in JTMS or similar DoD logistics modernization programs
  • Knowledge of the Agile methodology.
  • S/4 HANA implementation experience preferred.
  • Designing and implementing modern UI5 or Fiori-style front-end User Interfaces using SAP libraries and techniques would be a plus.
  • SAP Certification in one or more of the following disciplines are desired
  • ABAP Development and Maintenance
  • UI5 or Fiori Design and Development.


-

The Technical Project Manager supports the planning, execution, tracking, and delivery of technical projects across multiple teams. This role acts as a central point of coordination between business stakeholders, technical teams, vendors, and project leadership, ensuring projects remain on schedule, within scope, and aligned with organizational goals.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, comfortable working in a technical environment, and skilled at managing communications, documentation, and project activities across multiple concurrent initiatives.

As our technical project manager, you become a member of a project team, supporting day-to-day project activities related to the TrainAI project process. In addition to tasks requiring a technical specialty, regular project coordinator tasks will include client data management, project set up, scheduling, project file organization, and placing tasks with raters.

The Technical Project Manager is responsible for coordinating both client-facing project activities and technical deliverables to support the successful execution of client projects. Working closely with the Director, Program Managers, and Project Managers, this role oversees resource allocation, task coordination, and project timelines across a variety of engagements. The Technical Project Manager also actively participates in client and internal meetings, identifies emerging business and operational issues, and provides recommendations to improve project delivery, efficiency, and overall account performance.

About RWS TrainAI Data Services

Training or fine-tuning artificial intelligence (AI) requires data. LOTS of data. However, not just any data will do – our clients need responsible AI data that’s targeted, accurate and reliable to ensure machine learning (ML) success. But preparing AI training data is a monumental task that can take up the vast majority of AI project time, leaving AI teams with precious little time to focus on developing, deploying and evaluating ML models. RWS TrainAI helps our clients address this challenge head-on.

With a seamless blend of technological understanding and human intelligence, RWS TrainAI provides complete, end-to-end data collection and content generation, data annotation or labelling, human-in-the-loop data validation and generative AI data services for all types of AI, in any language, at any scale, based on the principles of responsible AI. Today, TrainAI supports four of the world’s top five technology companies, enhancing the performance of their generative AI applications by providing services such as prompt engineering, response refinement and red teaming with locale-specific domain experts across a broad range of topic areas and educational levels.

jobs.excerpt: About SparkSpark is a science-driven, philanthropically funded non-profit that accelerates progress on unsolved climate challenges.
jobs.description:
About Spark

Spark is a science-driven, philanthropically funded non-profit that accelerates progress on unsolved climate challenges. Our goal is to enable a safer climate by filling targeted gaps in current climate actions. We look around the corner at the key blind spots that pose big climate risks or offer big climate opportunities, like major sources of unabated emissions. Then we work to speed up the development of the fields needed to address those challenges.

We are a team of scientists, policy experts, innovators, and systems thinkers working to build today’s foundations for the comprehensive climate solutions we will need tomorrow. Rather than betting on individual pathways or innovations, we work to grow a field as a whole so that the most effective science and solutions can be surfaced and scaled. We use a large suite of field-building tools to support new research, markets, policies, and talent development, through both in-house initiatives and building broader coalitions. We are currently focused on super pollutants from agriculture (specifically methane and nitrous oxide), warming-induced greenhouse gas emissions, and methane removal.

Spark’s impact is made possible by a community of generous and pioneering individuals, foundations, and organizations that share our vision for a safer climate future.

Position Summary

Spark is looking for a Senior Gifts Officer to build and deepen Spark's relationships with major and principal donors. This is a frontline fundraising role for someone who thrives on relationship-driven work, can effectively direct the rhythm and flow of funder relationships, and brings organization and diligence to the fundraising process. We’re looking for someone who is deeply comfortable working alongside scientists and researchers and who knows how to translate their work and leverage their ideas to attract funders.

You'll report to our Executive Director and work closely with our Program Directors to steward relationships and close gifts that move Spark’s fields forward. You’ll act as a connective node across our development and program teams—mapping funder interests to the right programs, coaching program directors ahead of funder meetings, making sure the right ask reaches the right funder at the right time, and owning follow-up steps with funders to bring grants through their process.

What You'll Do

  • Attend funder meetings alongside executive leadership and program leads and identify, document, and drive the next steps

  • Coach program directors on how to communicate with and engage funders more effectively over time

  • Coordinate funder strategy across Spark’s programs—mapping funders to programs, clarifying relationship owners, and sequencing the right ask from the right program at the right time

  • Close funding opportunities by understanding each donor’s perspective, portfolio, and knowing when and how to make the ask, and managing grant proposal steps and timelines.

  • Steward funder relationships individually—tracking each funder’s interests and what they respond to, and matching Spark’s latest wins, research, and communications products to the right moments for engagement

  • Work directly with scientists and program leads to translate complex research into compelling philanthropic narratives

  • Prepare high-quality funder materials including briefings, proposals, reports, and stewardship updates

  • Represent Spark at field convenings, donor events, and conferences

  • Maintain rigorous CRM hygiene and contribute to pipeline reporting and forecasting

What We're Looking For

  • 7+ years of frontline fundraising experience or comparable sales or business-development experience, with a track record of closing six- and seven-figure deals

  • Experience building a portfolio of new relationships in a growth-stage or start-up environment

  • Proven experience working in or alongside scientific, research, or technical organizations and the ability to partner with subject matter experts

jobs.title: Casper Test Operations Associate
jobs.excerpt: Help make higher education tests run smoothly, and the operation behind them smarter.
jobs.description:
Help make higher education tests run smoothly, and the operation behind them smarter.

When thousands of applicants complete Casper each year as part of applying to university and professional programs, there’s a team behind the scenes making sure every live test has the people and support it needs.

As our Test Operations Associate, you’ll help run the operation behind our Test Support Agents (TSAs), the people who support applicants during live tests. You’ll build rosters, coordinate coverage, track availability and training, answer questions, and help make sure payments are accurate and on time.

There’s also plenty of opportunity to make our processes better.

If you’re someone who notices the spreadsheet that takes too many steps, information being entered twice, or a repetitive task that could be automated, you’ll have room to do something about it here. You already use AI and other tools to make your own work smarter, and you’ll have opportunities to apply that mindset to real operational problems.

You’ll learn our operation from experienced teammates while bringing your own ideas and experience from the start. As your knowledge grows, you’ll take on more complex rostering and resourcing decisions, lead live tests, and help create smarter, more scalable ways of working.

You don’t need previous experience in test operations or higher education. Your experience might come from operations, customer support, administration, hospitality, education, events, logistics, or another environment with lots of moving pieces. What matters is what you’ve learned from that experience: how you organise work, solve problems, support people, improve processes, and follow through on the details.

Before you apply: This is a fully remote role open to candidates anywhere in Australia. We’re hiring for an existing, open position. You’re welcome to use AI thoughtfully when preparing your application and conversations with our team. Just make sure what you share reflects your own experience, thinking, and judgment. During live conversations, please don’t use AI to generate responses unless invited to do so.

The Work You’ll Do

Some days, you’ll be building rosters for upcoming tests, checking availability, or making sure TSA payments are ready to go. Other days, you might be responding to a last-minute scheduling change, supporting a TSA with a question, leading a live test, or digging into a process that feels more manual or complicated than it needs to be.

Make sure every test has the right support

You’ll gather TSA availability, keep track of what people are trained to do, build rosters for upcoming tests, and coordinate additional coverage when plans change.

There’s judgement involved. You might have ten people available, but that doesn’t automatically mean you have the right ten people. Different tests have different needs, TSAs bring different experience and strengths, and availability can change quickly. You’ll learn how to put those pieces together and take on increasingly complex rostering and resourcing decisions.

Be someone our TSAs can rely on

Our TSAs are contractors, but they’re an important part of how we deliver a great applicant experience. You’ll be one of the people they can turn to when they have questions, need help with a shift, or aren’t sure what to do next.

You’ll help keep communication clear, information current, and people prepared for the work ahead. As you grow, you’ll also contribute to onboarding and training new TSAs and help us understand where we may need more capacity, training, or support.

Make sure the details add up

You’ll track shifts and hours, review payment information and invoices, and work with our Finance team to make sure TSAs are paid accurately and on time.

You don’t need a finance background, but you should be comfortable working with numbers and spreadsheets, checking your work, and investigating when something doesn’t look right.

Lead live tests

You’ll be trained to lead Casper test sessions yourself, coordinating the TSAs working a test, keeping an eye on how things are progressing, answering questions, and helping the team respond when something unexpected happens.

You’ll shadow experienced teammates before leading independently. Over time, you’ll become another person the team can rely on to keep live tests moving smoothly, particularly during Australian and New Zealand-friendly hours.

Help us build smarter ways of working

You’ll have opportunities to use AI, automation, and other tools to make recurring work simpler and more reliable. That could mean improving how we collect and organise TSA availability, reducing manual work in rostering or payments, making information easier to find, or helping build workflows we haven’t thought of yet.

You won’t be expected to change things before you understand them. Learn the operation first, then bring your ideas and experience to making it better.

Who You’ll Work With, and How

You’ll report to our Manager, Support and join a small Operations - Support team across Australia and Canada. You’ll be one of two full-time Support team members currently based in Australia, helping strengthen our coverage as our work across Australia and New Zealand grows.

You’ll work closely with experienced teammates who know our test and TSA operations deeply. Expect plenty of context-sharing and shadowing early on, with more independence as your knowledge grows.

Your work will also connect you with:

  • Test Support Agents, who you’ll coordinate and support throughout their work with us.
  • Finance, who you’ll partner with to keep TSA payments accurate and on time.
  • Customer Success and Operations, whose work helps shape test schedules, applicant volumes, and the support we need to have in place.
  • Product and Engineering, sharing feedback from the day-to-day operation to help improve the tools, workflows, and products that support test delivery.
  • Your broader Support team, who you’ll work alongside to deliver live tests and solve problems as they happen.

Because much of Acuity is based in Canada, your working day won’t fully overlap with everyone else’s. We work asynchronously where we can, with intentional overlap for learning, collaboration, and team connection.

The Impact You’ll Have

  • Keep live tests running smoothly. Help make sure every test has the right people, preparation, and support in place when it begins.
  • Give TSAs a strong experience, too. Help the people supporting our applicants feel informed, prepared, and able to do their best work.
  • Catch problems before they become bigger ones. Notice when something doesn’t look right, investigate what’s happening, and help get it back on track.
  • Create capacity for the team. Take ownership of important recurring work so experienced teammates have more room to focus on analysis, planning, and what comes next.
  • Help us scale smarter. Turn what you learn from the day-to-day operation into clearer processes, better workflows, and thoughtful uses of automation and AI.

How You’ll Succeed Here

You don’t need to arrive knowing how Casper or test operations work. You do need to bring the habits and mindset that will help you learn the operation quickly and make it stronger over time.

  • You’re organised and dependable. You can keep track of moving pieces, manage recurring responsibilities, and follow through without things getting lost.
  • You notice what others might miss. A number looks wrong, information is missing, two systems don’t match, or a step hasn’t happened when it should. You stop and investigate rather than simply moving it along.
  • You like figuring things out. When something doesn’t go as expected, your instinct is to understand what happened, gather the right information, and work towards a solution.
  • You develop judgement, not just routines. You want to understand why a process works the way it does so you can make good decisions when the answer isn’t written in a checklist.
  • You have an improvement instinct. Repetitive or unnecessarily complicated work makes you curious. You look for ways to simplify, automate, document, or redesign it rather than assuming that’s just how it has to be.
  • You’re good with people. You communicate clearly, respond thoughtfully, and understand that strong operations are also about making it easier for other people to do their work well.
  • You learn and adapt quickly. You ask useful questions, apply what you learn, respond well to feedback, and become more independent as your knowledge grows.

Over time, success means becoming someone the team trusts not only to keep the operation moving, but to understand it well enough to help us make it better.

What You Might Bring

There’s no single background that prepares someone for this role. Experience with some of the following would give you useful foundations to build from:

  • Coordinating rosters, schedules, events, staffing, logistics, or other work with lots of moving pieces.
  • Working with spreadsheets, numbers, payments, invoices, or information that needs to be accurate.
  • Supporting customers, contractors, employees, students, or others who rely on you for clear information and follow-through.
  • Working across multiple systems or tools and keeping information organised between them.
  • Improving a recurring process, documenting a better way of doing something, or spotting unnecessary manual work.
  • Using AI as part of how you work. You’ve gone beyond experimenting and have used AI to solve real problems, organise or analyse information, automate repetitive work, or improve workflows. You can tell us what you tried, what worked, and where your own judgement still mattered.

Experience with workforce rostering, contractor operations, live events, test delivery, or higher education could be useful, but none of it is required.

How We Support You

Our Australian team members are employed through our Employer of Record, Deel, with access to Acuity benefits and programs alongside Australian employment entitlements.

Transparent compensation. The starting salary range is $60,000–$70,000 AUD, with final offers reflecting experience, scope, market alignment, and internal equity. A 12% employer superannuation contribution is provided through Deel.

Learning that grows with you. $3,000 AUD annually for professional and personal development.

Shared success. Eligibility to participate in Acuity Insights’ Employee Share Option Plan, with grants based on role and level.

Time to rest and reset. In addition to your annual leave entitlement, there’s flexibility to take additional time off when needed, plus monthly Acuity Days and a two-week company-wide closure each December.

Health and wellbeing. Access to private health insurance or an allowance to support mental health and wellbeing. Specific availability and terms will be confirmed during the offer and Deel onboarding process.

Remote-first work. Work remotely from Australia, with company-provided tools and hardware and up to $150 AUD per month towards a co-working space where needed.

A note on working across time zones

Acuity is a Canadian-founded, remote-first company, with many colleagues based in North America and Europe. Working across time zones is a regular part of this role, so you'll need flexibility to start earlier or finish later to collaborate with Canadian teammates and lead live tests. We'll be thoughtful about scheduling and balancing these needs with sustainable working hours.

What Happens After You Apply

We review every application and don’t use AI to evaluate candidates, though you may be automatically screened out if you don’t meet baseline requirements such as being based in Australia and having the right to work in Australia. AI may support note-taking in some interviews, but people make every evaluation and hiring decision.

Our interviews are two-way conversations: a chance for us to understand your experience and for you to get to know Acuity, the role, and the people you’d work with. The process typically takes 2–4 weeks from first conversation to final decision.

Steps in the Process

Application Review. A member of our Talent team reviews your application.

Intro Conversation. Explore your experience, what you’re looking for next, and learn more about Acuity and the opportunity.

Manager Conversation. Dig deeper into how you approach operational work, solve problems, use judgement, learn, and work with others.

Team Conversations. Meet members of Operations - Support and explore some of the situations you might encounter in the role.

Decision. We typically make a decision within 2–4 business days after final conversations.

Offer & Reference Checks. If it’s a match, we’ll move to references and a formal offer.

About Acuity Insights

Acuity Insights builds products that help higher education institutions make better decisions about people, from admissions through to development.

Our work is grounded in a simple idea: people are more than their grades, and potential can be understood and developed, not just measured. Our Casper situational judgment assessment has been completed by over 1 million applicants and is backed by nearly 20 years of research.

Today, we’re evolving our products to better connect assessment, insight, and development, helping institutions identify potential and support its growth over time.
