Shape what's next with BCD

Director, AI & Data Programs (Remote)

Full time, Netherlands, Spain, United Kingdom, United States

We are hiring a Director, AI & Data Programs to lead the company-wide rollout of our Databricks platform across Advito, BCD Travel's consulting group. We take corporate travel programs to the next level by analyzing travel data, building program strategies, identifying risks and opportunities, and assisting in supplier negotiations.

Our data platform runs on Databricks, and AI already ships in our products. We're now extending that platform across the whole company, so every practice works from the same data, tools and AI capabilities. This role leads that program, and it's a big one: it touches how every team at Advito works with data. You'll own the plan, the people side of the change, and the operating discipline that keeps a large portfolio of work on track.

You'll also be an operating partner to our Head of Product and our Product Owners. They set direction, work with clients on AI, and lead product development. Your job is to make sure the department runs well: priorities are clear, AI initiatives are well vetted and scoped, commitments are tracked, and nothing important slips through the cracks. This role needs a strong grounding in AI and data. Most decisions here have a technical side, and our engineers and data teams need to trust your judgment.

As a Director, AI & Data Programs, you will:

  • Own the company-wide program to make Databricks the standard platform for data, analytics and AI across Advito, including scope, roadmap, sequencing and timing
  • Set up and run the program with an integrated plan, risk and dependency tracking, and a regular steering meeting with executive sponsors
  • Run change management as its own workstream: stakeholder mapping, communications, training, and a plain explanation for each team of what changes for them
  • Track adoption with real measures, such as active users and time to insight, and adjust the plan when the numbers call for it
  • Maintain one view of every AI and data initiative in the department, with status, owners, dependencies, dates and budget
  • Run intake and prioritization so new ideas get a fair look and a quick yes, no or later
  • Know the work well enough to question it: read a prototype, push on an architecture choice, test a vendor claim
  • Help set standards for AI in production, covering accuracy testing, human review, monitoring, cost and Responsible AI
  • Own the operating rhythm of the Data & AI function, including planning cycles, objectives and executive reporting
  • Support budget tracking, business cases, and partner and vendor relationships alongside the Head of Product
  • Lead a small team of data, AI and analytics practitioners, with clear ownership and regular coaching
  • Report to executives and stakeholders clearly and honestly, including when something is behind

About you

Three things matter most:

  • You've led a company-wide platform program. You've run a large change across several business units or functions (a data platform migration, an enterprise analytics rollout) and you can show us how adoption went after go-live. Databricks experience is a strong plus.
  • You run a tight program. Planning, governance, risk management and follow-through come naturally to you. PMP, PgMP, Prosci or Lean Six Sigma Black Belt credentials are welcome, though your track record counts for more.
  • You know AI and data well. You've worked closely with AI, ML, agentic AI or LLM applications in production, you understand how data platforms and pipelines work, and you use AI tools in your own work.

Beyond those:

  • Several years leading enterprise-level programs with their own budget, multiple vendor partners and executive sponsors
  • Formal change management experience, with communication, training and champion programs you've measured the results of
  • Experience working with offshore or nearshore development partners
  • Experience managing people, including technical practitioners
  • Strong stakeholder management across a matrixed, global organization, including people who don't report to you
  • Bachelor's degree in a quantitative, technical or business field, or equivalent experience

Nice to have

  • Databricks certification, or hands-on experience with Unity Catalog and platform governance
  • Domain experience in corporate travel, T&E, procurement, payments or B2B spend data
  • Experience developing managers as well as individual contributors

About Advito

Advito is the consulting division of BCD Travel, specializing in transforming corporate travel programs. Employing an intelligence-driven framework, Advito dynamically manages supplier spend and traveler behavior, ensuring efficient travel programs that meet the needs of all stakeholders. Through smart analytics, unique supplier strategies, and integrated traveler engagement, Advito elevates travel programs to new heights of sustainability, savings, and satisfaction. Advito is a pioneering travel consultancy with an ISO-certified carbon reporting methodology, GATE4, and a dedicated practice area for driving sustainable business travel.

Why you’ll love working here
Join a global industry leader where curiosity drives innovation, growth is continuous, and every voice matters. At BCD, you'll have the freedom to make an impact, the support to develop your potential, and the opportunity to help shape the future of travel.

Meet BCD
BCD Travel creates connections that move people and ideas forward. Through open technology and trusted human expertise, we help companies and people navigate change, simplify complexity and make confident decisions about how and when they travel. Our intuitive digital experiences for every stakeholder power journeys that fuel success and drive progress. With 15,000+ dedicated team members serving clients in 170+ countries, BCD is shaping a more sustainable future for business travel. Industry-leading meetings and events management and a global consultancy complete our suite of solutions and services. In 2025, BCD achieved $24.4 billion in sales. For more information, visit .

Get to know us by exploring our career site and checking out our social media:

What’s in it for you

  • Flexible working hours and work-from-home or remote opportunities

  • Opportunities to grow your skillset and career

  • Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge

  • A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools

At BCD Travel, we value you—our culture and success are defined by our people. We carefully consider a wide range of objective, gender‑neutral compensation factors, including professional background, skills, experience, and role scope.

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionAbout AllCloudAllCloud is a leader in amplifying organizations’ cloud potential through AI.
jobs.description:
Description

About AllCloud

AllCloud is a leader in amplifying organizations’ cloud potential through AI. With a track record of hundreds of successful migrations and implementations across AWS and Salesforce, AllCloud has developed strategies and solutions that enable businesses of all sizes to remain at the forefront of innovation.

AllCloud is a leader in AI-led professional and managed services. As an AWS Premier and audited managed services Partner, and Salesforce Consulting partner, AllCloud provides comprehensive AI-led cloud journey support, from initial migration to ongoing management through our Engage Managed Services. Our expertise ensures that clients remain aligned with ecosystem best practices while focusing on their core business growth.

AllCloud serves clients across the globe with offices in EMEA and North America. www.allcloud.io

Job Summary

This is a customer-facing engineering role, and the customer-facing half is not optional or secondary. You will lead technical engagements directly: running recurring security reviews, presenting findings to both engineering teams and executive stakeholders, defending your recommendations, and driving remediation that the customer can realistically staff and fund.

You'll pair that with hands-on ownership of detective controls, guardrails, and incident response across the customer portfolio. You build the thing, and you explain the thing to the person paying for it.

You'll also be the technical authority behind our global SOC. They run the shifts; you make sure what they know is right.

Responsibilities

  • Own client technical relationships, lead executive/developer security reviews, build prioritized remediation roadmaps, and communicate hard architectural risks directly.
  • Deploy and tune AWS native tools (GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, Inspector, CloudTrail) and Wiz; manage telemetry flowing into Datadog.
  • Serve as the escalation authority for the SOC team, keeping playbooks updated and tuning detection logic to eliminate false positives.
  • Lead investigations (timeline, root cause, executive reporting) and develop reusable Python/boto3 scripts for enrichment and containment.
  • Architect security guardrails (SCPs, IAM, network policies) using Terraform or CDK; manage AWS LZA, Identity Center, and automated remediation pipelines.

﻿What's genuinely different about this role.

﻿We'd rather you hear this from us than discover it in a month or two.

  • Context switching is the job. You'll move between customer environments with different architectures, different maturity, and different definitions of "urgent."
  • You work through other people's accounts. Cross-account role design, delegated administration, and access boundaries are core skills here, not an afterthought. Getting access right for us is itself a security control we owe the customer.
  • You don't get to know one estate deeply. The compensating skill is pattern recognition: spotting the same misconfiguration across ten different architectures.
  • The customer is often the constraint. You'll regularly recommend something correct that the customer declines or defers. Learning to document that disagreement, and to keep advocating without becoming an obstacle, matters more here than in an in-house role.

Requirements

  • 5+ years in cloud engineering, with at least 2+ years dedicated to AWS security.
  • Proven track record leading technical reviews, delivering board/exec-ready reports, and advising external clients directly during high-pressure incidents.
  • Deep expertise in IAM evaluation logic, SCPs, permission boundaries, cross-account federation, and KMS key architectures.
  • Hands-on experience developing modular, scalable Terraform or CDK code.
  • Practical administration of AWS Organizations, Control Tower, or Landing Zone Accelerator (LZA).
  • Proficient in Python and boto3 for building production-grade, reusable security tooling and auto-remediations.
  • Working knowledge of mapping PCI DSS or HIPAA controls directly to AWS infrastructure.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with AWS LZA (customization repos/nested stacks), Wiz (or similar CNAPP/CSPM), and Datadog Cloud SIEM.
  • Prior background in an MSSP, security consultancy, or presales/solutions architecture.
  • Experience partnering with a 24/7 SOC to write actionable runbooks, escalation criteria, and tuning operational handoffs.
  • Building EventBridge-driven auto-remediation, custom Config rules, and blocking CI/CD security gates (SAST/SCA/secrets).
  • Hands-on network security architecture covering Transit Gateway segmentation, AWS Network Firewall, and VPC traffic inspection.
  • Experience mapping infrastructure controls to SOC 2, ISO 27001, NIST 800-53, or FedRAMP.
  • AWS Security Specialty or Solutions Architect Professional Certification

Why work for us?

Our team inspires progress in each other and in our customers through our relentless pursuit of excellence; you will work with leaders who promote learning and personal development. We offer competitive salaries, bonus incentives, benefits, flexible hours, and mentoring. Apply now to become part of the team.

About the company

Paid per approved task, about $35/hr equivalent. One flat rate for every approved task.

Built to fit around a clinical practice:

  • Tasks estimated at about 10–20 hrs/week while the project is active; you choose when and how much to contribute
  • Contribute anytime, from anywhere
  • No patient contact, no malpractice exposure: you review written clinical cases
  • All reviewers are license-verified physicians
  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved

Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based.

What this opportunity involves

We’re looking for actively practicing, US-licensed physicians (MD/DO) living outside the US, with an active, unrestricted US medical license, to evaluate clinical EHR vignettes for a medical AI evaluation project. General and internal medicine are the main focus. On this project, contributors may:

  • Evaluate clinical EHR vignettes paired with a question, a proposed answer, and a distractor “trap” answer across diagnosis and treatment tasks, spanning cardiovascular, nervous, hematologic, respiratory, digestive, urinary, reproductive, musculoskeletal, and integumentary systems;
  • Score the clinical reasoning quality of benchmark items: vignette accuracy and completeness, whether the vignette gives the answer away, answer correctness and gradeability, and trap quality;
  • Check whether the reasoning chain reaches the answer from vignette facts alone, correct reasoning traces, and write short rationales;
  • Work within three independent blind reads, followed by physician adjudication. Real clinical complexity only. You’re improving the AI tools you’ll eventually use yourself.

If you’re a practicing physician ready to take on this challenging and engaging project, apply to take part!

What we look for

This opportunity is a good fit for US-licensed physicians living outside the US who are looking for a flexible, time-limited project they can fit around clinical practice. Ideally, contributors will have:

  • Medical degree (MD or DO) and an active, unrestricted US medical license (verified at onboarding and re-checked monthly);
  • Board certification or completed residency training, with recent direct patient care (attending-level preferred);
  • Broad, multi-system diagnostic and treatment experience (internal, family, emergency, or hospital medicine);
  • Strong clinical reasoning: differential diagnosis, next-step management, and application of evidence-based guidelines;
  • Prior experience in medical AI evaluation, clinical content or exam-question review, or medical annotation/QA (a plus);
  • Strong written English (C1+).

This opportunity is not suitable for medical students, unlicensed medical graduates, non-physician clinicians (NPs, PAs, nurses, pharmacists), or non-clinical healthcare titles.

How it works

Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid ​

How to apply

Please submit your CV in English and indicate your level of English proficiency.

Project time expectations

You decide when and how much to contribute. For this project, tasks are estimated at around 10–20 hours per week during active phases. This is an estimate, not a minimum or a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. Tasks are submitted within the project timeline and need to meet the listed acceptance criteria to be approved.

Earnings

Earnings are per approved task, at a flat rate set to about $35/hr equivalent based on estimated task time. There are no tiers or speed adjustments to the base rate. QA and adjudication tasks are paid at a higher rate.

  • $50 one-time onboarding reward, paid once your first production task is approved.
  • Incentives: additional earnings for high-quality approved tasks. Terms are shared in the project guidelines.

About the role

Reporting to the Chief Actuary, this highly visible executive will provide strategic oversight of Symetra's enterprise actuarial infrastructure, including enterprise modeling, statutory valuation, experience studies, international reporting, and the Office of the Appointed Actuary. The role serves as a critical bridge between actuarial insight and enterprise decision-making, helping shape financial strategy, capital management, regulatory compliance, and long-term growth. This is an ideal role for an accomplished leader who excels at influencing strategy, developing high-performing teams, and modernizing actuarial capabilities through innovation, analytics, and technology.

Leading through senior actuarial leaders, you will provide strategic direction across:

  • Enterprise Modeling
  • Experience Studies
  • International Reporting including European Embedded Value and International Capital Standards
  • Office of the Appointed Actuary
  • Actuarial Governance

A key focus of this role is advancing next-generation actuarial capabilities through automation, modern data platforms, advanced analytics, and AI while enhancing the strategic value actuarial brings to enterprise decision-making.

What You will Do

Enterprise Strategy & Executive Partnership

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the Chief Actuary, CFO, and senior executives on financial performance, risk & capital management, and strategic decision-making.
  • Provide an enterprise perspective that connects actuarial insights to long-term value creation.
  • Support major strategic initiatives, including corporate transactions, capital strategy, and enterprise planning.
  • Build strong partnerships across Finance, Actuarial, Data & IT, offshore Bermuda team, Investments, Risk, and business divisions.

  • Serve as a key enterprise voice on actuarial implications affecting the balance sheet, capital position, earnings, and long-term financial performance.

Actuarial Transformation, Innovation & Modernization

  • Champion the modernization of enterprise actuarial capabilities and operating models.
  • Accelerate adoption of automation, advanced analytics, AI, and modern modeling technologies.
  • Drive scalable, enterprise-wide technology, data, and process solutions that improve efficiency, governance, and decision support.
  • Challenge existing paradigms and drive organizational change that improves how actuarial insights are developed, communicated, and applied across the enterprise.

Organizational Leadership & Talent Development

  • Establish clear priorities, accountability, and decision-making frameworks.
  • Strengthen succession planning and develop the next generation of actuarial leadership.
  • Promote collaboration and alignment across actuarial functions and enterprise stakeholders.

Enterprise Oversight & Governance

  • Support regulatory, rating agency, and parent company reporting obligations while maintaining appropriate actuarial independence and accountability.

“If you want to invest in yourself and build a career, this is a great place to work. If you don't want to put in the effort to learn the industry and become a student of the business (it takes real effort!), there are easier places to work.” - Cris H., VP Internal Sales

  • Flexible full-time or hybrid telecommuting arrangements

  • An experienced change agent who has led modernization, transformation, or large-scale organizational initiatives.
  • Passionate about leveraging technology, analytics, automation, and AI to drive business value.

jobs.title: Recruiter
jobs.excerpt: About the OpportunityGreat leaders don’t always apply.
jobs.description:
About the Opportunity
Great leaders don’t always apply. We’re looking for a recruiter who knows how to find them, start a conversation, and turn that connection into a successful hire.
Allstar Services is seeking a Recruiter to own proactive sourcing and full-cycle recruiting for leadership positions across our national family of residential roofing and exterior remodeling brands. Your primary focus will be hiring Sales Managers, Regional Operations Leaders, and General Managers who can build teams, improve performance, and support business growth.
In this role, you’ll research target companies, engage passive candidates, assess leadership accomplishments, and guide candidates through interviews, offers, and their start date. You’ll partner directly with hiring leaders and our centralized Talent Acquisition team to deliver qualified talent across multiple brands and markets.
This is an individual contributor role with ownership of assigned searches. Leadership recruiting will be your primary focus, with the flexibility to support other positions and recruiting priorities as business needs change.

What You’ll Do

Proactive Sourcing and Headhunting
  • Develop targeted sourcing strategies for sales leadership, regional operations, and general management searches.
  • Identify and engage passive candidates through LinkedIn, Boolean search, competitor research, industry networks, referrals, and direct outreach.
  • Research target companies and markets to identify leaders with relevant industry experience and demonstrated business results.
  • Create personalized outreach that connects each candidate’s background and career goals to the opportunity.
  • Use phone, email, and LinkedIn outreach with consistent follow-up to generate conversations and build relationships.
  • Maintain talent pipelines for current searches and anticipated leadership needs across our brands.
  • Protect confidentiality when managing sensitive searches and candidate information.
Full-Cycle Recruiting and Candidate Assessment
  • Own assigned searches from intake and sourcing through screening, interviews, offer discussions, acceptance, and start date.
  • Conduct thorough screening conversations to evaluate leadership scope, business accomplishments, team development, motivation, and compensation expectations.
  • Ask specific follow-up questions to understand what candidates personally owned, how they achieved results, and how their experience translates to the position.
  • Present qualified candidates with clear summaries of their accomplishments, interest, compensation alignment, and potential gaps.
  • Coordinate interviews and required assessments, including Culture Index, while keeping candidates informed and engaged.
  • Identify concerns early, discuss competing opportunities, and support offer negotiations within approved compensation parameters.
  • Maintain communication after offer acceptance to support a successful transition and start.
Hiring Manager Partnership
  • Partner with hiring leaders to define position requirements, business priorities, and the outcomes expected of each hire.
  • Establish clear search expectations, interview steps, and communication practices.
  • Provide regular updates on sourcing progress, candidate pipelines, market feedback, and obstacles.
  • Recommend adjustments when candidate availability, compensation, or search criteria affect results.
  • Follow up on interview feedback and hiring decisions to maintain momentum.
  • Help hiring managers assess candidates against consistent, job-related criteria.
Recruiting Operations and Team Collaboration
  • Maintain accurate candidate records, sourcing activity, interview feedback, and next steps in Pinpoint.
  • Use recruiting technology and automation effectively while maintaining thoughtful, personal candidate communication.
  • Monitor outreach response, qualified candidate pipelines, interview conversion, and hiring outcomes to improve search strategies.
  • Take ownership of commitments, communicate challenges promptly, and follow through without repeated reminders.
  • Work collaboratively with teammates and hiring leaders, share candidates and sourcing insights, and contribute to shared hiring goals.
  • Receive feedback professionally and apply it to improve performance.
  • Adapt to changing priorities and support additional roles, brands, or recruiting projects as business needs evolve.
  • Follow established recruiting processes and contribute practical ideas for improvement.

What You Bring

  • At least 2 years of recruiting experience that includes proactively sourcing and hiring management-level or leadership candidates.
  • Demonstrated success engaging passive candidates through direct outreach and managing them through interviews, offers, and closing.
  • Experience owning full-cycle searches and balancing multiple positions, hiring managers, and deadlines.
  • Strong sourcing and research skills using LinkedIn, Boolean search, competitor mapping, and professional networks.
  • The ability to evaluate candidates beyond their titles and resumes, with a focus on measurable accomplishments and relevant leadership experience.
  • Clear, persuasive written and verbal communication skills.
  • Sound judgment and discretion when handling confidential information.
  • Strong organization, attention to detail, and consistent follow-through.
  • The ability to work independently, remain accessible, and maintain productivity in a remote environment.
  • A collaborative approach, willingness to help, and openness to feedback and changing priorities.
  • Experience maintaining accurate pipelines and recruiting activity in an applicant tracking system.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Agency recruiting, direct placement, or executive search experience.
  • Experience recruiting for roofing, exterior remodeling, home services, construction, or related field-based businesses.
  • Experience hiring Sales Managers, Regional Operations Leaders, or General Managers.
  • Experience supporting multiple brands, locations, or a growing private equity-backed organization.
  • Familiarity with Pinpoint or a similar applicant tracking system.
What Success Looks Like
  • Proactive sourcing produces consistent conversations with qualified leadership candidates.
  • Hiring managers receive well-assessed candidates whose experience aligns with the role’s business needs.
  • Candidates receive timely communication and remain engaged throughout the hiring process.
  • Searches progress with clear next steps, consistent follow-up, and accurate pipeline information.
  • Recruiting strategies improve based on results and market feedback.
  • You contribute to team goals and adjust your support as organizational priorities change.

Why Join Allstar Services?

  • Direct business impact: Help hire the leaders responsible for building teams and improving performance across our brands.
  • Variety and ownership: Manage searches across different businesses, markets, and leadership functions.
  • Fully remote work: Contribute from a remote environment with clear expectations and accountability.
  • A collaborative team: Work alongside recruiting professionals who share resources, ideas, and responsibility for results.
  • An evolving recruiting function: Use modern recruiting tools and help strengthen how we identify, engage, and hire talent.
About Allstar Services
Allstar Services is a full-service provider of residential exterior replacement, repair, and maintenance services, including roofing, siding, windows, and gutters.
Our family of market-leading brands combines local expertise and customer relationships with shared resources and best practices that support growth. Our culture is rooted in supporting one another, serving customers with integrity, improving continuously, and embracing change.
If you enjoy finding talent, building relationships, and helping strong leaders see their next opportunity, we’d like to hear from you.
Allstar Services is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.excerpt: About Opendoor At Opendoor our mission is to tilt the world in favor of homeowners and those who aim to become one.
jobs.description:
About Opendoor

At Opendoor our mission is to tilt the world in favor of homeowners and those who aim to become one. Homeownership matters. It's how people build wealth, stability, and community. It's how families put down roots, how neighborhoods strengthen, how the future gets built. We're building the modern system of homeownership giving people the freedom to buy and sell on their own terms. We’ve built an end-to-end online experience that has already helped thousands of people and we’re just getting started.

What You’ll Need

  • Strong negotiation and communication skills — comfortable on the phone, able to explain complex terms simply, and skilled at advocating for your client while preserving relationships.
  • Proven ability to transact at high volume, stay organized, and hit deadlines in a fast-paced, metrics-driven environment.
  • High ownership mindset and comfort working cross-functionally to resolve issues (title, inspections, HOA, lender, internal ops, etc.).

About the Role

At Opendoor, we’re rebuilding how people buy and sell homes, with more certainty, more choice, and less friction in the most important financial decision of their lives. Opendoor 2.0 is about focus, execution, and delivering real value for homeowners and those striving to become homeowners.

Our Resale Listing Partners are licensed real estate professionals who serve as the single point of contact with buyer’s agents from offer through close on Opendoor-owned homes. They negotiate on behalf of our seller (Opendoor), coordinate with internal teams and title partners, and drive smooth, on-time closings while delivering a standout agent and buyer experience.

We’re building a remote Listing Partner team in Massachusetts for professionals with an active Massachusetts real estate license. As a Listing Partner, you’ll focus on learning our playbook, mastering our tools, and building strong negotiation and communication skills. You’ll be supported with training, clear processes, and coaching so you can ramp into handling a high volume of listings and contracts with confidence.

What You’ll Do

  • Own offer-to-close communications with buyer’s agents on assigned Opendoor listings, serving as their primary point of contact throughout the transaction.
  • Negotiate offers and terms (price, concessions, repairs, timelines) within Opendoor guidelines to balance conversion, margin, and customer experience.
  • Oversee transactions to close by deadline through coordinating with internal teams (pricing, homes/renovations, transaction coordinators, title/escrow, brokerage) and external partners to clear issues and keep files moving.
  • Manage repair negotiations by reviewing inspection reports, leveraging our internal tools and workflows, and presenting clear, data-backed counters to buyer’s agents.
  • Maintain high-quality documentation in our internal systems (offer details, counter terms, repair decisions, key milestones) so others can quickly understand the status of each file.
  • Monitor portfolio health for your assigned listings, paying special attention to long-DOM homes and higher-risk transactions, and escalating when additional support or strategy is needed.
  • Deliver excellent agent and buyer experiences through proactive communication, expectation setting, and timely follow-up via phone, email, and text.
  • Adopt and champion new tools and processes (e.g., negotiation models, automation, AI-powered workflows, TC support) designed to increase both your productivity and deal quality.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • Active real estate salesperson license in any state (or ability to obtain within a defined timeline prior to start date, subject to business needs and brokerage requirements).
  • Experience listing and/or selling homes.
  • Experience in residential real estate (e.g., listing agent, buyer’s agent, transaction coordinator, or similar client-facing role), or directly transferable experience in high-volume negotiations or transaction management.
  • Familiarity with MLS, transaction management platforms, and CRM tools.
  • Prior experience working in a centralized or inside sales environment (phone- and email-heavy).
  • Comfort using data and tooling (reports, dashboards, AI/automation) to inform decisions and prioritize your time.

How We Work

  • Schedule: Full-time, with flexibility needed for peak volume periods; weekend coverage is required.
  • Collaboration: You’ll work closely with other Listing Partners, Transaction Coordinators, Pricing, Homes, Title & Escrow, and Brokerage to create a seamless end-to-end experience.
  • Performance: We look at a balanced scorecard including conversion, fallthroughs, negotiation outcomes, title attach, pend-to-close time, and customer experience, with coaching and support to help you grow over time.

Why Join Opendoor

  • Opportunity to be part of an evolving resale team that is core to Opendoor’s strategy and growth.
  • Performance-based incentive pay aligned to outcomes you directly influence.
  • Training, tools, and coaching to help you advance to higher levels of impact and responsibility.
  • Benefits package including health coverage and other company programs (details provided during the interview process).

Closing Statement

About Opendoor
Founded in 2014, Opendoor’s mission is to power life’s progress one move at a time. We believe the traditional real estate process is broken and our goal is simple: build a digital, end-to-end customer experience that makes buying and selling a home simple and certain.

  • To learn how we are reinventing the real estate industry check out our website.
  • Hear about our culture directly from team members by visiting The Muse.
  • Discover what we are building for our customers by reading our blog.

Opendoor Values

Openness

We believe that being open about who we are and what we do allows us to be better.

Equal Opportunity
Individuals seeking employment at Opendoor are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or other protected status under all applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

We collect, use, and disclose applicant personal information as described in our personnel privacy policies. To learn more, you can find the policy details for California residents here and for Canada residents here.

Sr. Partner Marketing Manager

Remote – US

About Backblaze

Backblaze (NASDAQ: BLZE) is the high-performance capacity storage layer for AI. Founded in 2007, we scaled the business on less than $3 million in outside funding until our 2021 IPO on the Nasdaq. Today we manage over five billion gigabytes of data for 500K+ customers in 175+ countries, including AI platforms, GPU clouds, businesses, developers, IT professionals, and individuals.

About the Role

As a best of breed storage platform, a robust partner ecosystem is how Backblaze reaches the AI market: GPU clouds, AI infrastructure vendors, data and AI platforms, and the events where that ecosystem gathers.

You will serve our Partnerships & Ecosystem team, and report to the VP of Marketing. Product Marketing, Campaign leads, Content and Creative, Demand Generation, Communications, and Analyst Relations all back you up as you provide the bridge between corporate GTM efforts and our partner orgs GTM efforts. You work at a senior level and carry the work yourself, with strong collaboration and teams to support your efforts.

The job is to give partner marketing the same structure, standards, and ambition as everything else Marketing does, and to make every partnership worth more to Backblaze, to the partner, and to the customers we share.

What You’ll Do

Set the plan and the operating rhythm

  • Build and run a rolling six-month partner marketing plan with the Partner team with a focus on priority partnerships in the AI space
  • Structure the work in manner that keeps the teams aligned and informed with shared calendars, clear intake paths, and a point of view on what Backblaze will and won’t do
  • Fold partner marketing into Marketing’s broader planning so partner programs, launches, and campaigns move with brand, product marketing, and demand generation priorities
  • Stay agile and responsive as opportunities evolve and shift around you
  • Lead the reporting cadence on impact, in collaboration with the business intelligence team, at a level consumable from c-suite to team meetings

Translate our story for partners

  • Take Product Marketing’s core positioning and materials and adapt them for each partner’s sellers, architects, and customers: joint value propositions, partner-facing narratives, and co-branded messaging that stay true to how Backblaze talks about itself.
  • Equip priority partners’ teams to get Backblaze right, with kits, one-pagers, and sales plays built alongside Enablement and Partnerships

Build brand with the ecosystem

  • Raise Backblaze’s profile with the most credible names in AI through joint narratives, co-presented content, webinars, and thought leadership that establish Backblaze as a storage leader for AI
  • Coordinate announcements with Communications, including the disclosure requirements that come with being a public company
  • Working with the events team, advocate for Backblaze’s presence at AI-first events and moments where we can show up with strategic partners

Bridge marketing and enablement

  • Working with the content and creative team, build co-branded reference architectures, joint case studies and customer references, and informative announcements that help customers make decisions
  • Work with DevRel and Sales Engineering around content and enablement with technical depth, they can provide the substance but you’ll need to provide structure and promotion
  • Own how Backblaze appears on partner surfaces: integration and partner pages, directories, marketplace listings, co-branded assets, and Powered By Backblaze materials, and documentation. Keep them accurate, current, and consistent
  • Support analyst submissions for partner-validated architectures alongside our Analyst Relations team

The Right Fit

Required

  • 7–10 years in B2B technology marketing, including 4+ years in partner, alliance, or ecosystem marketing at an infrastructure, cloud, data, or AI company.
  • A record of launching and running co-marketing with partners larger than your own company, and of earning priority from a partner’s marketing team
  • Proven skill at translating core product positioning into partner-specific narratives, and the writing ability to draft them yourself. Bring samples
  • Technical fluency to work with Sales Engineers and partner architects: cloud and object storage, S3-compatible APIs, and how AI and data pipelines use storage (training data, checkpoints, inference)
  • Experience planning and executing a presence at major industry conferences, ideally in the AI ecosystem
  • Comfort reading pipeline and campaign data in Salesforce and dashboards that others build, and turning it into decisions
  • The discipline to work solo: set priorities, hold them, and use AI tools to multiply your output without lowering the bar

Strongly Preferred

  • Partner marketing experience at an AI cloud, AI infrastructure vendor, or data platform.
  • Experience with partner-hosted conferences and co-presented programming at GTC scale.
  • Public company experience, including work within disclosure requirements for partner announcements.
  • Experience standing up partner marketing in a function that did not have a home.
  • A background producing technical proof: reference architectures, benchmark-backed content, and customer references.

Logistics

  • Location: Remote – US
  • Travel: ~25%, concentrated around major AI events and partner meetings
  • Reports to: VP, Marketing
  • Partners with: Partnerships & Ecosystem, Product Marketing, Revenue Operations, Channel Marketing, Content and Creative, Demand Generation, Communications, Analyst Relations

Backblaze Perks

  • Healthcare for family, including dental and vision
  • Competitive compensation and 401K
  • RSU grants for full-time employees
  • ESPP program
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Maternity & paternity leave
  • MacBook Pro to use for work plus a generous stipend to personalize your workstation
  • Childcare bonus (human children only)
  • Fertility treatment and support
  • Learning & development program
  • Commuter benefits
  • Culture that supports a healthy work-life balance

Pay Transparency

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base pay ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar-stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors, including candidate location, skills, depth of work experience, and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

The base pay range for this position is $135,000 – $150,000

At Backblaze, we value being fair and good to our customers, partners, and employees. That’s why diversity, equity, and inclusion are at the core of our values. We are committed to fostering a workforce where all employees feel a sense of belonging regardless of race, ethnicity, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, religion, socio-economic status, ability, veteran status, and education. We believe that our dedication to cultivating a diverse workspace not only allows us to better serve our customers in over 175 countries, but further reinforces our commitment to doing the right thing. Join our collaborative team dedicated to solving complex problems with sustainable solutions while building your future as a leader. At Excella, you’re empowered to make lasting impact, turning today’s challenges into tomorrow’s mission successes.

  • Workplace locations look different for everyone. Excellians are a distributed workforce and whether you're working from your home office or a client site, we support a flexible work/life integration regardless of your location.
  • We offer top of industry medical, dental, and vision benefits with multiple options to choose from such as an employer-contributed health savings account, infertility coverage, and orthodontia so you can select the plan that works best for you.

Choose between a variety of Mac or PC devices, and to ensure your hardware remains current, at the end of a 3-year period Excella will replace your existing computer with a new model from the program. Plus, we’ll even give you the original device to keep for your personal use!
  • With Excella’s Annual Internet Reimbursement benefit, all employees receive an additional $25 per month to help offset the cost of internet access. This initiative reflects our commitment to supporting you in staying connected and productive, no matter where you work.

  • We encourage mindfulness and overall well-being through employee wellness events, a HeadSpace membership, as well as access to TalkSpace and mental health coverage through our medical plans.

Overview

We are looking for thought leaders in Agile, Product Management, and Business Analysis to join our team who are passionate about delivering innovative that meet real business needs. Our Agile Analysts thrive in collaborative, cross-functional teams—working closely with UX designers, developers, data specialists, and business stakeholders to shape and deliver features that align with the overall product strategy. We combine Agile methodologies with modern analysis techniques to define success, drive the product vision and strategy, and lead the creation and prioritization of feature roadmaps based on business value and user impact.

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with product leaders, designers, engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to shape product direction and deliver valuable solutions from concept to launch. 
  • Define and evolve a product vision and strategy rooted in user needs, business objectives, and data. 
  • Lead discovery efforts, apply analysis techniques related to user research, mapping, and modeling, and conduct feasibility assessments to explore and validate product ideas. 
  • Create and maintain a product roadmap that balances short-term delivery with long-term innovation; ensure transparency and alignment across teams. 
  • Prioritize product features and capabilities based on value, effort, dependencies, and user feedback. 
  • Translate ideas into clear, testable user stories and success criteria; support agile events and iterative delivery. 
  • Establish and track key product metrics to evaluate performance and guide continuous improvement. 
  • Act as a bridge between business and technology, ensuring shared understanding of goals and outcomes. 
  • Support adoption planning and coordinate product rollouts using change management principles in collaboration with partners across the business. 
  • Proactively identify risks, blockers, and cross-team dependencies; take ownership of resolution paths. 
  • Help shape and evolve good practices across the team—encouraging collaboration, user focus, and agility. 
  • Mentor team members, share knowledge, and promote a product-thinking mindset across the organization. 
  • Lead and conduct functional testing, user acceptance testing (UAT), 508 compliance testing, etc. 

Qualifications:

jobs.title: Clinical Trial Data Manager III - Office of Data Quality
jobs.excerpt: The Office of Data Quality (ODQ) provides research support to the Dana-Farber/Harvard Cancer Center with a focus on quality assurance, quality control, and process improvement.
jobs.description:
The Office of Data Quality (ODQ) provides research support to the Dana-Farber/Harvard Cancer Center with a focus on quality assurance, quality control, and process improvement. Functions of ODQ include protocol subject registration and randomization, clinical research auditing, data and safety monitoring, quality control of DF/HCC initiated clinical trial data, participation in general clinical trials education, and committee management.

The Clinical Trial Data Manager III (CTDM III) reports to the Director of ODQ. The Clinical Trial Data Manager III performs analytical and regulatory work directly related to DFHCC’s policies, reporting requirements and adherence to local, state, and federal regulations. This position is responsible for independent application of advanced knowledge in the area of clinical research, quality assurance, and data sciences to advance DFHCC’s mission. This role requires comprehension of research study design, and significant judgment in applying data standards and best practices to novel research constructs. In doing so, the Clinical Trial Data Manager III works closely with investigators, research teams, and biostatisticians to ensure the integrity and quality of clinical trial data.

This position's work location is fully remote, never on campus. The selected candidate may only work remotely from a New England state (ME, VT, NH, MA, CT

Located in Boston and the surrounding communities, Dana-Farber Cancer Institute is a leader in life changing breakthroughs in cancer research and patient care. We are united in our mission of conquering cancer, HIV/AIDS, and related diseases. We strive to create an inclusive, diverse, and equitable environment where we provide compassionate and comprehensive care to patients of all backgrounds, and design programs to promote public health particularly among high-risk and underserved populations. We conduct groundbreaking research that advances treatment, we educate tomorrow's physician/researchers, and we work with amazing partners, including other Harvard Medical School-affiliated hospitals.

PRIMARY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

The primary role of the Clinical Trial Data Manager III is to interpret DF/HCC policies, clinical trial protocols, clinical trial agreements, applicable regulations, GCP, and best practices in order to make decisions regarding the quality of clinical trial data and the appropriateness of data use and release. The Clinical Trial Data Manager III must independently determine whether data is sufficiently complete and accurate, and a request for data release for the defined business use is appropriate per policies, regulations, and best practices. The Clinical Trial Data Manager III has the authority to expedite or delay the release of clinical trial data accordingly.

Project Support/Management:

  • Ensures clinical trial data collected throughout the conduct of a protocol are complete and accurate. Monitors the timely submission and completeness of clinical trial data entry, perform edit checks on the data, issue and resolve data queries, and perform other quality control and data cleanup tasks.
  • Appropriately triages and prioritizes assigned Data Requests. Manages assigned tasks to meet deadlines.
  • Using InForm EDC, reviews data captured on electronic case report forms to verify completion per protocol requirements.
  • Reviews program-generated queries and responses, reissues queries as appropriate, and closes queries upon resolution.
  • Ensure coding of Adverse events meets both study and regulatory requirements.
  • Generates query reports for distribution to study teams.
  • For all types of data requests, performs logical edit checks on the data and reviews trends in the data to identify potential errors. Manually issues queries in response.
  • Collaborates with the study monitors to determine appropriate validation process for each data field. Tracks monitors’ review, source verification, and query resolution.
  • Prepares and extracts data sets from the database and transfer to the study statisticians and appropriate staff to aid in analysis.
  • Performs other related quality control tasks to identify discrepancies and violations. Reports findings to investigators or ODQ leadership as appropriate.

Quality Assurance:

  • Monitors completeness and timeliness of clinical trial data entry.
  • Generates missing data reports for distribution to research teams.
  • Reviews missing data reports for significant non-compliance and notifies investigators or ODQ leadership as appropriate.
  • Generates data reports for review by DF/HCC oversight committees (e.g., DSMB, DSMC).
  • Determines when and whether data is of acceptable quality for release in response to a data request.

Customer Service:

  • Acts as a resource for investigators and study teams for items related to clinical trial data
  • Communicates directly with investigators and research teams regarding discrepancies and data entry processes. Monitors shared mailbox and is responsible for ensuring timely responses to all inquiries.
  • Provides superior customer service when handling research team requests and responding to questions.
  • Guides research teams and investigators by encouraging best practices and assisting in the education of study team members on protocol-specific data entry requirements.
  • Coordinates with research teams to prepare data for analysis and/or study completion.

Database Management:

  • Verifies the accuracy and completeness of information within various systems that support clinical trial operations.
  • Reviews critical data fields in the OnCore Clinical Trials Management System to ensure accuracy and consistency with institutional and departmental policies.
  • Performs quality control activities on data present in various systems to identify errors or discrepancies.
  • Generates reports from various systems for comparison and to aid in the conduct of quality control processes.

In fulfilling the above duties, the Clinical Trial Data Manager III will interpret DF/HCC policies, applicable regulations, GCP, and best practices in order to evaluate the quality of clinical trial data and make decisions regarding data release. The Clinical Trial Data Manager III has independent decision-making authority to determine whether data is sufficiently complete and accurate for the requested business use and may expedite or delay the release of clinical trial data accordingly.

The Clinical Trial Data Manager III will act as lead data manager for a large and complex data request that requires collaboration among multiple CTDMs. This involves coordinating communication and data review assignments with members of the team and tracking completion towards deadlines. The Clinical Trial Data Manager III will support updates to internal policies and work instructions, and training and mentorship of new team members and junior staff. The Clinical Trial Data Manager III will represent ODQ in meetings with other departments, investigators, and research teams.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES REQUIRED:

  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with written and verbal English.
  • Complex problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently.
  • Knowledge of clinical trial regulations and procedures, data management processes and database-related technical skills.
  • Ability to performing more advanced quality control processes.
  • Strong understanding of data management processes and is able to resolve complex issues and questions independently.
  • Able to provide input on overall data quality planning, procedures, and systems with an eye towards consistent improvement.
  • Able to handle some projects independently, and work with CTDMs and/or the Manager of CTDM on larger projects.
  • Ability to perform larger and more complex projects independently.
  • Demonstrates significant database management expertise, a strong understanding of internal procedures and the relationship between connected systems and databases (e.g.InForm, OnCore, Epic, BOE, COE)
  • Assist Manager of CTDM in allocating and prioritizing workloads for multiple projects, as needed
  • Mentor and train CTDMs in query management and other CDM related activities
  • Able to provide input on and assist the Manager of CTDM in drafting and revising departmental work instructions.
  • Able to generate high-level reports and lead projects to completion.

MINIMUM JOB QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific specialty or other relevant major preferred, or equivalent work experience. Master’s degree (MPH, Biostatistics, Social Sciences, or other relevant fields) preferred.
  • 3 years of relevant clinical research experience, including data collection, maintenance or monitoring.
  • A strong understanding of regulatory requirements and best practices related to the conduct of human subject research (e.g., FDA regulations, ICH GCP) is required.
  • Experience with electronic data capture systems and electronic case report forms (InForm preferred).
  • Exceptional knowledge and/or experience in research methods, database design and programming are preferred.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES: None


PATIENT CONTACT: None

At Dana-Farber Cancer Institute, we work every day to create an innovative, caring, and inclusive environment where every patient, family, and staff member feels they belong. As relentless as we are in our mission to reduce the burden of cancer for all, we are committed to having faculty and staff who offer multifaceted experiences. Cancer knows no boundaries and when it comes to hiring the most dedicated and compassionate professionals, neither do we. If working in this kind of organization inspires you, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.description:
About Us:

  • PROVE Partners, LLC, founded in 2003 and based in Las Vegas, Nevada, and Denver, Colorado, is a patient-centric complex claims administration and healthcare finance company that provides innovative services and financial products to injury victims, medical providers, and law firms in the United States.
  • PROVE is primarily engaged in a fast-growing form of specialty reimbursement commonly referred to as medical lien funding, which enables victims of third-party liability accidents (e.g., motor vehicle collisions) to access healthcare at their greatest time of need.
  • PROVE is more than a medical lien funder—we offer patients a full suite of financial products, including co-pay and deductible finance and pre-settlement loans, providers with comprehensive revenue cycle solutions, including outsourced complex claims administration, and attorneys with patient concierge services and technology solutions to manage caseloads, reduce overhead, and most importantly, maximize the outcome for their clients.
  • PROVE maintains a fortress balance sheet, supported by a group of institutional capital partners that manage more than $16 billion in assets under management.
Mission: We help injury victims in their greatest time of need.

Core Values: PROVE Partners wants to make an IMPACT on the lives of the patients we help, the clients we work with, and the team we treasure.

I = Innovate Daily

M = More…with Less

P = Pursue Growth and Learning

A = Accountability

C = Communication

T = Teamwork

Job Summary:

PROVE Partners is engaging an experienced Senior Accounting and Finance Consultant (remote) to support accounting operations, financial reporting, treasury functions, and internal control processes in a fast-paced, globally distributed business environment.

This hands-on Senior Accounting Manager or Controller level consultant will support day-to-day accounting operations, financial close processes, cash reporting activities, budgeting support, reconciliations, and cross-functional coordination with operational and finance stakeholders.

The ideal candidate will possess strong experience in accounting and finance within healthcare finance, professional services, specialty finance, receivables management, or similarly structured operational environments. Candidates should be comfortable operating independently within fast-paced organizations with evolving processes, cross-functional collaboration requirements, and high levels of accountability.

Key Responsibilities:

Accounting & Financial Close

  • Support and coordinate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close processes, including journal entries, accruals, account reconciliations, and review of supporting schedules.
  • Maintain the general ledger and ensure accurate classification of all transactions.
  • Support accounting operations related to accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, commissions, and fixed assets.
  • Ensure payroll, commissions, accounts payable, and required debt payments are processed accurately and in a timely manner.
  • Maintain a unified chart of accounts across all business units and legal entities.
  • Review and approve balance sheet reconciliations and ensure tight reconciliation between operational systems and the general ledger.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and deliver periodic financial reporting packages, operational analyses, and reporting summaries for finance leadership and key business stakeholders.
  • Prepare weekly expenditure analyses, 13-week cash flow scorecards, KPI reporting, and variance analyses.
  • Support annual budgeting and forecasting processes and report significant variances to management.
  • Develop and maintain frameworks for accrual accounting, revenue recognition, and allowance for credit losses.
  • Analyze portfolio performance, cash collections, funding activity, and operational trends across PROVE’s healthcare finance and litigation finance products.

Treasury, Controls & Compliance

  • Support treasury-related operations, including monitoring cash balances, funding activity, reconciliations, and cash forecasting.
  • Monitor financial obligations, reporting requirements, and compliance-related financial activities.
  • Develop, document, and improve internal controls, accounting policies, and finance procedures.
  • Ensure compliance with U.S. GAAP, internal policies, and all applicable federal, state, and local reporting requirements.
  • Coordinate with external auditors, tax advisors, lenders, and other third-party partners during audits, quarterly reviews, and reporting cycles.

Systems & Process Improvement

  • Lead or support implementation and optimization of ERP, accounting, and reporting systems, including NetSuite, QuickBooks, Tableau, Power BI, or similar tools.
  • Partner with operations, servicing, and settlements teams to improve data flow, financial visibility, and process efficiency.
  • Identify opportunities to automate manual processes, improve reporting accuracy, and build a scalable finance infrastructure.
  • Support strategic initiatives, special projects, acquisitions, and process improvement efforts.

Leadership

  • Oversee and support global accounting contractors and finance support personnel, including onboarding, workflow coordination, training support, quality review, and operational guidance.
  • Serve as a primary finance lead for day-to-day accounting operations and cross-functional coordination within a remote-first contractor environment.
  • Promote accountability, collaboration, communication, and operational excellence across distributed teams and cross-functional workflows.
  • Collaborate with finance leadership and operational stakeholders to support financial visibility, reporting accuracy, and strategic initiatives.
Job Qualifications:
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field required.
  • CPA or CPA-equivalent certification strongly preferred; public accounting experience highly preferred.
  • 7–10+ years of progressive accounting and finance experience, including at least 3 years in a Controller or accounting leadership role.
  • Experience in specialty finance, healthcare finance, lending, receivables, or financial services strongly preferred.
  • Strong technical accounting knowledge, including U.S. GAAP or equivalent international accounting standards, financial reporting, and internal controls.
  • Experience leading month-end close, preparing financial statements, and managing external audits.
  • Advanced Excel skills required, including pivot tables, lookups, index-match, and financial modeling.
  • Experience with QuickBooks, NetSuite, or other ERP/accounting systems.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, remote-first, globally distributed contractor environment with strong attention to detail and accountability.
Ideal Candidate Profile:
  • Detail-Oriented: Ensures accuracy in all financial information.
  • Strong Technical Accountant: Understands U.S. GAAP and complex accounting flows.
  • Analytical Thinker: Able to interpret financial results and identify key drivers.
  • Process-Oriented: Seeks opportunities to improve workflows and controls.
  • Collaborative: Communicates effectively with distributed cross-functional teams across multiple countries and time zones.
  • Growth Mindset: Eager to learn and contribute in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment.

Remote | United States | Project-Based Independent Contractor

Compensation: $20-$50 USD/hour, based on specialty, experience, and project requirements

Help Shape the Future of AI in Pharmaceutical

What if your expertise in pharmaceutical quality systems, GMP compliance, and quality oversight could help artificial intelligence better understand quality management practices and regulatory expectations?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting experienced pharmaceutical quality professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We're seeking Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance professionals who can apply their expertise in quality systems, compliance, investigations, and GMP operations to evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content.

This isn't a traditional position. You won't be preparing submissions, managing product registrations, or interacting with health authorities. Instead, you'll evaluate complex regulatory content, identify technical inaccuracies, assess regulatory reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

Your pharmaceutical expertise is what matters. AI experience is a plus, not a requirement.


Important Note: This is a freelance, task-based role designed for those seeking supplemental income. It’s essential to understand the nature of freelance work—tasks will be assigned as they become available, and work may be irregular or intermittent.

The Opportunity

As a Pharmaceutical Quality Assurance Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, and reasoning of AI-generated pharmaceutical and biotechnology content.

You'll analyze scientific, regulatory, manufacturing, and compliance-related scenarios, identify errors or unsupported conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in industry standards, regulatory frameworks, and professional judgment.

Your contributions will help improve how AI systems understand and respond to complex pharmaceutical and biotechnology challenges.

What You'll Do

  • Evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content: Assess scientific, technical, and regulatory responses for accuracy, completeness, consistency, and compliance with industry standards.
  • Review scientific and regulatory information: Examine content related to quality systems, manufacturing, validation, submissions, development, and compliance activities.
  • Analyze technical reasoning: Determine whether AI-generated conclusions are supported by relevant scientific principles, regulatory expectations, and industry best practices.
  • Identify errors and inconsistencies: Recognize unsupported claims, technical inaccuracies, missing context, and flawed reasoning.
  • Validate information: Reference relevant FDA requirements, GMP regulations, ICH guidelines, and accepted pharmaceutical industry practices.
  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend technically accurate corrections.

About Accenture

Accenture helps the world's leading enterprises reinvent by building their digital core and unleashing the power of AI to create value at speed for organizations across industries. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI, and to be the most client-focused, AI-enabled, great place to work in the world. We bring together the talent of our approximately 814,000 people with proprietary assets and platforms, deep process and industry expertise, and leading ecosystem relationships to deliver end-to-end solutions and measurable outcomes at scale. Through our Reinvention Services, we offer broad expertise across Cybersecurity, Digital Core, Finance, Industry and Enterprise, Song, Supply Chain and Engineering, and Talent, with advanced capabilities in AI and Data, Industry and Process, and Technology. We serve approximately 9,000 clients and generated approximately $74 billion in FY26 revenue. Visit us at accenture.com.


You Are:

Accenture Products & Platforms for HR, Talent and Skilling (APP HTS) is a dedicated software business within Accenture, specializing in complementary applications for SAP environments. With a focus on enhancing SAP ERP Human Capital Management, SAP SuccessFactors, and SAP Plant Maintenance, APP HTS develops, sells, supports, and maintains innovative add-on solutions that extend core SAP capabilities.While our 150 specialists in software development, product management, support and testing help HR and Plant Maintenance teams to make the transition to working more efficiently and effectively, raising productivity, and driving better business outcomes.

For nearly two decades, APP HTS has been driving digital transformation and operational excellence across global enterprises. Today, more than 1,900 customers in over 48 countries rely on APP HTS to improve how SAP users work and live—empowering HR, talent, and skilling functions with intelligent, scalable tools.


To learn more about the Accenture Products & Platforms for HR, Talent and Skilling practice, please visit our site.


The Role


As a Level 7 Software Sales Manager, you drive growth for an assigned software product or portfolio. You engage prospects and clients consultatively, manage the full sales cycle, position differentiated software capabilities, and help clients achieve measurable business outcomes. You work across product, technical, marketing, and leadership teams to build pipeline, advance opportunities, and close complex software deals.


The Work:

Client Engagement & Prospecting

  • Initiate cold calls to prospective customers and schedule qualified appointments.
  • Assess prospects based on sales strategy, budget alignment, and decision-making authority.
  • Present products and services through tailored demonstrations to qualified leads.
  • Manage the full sales cycle from initial outreach to deal closure, ensuring process adherence.

Presentation & Representation

  • Deliver compelling product demos and adapt sales collateral to audience needs.
  • Conduct live and web-based presentations, supported by technical pre-sales resources.
  • Represent ASW professionally at trade shows, conferences, and customer events.
  • Travel occasionally for client demos and industry engagements.

Sales Operations & CRM

  • Document all sales activities in Accenture’s CRM system with accuracy and consistency.
  • Prepare for and actively participate in business development status meetings.
  • Collaborate with management to refine and enhance sales presentations and messaging.
  • Construct and deliver customer presentations, quotes, RFIs, and RFPs.

Market Awareness & Product Knowledge

  • Stay informed on evolving market trends, technologies, and competitive offerings.
  • Participate in educational sessions on product updates and development roadmaps.
  • Help clients maximize the value of software features through consultative engagement.

Performance & Negotiation

  • Meet or exceed productivity metrics as defined by the management team.
  • Negotiate pricing and commercial terms to close deals effectively.

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 25% to 50% depending on business need and client requirements.

Here’s What You Need:

  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in software sales; proven track record of exceeding sales metrics.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience selling to SAP customers, functional and technical experience in SAP Plant Maintenance (SAP PM) or SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM)
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience designing/executing go-to-market strategies and campaigns.
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience demonstrated success in closing complex, high-value sales opportunities.
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)

Bonus Points If:

  • You have external client-facing consulting experience

Professional Experience:

  • Proven ability to develop and maintain relationships with customers.
  • Strong persuasive communication and presentation abilities.
  • Advanced negotiation skills to navigate complex financial and operational requirements.
  • Self-driven, tenacious, and resilient, with a positive outlook.

In addition to base pay, this Sales role is eligible for additional incentive compensation under the Sales Achievement Bonus Plan which is based on achievement toward individual sales targets, subject to Plan terms

Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors, which may include but are not limited to the specific office location, role, skill set, and level of experience.
