This role is responsible for protecting the systems, data, and infrastructure that power Rezilient’s CloudClinic model, with a particular focus on safeguarding protected health information (PHI) and personally identifiable information (PII) across our cloud platform, clinical environments, and corporate systems.

You will design, build, and operate the technical security controls that keep Rezilient secure, from cloud and application security to identity and access management, endpoint protection, detection, and incident response. Working closely with Engineering, Product, IT, Clinical Operations, and our Security & Compliance team, you will embed security into how we build and run our platform, and provide the technical evidence and expertise that support frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA/HITECH, and HITRUST.

This is a senior IC role for an engineer who can move comfortably between architecture and execution. The ideal candidate brings deep technical expertise, sound judgment, and the ability to translate security needs into practical solutions that enable a fast-moving healthcare technology company to grow safely.

Key Responsibilities

Cloud & Infrastructure Security

  • Design, implement, and maintain security controls across Rezilient’s cloud infrastructure, including network security, encryption, secrets management, logging, and configuration hardening.
  • Build and manage security guardrails using infrastructure as code, cloud-native security tools, and automated policy enforcement.
  • Continuously assess cloud environments for misconfigurations, excessive permissions, and exposure risks, and drive remediation with Engineering.
  • Ensure PHI and PII are protected at rest and in transit, with appropriate data classification, access restrictions, and retention controls.

Application & Product Security

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to embed security into the software development lifecycle, from design through release.
  • Lead threat modeling and security design reviews for new features, integrations, infrastructure, and architecture decisions.
  • Own application security tooling and processes, including static and dynamic analysis, dependency and container scanning, and secure code review.
  • Establish secure development standards and coach engineers on secure coding practices and common vulnerability classes.
  • Assess the security of third-party integrations, APIs, and EHR and partner data exchanges that handle patient data.

Identity, Access & Endpoint Security

  • Partner with IT to design and enforce identity and access management controls, including SSO, MFA, role-based access, least privilege, and access reviews.

Detection, Response & Vulnerability Management

  • Build and tune security monitoring, logging, and alerting to detect suspicious activity across cloud, application, identity, and endpoint layers.
  • Serve as a technical lead during security incidents, coordinating investigation, containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident review.
  • Develop and maintain incident response runbooks and lead tabletop exercises with cross-functional teams.
  • Own the vulnerability management program, including scanning, prioritization, remediation tracking, and coordination of penetration tests.
  • Monitor the threat landscape relevant to healthcare and cloud environments and proactively adapt defenses.

Security Governance & Compliance Support

  • Produce evidence for technical controls for SOC 2, HIPAA/HITECH, HITRUST, and related frameworks.
  • Support audits, risk assessments, and remediation efforts with technical expertise, documentation, and control testing.
  • Contribute to security policies, standards, and procedures, ensuring they are technically sound and practical to operate.

Technical Leadership & Security Culture

  • Act as a trusted security advisor to Engineering, Product, IT, and leadership, translating technical risk into clear business impact and recommendations.
  • Automate security processes and reduce manual work through scripting, tooling, and integration.
  • Contribute to security awareness efforts with practical, role-specific guidance for engineers and staff.
  • Help shape the long-term information security roadmap and mentor team members as the security function grows.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years of experience in information security, security engineering, or a closely related technical role, ideally in healthcare, digital health, or SaaS/cloud environments.
  • Deep hands-on experience securing AWS cloud environments, including IAM, networking, encryption, logging, and cloud-native security services.
  • Strong background in application security, including threat modeling, secure code review, and security testing tools within CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with identity and access management, endpoint security, and security monitoring or SIEM tools.
  • Proven experience leading or supporting incident response and vulnerability management programs.
  • Working knowledge of security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, HIPAA/HITECH, HITRUST, ISO 27001/27002, or NIST CSF, and experience providing technical evidence for audits.
  • Proficiency in scripting or programming (e.g., Python, Go, or Bash) and experience with infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform).
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain technical risks to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Comfort operating as a senior individual contributor in a fast-moving startup environment with broad ownership.
  • Experience protecting PHI or other regulated data is strongly preferred.
  • Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, GIAC (e.g., GCIH, GCLD, GWAPT), or cloud security certifications are a plus.

Benefits

At Rezilient Health, we're on a mission to make humane healthcare truly abundant, and we invest in the people who make that possible. This is a high-impact role where your ideas directly shape how care is delivered, within a supportive, collaborative, and diverse team that believes healthcare is fundamentally a human experience. We back that commitment with a robust total rewards package:

  • Meaningful ownership through stock options, allowing you to share directly in the value you help create as we grow
  • Competitive base compensation
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage options, with Rezilient contributing toward your premiums
  • Complimentary access to Rezilient's clinical programs for you and your household members, the same connected care we deliver to our patients
  • 401(k) retirement plan to support your long-term financial well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off, so you can recharge without counting days
  • Dedicated Paid Sick Leave, separate from your FTO, for when health needs come first
  • 11 paid company holidays each year
  • Paid family leave to support you through life's biggest moments
  • Optional ancillary benefits, including life insurance, disability coverage, and a Health Savings Account (HSA)

jobs.description:
We are hiring for two roles. Apply for the role that matches your experience.
  • Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor: £35,000. Reports to the Senior Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor.
  • Senior Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor: £40,000. Reports to the Operational Compliance Manager.
Location: Fully remote
Hours: 39 hours per week, Monday to Friday. Flexible hours contract.

Our Mission

At Mojo Mortgages, we’re on a mission to become the largest and most disruptive mortgage broker in the UK. We’re a fast-moving, ever-evolving fintech. We’ll get there by transforming the mortgage journey so everyone can approach it with confidence. Change is constant here, and so is our drive to work smarter, think bigger and raise the bar.
Quality assurance is central to that mission. By holding our advice to the highest standards, we build lasting trust with our customers. We make sure our advice is always clear, accurate and in their best interest. This is a place for people who embrace challenge, hold themselves to a high standard and use technology to do their work better. We celebrate those who bring passion, accountability and fresh ideas.
At the heart of everything we do are our behaviours: care personally, challenge directly, put people first, keep exploring, love what you do, and always be accountable. If that sounds like you, we want you on the journey with us.

The Roles

Both roles assess mortgage advice and listen to calls. The Senior role does that and also leads the team.
Every individual case assessment is made by an assessor using their own judgement. You will work in a small, dedicated team where your eye for detail and analytical skills are central to the integrity of our mortgage advice. Your assessments give us confidence that customers receive clear, accurate advice. Your insight helps us keep raising the standard.

Key Responsibilities

What Both Roles Do
  • Assess advice. Assess mortgage advice against our internal standards, the FCA Consumer Duty and the Conduct Rules, meeting the T&C Scheme sampling requirements. Listen to calls as part of every assessment.
  • Own your output. Complete your agreed monthly volume to the quality and turnaround standards set by the Operational Compliance Manager. Flag risks early.
  • Give clear feedback. Record every outcome with specific, evidence-based feedback that Mortgage Experts and Sales Managers can act on without re-listening or re-working the case.
  • Stand behind your decisions. Apply the scoring criteria consistently. Explain your reasoning in calibration and defend your decisions on appeal.
  • Drive improvement. Escalate compliance risks promptly, find the root causes, and highlight routine checks that could be automated.

How the Two Roles Differ

Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor (£35,000)
  • No line management. You focus on your own assessments.
  • Review ID&V referrals. Review Smartsearch referrals, decide what additional verification checks are needed, and escalate any PEP or sanctions list matches to Risk & Compliance.
Senior Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor (£40,000)
  • Line manage four QA assessors. Set objectives, track the team’s output against the monthly requirement, and raise people concerns with the Operational Compliance Manager and HR.
  • Spend about 70% of your time assessing, including the most complex and highest-risk cases.
  • Lead calibration and coach assessors. Make clear, defensible scoring decisions. Coach through feedback, side-by-side reviews and “check the checker” assessments.
  • Manage the appeals process. Appeals are decided by someone other than the original assessor, so the Operational Compliance Manager or another senior assessor decides any appeal against your own assessments.
  • Produce monthly MI. Analyse failure trends and recommend action.
  • Set the risk-based case selection approach. Prioritise high-risk cases and cover all advice areas in line with the T&C framework.
  • Support T&C oversight. Help the Operational Compliance Manager maintain the Adviser Competence framework and RAG status records, and advise where our QA framework needs to change.
  • Be the voice of QA. Represent QA with Operations, Sales and Risk & Compliance, and help shape tooling, process and the T&C Scheme.

Who We’re Looking For

You embody our behaviours. You are meticulous, self-driven and confident in your own judgement. You give direct feedback that builds trust between QA, Mortgage Experts and Sales Managers, and you work at pace without letting accuracy slip. For the Senior role, you are also a fair, supportive line manager who brings others with you.

Qualifications (both roles)
  • CeMAP 1, 2 & 3 or equivalent.
  • Hold, or be able to obtain, the competence status needed to assess advice and sign off assessments under our T&C Scheme.
Experience
  • Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor: A minimum of 2 years’ experience as a QA assessor in financial services, ideally in mortgage advice, with a track record of meeting volume and quality expectations.
  • Senior Customer Outcomes & Advice Quality Assessor: We would expect 3+ years as a QA assessor or QA lead in UK mortgage advice, or equivalent experience gained at Mojo. This must include line managing a team, leading calibration, handling appeals and coaching others.
Skills (both roles)
  • Sound knowledge of FCA mortgage advice requirements, with the confidence to explain and defend scoring decisions on complex cases.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy under pressure.
  • Experience of, or appetite to learn, AI and automated tools, with the judgement to test their outputs.
  • Comfortable with change.
  • Intermediate proficiency in Google Sheets, Docs and Slides.
Additional skills (Senior role)
  • Expert FCA knowledge, including T&C, high-risk cases, vulnerable customers and conduct breach investigations.
  • Strong analytical skills and the credibility to influence stakeholders at all levels of seniority.

Benefits

  • Remote working
  • Basic Salary of up to £40k
  • Work from anywhere in the world for up to 22 days per year
  • 25 days holiday plus bank holidays (up to 28 days with length of service)
  • Pension via Aviva (Pension match up to 5%)
  • Sick pay and sick pay insurance
  • Wellness programme from Able Futures
  • Critical Illness cover & Subsidised private medical insurance
  • Death in service Policy
  • Enhanced Maternity, primary adoption & Enhanced paternity & secondary adoption pay
  • Compassionate leave
  • Long service awards up to £5000

jobs.title: Digital Product Designer
jobs.excerpt: About Ajaia Ajaia is an AI implementation consultancy and product studio.
jobs.description:
About Ajaia
Ajaia is an AI implementation consultancy and product studio. We help organizations move from AI experimentation to measurable return on investment across four practices: AI Strategy and Advisory, Workforce Training and Enablement, Process Optimization, and Custom AI Development. Our work sits with executives and the people who do the actual work, and it is judged on whether something changed in production, not on whether a pilot looked good in a deck.

Position Overview
Ajaia is hiring a Digital Product Designer to run discovery and design on client engagements and on Ajaia’s own product suite. You will talk to the people who actually do the work, watch what they do rather than only what they say, and turn that into journeys, wireframes, and prototypes an engineer can build from. You will test the design against real users before a line of production code is written, and you will hold the standard for how everything Ajaia ships looks and behaves.

This is a hands-on seat: you do the research and the design yourself, rather than handing off between the two.

This is a fully remote role. Discovery, user testing, and collaboration with clients and engineers all happen online.

Compensation: $10,000 to $14,000 base, depending on experience, plus a performance bonus of up to 100% of base salary.

How we expect you to work
AI use is a core execution requirement at Ajaia, not optional tooling. You will use AI tools daily to move from interview notes to synthesis, from synthesis to wireframe, and from wireframe to something clickable. You are judged on what you keep from that process, not on how much of it AI produced.

Staying current with new design and prototyping tools is part of the job, and so is knowing when a shortcut needs your hand back on it before a user ever sees it.

What you will do

  • Run discovery on client engagements: interview the people doing the work, watch them do it over screen-share, and find the gap between what they say and what they actually do.
  • Talk to users of Ajaia’s own products the same way. The product suite is not exempt from the same rigor client work gets.
  • Synthesize findings into what people actually need, stated separately from what they asked for, with the evidence for each.
  • Design the solution: user journeys, wireframes, and prototypes that an engineer can build from without guessing.
  • Decide where a human has to sign off inside a workflow, and design that checkpoint into the product rather than bolting it on afterward.
  • Test designs with real users before code exists, not after.
  • Push back on a stakeholder’s feature list when the evidence points somewhere else, and explain why in terms they can act on.
  • Own the design standard across Ajaia’s product suite so a designer joining engagement three does not have to reinvent decisions made on engagement one.
  • Prototype with AI tools as a default, not a novelty. Know when the AI-native path saves real time and when it produces something you have to rebuild by hand anyway.
  • Hand off design work in a state an engineer can actually start from, and stay involved enough during the build to catch it when implementation drifts from the intent.

Requirements

  • Runs discovery yourself: interviews, usability testing, and reading behavioral data.
  • Moves from synthesis to a working prototype fast.
  • Designs the human checkpoints into a workflow rather than bolting them on later.
  • Comfortable holding your ground when the evidence points somewhere a stakeholder does not expect.
  • AI fluent: uses AI daily to research, synthesize, and prototype, and can tell good output from slop.
  • Comfortable working directly alongside engineers through build.
  • No minimum years required. We hire on the work.
  • Fully remote, and comfortable running interviews and user testing over video.
  • A bachelor’s degree is preferred and is not a requirement.

Nice to have

  • A public portfolio or case studies we can look at before we meet.
  • Experience designing AI-native workflows, including where a human checkpoint belongs.
  • Consulting, agency, or professional services experience with concurrent clients.
  • Comfort with lightweight front-end implementation.

Benefits

Competitive benefits.

You've Never Been Satisfied with "Good Enough."

You didn't get into this to manage one piece of a project. You got into it to change how the world gets built.

At Accenture Construct, that's the job. You'll help deliver the data centers, power grids, rail networks, factories and public infrastructure that keep communities moving — smarter, safer and more sustainably.

Because “good enough” builds the past. You're here to build what's next.
Visit us here to learn more about ​Accenture Construct
As Accenture continues to grow, you may see a variety of new career opportunities, and depending on the role and location you may be directed to apply through Accenture LLP or one of our other legal entities - Accenture Construct LLC or Accenture Construct Inc., with benefits varying by country and role, so please check with your recruiter for details.

BONUS POINTS IF YOU HAVE:

  • Work that outlasts you. People will use what you build for forty years without knowing your name. That's the point.
  • Recognition that means something in this industry. Accenture Construct is ranked #6 globally in ENR's 2026 Top 50 Program Management Firms and #4 in Building Design + Construction's Top 80 Construction Management Firms for 2026.

ABOUT ACCENTURE CONSTRUCT

  • Accenture Construct is Accenture's global capital projects business.
  • The data centers behind AI. The grid behind the energy transition. The rail, water and airports everything else runs on.
  • We plan them, engineer them, deliver them and hand them over — and unlike most of this market, we're on the hook for whether they land on time. More than 5,000 practitioners across the Americas, EMEA and APAC. One team that owns the whole thing.

jobs.description:
This role is part of our Central M&A Team at saas.group.

What is saas.group?

Think of us as the driving catalyst behind your favorite software success stories. saas.group, established in 2017, is on a mission to turbocharge promising B2B SaaS ventures, unlocking their full potential. As a Software-as-a-Service portfolio powerhouse, we specialize in acquiring small software treasures and polishing them into industry stars. With a dynamic, fully remote team of nearly 380+ colleagues spanning 50+ countries we are truly global and we are rewriting the playbook on SaaS innovation and collaboration. We grow 25 exciting brands under our umbrella.Feel free to explore our Candidate's Hub to get an insider's view, dive into our culture, gain valuable insights into our teams and how we work.

Also, don’t forget to follow saas.group on LinkedIn to stay up-to-date on our job openings, podcast episodes, and with all things happening at our company.

Profile Overview

Our Investment Team deploys $50M+ of capital a year into niche, bootstrapped PLG software companies across North America and Western Europe. These are capital-efficient, founder-built businesses that most funds overlook because they are too small, too founder-owned or too unconventional. We see the opportunity, and we operate what we buy.

We're hiring an Associate Director, Investments to sit in the principal seat. You'll report to our Head of M&A, work alongside an existing Associate Director and have significant exposure to our C-suite. As deal captain, you qualify the opportunity, make the first offer, build the investment case, set the price, negotiate with the founder, run diligence and take the deal to close. You won't be building pitch books or playing a supporting role, and you won't wait years to lead a deal of your own. Your judgement decides where our capital goes.

If you bring the commercial diligence skills or deal instincts of a lower mid-market PE or M&A team, and you want to own outcomes rather than advise on them, this is your role. You'll work directly with founders, our C-suite and the operators who scale the businesses you buy.

Your impact in the first 6-12 months will be:

  • Own early-stage qualification: take new opportunities from first call to a non-binding offer quickly, kill weak ones early and turn the strongest into IC-ready investment cases.
  • Earn the trust of founders, our C-suite and the operating teams who will run the businesses you buy.
  • Step in as deal captain on your first live transactions and drive them from LOI to signed SPA.

Your responsibilities

  • Capital allocation: Underwrite every deal you lead. Form a clear view on value, risk and returns, write the investment memo and defend your recommendation in front of our Investment Committee.
  • Qualification and offers: Qualify new opportunities fast, kill weak ones early and issue non-binding offers on the ones worth pursuing. You set the price and structure that frame the deal all the way to LOI.
  • Deal captaincy: Own the process end to end, from first call and non-binding offer through LOI, diligence and SPA to closing. You set the timeline, run the workstreams and own the outcome.
  • Commercial due diligence: Lead our in-house CDD. Size the market, map the competition, define the right to win and get to the truth on quality of revenue: retention, concentration, pricing power and the durability of growth.
  • Financial and commercial modelling: Build models from a blank sheet: ARR bridges, cohort and retention analysis, unit economics, scenarios, valuation and returns.
  • Negotiation: Lead negotiations with founders and their advisors on price, structure and key terms, landing deals that work for the seller and for our returns.
  • Diligence leadership: Run the full DD process across internal experts (finance, tech, product, marketing, legal, people) and external legal, financial and tax advisors, and turn their findings into decisions.
  • Stakeholder leadership: Represent saas.group to sellers, brokers and advisors, and work hand in hand with our C-suite, leadership and the operators who take over after closing.
  • Coaching: Develop the junior members of the team as a hands-on player-coach.

What You bring to the table

  • 6+ years of professional experience after university, with a strong track record in transactions, strategy or both.
  • Training at a top-tier firm or team in one or more of:
    • Private equity: lower mid-market transactions, typically sub-$10M EBITDA, ideally in software or tech-enabled services.
    • Strategy consulting: MBB (McKinsey, BCG, Bain) or leading strategy firms such as Roland Berger, Oliver Wyman, Kearney, L.E.K. Consulting, OC&C, Simon-Kucher or Arthur D. Little.
    • Big Four strategy and deals: Strategy& (PwC), EY-Parthenon, Deloitte (Monitor Deloitte / M&A) or KPMG Deal Advisory, especially in commercial due diligence.
    • Corporate development / in-house M&A: ideally at a high-velocity aggregator or buy-and-build strategic.
    • Investment banking: M&A advisory at mid-market or tech-focused boutique banks, ideally on lower mid-market transactions with enterprise values below $50M.
  • An investor's mindset: you think like an owner, form a point of view quickly and back it with numbers.
  • Live deal experience: you know what it takes to get a deal over the line, and ideally you've led workstreams or been the day-to-day deal lead.
  • Excellent financial modelling and valuation skills: you build from a blank sheet and can defend every assumption.
  • A player-coach approach: you have experience developing junior talent and enjoy doing it.
  • Real commercial due diligence experience: market sizing, competitive analysis, customer and expert interviews, and quality-of-revenue work.
  • Presence: you can negotiate with founders selling their life's work and hold your ground with the C-suite and advisors.
  • Rigorous project management: you keep multiple parties, timelines and documents moving without dropping the ball.
  • A genuine interest in software and SaaS business models. A software background is an advantage but not a requirement.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken; additional European languages are a plus.
  • Real AI fluency and the drive to put it to work: you already use AI tools (Claude especially) day to day and look for ways they can speed up research, analysis, modelling and diligence workflows.

What’s in it for You

  • Principal seat, real ownership: You'll lead deals and allocate capital as a principal, not an advisor, then watch the companies you bought grow inside our portfolio.
  • Deal flow and exposure: $50M+ deployed every year across two continents, with direct access to our C-suite and Investment Committee from day one.
  • Ultimate flexibility: We’re 100% remote. You can work from wherever you like, whenever you like.
  • Freedom and autonomy: We’re a high-trust team, and you’ll be given lots of flexibility to solve problems in your own way — with plenty of help from the team when you need it.
  • Minimum bureaucracy: We don’t like to get bogged down with meetings and red tape. We like to be efficient and keep momentum steady & sustainable.
  • Small & friendly team: We help each other out, have fun, and joke around.
  • Our network: We are a community of entrepreneurial SaaS professionals that regularly exchange ideas, knowledge, learning and expertise with each other internally.
  • Flexible time off: We want you to recharge your batteries when needed.

We don’t just simply offer you to “take a job with us” but rather to “join us on this journey” to build the world's largest platform of independent SaaS companies.

Sounds like something you’re up for? Feel free to apply even if you don’t check all these boxes. We believe in the power of diversity and fresh perspectives to spice up our team. Your application might just be the missing ingredient!

jobs.excerpt: About T-InnovaT-Innova has built the software that runs sports centers, gyms and clubs in Spain since 1993, from its base in Castelldefels, Barcelona.
jobs.description:
About T-Innova

T-Innova has built the software that runs sports centers, gyms and clubs in Spain since 1993, from its base in Castelldefels, Barcelona. Deporwin and DeporSite handle memberships, bookings and activities, payments and billing, reception point of sale and the access control at the door for around 300 clients, from single facilities to chains of dozens of centers. T-Innova is part of the Manos Group within Valsoft, a Canadian group that acquires and grows vertical-market software companies, which gives it the backing of a larger group while it runs as a focused, independent product company.

After more than 30 years in this market, T-Innova is building its next product: a new cloud platform, designed agentic-first from day one. The groundwork is done. The existing system has been mapped into a documented catalog of thousands of use cases, and the scope of the first release has been agreed across the company. The new product is built fresh from that catalog. The hard part is the bridge: many clients run customized on-premise installations of today's system, and every one of them has to keep running well until it moves across. We're growing the engineering team to do both.

The role

This is a developer role for someone early in their career who already builds software with AI coding agents and wants to do it on a real product with real clients. You'll help build T-Innova's new product and help keep the current platform running for the clubs that depend on it today, working closely with the Tech Lead and the rest of the team.

What you'll do

  • Build features of the new cloud product with AI coding agents, from a written specification through to tested, reviewed code.
  • Investigate and fix issues on the current platform, using agents to read and explain legacy code in Visual Basic 6, .NET Framework, PHP and SQL Server before you change it.
  • Write and maintain automated tests, and help keep the CI pipeline green.
  • Keep the documentation and the use-case catalog current as the product changes.
  • Take part in code review in both directions, and share what you learn about working with agents with the rest of the team.

What we're looking for

  • At least three years of professional development experience, or a strong graduate or self-taught profile with substantial projects behind it.
  • You already use AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot agents as your main way of building software, and you can show work you built that way and explain how you checked it.
  • Solid fundamentals: data structures, SQL, HTTP and APIs, version control, and writing tests.
  • Curiosity about how existing systems work, and the patience to understand old code before changing it.

• Clear written and spoken English.

Nice to have

• Spanish.

  • Any exposure to .NET, PHP or Visual Basic.
  • Experience building an LLM feature, an agent or an MCP server.
  • Exposure to a cloud platform (Azure, AWS or GCP) or a CI/CD pipeline.
  • An interest in sports, fitness or club management, or experience with booking and membership systems.

How we work

We hire for agentic development first and a tech stack second. AI coding agents do most of the typing, and engineers do the thinking: writing the specification, breaking the work into tasks an agent can carry out, reviewing every change, and proving it works with tests before it ships. The product itself uses agentic AI to take routine work off our clients' hands.

The team sets its own working method. The Manos Group supplies the shared architecture, an engineering standard for product AI and a shared framework for agentic user experiences, so T-Innova builds on what works across the group rather than starting alone.

Why T-Innova

Your work will reach real users quickly, on a product that sports facilities across Spain rely on every day. You'll learn agentic development on production software alongside people who do it daily, with the backing of the Manos Group and Valsoft.

The essentials

Location: Remote, working European time zones (a working day that overlaps Central European Time). Occasional travel to the Castelldefels office near Barcelona.

Language: Fluent English is required. Spanish is a plus: colleagues and clients are Spanish-speaking.

Reports to: Tech Lead, T-Innova.

Employment: Full time.

How to apply

Apply through Workable with your CV and, if you can, one example of work you built agentically: the specification you wrote, how you steered the agent, and how you proved the result. A repository, a write-up or a short screen recording all work. Shortlisted candidates do a practical session building a small feature with an AI coding agent, with a senior engineer alongside you.

SDET Engineer - Remote

Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SDET Engineer
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000–$165,000 Annually
Experience Required: 12+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary:
We are seeking an experienced SDET Engineer to bring strong software engineering practices to the discipline of test automation. In this role you will design, build, and continuously improve automation frameworks, write production-quality test code, and partner with development teams to embed quality engineering throughout the SDLC. The ideal candidate will combine strong programming skills with deep knowledge of testing strategy, including unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, and security testing in modern distributed systems. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design and build robust, scalable test automation frameworks for web, API, mobile, and microservice testing.
  • Write production-quality automated test code in Java, Python, JavaScript, or C# using frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, RestAssured, or Pact.
  • Implement contract testing using Pact or similar tools to validate service contracts in microservice ecosystems.
  • Build comprehensive CI/CD test pipelines integrated with Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
  • Develop performance test suites using JMeter, Gatling, k6, or Locust, including realistic load models and result analysis.
  • Implement security testing fundamentals including dependency scanning, SAST, DAST, and OWASP-based checks.
  • Lead test strategy discussions, including risk-based testing, exploratory testing, and shift-left practices.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and architects to identify quality risks early.
  • Perform root-cause analysis of production incidents, and translate findings into automated regression tests.
  • Drive continuous improvement of test coverage, test reliability, and time-to-feedback.
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and uphold engineering rigor in the testing community.
  • Maintain comprehensive test documentation, traceability, and reporting dashboards, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Contribute to internal testing tools and reusable libraries, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.

Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • 12 or more years of experience as an SDET or in test-focused software engineering roles.
  • Strong programming skills in at least one of Java, Python, JavaScript, or C#.
  • Hands-on experience with at least one major UI automation framework (Selenium, Cypress, Playwright).
  • Solid experience automating REST and/or gRPC APIs.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines for test automation.
  • Solid SQL skills and experience with database validation.
  • Strong understanding of microservices, distributed systems, and modern web architectures.
  • Excellent debugging, communication, and documentation skills.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.

How to Apply

jobs.excerpt: DescriptionCompany OverviewSundaySky is a category-defining SaaS platform that enables enterprises and upper mid-market organizations to deliver highly personalized video experiences at scale across the entire customer lifecycle.
jobs.description:
Description

Company Overview

SundaySky is a category-defining SaaS platform that enables enterprises and upper mid-market organizations to deliver highly personalized video experiences at scale across the entire customer lifecycle. Built for modern, data-driven teams, the platform empowers marketers, CX leaders and field organizations to transform complex data into dynamic, relevant video communications that deepen engagement, improve the customer experience, increase conversion, and strengthen long-term relationships. Founded in Tel Aviv in 2007, SundaySky serves some of the world’s most recognized banking, financial services, and insurance firms. As the pioneer of AI-powered video personalization, SundaySky reimagines how enterprises communicate. Moving beyond static, one-size-fits-all content to intelligent, adaptive video experiences. The platform combines generative AI, real-time rendering, and an intuitive creation workflow to make personalized video fast, scalable, and measurable. By unifying creation, personalization, distribution, and optimization in a single system, SundaySky enables teams to deliver emotionally resonant experiences that drive outcomes, turning video into a core growth and engagement engine rather than a costly, slow-moving production exercise.

Investment History

In July 2022, SundaySky completed a $100 million investment from the private equity firm Clearhaven Partners, providing capital for growth and innovation. This investment completes the transition of the business from a managed services company to a SaaS company, enabling the next stage of growth. Clearhaven is a Boston-based private equity firm focused exclusively on software and technology investments. Founded in 2019 by an investor-operator team with over 50 years of combined experience, Clearhaven was purpose-built to partner with differentiated, growth-stage software companies. The firm invests thematically in high-quality B2B software businesses, supporting management teams seeking an operationally focused partner to drive transformational growth.

The Opportunity

SundaySky is positioned in an incredible market for personalized, enterprise video. The company represents an extremely attractive opportunity in a fast-growing market:

  • Compelling financial profile
  • $25M+ revenue
  • 20%+ SaaS bookings growth in 2025 vs. 2024
  • EBITDA positive
  • 80 FTE globally
  • Significant market opportunity
  • TAM for Enterprise Video Content Management
  • $48B+ TAM with a growing CAGR of 13% by 2030
  • 65% of businesses use videos for customer service, 61% of companies use videos for employee communications
  • Opportunity to activate moments that matter during the customer lifecycle through personalized video to drive real business outcomes
  • Strong Customer Base
  • Blue chip customer base in banking, financial services and insurance
  • Leading banks and financial service firms such as Bank of America, Schwab, Morgan Stanley, T. Rowe Price, Ascensus, Broadview and Bread Financial
  • Health, commercial and property insurance firms including Chubb, Zurich America, Progressive, Liberty, Aetna, UnitedHealth Care, Anthem, Emblem, Kaiser Permanente, and Florida Blue

About the Role

We are seeking a Principal Engineer to provide hands-on technical leadership across SundaySky's product and platform. This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who can turn ambiguous business and product goals into durable architecture, lead the most complex cross-platform initiatives, and materially improve how the engineering organization designs and delivers software. The ideal candidate combines deep full-stack and distributed-systems expertise with pragmatic judgment, strong product thinking, and the ability to influence through technical credibility. This person will remain close to the code while setting direction across video creation, personalization, rendering, data, AI, distribution, and the shared platform capabilities that support them.

Responsibilities

  • Define and evolve the technical architecture for SundaySky's multi-tenant SaaS platform across frontend applications, backend services, data systems, media pipelines, integrations, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Lead the technical strategy and design for the company's highest-risk, most ambiguous, and most cross-cutting product and platform initiatives.
  • Translate business strategy, product requirements, and customer needs into scalable technical capabilities, sequenced investments, and executable implementation plans.
  • Serve as a hands-on technical leader by prototyping critical paths, contributing production code, reviewing high-impact changes, and resolving the hardest engineering problems.
  • Establish clear architectural principles, service boundaries, integration patterns, data contracts, and decision records that enable teams to move quickly without creating unnecessary complexity.
  • Drive modernization of established platform components while preserving business continuity and the delivery of new customer value.
  • Identify and address systemic risks involving scalability, performance, reliability, availability, security, privacy, operability, and maintainability.
  • Guide the architecture of video creation, real-time and batch rendering, personalization, animation, media processing, asset management, analytics, and distribution capabilities.
  • Shape the responsible use of generative AI, large language models, synthetic media, and AI-assisted engineering tools across the product and development lifecycle.
  • Partner with Product and UX to evaluate solution options, expose constraints early, and balance customer value, delivery speed, platform leverage, and long-term technical health.
  • Partner with Engineering leadership, DevOps, QA, and Security to improve system design, delivery practices, production readiness, and operational resilience.
  • Lead technical discovery, architecture reviews, design reviews, and cross-team alignment for major initiatives.
  • Create leverage through shared frameworks, reusable components, platform services, automation, developer tooling, and well-defined engineering standards.
  • Raise the quality of technical decision-making through rigorous code reviews, design feedback, mentoring, pairing, and clear written communication.
  • Coach senior and mid-level engineers, develop emerging technical leaders, and help teams independently make sound architectural decisions.
  • Improve observability, capacity planning, incident response, root-cause analysis, and the elimination of recurring production issues.
  • Evaluate new technologies and external platforms through focused experimentation, evidence-based tradeoffs, and clear adoption recommendations.
  • Communicate technical strategy, architectural decisions, risks, and tradeoffs effectively to both engineering and non-technical stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Approximately 12 or more years of professional software development experience, including significant technical leadership in production SaaS environments.
  • A sustained record of designing, building, and operating complex, business-critical software platforms at scale.
  • Expert full-stack engineering capability, with deep experience in modern JavaScript and TypeScript and strong proficiency in at least one backend technology such as Node.js, Python, Java, or C#.
  • Advanced experience with modern frontend architecture, preferably React, including component systems, state management, performance, accessibility, browser behavior, and complex workflow-oriented applications.
  • Deep expertise in distributed systems, service architecture, APIs, asynchronous workflows, event-driven patterns, background processing, and failure handling.
  • Strong experience with relational and non-relational data architecture, schema design, data integrity, migration strategies, and performance optimization.
  • Experience designing enterprise integrations involving third-party APIs, identity providers, data platforms, webhooks, file exchange, and event-based interfaces.
  • Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture, preferably AWS, including containers, serverless services, networking, storage, compute, deployment patterns, and cost management.
  • Experience establishing CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code, automated testing, observability, and production-operability practices for distributed applications.
  • Strong knowledge of application and platform security, authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, secrets management, data protection, privacy, and secure software development.
  • Experience designing for scalability, resilience, high availability, graceful degradation, disaster recovery, and measurable service-level objectives.
  • Demonstrated ability to modernize a mature platform incrementally while continuing to deliver product capabilities and protect customer commitments.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead architecture and implementation across multiple teams without relying on formal reporting authority.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical decisions, tradeoffs, and risks to varied audiences.

﻿Preferred Technical Experience

  • Experience with video, audio, media processing, creative tooling, animation, rendering, transcoding, or digital asset management.
  • Experience with browser-based motion graphics using React, JavaScript, CSS animations, Canvas, WebGL, WebAssembly, or related technologies.
  • Experience with generative AI, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, prompt orchestration, or AI-generated media.
  • Experience architecting configurable enterprise platforms and internal developer platforms with reusable services, fine-grained permissions, approval workflows, auditability, and governance controls.
  • Experience with high-throughput job orchestration, message queues, event buses, streaming systems, or distributed rendering workloads.
  • Experience with enterprise data connectivity, CRM or customer-data platforms, personalized content systems, or customers in regulated industries such as banking, financial services, and insurance.
  • Experience with AWS or another major cloud provider.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with automated browser testing frameworks.
  • Experience with event-driven systems, background jobs, message queues, or asynchronous processing.
  • Experience integrating third-party applications or services.
  • Experience working on a multi-tenant SaaS platform.
  • Experience in an Agile or iterative product-development environment.

Principal-Level Expectations

A successful Principal Engineer should be able to:

  • Set coherent technical direction across multiple products, teams, and planning horizons.
  • Personally solve the highest-leverage technical problems while enabling others to execute the broader solution.
  • Convert ambiguous strategic goals into clear architecture, technical milestones, ownership boundaries, and delivery paths.
  • Make consequential technical decisions with incomplete information and clearly articulate the assumptions and tradeoffs involved.
  • Recognize systemic risks and architectural constraints before they become delivery or production failures.
  • Create durable organizational leverage through platforms, standards, tools, documentation, and stronger technical leaders.
  • Build alignment across teams, resolve technical disagreements constructively, and influence decisions through evidence and credibility.
  • Balance immediate business needs with scalability, reliability, security, maintainability, and long-term platform evolution.
  • Raise engineering quality and delivery confidence without becoming a bottleneck or centralizing every decision.
  • Demonstrate accountability for the health, evolution, and business impact of the platform as a whole.

Compensation & Benefits

Base salary: $225,000-$250,000 annually

Additional compensation and benefits include an annual bonus, equity, 401(k), medical, dental, and vision insurance, short-term disability coverage, and paid parental leave.

SundaySky is an equal-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Different makes us better.

Bruker is enabling scientists and engineers to make breakthrough post-genomic discoveries and develop new applications that improve the quality of human life. Bruker’s high performance scientific instruments and high value analytical and diagnostic solutions enable scientists to explore life and materials at molecular, cellular, and microscopic levels. jobs.description:
At TixTrack, we support our clients by creating superior ticketing solutions for performing arts and cultural institutions through a combination of modern technology, beautifully simple design, and the art of listening.

Headquartered in the heart of the Broadway Theatre District, NYC, we are a small, but growing team of hardworking, highly motivated individuals. With a presence across both the US and UK, and trusted by key players on Broadway and the West End, we are passionate about our work and driven to innovate with our customers to solve current and future challenges with new solutions.

Our core product, Nliven, is a real-time platform that helps venues manage ticket sales efficiently while creating a more engaging buying experience for customers. We are transforming our engineering culture to align with an Empowered Teams model, embracing Continuous Delivery and focusing on building capabilities to drive higher quality, reliability, and speed.

Even with a highly dispersed, largely remote workforce, we stay connected through our Slack channels, virtual events and regional meetups. Come see how we “role”.

About The Role

We're looking for a full stack Software Engineer to help build and improve the nLiven platform, working in both the frontend and backend. You'll write code across .NET Core and modern JavaScript frameworks like React and Vue, extending and improving our existing systems with tests as part of every change.

We're hiring at two levels, and the scope of the role grows with your experience. Early-career engineers will start with well-defined tasks and bug fixes, learning our codebase and practices while senior engineers pair with them, review their code, and help them grow. Engineers with solid full stack experience will own well-scoped features from start to finish, with guidance from senior engineers when the path isn't clear.

You'll report to an Engineering Manager and work closely with a team that invests in its engineers. We'll determine the right level based on your experience and the interview process, so if you're not sure where you land, apply anyway.

This position is full-time and fully remote. Candidates must be located in California, Oregon, Colorado, Texas, Tennessee, Utah, Wisconsin, Minnesota, Louisiana, Florida, Virginia, North Carolina, South Carolina, New Jersey, New York, or Connecticut. Candidates may be required to travel and/or meet up in-person from time to time. There may also be an expectation in the future for hybrid work in a local office.

About You

  • You're curious about how things work and eager to keep growing, whether that means picking up a new language, learning an unfamiliar part of the codebase, or taking on a bigger piece of work.

  • You take pride in quality. You write tests, make small and safe changes, and try to leave code better than you found it.

  • You communicate clearly and ask questions early. When you're stuck, you say so, and when you make a technical decision, you can explain why.

  • You value feedback and collaboration, whether it's a code review, a pairing session, or working with Product and Design to understand the problem behind the work.

What You'll Do

  • Build features and fix bugs across the stack, from well-defined tasks to features you own from design through production, working closely with Product Managers, Designers, and other engineers.

  • Write clean, readable, maintainable code, with automated tests as part of every change.

  • Work confidently in existing codebases: read before you change, follow established patterns, and make small, safe changes that get reviewed early.

  • Understand the customer problem behind your work by partnering with Product and Design.

  • Participate in code reviews by acting on feedback, asking questions to learn, and giving clear, constructive feedback to others.

  • Follow the team's coding standards and best practices, and suggest improvements where you see them.

  • Investigate and fix bugs and performance issues, pulling in senior engineers when a problem needs a wider view.

  • Build with security in mind, including input validation, authorization checks, and error handling.

  • Add logging, monitoring, and tests to the features you build, and use what they show to improve them.

  • Pair and mob regularly with teammates to build skills, share context, and help newer engineers get up to speed.

  • Update technical documentation, such as API contracts and design notes, when your work changes how something behaves.

  • Contribute to architectural discussions, bringing perspective from the code you work in day to day.

  • Point out friction in tooling, docs, CI/CD workflows, or team processes, and help fix it.

  • Take part in production support and incident reviews alongside experienced teammates.

Other Duties

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for the job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

What You'll Bring

Minimum Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Professional software development experience:

    • Level 1: Up to two years. Internships, co-ops, and substantial personal or open source projects count.

As a Senior Enterprise Account Executive, you will be responsible for executing a strategic sales plan within your assigned territory, focusing on revenue growth and new customer acquisition. At Allergan Aesthetics, an AbbVie company, we develop, manufacture, and market a portfolio of leading aesthetics brands and products. Our goal is to consistently provide our customers with innovation, education, exceptional service, and a commitment to excellence, all with a personal touch. For more information, visit Follow Allergan Aesthetics on LinkedIn.


Job Description

The Manager, Cloud Engineering, will continuously collaborate with key stakeholders across the business to solve critical technical problems for Allergan Aesthetics. You will be a hands-on leader of the foundational engineering team driving our system/service reliability, scale, and developer productivity. In this dual-focus leadership role, you will bridge the gap between keeping our production environment highly resilient and ensuring our internal software developers have friction-free, high-speed tools and pipelines. You will lead a talented team of engineers who build scalable infrastructure, standardize developer tooling, reduce toil, and foster a culture of operational excellence across the entire engineering organization.

People & Team Leadership:

  • Manage, lead, hire, develop and mentor a team of Platform Engineers to deliver high-quality infrastructure and developer solutions that are secure, resilient, and scalable.
  • Foster a collaborative and inclusive team culture, encouraging knowledge sharing and continuous learning.
  • Create and recommend professional learning paths for direct reports
  • Conceptualize and execute technical approaches for emerging systems and architecture.
  • Implement, through the team, the high bar of quality and standards for production reliability and the developer experience
  • Act as the key point of contact between your team and other stakeholders and partner teams

Site Reliability & Platform Engineering:

  • Lead the adoption and maturation of SRE practices across the organization, partnering with service owners to improve production reliability.
  • Define and champion SLO/SLI frameworks and error budget-based decision making to drive prioritization between reliability and feature work.
  • Lead the strategy for internal developer platform capabilities — influence self-service infrastructure, developer tooling, and deployment patterns that improve velocity and reduce toil for product teams.
  • Responsible for team capacity planning and staffing allocation activities to ensure sufficient staffing for current and future needs.

Incident Management & Response:

  • Plan, staff and support on-call rotation.
  • Manage robust incident response and resolution, capture corrective and preventative actions and continuous improvements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience (1-3 years) in a leadership role managing cloud/platform engineering teams with 6+ years of hands-on experience in SRE, DevOps, Infrastructure, and Platform Engineering.
  • Experience building and operating internal developer platforms that improve engineering productivity, standardize delivery patterns, and reduce operational toil.
  • Deep background in modern cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure), container orchestration (Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi), and CI/CD tools (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, GitLab CI).
  • System Design: Proven track record in designing, scaling, and maintaining distributed systems with high availability requirements.
  • Observability: Experience implementing comprehensive monitoring, logging, tracing, and alerting frameworks (Datadog, Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry)
  • Experience surveying developer teams to identify friction points, prioritize platform improvements, and translate feedback into self-service capabilities that improve developer productivity.
  • Deep experience with platform engineering and SRE practices and frameworks
  • Programming proficiency of various languages (e.g., Java, C#, Python, Go, Rust)

We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Neobank app.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

What You Will Build

  • Build AI agents, workflows, tools and automations that solve real customer, product and operations problems.

  • Apply LLMs, retrieval, tool calling, evaluations, guardrails and automation to practical financial workflows.

  • Design around real constraints: accuracy, hallucination risk, latency, cost, security, compliance and user trust.

What We Look For

  • Hands-on engineering ability, not just AI strategy or management experience.

  • Able to ship working systems, test quality and improve reliability over time.

The Role

As a Software Engineer on Bloomerang's PDLC Operations team, you will build the internal integrations and automations that connect how we build product with the teams who bring it to customers. With our AI-driven product development lifecycle, we ship faster than ever, and the handoffs to Marketing, Enablement, Sales, and our Customer teams have to keep up. Your job is to build the product knowledge layer that gives those teams the context and content they need, when they need it.

You'll report to the Sr. Manager, PDLC Operations, who sets the direction for our PDLC systems, and you'll turn that direction into working tools quickly. You'll build a version, put it in front of users, keep what works, and throw out what doesn't.

About Refold

Enterprise integrations are still built by hand, one customer at a time, by a human supply chain of consultants. We think that's the last big software category that hasn't been automated — and we're automating it.

Refold is the AI integration delivery layer. Our agents build, test, deploy, and maintain integration workflows inside our customers' own products, white-labeled, up to 90% faster. Trained on millions of real-world contexts across SAP, Oracle, Workday, NetSuite, and Salesforce, we turn integration work that used to take quarters into days — and then keep it running, because the agents detect failures and repair mappings themselves.

Traction: 30+ paying enterprise customers, 1,500+ active users, 10M+ API calls processed daily, seven-figure ARR. Customers include Incorta, Kantata, Coupa, Naehas, OvationCXM, and Zycus. The results are the pitch: Kantata ships integrations 75% faster with 8x delivery capacity; Incorta cut time-to-go-live by 70% and recovered 8,000+ engineering hours; Naehas went from 3–5-month builds to 90% faster delivery.

Refold was founded by Jugal Anchalia and Abhishek Kumar, who have been featured in Forbes 30 Under 30. We've raised $6.5M led by Eniac Ventures (early investors in Airbnb & Uber) and Tidal Ventures, with Better Capital, Ahead VC, Karman Ventures, Z21 Ventures, and Titan Ventures participating.

We're assembling a founding team of people who learn fast, raise the bar, and shape the company from day one. This is the second AE seat in the US and the first hired to build the motion, not inherit it.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the technical win: Lead discovery, demos, and architecture conversations from first call to signature. When a deal is won or lost on technical confidence, that outcome is yours

  • Build the proof, don't slide it: Stand up working prototypes against the customer's actual systems and messy data — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce. Our product is the demo; a deck is a fallback, not a strategy

  • Run crisp POCs: Design focused evaluations with explicit success criteria, timelines, and exit conditions. We're deliberately moving away from 4-week POCs — help us prove value in days

  • Speak both languages: Translate schema mapping, auth flows, multi-tenancy, and in-tenant deployment into terms a CTO trusts and a VP of Professional Services can build a business case on

  • Clear security and procurement: Own architecture reviews, security questionnaires, and RFP/RFI responses. Air-gapped, in-tenant deployment is one of our strongest cards — know how to play it

  • Hand off clean: Partner with Delivery and our Forward Deployed Engineers so every go-live starts from a real technical plan, not a rediscovery exercise

  • Feed the platform: You'll be one of our highest-signal sources of product truth. Surface the gaps and friction you hit in the field and push them into the roadmap

  • Build the SE motion: Turn what works into a demo library, discovery framework, POC playbook, reference architectures, and competitive teardowns against iPaaS incumbents

  • Technical buyers you'll face: CTOs, CPOs, VPs of Product, VPs of Professional Services / Delivery, plus platform architects and security reviewers

  • Ideal customer: Sales-led with an integrations page, an internal PS team or SI dependency, and enterprise deals that hinge on connectors

  • Competitive set: iPaaS and middleware incumbents (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, SnapLogic) and in-house build

  • Current growth team: 1 BDR, 1 AE, 2 Marketing, 4 Post-Sale, plus a 20-person engineering and delivery org

Required Skills & Abilities

  • Proven SE: 5–8 years in solutions engineering, pre-sales, or technical consulting at a SaaS, data, or AI company. This is a hard requirement — we're not training someone into the seat

  • Builder, not just a presenter: Hands-on with APIs and data integration, and fluent enough in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript to build a working prototype yourself over a weekend

  • Enterprise systems fluency: Real experience with systems of record — SAP, Oracle, NetSuite, Workday, Salesforce, Dynamics — and the messy parts: custom fields, schema mapping, OAuth, retries, idempotency, why an integration broke at 2 am

  • Sales instinct: You've sold to or with product and professional services teams at software companies and understand what changes when your buyer's customer is the end user

  • Room-ready: You can hold a CTO's attention, survive a security review, and be the calm one when the demo environment misbehaves

  • High ownership in ambiguity: No playbook exists yet. You'll write it while running live deals, and you'll be comfortable doing both at once

Nice to Have

  • Background in iPaaS, middleware, integration, or data infrastructure — or a track record of selling against MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, or SnapLogic

  • Hands-on with LLMs and agentic frameworks, not just familiar with the concepts

  • Experience with air-gapped, in-tenant, or customer-VPC deployments and the security conversations that come with them

  • Cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, Azure) and containerised environments (Docker, Kubernetes)

  • First-SE or early-stage experience where you built the function, not joined one

  • Worked day-to-day with an offshore engineering or delivery team

Why do you want to work here?

  • Impact: Fast-growing seed-stage company ($6.5M from Eniac Ventures & Tidal Ventures) with early Fortune 500-scale deployments and real, quantified customer outcomes

  • Speed: A category to define and a narrative to own, with founder-level access and no layers between you and the decision

  • Ownership: Cutting-edge AI solving a high-value enterprise problem nobody has cracked — backed by technical founders building a next-generation infrastructure platform

Compensation:

  • $100,000-$120,000 (annual)

Equal Employment Opportunity

We're a small, fast-growing team, and we're intentional about building an inclusive culture from day one. We welcome teammates of all backgrounds and don't discriminate based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race. If you're excited by our mission, you belong here.

Compensation Range: $100K - $120K

We're looking for highly experienced software engineer (SR+) to help evaluate the quality of interactions with modern coding agents such as OpenAI Codex and Claude Code.

This is not a traditional engineering role. You won't be writing production code. You'll be evaluating something harder: whether the model thinks like a great engineer.

What this role actually is

You will assess how AI coding agents behave in real-world scenarios, focusing on:

• Whether the response makes sense

  • Whether the preamble and reasoning are useful
  • Whether the output reflects strong engineering judgment
  • Whether the interaction feels right to an experienced developer

This role is about engineering taste. Syntax correctness is the easy part.

What you'll be doing

  • Evaluate AI-generated coding interactions end to end
  • Judge whether outputs are useful, correct at a high level, and aligned with how a strong engineer would think
  • Assess the quality of explanations and reasoning, not just the code
  • Distinguish between levels of response quality (what makes something a 2 vs a 4)
  • Give clear, opinionated feedback in writing on what worked, what didn't, and what felt off or misleading
  • Help define what great looks like when working with tools like Cursor, Codex and Claude Code

What we mean by "taste"

We're looking for engineers who can answer questions like:

  • Does this feel like something a strong engineer would actually say?
  • Is this explanation helpful, or just technically correct?
  • Is the model guiding the user well, or just dumping output?
  • Would this interaction build or erode trust?

You should be comfortable making subjective but rigorous judgments, and explaining them clearly.

Who you are

  • Senior, Staff or Principal-level engineer (or equivalent experience)
  • Strong background in TypeScript/JavaScript or Python
  • Hands-on experience with at least one of OpenAI Codex, Claude Code or Cursor

As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) at GitLab, you’ll help keep all user-facing services and production systems reliable, scalable, and efficient. Our SREs combine a pragmatic operations mindset with strong software engineering practices to drive automation, reduce toil, and improve resilience across our platform.

In the Environment Automation specialization, your focus is on operating and automating hundreds of GitLab environments—from initial provisioning to day-to-day maintenance tasks.

Unlike other SRE roles, this position centers on automating the lifecycle of many tenant environments, ensuring they remain secure, consistent, and reliable at scale.

Some examples of the projects you could work on:

  • Designing infrastructure automation that provisions and operates GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes
  • Creating and maintaining deployment packages for GitLab, such as Helm Charts and omnibus-gitlab

  • Integrating with and operating infrastructure in cloud provider ecosystems (e.g., IAM, networking, storage)
  • Championing and implementing cloud security best practices across automated infrastructure

What You’ll Do

  • Build & Scale Multi-Tenant Infrastructure: Design and implement automation that provisions and manages hundreds of isolated GitLab environments using Terraform, Ansible, and Kubernetes. Manage complex state strategies and workspace configurations to support scale and maintainability.
  • Debug & Resolve Production Issues: Troubleshoot issues across Kubernetes clusters, cloud services, and GitLab apps—identifying root causes of failed deployments, crash loops, and scheduling conflicts to ensure service continuity.
  • Automate Operations at Scale: Replace manual workflows with infrastructure-as-code solutions, including automated version upgrades, configuration rollouts, and provisioning pipelines that operate reliably across all tenants.
  • Monitor & Predict Capacity: Build observability systems that detect bottlenecks, predict usage trends, and optimize resource consumption using tools like Prometheus, ELK, and Grafana.
  • Respond & Lead During Incidents: Lead incident response and postmortem efforts, applying technical depth to resolve issues and establish operational standards that reduce future risk.
  • Architect & Collaborate: Influence architectural decisions around automation, scalability, and operational excellence. Partner with engineering teams to improve automation, platform resilience, and production-readiness.

What You’ll Bring

  • Production-Scale Experience: Proven ability to operate and troubleshoot production workloads across multiple tenants or environments. Deep understanding of how distributed systems fail at scale and how to build in resilience.
    Terraform & IaC Mastery: Strong hands-on experience with Terraform, including workspace strategies, state management, and automation patterns that scale. Comfortable solving state isolation issues and building reliable, reusable infrastructure code. Experience with Ansible and templating tools like Jsonnet is a plus.
    Kubernetes in Production: Skilled at diagnosing deployment failures, interpreting pod logs, and debugging scheduling issues and rollback scenarios in live environments. Understands how pods, ReplicaSets, and controllers interact in production.
    Programming & Code Analysis: Ability to read and debug code in Go and/or Ruby. Familiar with identifying performance issues, scalability concerns, and contributing to infrastructure tooling through thoughtful code analysis.
    Large Scale Operations Background: Experience supporting infrastructure for many customers or environments simultaneously. Comfortable managing isolation, scaling, monitoring, and incident response across diverse workloads.

    GitLab Platform Proficiency: Comfortable using GitLab as a daily tool for infrastructure automation, collaboration, and operational workflows.

GitLab’s Dedicated team, where the SRE Environment Automation role sits, is on a mission to deliver a fully managed, single-tenant GitLab experience through the GitLab Dedicated platform. Our goal is to eliminate manual operations across the entire lifecycle of customer environments, including provisioning, upgrades, security, and monitoring, so customers can focus on unlocking the full potential of The One DevOps Platform without managing the underlying infrastructure. We build scalable, automated systems that ensure each GitLab Dedicated instance is secure, consistent, and production-ready—whether we're managing 10 environments or hundreds.

jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!
